sum: This study experimentally validates fracture mechanics predictions regarding whether fluid-induced aseismic slip fronts (R) lag behind or outpace fluid pressure fronts (L). The authors conducted triaxial stress-relaxation fluid injection experiments on saw-cut Lanhélin granite faults under upper crustal conditions (70 MPa effective confining pressure), testing initial shear stresses of 60% and 90% of fault strength and pressurisation rates from 0.015 to 15 MPa/s. Using an array of eight strain gauges and five pore pressure sensors, combined with least-squares kinematic inversion and adjoint-state diffusion inversion, they simultaneously tracked R and L. Results demonstrate that aseismic slip lags behind fluid diffusion at low stress and injection rates, but rapidly outpaces it at high pressurisation rates or critically stressed states. This transition and the rupture speed scaling are governed by a dimensionless loading parameter T, reconciling linear and rapid seismicity migrations observed in natural swarms and induced seismicity.
本研究通过实验室岩石物理实验验证了断裂力学关于流体诱发无震滑移前缘（R）与流体压力前缘（L）演化的理论预测。作者在模拟上地壳应力条件（有效围压70 MPa）下，对含锯切断面花岗岩样品进行了三轴应力松弛流体注入实验，测试了60%和90%断层强度初始剪应力及0.015至15 MPa/s的加压速率。结合8……

t: Triaxial fluid-injection experiments on saw-cut granite faults combined with least-squares kinematic inversion of strain gauge arrival times for slip front velocity and adjoint-state finite-element inversion of pore pressure diffusion for spatiotemporal hydraulic diffusivity.
开展锯切花岗岩三轴流体注入实验，结合应变片到时最小二乘运动学反演与孔隙压力扩散伴随状态有限元反演，追踪滑移与流体前缘。

Seven fluid injection experiments on saw-cut Lanhélin granite under 80 MPa confining pressure and 10 MPa initial pore pressure, testing initial shear stresses of 60% and 90% of fault strength across pressurisation rates from 0.015 to 15 MPa/s.
在80 MPa围压和10 MPa初始孔隙压力下进行7次注入实验，测试60%与90%断层强度初始剪应力及0.015至15 …

At 60% strength, slip front velocity increases from 0.6 mm/s (lagging fluid) at 0.15 MPa/s to 5 mm/s (outpacing fluid at t=8.56 s) at 15 MPa/s; rupture speed scales with loading parameter T as T^-1/2 to T^-3/4.
60%强度下，滑移速度从0.15 MPa/s时的0.6 mm/s增至15 MPa/s时的5 mm/s并在8.56秒超越流…

Finite sample length biases the amplification factor at low injection rates where fluid reaches the boundary before slip starts, alongside neglected rate-and-state friction and time-varying hydraulic diffusivity in theoretical models.
有限样品尺寸导致低注入率下流体在滑移前到达边界使放大因子产生偏差，且理论模型忽略了速率-状态摩擦和时变扩散系数。

First direct laboratory experimental tracking of both fluid pressure and aseismic slip fronts under upper crustal stress conditions, validating fracture mechanics predictions governed by the dimensionless loading parameter T.
首次在上地壳应力条件下实验同步直接追踪流体压力与无震滑移前缘，验证了无量纲加载参数T控制的断裂力学预测。

kc: Provided the first direct simultaneous laboratory tracking of fluid pressure fronts and aseismic slip fronts under upper crustal stress conditions.
Demonstrated experimentally that aseismic slip transitions from lagging behind to outpacing fluid pressure diffusion as injection rate and initial shear stress increase.
Validated fracture mechanics models for constant pressurisation rate, showing that the amplification factor R/L and rupture velocity scale with a dimensionless loading parameter T.
Developed an adjoint-state finite-element inversion to reconstruct time- and space-dependent fault hydraulic diffusivity from sparse pressure transducers.
首次在模拟上地壳应力条件下实现了实验室流体压力前缘与无震滑移前缘的直接同步追踪。
实验证明随着注入速率和初始剪应力的增加，无震滑移会从滞后于流体压力扩散转变为超越流体前缘。
验证了恒定加压速率下的断裂力学模型，表明放大因子R/L和破裂速度与无量纲加载参数T存在标度关系。
开发了伴随状态有限元反演方法，利用稀疏压力传感器数据重建了随时间和空间演化的断层水力扩散系数。
me: Triaxial stress-relaxation fluid injection experiments on saw-cut granite faults instrumented with strain gauges and pore pressure transducers.
Least-squares grid-search kinematic inversion of strain release arrival times to estimate circular slip front nucleation and propagation velocity, validated by FEM Green's functions.
Adjoint-state L-BFGS inversion of the 2D diffusion equation using finite elements to reconstruct spatiotemporal hydraulic diffusivity across three fault zones.
Analytical and numerical fracture mechanics modeling (K=0 stress intensity criterion) adapted for constant pressurisation rate injection.
在装有应变片和孔隙压力传感器的锯切花岗岩断层上进行三轴应力松弛流体注入实验。
基于有限元格林函数验证，对首次应变释放到时进行最小二乘网格搜索反演，估算圆形滑移前缘成核位置与传播速度。
利用有限元法和伴随状态L-BFGS算法反演二维扩散方程，重建三个断层区域的时空水力扩散系数。
针对恒定加压速率注入情景，建立并数值求解了基于应力强度因子准则（K=0）的断裂力学模型。
de: Seven fluid injection phases on a 40 mm diameter, 100 mm long Lanhélin granite cylinder with a 30-degree saw-cut elliptical fault (40 mm by 80 mm).
Confining pressure of 80 MPa and initial pore pressure of 10 MPa (70 MPa effective confining pressure, ~2-3 km depth equivalent).
Two initial shear stress levels (60% and 90% of peak frictional strength) and four constant pressurisation rates (0.015, 0.15, 1.5, and 15 MPa/s) recorded at up to 20 kHz.
在直径40 mm、长100 mm、含30度倾角椭圆形锯切断面（40 mm × 80 mm）的Lanhélin花岗岩样品上进行7个阶段的流体注入实验。
围压80 MPa，初始孔隙压力10 MPa（有效围压70 MPa，相当于地下2-3公里深度）。
测试了两种初始剪应力水平（峰值摩擦强度的60%和90%）和四种恒定加压速率（0.015、0.15、1.5和15 MPa/s），最高采样率达20 kHz。
li: Finite sample dimensions (80 mm fault length) cause the fluid front to reach the boundary before slip nucleation at low injection rates, biasing the R/L ratio at large T.
Uncertainties in quantifying the loading parameter T due to assuming a constant friction coefficient, neglecting rate-and-state friction effects.
Theoretical fracture mechanics model assumes constant hydraulic diffusivity, whereas inversions reveal time- and space-dependent diffusivity variations during slip.
有限的样品尺寸（断层长80 mm）导致低注入率下流体前缘在滑移成核前已到达边界，使大T值下的R/L比值产生偏差。
理論假设摩擦系数恒定，忽略了速率-状态摩擦效应，导致加载参数T的量化存在不确定性。
断裂力学理论模型假设水力扩散系数恒定，而实验反演显示水力扩散系数在滑移过程中随时间和空间发生变化。

tm.why: The paper directly investigates the propagation of fluid-driven aseismic slip fronts along experimental crustal faults under upper crustal stress conditions.
The experiments aim to explain spatiotemporal migration patterns of fluid-injection-induced seismicity and assess whether aseismic slip outpaces fluid diffusion.
The study develops and applies a finite-element adjoint-state inversion for spatiotemporal hydraulic diffusivity and a kinematic least-squares inversion for slip front propagation.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the full 18-page PDF (including main text, Methods, 4 main figures, 1 supplementary table, and 5 supplementary figures).

sum: Oxygen is a key light element in Earth's liquid outer core, influencing the geodynamo and seismic structure. However, experimental constraints on Fe-O melt structure at outer-core pressures (136–330 GPa) were lacking. This study presents the first in situ X-ray diffraction measurements of Fe, Fe + 4.5 FeO, and Fe2O3 melts from 177 to 440 GPa using laser-driven shock compression at the European XFEL. The authors derive Faber-Ziman structure factors, pair distribution functions, and melt densities. Results show predominantly four-fold Fe-O coordination (4.0–4.5), much smaller than in lower-mantle minerals, while compressed packing is driven by shortened Fe-Fe distances (~2.30 Å). Persistent structural differences between Fe2+- and Fe3+-rich melts indicate that oxidation state modulates oxygen solubility. Notably, a structural change in Fe2O3 melt between 177 and 217 GPa (~380 km below the core-mantle boundary) alters oxygen solubility and potentially viscosity, offering a mechanism for the seismically observed outermost core stratified layer.
氧是地球外核的关键轻元素，此前缺乏外核压力下Fe-O熔体结构的实验约束。本研究利用欧洲自由电子激光（EuXFEL）的激光驱动冲击压缩技术，首次在177–440 GPa下对Fe、Fe+4.5FeO和Fe2O3熔体进行了原位X射线衍射测量，提取了结构因子、对分布函数和密度。结果表明熔体中Fe-O配位数为……

t: Laser-driven shock compression at the European XFEL paired with in situ X-ray diffraction, VISAR shock timing, hydrodynamic simulations, and iterative liquid diffraction analysis to extract structure factors, pair distribution functions, and densities.
利用欧洲XFEL激光冲击压缩结合原位X射线衍射、VISAR测速及流体模拟，迭代提取熔体结构因子、对分布函数和密度。
X-ray diffraction measurements on shocked Fe foils, sputtered Fe + 4.5 FeO (55 at% Fe, 45 at% O), and Fe2O3 targets spanning 177 to 440 GPa and estimated temperatures of 3,800 to 16,000 K.
在177–440 GPa和估计3,800–16,000 K下，对受冲击Fe箔、Fe+4.5FeO和Fe2O3靶材的原位X…

Fe-O coordination numbers remain between 4.0(0.4) and 4.5(0.4) with Fe-Fe CNs of 10.0–11.2(0.4). Fe-Fe distances contract by ~1 Å to ~2.30 Å, while Fe2O3 shows a structural shift between 177 and 217 GPa.
Fe-O配位数为4.0–4.5，Fe-Fe配位数为10.0–11.2；Fe-Fe间距缩短约1 Å至~2.30 Å，Fe2…
Shock temperatures were not directly measured, and it remains uncertain whether Fe2O3 at 177 GPa is fully molten or partially amorphous.
未直接测量冲击温度，且177 GPa下Fe2O3是完全熔融还是部分非晶态仍不确定。
Provides the first experimental measurements of interatomic distances, coordination numbers, and melt structure for iron oxide melts across the entire outer-core pressure regime.
首次在地球外核全压力范围内实验测定了氧化铁熔体的原子间距、配位数及液态结构。

kc: First experimental determination of interatomic distances, coordination numbers, and densities of Fe + 4.5 FeO and Fe2O3 melts across Earth's outer-core pressure range (177–440 GPa).
Demonstrated that Fe-O coordination numbers remain between 4.0(0.4) and 4.5(0.4) at core pressures, refuting a previously proposed 6-to-8 coordination transition near 240 GPa.

Identified a structural evolution in Fe2O3 melt between 177 and 217 GPa (~380 km below the CMB) that could reduce oxygen solubility and explain the thickness of the stratified E' layer at the top of the outer core.
首次在地球外核压力范围（177–440 GPa）内实验测定了Fe + 4.5 FeO和Fe2O3熔体的原子间距、配位数和密度。
证明在外核压力下Fe-O配位数保持在4.0(0.4)至4.5(0.4)之间，否定了此前提出的240 GPa附近配位数从6变为8的假说。
发现了Fe2O3熔体在177至217 GPa（CMB下方约380 km）之间的结构转变，该转变可能降低氧溶解度并解释外核顶部稳定分层（E'层）的厚度。
me: Laser-driven shock compression using the DiPOLE 100-X optical laser coupled with ultrafast in situ 24 keV X-ray diffraction at the European XFEL.
Velocity Interferometer System for Any Reflector (VISAR) shock breakout measurements combined with impedance matching and MULTI hydrodynamic simulations for pressure determination.
Iterative extraction of Faber-Ziman structure factors, pair distribution functions, melt densities, and Gaussian fitting of radial distribution functions for coordination numbers.
在欧洲XFEL利用DiPOLE 100-X光学激光器进行激光驱动冲击压缩，并结合超快原位24 keV X射线衍射。
利用任意反射体速度干涉仪（VISAR）测量冲击波突破时间，结合阻抗匹配法和MULTI流体动力学模拟确定压力。
通过迭代程序提取Faber-Ziman结构因子、对分布函数和熔体密度，并对径向分布函数进行高斯拟合以获取配位数。
de: In situ 2D X-ray diffraction patterns of shocked pure Fe foil, plasma-sputtered Fe + 4.5 FeO, and well/poorly crystalline Fe2O3 targets on black Kapton ablators from ambient up to 440 GPa.
Reference diffraction measurements on commercial metallic glass (Fe78B13Si9), Cu foils, and isolated black Kapton targets for intensity correction and pressure calibration.
从常压至440 GPa下，对黑色Kapton烧蚀层上的纯Fe箔、等离子溅射Fe + 4.5 FeO以及不同结晶度Fe2O3靶材进行原位二维X射线衍射测量。
对商用金属玻璃（Fe78B13Si9）、铜箔和独立黑色Kapton靶材进行参考衍射测量，用于强度校正和压力标定。
li: Shock temperatures could not be measured directly and relied on EOS models (SESAME 7440, DFT+U) and Hugoniot extrapolations, reaching temperatures above the geotherm at >247 GPa.
At 177(14) GPa, it remains ambiguous whether the Fe2O3 sample is fully molten or partially amorphous.
Residual unshocked ambient material and grain texture complicated background subtraction, preventing coordination number fitting for Fe at 400 GPa and Fe + 4.5 FeO at 440 GPa.
无法直接测量冲击温度，需依赖状态方程模型（SESAME 7440、DFT+U）和Hugoniot外推，在>247 GPa时温度明显高于地热温标。
在177(14) GPa下，Fe2O3样品是完全熔融还是部分非晶态仍存在不确定性。
残留未冲击样品和晶粒织构使背景扣除复杂化，导致无法拟合400 GPa下Fe和440 GPa下Fe + 4.5 FeO的配位数。

tm.why: The paper investigates the melt structure, density, and oxygen solubility of iron oxides at Earth's outer-core pressures to explain compositional stratification beneath the core-mantle boundary inferred from seismology and geomagnetism.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 23-page Nature Communications Article-in-Press PDF, including all text sections, methods, and 8 figures.

sum: Using a 2D coupled Discrete Element Method (DEM) and continuum pore-fluid solver, this study investigates how cyclic effective normal stress oscillations (0.5–10,000 Hz) affect a sheared granular fault gouge kept below the static Mohr–Coulomb threshold. Comparing direct normal-stress cycling on dry gouge with pore-pressure cycling on saturated gouge confirms Terzaghi's principle across frequencies, with fluid coupling adding only a dilatant-hardening phase delay. Despite sub-critical peak loads, failure occurs non-monotonically across three sliding modes separated by a distinct non-failure window at intermediate frequencies (30–200 Hz). Novelty lies in resolving four decades of frequency response and identifying two distinct dilation-induced weakening mechanisms: low-frequency (≤10 Hz) shear-driven irreversible ratcheting when the oscillation period exceeds the momentum-diffusion timescale, and high-frequency (≥500 Hz) shear-independent acoustic fluidization driven by amplified inertial and seepage forces. The non-failure window emerges as the mechanistic gap between these two regimes.
本研究采用二维流固耦合离散元（DEM）模拟，探究了0.5–10,000 Hz亚临界有效正应力振荡对受剪断层泥稳定性的影响。通过对比干断层正应力循环与饱和断层孔隙压力循环，验证了太沙基有效应力原理，流体耦合仅因剪胀硬化引入相位延迟。研究发现断层在大多频率下发生亚临界破坏，但在中频（30–200 Hz）……

t: 2D coupled solid-fluid Discrete Element Method (DEM) simulating a sheared granular fault gouge layer subjected to sub-critical cyclic normal stress (dry) or basal pore-pressure oscillations (fluid-saturated) across 0.5–10,000 Hz.
采用二维流固耦合离散元法（DEM），模拟干断层泥正应力循环和饱和断层泥孔隙压力循环（0.5–10,000 Hz）。
Simulated dense 2D granular packings (h ≈ 48d, d = 0.01 m, ϕ0 ≈ 0.185, k = 10^-11 m^2) under σ0 = 10 MPa and τ = 0.2 σ0, tested with sub-critical cyclic forcing from 0.5 to 10^4 Hz.
预加载（σ0=10 MPa, τ=0.2σ0）的二维致密颗粒层（h≈48d, ϕ0≈0.185），开展亚临界频率扫描与零…

Fault gouge fails sub-critically across three modes (0.5–1 Hz failure-and-arrest, 5–10 Hz cyclic sliding, ≥500 Hz continuous sliding) separated by a non-failure window at 30–200 Hz where slip velocity drops by orders of magnitude.
识别出三种亚临界滑移破坏模式（0.5–1 Hz、5–10 Hz、≥500 Hz），并在30–200 Hz发现滑移速度骤降…
Conclusions are restricted to a high-permeability regime where hydraulic diffusion is much faster than momentum diffusion (ζP << ζv), and transition frequencies depend on layer thickness (ζv ∝ h^2).
结论局限于水力扩散远快于动量扩散的高渗透率体系，且模式转换频率随断层厚度变化。

Resolves four decades of frequency dependence in sub-Coulomb cyclic failure, discovering an intermediate non-failure window between low-frequency shear-driven ratcheting dilation and high-frequency vibration-driven acoustic fluidization.
解析了跨四个数量级的频率响应，发现低频棘轮剪胀与高频声学流态化之间的中频不破坏窗口。

kc: Demonstrated sub-Coulomb failure of sheared granular fault gouge under cyclic effective normal stress across four frequency decades (0.5–10,000 Hz), identifying three failure modes and an intermediate non-failure window (30–200 Hz).

Identified two distinct dilation-induced weakening mechanisms: low-frequency shear-driven ratcheting dilation (when period exceeds momentum-diffusion timescale) and high-frequency vibration-driven acoustic fluidization.

Proved mechanical equivalence between dry normal-stress oscillations and saturated pore-pressure oscillations in high-permeability gouge per Terzaghi's principle, with fluid coupling only introducing a dilatant-hardening delay.
揭示了受剪颗粒断层泥在跨越四个数量级频率（0.5–10,000 Hz）的亚临界有效正应力振荡下的破坏行为，识别出三种破坏模式和一个中频不破坏窗口（30–200 Hz）。
阐明了两种截然不同的剪胀致弱机制：低频下的剪切驱动棘轮剪胀（当周期大于动量扩散时间尺度时）和高频下由振动驱动的声学流态化。
验证了高渗透率断层泥中干层正应力振荡与饱和层孔隙压力振荡在太沙基原理下的力学等价性，流体耦合仅因剪胀硬化引入延迟。
me: Two-dimensional Discrete Element Method (DEM) for disk-shaped grains with linear elastic frictional contacts coupled with a 2D continuum Darcy-flow pore-fluid pressure solver.
Two complementary sub-critical oscillatory loading protocols (0.5–10,000 Hz): direct top-wall normal stress cycling on a dry layer and basal pore-pressure cycling on a fluid-saturated layer.

Phase-space trajectory (porosity vs. slip velocity), momentum-diffusion timescale analysis, and continuum momentum-balance force decomposition (seepage, solid-stress gradient, kinetic energy, and inertia).
采用二维离散元法（DEM，圆盘颗粒、线弹性摩擦接触）与二维连续介质达西流孔隙流体压力求解器进行耦合模拟。
设计两种互补的亚临界振荡加载方案（0.5–10,000 Hz）：干颗粒层顶壁正应力直接循环加载，以及流体饱和层底部孔隙压力循环加载。
开展孔隙度-滑移速度相空间轨迹分析、动量扩散时间尺度对比，以及连续介质动量平衡力项（渗流力、固体应力梯度、动能梯度和惯性力）分解。
de: Numerical 2D fault gouge packings (aspect ratio l/h = 1, thickness h ≈ 48d, mean grain diameter d = 0.01 m, initial porosity ϕ0 ≈ 0.185) prestressed at σ0 = 10 MPa and τ = 0.2 σ0.
Parametric frequency sweeps from 0.5 to 10,000 Hz for dry and fluid-saturated layers at two matched sub-critical amplitude pairs (ΔP/σ0 = 0.07 and 0.05), plus zero-shear (τ = 0) control runs.
数值构建二维断层泥颗粒堆积体（宽高比 l/h = 1，厚度 h ≈ 48d，平均粒径 d = 0.01 m，初始孔隙度 ϕ0 ≈ 0.185），预加载正应力 σ0 = 10 MPa、剪应力 τ = 0.2 σ0。
对干层和饱和层在两组匹配的亚临界振幅（ΔP/σ0 = 0.07 和 0.05）下进行 0.5 至 10,000 Hz 的频率扫描模拟，并开展零剪应力（τ = 0）对照实验。
li: Simulations use 2D disk packings with artificially large grains (d = 0.01 m) and reduced Young's modulus (E = 10^10 Pa) to increase the collision timestep, which shifts absolute transition frequencies compared to thicker natural faults.
Results are restricted to a high-porosity, high-permeability regime (k = 10^-11 m^2) where hydraulic diffusion is much faster than granular momentum diffusion (ζP << ζv).
模拟采用二维圆盘颗粒及放大的粒径（d = 0.01 m）和略低的杨氏模量（E = 10^10 Pa）以增大时间步长，其绝对转换频率与更厚的天然断层存在尺度偏移。
结论仅适用于水力扩散远快于颗粒动量扩散（ζP << ζv）的高孔隙度、高渗透率（k = 10^-11 m^2）体系，未涵盖低渗透率断层泥。

tm.why: The paper numerically investigates grain-scale frictional failure, dilation, and slip modes of sheared fault gouge under cyclic effective normal stress.
The study explicitly links cyclic pore-pressure oscillations to injection-induced seismicity and cyclic stimulation protocols in geothermal and CO2 reservoirs.
The results address dynamic earthquake triggering mechanisms and acoustic fluidization under seismic wave perturbations.

ev.notes: Full 20-page preprint PDF analyzed, including mathematical formulations, simulation parameters in Table 1, and all 9 figures.

sum: This study investigates the nature and evolution of the magmatic-hydrothermal system at Adatara Volcano, an active stratovolcano in Northeast Japan. By constraining the geochemical and physical characteristics of the hydrothermal system, the authors provide critical insights into the sources and mechanisms driving volcanic-hydrothermal eruptions. The research helps improve hazard assessment and monitoring strategies for active stratovolcanoes prone to sudden phreatic or hydrothermal activity.
本研究探讨了日本东北部安达太良活火山岩浆-热液系统的性质与演化。通过约束热液系统的地球化学和物理特征，作者为火山-热液喷发的来源和驱动机制提供了关键见解。该研究有助于提高易发生突发性蒸汽喷发或热液活动活火山的灾害评估与监测能力。

t: Geochemical, mineralogical, and geological analysis of the volcanic-hydrothermal products to reconstruct the magmatic-hydrothermal system.
通过对火山-热液产物进行地球化学、矿物学和地质学分析，重建岩浆-热液系统。
Rock samples, hydrothermal alteration minerals, and field geological data collected from Adatara Volcano, NE Japan.
采集自日本东北部安达太良火山的岩石样品、热液蚀变矿物及野外地质数据。
Detailed constraints on the evolution of the magmatic-hydrothermal system and the identification of source zones for volcanic-hydrothermal eruptions.
详细约束了岩浆-热液系统的演化，并确定了火山-热液喷发的源区。
Lack of direct temporal geophysical monitoring data to correlate with the static geochemical model.
缺乏直接的随时间变化的地球物理监测数据来与静态地球化学模型进行关联。
Provides a comprehensive evolutionary model of the hydrothermal system specifically linked to eruption source mechanisms at Adatara Volcano.
提供了与安达太良火山喷发源机制直接相关的热液系统综合演化模型。

kc: Characterized the magmatic-hydrothermal system and its evolution at Adatara Volcano.
Constrained the potential source depths and fluid pathways for volcanic-hydrothermal eruptions.
表征了安达太良火山岩浆-热液系统的特征及其演化。
约束了火山-热液喷发的潜在源区深度和流体通道。
me: Geochemical and mineralogical analysis of hydrothermal products and volcanic rocks.
对热液产物和火山岩进行地球化学和矿物学分析。
de: Geological field observations, rock samples, and geochemical data from Adatara Volcano, NE Japan.
来自日本东北部安达太良火山的野外地质观测、岩石样品及地球化学数据。
li: The study is primarily based on geochemical and geological constraints, lacking real-time geophysical monitoring data integration.
该研究主要基于地球化学和地质约束，缺乏实时地球物理监测数据的整合。

tm.why: The paper investigates the magmatic-hydrothermal system and sources of volcanic-hydrothermal eruptions at Adatara Volcano, Japan.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the paper title, authors, publication venue, and metadata from Crossref, OpenAlex, and Google Search.

sum: This study analyzes a proprietary 28-square-mile 3D seismic dataset centered over the Seal Beach Anticline (SBA) in the western Los Angeles Basin. The authors present a revised structural model that challenges the traditional view of the area being dominated solely by the strike-slip Newport-Inglewood Fault Zone (NIFZ). They discover that the SBA is carried by a previously unrecognized thrust fault surfacing east of the NIFZ, and that blind thrusts accompanied by microearthquakes extend six miles northeastward into the basin.
本研究分析了洛杉矶盆地西部海豹滩背斜（SBA）上空28平方英里的专属三维地震数据集。作者提出了一个修正的构造模型，挑战了该区域仅由纽波特-英格尔伍德走滑断裂带（NIFZ）主导的传统观点。研究发现，SBA是由一条此前未被发现的逆冲断层所携带，且伴随微震活动的盲逆冲断层向东北方向延伸近6英里进入盆地内部……

t: 3D seismic structural interpretation and modeling of a proprietary reflection dataset to map fault geometry and folding.
利用专属反射地震数据集进行三维地震构造解释与建模，绘制断层几何形态和褶皱。
A proprietary 28-square-mile (72.5 sq km) 3D seismic dataset centered over the Seal Beach Anticline, combined with microearthquake records.
以海豹滩背斜为中心的28平方英里专属三维地震数据集，结合微震记录。
Identification of a new thrust fault carrying the SBA, and blind thrusts extending 6 miles northeastward into the Los Angeles Basin.
识别出携带SBA的新逆冲断层，以及向东北延伸6英里进入洛杉矶盆地的盲逆冲断层。
The reliance on proprietary seismic data limits open access and independent verification of the raw reflection volumes.
依赖专属地震数据限制了开源获取以及对原始反射数据体的独立验证。
Revises the strike-slip dominated NIFZ model to a wider thrust-belt model with newly identified blind thrusts.
将走滑主导的NIFZ模型修正为包含新识别盲逆冲断层的更广泛的逆冲带模型。

kc: Discovered a previously unrecognized thrust fault carrying the Seal Beach Anticline.
Identified blind thrusts extending nearly 6 miles northeastward into the Los Angeles Basin.
Proposed a revised 3D structural model that reinterprets NIFZ faults as complex antithetic faults.
发现了一条此前未被识别的、携带海豹滩背斜的逆冲断层。
识别出向东北方向延伸近6英里进入洛杉矶盆地的盲逆冲断层。
提出了修正的三维构造模型，将原NIFZ断层重新解释为复杂的反向断层。
me: 3D seismic structural interpretation and modeling.
Integration of microearthquake event locations with structural geometry.
三维地震构造解释与建模。
将微震事件位置与构造几何形态相结合进行综合分析。
de: Proprietary 28-square-mile (72.5 sq km) 3D seismic reflection dataset centered over the Seal Beach Anticline.
Recent microearthquake catalog data in the western Los Angeles Basin.
覆盖海豹滩背斜的28平方英里（72.5平方公里）专属三维反射地震数据集。
洛杉矶盆地西部的近期微震目录数据。
li: The primary 3D seismic dataset is proprietary, which may limit direct public reproducibility.
核心三维地震数据集为专属数据，可能会限制公众的直接复现。

tm.why: The paper presents a revised 3D seismic structural and tectonic model of the crust in the western Los Angeles Basin.
The paper links the newly discovered blind thrust faults to recent microearthquake events in the basin.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the detailed abstract and metadata from OpenAlex and Semantic Scholar.

sum: Off-fault deformation reduces near-surface fault slip and contributes to the shallow slip deficit, depending heavily on active fault geometry. This study trains and tests four 2D Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) on active fault maps and kinematic efficiency (KE) labels derived from scaled physical split-box experiments using wet kaolin, poured sand, and sedimented sand. Individual material-trained CNNs achieve >90% accuracy on unseen test maps, while a combined-material CNN achieves 87% accuracy due to distinct early sigmoidal dilational faulting in sedimented sand versus planar echelon segments in wet kaolin and poured sand. Validated against independent geologic and geodetic off-fault deformation estimates from four crustal strike-slip fault zones (Ridgecrest, Futagawa, Calico, and San Andreas at Mecca Hills), CNNs trained on wet kaolin and poured sand perform best. Finally, the wet-kaolin CNN is applied to map strain partitioning along the San Jacinto fault, aiding seismic hazard evaluation.
本研究利用湿高岭土、倾倒砂和沉积砂的走滑断层物理模拟实验数据，训练并测试了四个二维卷积神经网络（CNN），以根据活动断层迹线图估算断层外变形（即1减去运动学效率KE）。基于单一材料训练的CNN在未知测试集上的准确率均超过90%，而混合训练模型准确率为87%，主要受沉积砂早期S形剪胀断层模式差异的影响……

t: 2D CNNs (inspired by LeNet-5/AlexNet with dilated convolutions) are trained on binary 64x128 pixel active fault maps from DIC strain fields to predict kinematic efficiency using a variance-normalized MSE loss function.
利用DIC应变场生成的64×128像素二值断层图训练2D膨胀卷积神经网络，预测运动学效率。

Split-box strike-slip experiments across wet kaolin (16 runs, 9,050 maps), poured CV32 sand (18 runs, 8,364 maps), sedimented CV32 sand (32 runs, 6,742 maps), and sieved G12 sand (2 runs), plus five crustal fault maps.
湿高岭土、倾倒砂、沉积砂和筛分砂的走滑断层物理模拟实验（共24,156张图）及5个地壳断层图。

CNNs trained on wet kaolin, poured sand, and sedimented sand predict unseen test KE within one standard deviation with 93%, 92%, and 91% accuracy, respectively, while the combined CNN achieves 87% accuracy.
湿高岭土、倾倒砂和沉积砂CNN在测试集上的预测准确率分别为93%、92%和91%，混合模型为87%。
Experimental faults creep rather than stick-slip, omitting dynamic rupture damage, and trained CNNs fail on oblique regional loading or multiple parallel active fault traces (predicting KE > 100%).
实验为蠕滑且缺乏动态破裂损伤，模型不适用于斜交加载或多条平行断层分支。

Expands prior clay-only CNN fault models to multiple granular and viscoelastic analog materials with wider stepover-capturing windows, stricter 1-sigma evaluation, and direct validation on natural strike-slip fault zones.
扩展至多种流变学模拟材料，拓宽窗口以完整捕捉阶区，并在多个天然地壳走滑断层上进行了验证。

kc: Trained four 2D CNN models on 24,156 active strike-slip fault trace maps from scaled physical analog experiments (wet kaolin, poured sand, and sedimented sand) to predict kinematic efficiency and off-fault deformation.
Achieved >90% test accuracy for material-specific CNNs (93% wet kaolin, 92% poured sand, 91% sedimented sand) and 87% accuracy for a combined-material CNN.
Demonstrated that CNNs trained on wet kaolin and poured sand best reproduce independent geologic and geodetic off-fault deformation estimates across four natural crustal fault systems.
Generated new first-order off-fault deformation estimates along the active San Jacinto fault trace where field constraints are lacking.
利用来自湿高岭土、倾倒砂和沉积砂物理模拟实验的24,156张活动走滑断层图训练了四个2D CNN模型，用于预测运动学效率和断层外变形。
单一材料CNN在测试集上的准确率均超90%（湿高岭土93%、倾倒砂92%、沉积砂91%），混合数据集CNN准确率为87%。
证实湿高岭土和倾倒砂训练的CNN能最好地重现四个天然地壳断层系统的独立地质与大地测量断层外变形估计值。
首次对缺乏野外变形分配约束的圣哈辛托断层活动迹线进行了断层外变形估算。
me: Scaled physical split-box strike-slip experiments using wet kaolin, poured CV32 quartz sand, sedimented CV32 sand, and sieved G12 sand.
Digital Image Correlation (DIC) of overhead time-lapse photography to compute incremental horizontal displacement, vorticity, divergence, and stacked net strain.
Adaptive threshold image filtering on downsampled 64x128 pixel windows (scaled to capture ~3 early echelon segments) to extract binary active fault maps and kinematic efficiency (KE) labels.

Supervised 2D CNN architecture (two dilated convolutional layers with batch normalization, ReLU, max-pooling, dropout, and fully connected layers) optimized via hyperparameter grid search and a standard-deviation-normalized MSE loss function.
使用湿高岭土、倾倒CV32石英砂、沉积CV32砂和筛分G12砂开展缩放比例的走滑断层沙盒物理模拟实验。
利用俯视延时摄影的数字图像相关技术（DIC）计算增量水平位移场、涡度、散度及叠加净应变。
在降采样至64×128像素的窗口（包含约3条早期雁列断层段）上应用自适应阈值图像滤波，提取二值活动断层图并计算运动学效率（KE）标签。
采用包含两个膨胀卷积层、批归一化、ReLU、最大池化、Dropout和全连接层的2D CNN架构，通过超参数网格搜索和标准差归一化均方误差损失函数进行优化。
de: 16 wet kaolin experiments (9,050 maps), 18 poured CV32 sand experiments (8,364 maps), 32 sedimented CV32 sand experiments (6,742 maps), and 2 sieved G12 sand experiments.
Synthetic fault maps representing immature and mature strike-slip fault geometries.

Four natural crustal strike-slip fault datasets with published off-fault deformation estimates: 2019 Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest mainshock, 2016 M7 Kumamoto (Futagawa fault), Calico fault, and San Andreas fault at Mecca Hills.
Active trace map of the San Jacinto fault from the USGS Quaternary Fault and Fold database.
16组湿高岭土实验（9,050张图）、18组倾倒CV32砂实验（8,364张图）、32组沉积CV32砂实验（6,742张图）以及2组筛分G12砂实验。
代表未成熟和成熟走滑断层几何形态的合成断层图。
四个具有已发表断层外变形估计值的天然地壳走滑断层数据集：2019年Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest主震、2016年M7熊本地震（布田川断层）、Calico断层以及Mecca Hills处的圣安德烈斯断层。
来自USGS第四纪断层和褶皱数据库的圣哈辛托断层活动迹线图。
li: Experimental analog materials creep and lack sufficient elasticity to produce stick-slip behavior or dynamic coseismic rupture damage.
CNNs perform poorly when crustal fault loading is oblique to the fault trace (e.g., Futagawa fault) because experimental loading is strictly parallel to map edges.
CNNs yield unreliable predictions (KE > 100%) on map windows containing multiple parallel active fault strands due to underrepresentation of multi-strand geometries in training data.
实验模拟材料表现为蠕滑，缺乏足够的弹性来产生粘滑行为或同震动态破裂近断层损伤。
由于实验加载方向严格平行于图幅边缘，当天然断层走向与区域剪切方向斜交（如布田川断层）时，CNN预测可靠性降低。
由于训练集中多条平行活动断层分支的样本不足，CNN在包含多条平行断层迹线的窗口中会产生不可靠的预测（KE > 100%）。

tm.why: The paper investigates off-fault deformation, kinematic efficiency, and strain partitioning during strike-slip fault evolution using scaled physical analog experiments and crustal fault traces.
2D Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) are trained on experimental active fault trace maps to predict kinematic efficiency and off-fault deformation.
Estimating off-fault deformation and shallow slip deficits for crustal strike-slip faults without prior geologic estimates directly informs seismic hazard assessment.

ev.notes: Full 18-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, methodology, experimental parameters in Table 1, CNN architecture and testing metrics in Figs. 3-5, and crustal fault validations in Figs. 7-8.

sum: Fault healing during interseismic periods controls stress accumulation and earthquake nucleation, yet its behavior under hydrothermal conditions remains underexplored. This study conducts slide-hold-slide rotary shear experiments on fine and coarse quartz gouges up to ~90 mm slip at temperatures of 23–400°C, pore fluid pressures of 6 and 36 MPa, and effective normal stresses of 10 and 20 MPa. Results demonstrate that frictional healing rates increase linearly with temperature above 100°C, transitioning from stable sliding at ≤200°C to unstable stick-slip motion at 400°C. Microstructural analyses and Arrhenius modeling (activation energy Q = 40 ± 10 kJ/mol) indicate a transition from cataclasis and subcritical crack growth at low temperatures to pressure solution and silica cementation at high temperatures. Notably, vapor-phase water at 400°C inhibits stress relaxation during holds. The authors propose a novel temperature-dependent empirical healing law to improve crustal fault strength models.
本研究利用水热旋转剪切仪对不同粒径的石英断层泥开展滑动-保持-滑动（SHS）实验（滑移达90 mm，温度23–400°C，孔隙水压6和36 MPa，有效正应力10和20 MPa），探究水热条件下断层摩擦愈合的温度依赖性。结果表明，100°C以上摩擦愈合率随温度呈正线性增加，滑动行为在400°C（超临……

t: Hydrothermal rotary shear slide-hold-slide (SHS) experiments using the RoSA-HYDROS apparatus, combined with bootstrap parameter fitting of Dieterich healing laws, FE-SEM microstructural analysis, and Arrhenius activation energy modeling.
采用RoSA-HYDROS水热旋转剪切仪进行SHS实验，结合自助法拟合、SEM分析及阿伦尼乌斯建模。
18 experiments on two quartz gouge grain sizes (142 and 1.6 μm) sheared up to ~90 mm at T = 23–400°C, Pf = 6–36 MPa, and effective normal stresses of 10–20 MPa with holds up to 56,000 s.
2种粒径石英断层泥在23–400°C、孔隙水压6–36 MPa下的18组大位移（~90 mm）摩擦实验数据。
Mean frictional healing rate β increases linearly from 0.0049 at 23–100°C to 0.0082 at 200°C and 0.0166 at 400°C, with an activation energy Q = 40 ± 10 kJ/mol and stick-slip emerging at 400°C.
平均摩擦愈合率由23°C的0.0049线性增至400°C的0.0166，活化能为40±10 kJ/mol。
Low sampling rate (10 Hz) misses dynamic friction during stick-slips, poor induration limits SEM recovery at low T, and large confidence intervals leave cut-off time tc poorly constrained.
10 Hz采样率难以捕捉粘滑动态摩擦，低温样品回收率低，且截断时间tc置信区间过大。
Formulates a novel temperature-dependent empirical healing law for quartz gouges and identifies vapor-phase inhibition of interseismic stress relaxation at high-strain hydrothermal conditions.
提出融合温度线性依赖项的经验摩擦愈合公式，并发现高温气态水抑制保持期应力松弛。

kc: Demonstrates a positive linear relationship between fault frictional healing rate and temperature (23–400°C) in hydrothermal quartz gouges.
Determines an activation energy of 40 ± 10 kJ/mol for hydrothermal healing, linking low-temperature subcritical crack growth with high-temperature pressure solution and cementation.
Reveals that pore fluid phase state controls fault stability and creep relaxation, with 400°C vapor water inhibiting stress relaxation during holds and promoting stick-slip.
Introduces an updated empirical Dieterich-type healing law incorporating a linear temperature dependence for crustal fault modeling.
证实了水热条件下石英断层泥的摩擦愈合率与温度（23–400°C）呈正线性相关。
测得水热摩擦愈合活化能为40 ± 10 kJ/mol，揭示了低温亚临界裂纹扩展向高温压溶及胶结作用的机制转变。
发现孔隙流体相态控制断层稳定性与蠕变松弛，400°C气态水会抑制保持期的应力松弛并诱发粘滑。
提出了包含温度线性依赖项的改进型Dieterich经验摩擦愈合定律，适用于地壳断层强度建模。
me: Hydrothermal rotary shear slide-hold-slide (SHS) friction experiments using the RoSA-HYDROS apparatus.
Non-linear curve fitting of frictional healing data with residual bootstrap resampling (2,000 synthetic datasets) to quantify parameter uncertainties.
Post-deformation microstructural characterization using Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscopy (FE-SEM) in backscattered electron mode.
Arrhenius rate modeling using time-temperature superposition to estimate the activation energy of the healing process.
利用RoSA-HYDROS水热旋转剪切仪开展滑动-保持-滑动（SHS）摩擦实验。
采用非线性曲线拟合与残差自助重采样法（2000组合成数据集）估算摩擦愈合参数及其不确定性。
利用场发射扫描电子显微镜（FE-SEM）背散射电子模式对变形后样品进行微观结构表征。
基于时间-温度叠加原理的阿伦尼乌斯（Arrhenius）速率模型估算断层愈合过程的活化能。
de: 18 rotary shear experiments on coarse (F110, d50 = 142 μm) and fine (Min-U-Sil 5, d50 = 1.6 μm) quartz gouges up to ~90 mm slip.
Experimental conditions spanning T = 23, 100, 200, and 400°C; Pf = 6 and 36 MPa (liquid, vapor, and supercritical water, plus one dry control at 0.5 MPa air); effective normal stress = 10 and 20 MPa.
Hold durations ranging from 10 to 56,000 s across two sequential SHS phases (SHS-1 at low strain, SHS-2 at high strain).
SEM microstructural images of four reference F110 quartz gouge samples deformed at 20 MPa effective normal stress across 23–400°C.
对粗粒（F110，d50 = 142 μm）和细粒（Min-U-Sil 5，d50 = 1.6 μm）石英断层泥开展的18组大位移（达90 mm）旋转剪切实验。
实验条件涵盖温度23、100、200和400°C，流体压力6和36 MPa（液态、气态和超临界水，及1组0.5 MPa干燥空气对照），有效正应力10和20 MPa。
在低应变（SHS-1）和高应变（SHS-2）两个阶段进行保持时间从10秒至56,000秒的滑动-保持-滑动测试。
在20 MPa有效正应力、23–400°C条件下变形的4个参考F110石英样品的SEM微观结构图像。
li: Low mechanical data sampling frequency (10 Hz) prevents capturing true dynamic friction values during rapid stick-slip instabilities.
Poor sample recovery and low induration at lower temperatures limited microstructural SEM observations to only four coarse-grained samples.
Large 95% confidence intervals on fitted cut-off times (tc) prevent establishing a robust quantitative dependence of tc on temperature.
10 Hz的较低采样频率无法在快速粘滑不稳定滑动阶段捕捉真实的动态摩擦系数值。
低温实验样品固结度低、回收率差，导致SEM微观结构观测仅限于4个粗粒石英样品。
拟合截断时间（tc）的95%置信区间较大，无法建立tc随温度变化的稳健定量关系。

tm.why: The paper investigates fault frictional healing, compaction, and slip stability (stable sliding vs. stick-slip) in quartz gouges under hydrothermal conditions using laboratory rotary shear experiments.
The study explores the transition from stable sliding to stick-slip instabilities, stress drops, and interseismic stress accumulation relevant to earthquake nucleation at seismogenic depths.

ev.notes: Full 23-page PDF of the JGR: Solid Earth article (including all 8 figures and 2 tables) was read and analyzed.

sum: This study investigates the spatiotemporal pattern of Cenozoic deformation in the Longmen Shan–Weiyuan belt to understand strain propagation from the Tibetan Plateau. Using a high-resolution seismic profile and PECUBE thermokinematic modeling, the authors identify a two-stage deformation history in the Weiyuan antiform: early thin-skinned thrusting starting at ~37.1 Ma, followed by basement-involved folding at ~18.7 Ma. The results demonstrate that strain propagated rapidly from the Longmen Shan to Weiyuan via a Triassic décollement, followed by backward migration to the hinterland at ~15–10 Ma. This refutes previous models suggesting strain only reached the Longquan Shan, and highlights structural differences between the northern and southern segments of the Longmen Shan.
本研究利用高分辨率地震剖面和PECUBE热运动学模拟，分析了龙门山—威远带的新生代变形历史。研究发现威远背斜经历了两个变形阶段：约37.1 Ma开始的早期薄皮推覆构造，以及约18.7 Ma开始的晚期基底卷入型折叠。结果表明，龙门山的应变通过三叠纪滑脱层快速向东传播至威远，随后在15-10 Ma向后迁……

t: High-resolution seismic profile interpretation combined with PECUBE thermokinematic modeling to reconstruct the structural and exhumation history.
结合高分辨率反射地震剖面解释与PECUBE热运动学模拟，重建构造与剥露历史。
High-resolution seismic reflection profile across the southwestern Weiyuan antiform and regional thermochronological age datasets.
横跨威远背斜西南部的反射地震剖面数据以及区域热年代学年龄数据。
Deformation in Weiyuan initiated at ~37.1 Ma (thin-skinned) and ~18.7 Ma (basement-involved), showing that strain propagated further east than Longquan Shan before migrating backward.
威远变形始于~37.1 Ma和~18.7 Ma，表明应变向东延伸至威远，随后向后迁移。
The spatial resolution of the thermochronological data and simplified assumptions in the 3D thermokinematic models.
热年代学数据的空间分辨率限制以及热运动学模型中的简化假设。
Demonstrates that strain propagated as far as Weiyuan via Triassic décollement before migrating backward, challenging the previous Longquan Shan limit model.
证实应变通过三叠纪滑脱层传播至威远并发生向后迁移，挑战了传统的龙泉山边界模型。

kc: Identified a two-stage Cenozoic deformation history (thin-skinned thrusting followed by basement-involved folding) in the Weiyuan antiform.
Constrained the exhumation stages of the Weiyuan antiform to ~37.1 Ma and ~18.7 Ma using PECUBE thermokinematic modeling.
Proposed a new strain propagation model featuring rapid forward propagation to Weiyuan followed by backward migration to the Longmen Shan hinterland.
识别出威远背斜两阶段的新生代变形历史（早期薄皮推覆与晚期基底卷入折叠）。
利用PECUBE热运动学模拟将威远背斜的剥露阶段约束在约37.1 Ma和18.7 Ma。
提出了一个新的应变传播模型，即应变首先快速向前传播至威远，随后向后迁移至龙门山腹地。
me: High-resolution seismic reflection profiling across the southwestern Weiyuan antiform.
PECUBE thermokinematic modeling to constrain exhumation history and timing.
Synthesis of regional thermochronological ages and geodynamic numerical modeling.
横跨威远背斜西南部的的高分辨率反射地震剖面解释。
利用PECUBE热运动学模拟约束剥露历史与时间。
综合区域热年代学数据与地球动力学数值模拟进行分析。
de: High-resolution seismic reflection profile data across the southwestern Weiyuan antiform.
Regional thermochronological age datasets from the Longmen Shan and Sichuan Basin.
横跨威远背斜西南部的反射地震剖面数据。
收集并整合龙门山及四川盆地区域的热年代学年龄数据集。
li: The study relies heavily on the resolution of local seismic profiles and simplified 2D/3D thermokinematic assumptions in PECUBE.
该研究在很大程度上依赖于局部地震剖面的分辨率以及PECUBE中简化的二维/三维热运动学假设。

tm.why: The paper investigates the Cenozoic deformation, exhumation history, and strain propagation mechanisms of the Longmen Shan-Weiyuan belt using seismic profiles and thermokinematic modeling.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the complete abstract and metadata retrieved from ESS Open Archive and Crossref, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study presents a novel Centroid-Moment-Tensor (CMT) inversion method specifically designed for deep-sea earthquakes. By incorporating Scholte-Rayleigh waves—interface waves propagating along the seafloor—the method significantly improves the resolution of focal depths and source mechanisms for very shallow events. The authors apply this technique to the outer rise of the Japan Trench, successfully revealing minor, very shallow seismicity that was previously difficult to characterize using conventional CMT inversion methods.
本研究提出了一种针对深海地震的新型矩张量（CMT）反演方法。通过引入沿海底传播的Scholte-Rayleigh界面波，该方法显著提高了极浅源地震的深度和震源机制分辨率。作者将该技术应用于日本海沟外侧隆起区，成功揭示了传统CMT反演难以精确表征的微弱极浅层地震活动性。

t: A novel Centroid-Moment-Tensor (CMT) inversion method that incorporates Scholte-Rayleigh waves to resolve shallow offshore earthquake sources.
一种结合Scholte-Rayleigh波的新型矩张量（CMT）反演方法，用于解析浅层海底震源。
Ocean-bottom seismic waveform data recording shallow earthquakes in the outer rise of the Japan Trench.
记录了日本海沟外侧隆起浅层地震的海底地震仪波形数据。
Successful characterization of minor, very shallow seismicity in the Japan Trench outer rise that was previously unresolved.
成功表征了日本海沟外侧隆起处此前无法解析的微弱极浅层地震活动。
The method's performance depends heavily on the accuracy of shallow seafloor shear-wave velocity models.
该方法的有效性高度依赖于海底浅部剪切波速度模型的准确性。
limitations.src: Methodological inference based on Scholte-wave physics

t: First integration of Scholte-Rayleigh waves into CMT inversion to specifically target and resolve very shallow deep-sea seismicity.
首次将Scholte-Rayleigh波引入CMT反演，专门用于解决极浅层深海地震定位与机制难题。

kc: Developed a novel CMT inversion algorithm incorporating Scholte-Rayleigh waves for deep-sea environments.
Improved the depth resolution and source mechanism constraints for very shallow submarine earthquakes.
Revealed previously undetected or poorly constrained minor shallow seismicity in the Japan Trench outer rise.
开发了一种结合Scholte-Rayleigh波的适用于深海环境的新型CMT反演算法。
提高了极浅层海底地震的深度分辨率和震源机制约束能力。
揭示了日本海沟外侧隆起区此前未被发现或约束较差的微弱浅层地震活动。
me: Centroid-Moment-Tensor (CMT) inversion incorporating Scholte-Rayleigh interface waves.
Seismic waveform modeling in marine environments with water-sediment-crust layers.
结合Scholte-Rayleigh界面波的震源机制解（CMT）反演。
包含海水-沉积物-地壳层海洋环境中的地震波形模拟。
de: Seismic waveform data from deep-sea stations (such as ocean-bottom seismometers) near the Japan Trench outer rise.
来自日本海沟外侧隆起附近深海台站（如海底地震仪）的地震波形数据。
li: Requires accurate velocity models of the shallow seafloor sediments to correctly model Scholte-Rayleigh waves.
需要高精度的海底浅表沉积物速度模型以准确模拟Scholte-Rayleigh波。

tm.why: The paper develops a novel centroid-moment-tensor (CMT) inversion method to analyze deep-sea earthquakes and shallow seismicity.
The study incorporates Scholte-Rayleigh waves, which are interface waves typically recorded by ocean-bottom seismometers in deep-sea environments.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the paper title, authors, and metadata indicating the development of a Scholte-wave CMT inversion applied to the Japan Trench.

sum: This theoretical study bridges microscopic stochastic processes and macroscopic seismological theory. The authors reinterpret Aki and Richards' representation theorem—the foundation of elastodynamic displacement fields from cracking—using a generalized continuous-time random walk (CTRW) framework with multi-state transitions. By formulating macroscopic equations from expectation values, they identify the transition probability structures and time-scale conditions under which CTRW macroscopic behavior aligns with the conventional representation theorem. Specifically, when waiting-time distributions have characteristic time scales, the equations match under a specific hierarchy of observation and transition scales. This provides a novel stochastic perspective on the validity of the representation theorem, offering potential applications for modeling scattering and inelastic crustal deformation.
本研究将微观随机过程与宏观地震学理论相结合。作者利用包含多状态转换的广义连续时间随机游走（CTRW）框架，重新解释了描述裂隙产生弹性动力学位移场的Aki-Richards表示定理。通过构建期望值的宏观方程，确定了CTRW宏观行为与传统表示定理一致的转移概率结构和时间尺度条件。当等待时间分布具有特征时……

t: A generalized continuous-time random walk (CTRW) framework involving transitions among multiple state components formulated in terms of expectation values.
引入了包含多状态分量转换的广义连续时间随机游走（CTRW）框架，并基于期望值构建宏观方程。
No observational data was used; the study is purely theoretical and mathematical.
本研究为纯理论与数学推导，未采用实际观测地震数据。
Proved that macroscopic equations of the proposed CTRW framework become consistent with Aki and Richards' representation theorem under a specific hierarchy of observation and transition time scales.
证明了在特定的观测与转移时间尺度层级下，该CTRW框架的宏观方程与传统的Aki-Richards表示定理一致。
The framework's applicability to complex, real-world inelastic and scattering media remains to be tested.
该随机框架在实际复杂非弹性与散射介质中的具体应用效果仍有待验证。
First reinterpretation of the classical elastodynamic representation theorem from a microscopic stochastic process perspective using continuous-time random walks.
首次从基于连续时间随机游走的微观随机过程视角，重新解释了经典的弹性动力学表示定理。

kc: Formulated a generalized continuous-time random walk (CTRW) framework involving transitions among multiple state components to describe microscopic cracking processes.
Derived macroscopic equations from expectation values and proved the existence of a class of stochastic processes compatible with Aki and Richards' representation theorem.
Established the specific hierarchy of observation and transition time scales required for the stochastic model to match conventional elastodynamics.
构建了包含多状态分量转换的广义连续时间随机游走（CTRW）框架，用以描述微观裂隙过程。
通过期望值推导了宏观方程，并证明了存在一类与Aki-Richards表示定理相兼容的随机过程。
确立了随机模型与传统弹性动力学相匹配所需的观测和转换时间尺度的特定层级关系。
me: Continuous-time random walks (CTRW) with multi-state transitions.
Stochastic process modeling and expectation value formulation.
Time-scale hierarchy analysis comparing microscopic transition times and macroscopic observation times.
多状态转换的连续时间随机游走（CTRW）方法。
随机过程建模与期望值公式推导。
对比微观转换时间与宏观观测时间的尺度层级分析。
de: Theoretical derivation and mathematical proofs of compatibility between the stochastic CTRW framework and classical elastodynamic representation theorems.
随机CTRW框架与经典弹性动力学表示定理之间兼容性的理论推导与数学证明。
li: The study is purely theoretical and has not yet been applied to or validated with real-world seismic observations or complex heterogeneous media.
该研究纯属理论推导，尚未在实际地震观测数据或复杂的非均匀介质中进行应用与验证。

tm.why: The paper investigates the theoretical foundations of Aki and Richards' representation theorem, which is the mathematical basis for seismic source inversion and wave propagation theory.
The stochastic continuous-time random walk framework is directly linked to scattering and inelastic effects in crustal deformation.

ev.notes: The analysis is based entirely on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: Ocean-generated microseismic noise severely limits short-period (1–10 s) teleseismic observations of the deep Earth. This study presents an accessible, computationally efficient supervised deep-learning denoising auto-encoder (DAE) workflow to extract Sdiff and ultra-low velocity zone (ULVZ) post-cursors (Sdiff+). Rather than requiring scarce high-SNR real waveforms or costly 3D simulations, the DAE is trained in the time-frequency domain using 1D Instaseis synthetics combined with real Global Seismographic Network noise. The model generalizes well to unseen 3D AxiSEM3D synthetics and real recordings, and can be fine-tuned via transfer learning using 3D synthetics or tapered real data. Combining denoising with linear array stacking preserves back-azimuth estimates while further boosting SNR. Applying this workflow reveals previously undocumented short-period Sdiff pre-cursors and post-cursors across multiple ULVZs and uncovers novel East Pacific Rise-to-Japan Sdiff+ observations sampling the Hawaiian ULVZ nearly perpendicular (78° difference) to North American paths.
海洋微震噪声严重限制了利用短周期（1-10秒）远震数据研究深部地球结构。本文提出一种高效的有监督深度学习去噪自编码器（DAE）流程，利用1D Instaseis合成地震图和全球台网真实噪声在时频域进行训练，无需昂贵的3D模拟或大量高质量真实信号，并可通过迁移学习进一步优化。测试表明该方法可与台阵线性……

t: A supervised convolutional denoising auto-encoder maps real and imaginary STFT inputs to time-frequency mask functions (between 0 and 1) trained on 1D Instaseis synthetics and GSN noise, optionally refined via decoder transfer learning.
基于1D Instaseis合成波与全球台网噪声训练时频域卷积去噪自编码器预测掩码，并结合迁移学习。

Training uses 512,000 GSN noise traces (600 s at 5 Hz), 1D Instaseis synthetics (PREM_a_2s), 3D AxiSEM3D synthetics, and 724 augmented US Sdiff traces; testing uses 2000–2024 T-component ULVZ record sections.
采用51.2万条GSN噪声、1D/3D合成波及扩充真实波形训练，测试2000-2024年远震ULVZ剖面。

In 1D synthetic tests, median arrival time shift is 0–1 samples (at 5 Hz) down to signal-to-noise amplitude ratio 0.5; real applications reveal short-period ULVZ arrivals and Japanese Hawaiian ULVZ paths 78° from US paths.
信噪振幅比低至0.5时走时误差中位数仅0-1个采样点；发现ULVZ短周期震相及相差78°的日本台网路径。
Amplitude fidelity is not preserved and amplitude loss varies across phases (suppressing off-axis Sdiff+ relative to Sdiff), so amplitude measurements on denoised traces are discouraged.
振幅保真度不足且不同震相衰减不一致，去噪波形不宜用于定量振幅测量。

Demonstrates deep-Earth teleseismic denoising trained purely on fast 1D synthetics and global noise, discovering short-period ULVZ pre/post-cursors and perpendicular East Pacific Rise-to-Japan Hawaiian ULVZ observations.
无需3D模拟即可训练深部地球远震去噪模型，首次发现ULVZ短周期前驱波及夏威夷正交路径信号。

kc: Developed a computationally efficient supervised DAE training workflow using 1D Instaseis synthetics and real global GSN noise.
Demonstrated transfer learning using 3D AxiSEM3D synthetics and tapered real waveforms to enhance specific phase extraction.
Verified that trace-by-trace STFT mask denoising preserves phase arrival times and beamforming back-azimuths when combined with array stacking.
Identified previously undocumented short-period (2–9 s) Sdiff pre-cursors and post-cursors from the Hawaiian, Galápagos, and Pitcairn ULVZs.
Uncovered novel Sdiff+ observations of the Hawaiian ULVZ on F-net stations in Japan from East Pacific Rise earthquakes, providing cross-cutting ray paths 78° from North American paths.
开发了仅利用1D Instaseis合成波形与全球台网（GSN）真实噪声的高效有监督DAE去噪训练流程。
验证了利用3D AxiSEM3D合成波形和加窗真实波形进行迁移学习可进一步提升特定震相的提取效果。
证明基于短时傅里叶变换（STFT）掩码的逐道去噪在与台阵叠加结合时能保持走时和波束形成反方位角信息。
在夏威夷、加拉帕戈斯和皮特凯恩ULVZ数据中发现了此前未记录的短周期（2-9秒）Sdiff前驱波和后续波。
首次在日本F-net台网提取到源自东太平洋海隆地震的夏威夷ULVZ Sdiff+信号，提供了与北美路径相差78°的交叉射线约束。
me: Time-frequency domain convolutional denoising auto-encoder (DAE) predicting real-valued signal and noise masks on 199x61 short-time Fourier transform (STFT) spectrograms.
Supervised training using 1D Instaseis (PREM_a_2s) S, SS, and Sdiff synthetics summed with STA/LTA-screened horizontal-component noise from GSN stations.
Two-stage transfer learning by freezing encoder weights and retraining the decoder on regional noise, 3D AxiSEM3D ULVZ synthetics, or tapered real Sdiff waveforms.
Combining single-trace DAE output with linear beamforming/stacking within a 2° station radius at CMB critical slowness (8.36 s/°).
采用时频域卷积去噪自编码器（DAE），在199×61短时傅里叶变换（STFT）谱图上预测信号与噪声掩码。
利用1D Instaseis（PREM_a_2s）生成的S、SS和Sdiff合成波与经STA/LTA筛选的GSN水平向真实噪声叠加进行有监督训练。
实施两阶段迁移学习，冻结编码器权重并利用区域噪声、3D AxiSEM3D合成波或加窗真实Sdiff波形重训练解码器。
将单道DAE去噪结果与2°半径内固定核幔边界临界慢度（8.36 s/°）的线性波束形成/台阵叠加相结合。
de: 512,000 GSN noise windows (600 s at 5 Hz) and regional noise datasets (128,000 traces each for contiguous US, Alaska, and Japan).
1D Instaseis synthetic datasets across six octave-width filter bands from 2 to 100 s, plus a 3D AxiSEM3D cylindrical ULVZ simulation down to 4 s period.
Augmented real training dataset of 51,200 traces from 724 manually screened high-SNR Sdiff waveforms (30 earthquakes recorded in the US).
Real T-component Sdiff test record sections (2000–2024) sampling Hawaiian, Galápagos, Pitcairn, Central Pacific, and Vanuatu ULVZs recorded in the US, Alaska, and Japan.
512,000条GSN全球噪声记录（600秒长，5 Hz采样）以及美国本土、阿拉斯加和日本的区域噪声数据集（各128,000条）。
涵盖2至100秒六个倍频程频段的1D Instaseis合成数据集，以及最短周期4秒的3D AxiSEM3D圆柱形ULVZ数值模拟数据。
由美国台站记录的30个地震共724条高信噪比真实Sdiff波形经随机相移扩充生成的51,200条真实数据训练集。
2000-2024年间采样夏威夷、加拉帕戈斯、皮特凯恩、中太平洋和瓦努阿图ULVZ的切向分量远震剖面测试集。
li: Amplitude fidelity is degraded and amplitude loss varies between phases (e.g., off-axis Sdiff+ is suppressed relative to Sdiff), precluding quantitative amplitude measurements.
Performance degrades at very high noise levels (amplitude ratios below 0.5), where signals may be missed or low-amplitude incoherent artifacts may appear.
Retraining on a single 3D AxiSEM3D ULVZ model can be overly specific and does not universally improve Sdiff+ extraction across all ULVZ geometries.
振幅保真度受限，不同震相间振幅衰减不一致（如偏轴Sdiff+相对于Sdiff被部分压制），不宜用于定量振幅测量。
在极高噪声水平（信噪振幅比低于0.5）下性能显著下降，可能遗漏信号或产生低振幅非相干伪影。
基于单一3D AxiSEM3D ULVZ模型的迁移学习具有参数特异性，未必能普适提升所有ULVZ结构的Sdiff+提取效果。

tm.why: The paper develops and applies a supervised deep-learning denoising auto-encoder (DAE) with transfer learning to suppress microseismic noise in teleseismic waveforms.
The study targets ultra-low velocity zones (ULVZs) at the core-mantle boundary using Sdiff and Sdiff+ diffracted waveforms to constrain deep mantle heterogeneity.
The authors evaluate the denoiser alongside beamforming and linear array stacking, showing that back-azimuth directional information is preserved.

ev.notes: Full manuscript and supplementary materials (55 pages total) were read and analyzed, including all 12 main text figures, equations, method sections, and quantitative test benchmarks.

sum: Reliable automatic phase picking is critical for local seismic monitoring. While single-station machine learning pickers like PhaseNet and EQTransformer are widely used, recent multi-station approaches such as the Phase Neural Operator (PhaseNO) leverage spatiotemporal wavefield coherence across networks. This study evaluates off-the-shelf PhaseNO against PhaseNet and EQTransformer on four local seismic networks (8–12 stations, ~1 km spacing) monitoring hydraulic fracturing operations. Using per-pick metrics and PyOcto phase association, the authors show that PhaseNO achieves significantly higher recall and detects more low-SNR (<10 dB) arrivals, lowering the magnitude of completeness in three of four test regions. Although PhaseNO yields lower apparent precision against reference catalogs, manual review and a 10+ pick threshold confirm that 40–65% of uncataloged detections are real events. Sensitivity tests varying station counts from one to full arrays confirm that multi-station context suppresses localized noise and boosts picking accuracy.
本研究在四个用于监测水力压裂的局部地震台网（8-12个台站，间距约1公里）上，系统评估了多台站相干震相拾取算法PhaseNO，并与单台站算法PhaseNet和EQTransformer进行了对比。结合单震相指标与PyOcto震相关联分析，研究发现PhaseNO在低信噪比（<10 dB）条件下具有更高……

t: PhaseNO uses Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) for temporal processing and Graph Neural Operators (GNO) for spatial aggregation across arbitrary seismic network geometries, evaluated alongside PhaseNet and EQTransformer and associated into events using PyOcto.
利用结合FNO和GNO的PhaseNO进行多台站震相拾取，并与PhaseNet、EQT对比及使用PyOcto关联。

Four local hydraulic fracturing monitoring datasets from ISTI, featuring 8–12 shallow post-hole wideband seismometers at ~1 km spacing, 100 Hz 3-component waveforms, and 2–4 week analyst-reviewed and template-matched reference catalogs.
四个水力压裂监测局部台网数据（8-12个台站，间距约1公里，采样率100 Hz）及2-4周参考目录。

PhaseNO achieves P/S recall up to 0.93/0.93, outperforms baselines below 10 dB SNR, lowers magnitude of completeness in 3 of 4 regions, and manual review confirms 40% to >65% of uncataloged detections are real events.
PhaseNO在<10 dB低信噪比下召回率显著占优，降低了3个区域的完备震级，且40%-65%以上新检测事件为真。
PhaseNO was applied off-the-shelf without fine-tuning or transfer learning to local network characteristics, and its high sensitivity produces more unassociated or low-SNR false positive picks.
直接使用预训练模型而未针对局部台网微调，且高灵敏度产生了较多低信噪比误拾取。

First systematic evaluation of the multi-station PhaseNO picker on private-sector local hydraulic fracturing networks, including station-count ablation studies demonstrating how multi-station coherence suppresses single-station false alarms.
首次在水力压裂局部台网系统评估PhaseNO，并通过台站消融实验揭示多台站抑制噪声机制。

kc: Evaluated the multi-station PhaseNO algorithm on four private-sector local seismic networks monitoring hydraulic fracturing.
Demonstrated that PhaseNO achieves superior recall on low-SNR (<10 dB) waveforms and lowers catalog magnitude of completeness compared to PhaseNet and EQTransformer.
Validated via manual review and trigger-count thresholds (10+ picks) that 40% to >65% of PhaseNO's apparent false positive events are genuine uncataloged earthquakes.
Conducted station-removal ablation studies showing that increasing input stations from 1 to 4 rapidly increases precision by suppressing localized non-coherent noise.
在四个用于监测水力压裂的工业界局部地震台网上系统评估了多台站PhaseNO算法。
证明PhaseNO在低信噪比（<10 dB）波形上比PhaseNet和EQTransformer具有更高的召回率，并降低了地震目录的完备震级。
通过人工复核和触发数阈值（≥10个震相）验证了PhaseNO表观假阳性事件中40%至65%以上为真实未编目地震。
开展了台站消融实验，表明将输入台站从1个增加到4个可通过抑制局部非相干噪声快速提升精确率。
me: Multi-station spatiotemporal phase picking using Phase Neural Operator (PhaseNO), which combines Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) and Graph Neural Operators (GNO).
Baseline comparisons against single-station deep learning pickers (PhaseNet and EQTransformer via SeisBench).
4D space-time cell phase association using PyOcto.
False-positive validation via manual analyst review of 100 randomly sampled events per region and a 10+ pick cluster threshold.
Network sensitivity testing by running PhaseNO with a single station (PhaseNO1) and incrementally adding stations.
利用结合傅里叶神经算子（FNO）和图神经算子（GNO）的PhaseNO进行多台站时空震相拾取。
与SeisBench中的单台站深度学习拾取算法（PhaseNet和EQTransformer）进行基线对比。
使用PyOcto进行四维时空网格震相关联。
通过每个区域随机抽样100个事件进行人工复核以及10+震相触发阈值，对假阳性事件进行验证。
通过单台站输入（PhaseNO1）及逐步增加台站数量进行台网敏感性测试。
de: Four local seismic datasets from ISTI monitoring hydraulic fracturing, each consisting of 8–12 wideband borehole seismometers with ~1 km spacing.
2–4 weeks of continuous/windowed 3-component HH channel waveforms sampled at 100 Hz (120 s windows).
Reference ground-truth catalogs built using Earthworm automatic processing, template matching, and manual analyst scoping (1,070 to 3,991 events per region).
来自ISTI监测水力压裂的四个局部地震数据集，每个台网由8-12个间距约1公里的浅井宽频带地震仪组成。
持续2-4周的三分量HH通道波形数据，采样率100 Hz（120秒时间窗）。
结合Earthworm自动处理、模板匹配和人工校核建立的参考基准目录（每个区域1,070至3,991个事件）。
li: Off-the-shelf pre-trained PhaseNO was applied directly without transfer learning or fine-tuning to the local network settings.
PhaseNO generates many more picks than single-station models, leading to a wider spread (standard deviation) in pick time residuals and higher computational/association filtering demands.
直接使用了预训练的PhaseNO模型，未针对局部台网环境进行迁移学习或微调。
PhaseNO生成的震相拾取数量远多于单台站模型，导致拾取时间残差的标准差较大，且对后续关联过滤要求更高。

tm.why: The paper systematically evaluates the deep learning-based Phase Neural Operator (PhaseNO) against PhaseNet and EQTransformer for seismic phase picking.
The study focuses on automatic P and S phase picking, phase association via PyOcto, and earthquake catalog completeness.
The four local-scale seismic networks evaluated were specifically deployed to monitor hydraulic fracturing operations.

ev.notes: Full 16-page PDF (including Appendix figures A1–A11 and tables A1–A6) was analyzed and used as primary evidence.

sum: Integrating seismic velocity models with geological interpretations is often hindered by spatial and amplitude inconsistencies among inverted parameters like Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs. To bridge this gap, this study develops a double-difference body-wave travel-time tomography method constrained by Variation of Information (VI), which enhances statistical and nonlinear correlations between Vp and Vp/Vs models. Applied to 41,843 seismic events across 1,032 stations along the southeastern margin of the Tibetan Plateau, the method yields intrinsically consistent 3D Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs models with a horizontal resolution up to 0.2°. The authors then apply a feature-weighted K-means (W-K-means) clustering algorithm in a 5D space (longitude, latitude, depth, Vp, Vp/Vs) to partition the lithosphere into eight physically coherent domains. These clusters reveal marked vertical and lateral compositional differentiation—including felsic upper crust, partially molten middle-lower crust, and contrasting upper-mantle depletion between the Sichuan Basin and Chuandian Block.
本研究提出一种受信息变差（VI）约束的双差体波走时层析成像新方法，以增强Vp与Vp/Vs模型之间的内在统计相关性。利用藏东南地区1,032个台站记录的41,843个地震事件的P、S及S-P走时数据，反演获得了水平分辨率达0.2°的自洽三维Vp、Vs和Vp/Vs模型。随后采用特征加权K均值（W-K-m……

t: Double-difference body-wave tomography jointly inverts P, S, and S-P times for Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs while minimizing Variation of Information (VI) among Vp and Vp/Vs, followed by W-K-means clustering.
在双差体波层析成像中引入信息变差（VI）约束联合反演Vp、Vs和Vp/Vs，并结合W-K-means聚类划分地质单元。
Body-wave arrival times (556,693 P, 431,658 S, and 335,004 S-P picks) from 41,843 earthquakes recorded by 1,032 permanent and temporary stations across southeastern Tibet between 2008 and 2016.
使用藏东南1,032个台站记录的41,843个地震事件的556,693条P波、431,658条S波和335,004条S-…
Travel-time RMS dropped from 0.545 s to 0.349 s and S-P RMS from 0.649 s to 0.509 s, while VI between the two Vp/Vs models decreased from 3.11 to 1.63, enabling 8 distinct petrophysical clusters.
走时RMS降至0.349 s，两类Vp/Vs模型的VI从3.11降至1.63，并在五维空间中识别出8个岩石物理聚类域。
Quantitative conversion from seismic velocities to compositional variables is limited by lacking deep rock-physics constraints and reduced resolution below 20 km in sparse-seismicity areas.
20 km以下少震区分辨率降低，且因缺乏深部岩石物理约束，地震参数向组分变量的转换仍属定性。

First integration of Variation of Information constraints into body-wave double-difference tomography combined with feature-weighted clustering to directly transform seismic velocity models into geological domains.
首次将信息变差约束引入双差体波层析成像并结合特征加权聚类，实现从地震速度模型向地质模型的定量转换。

kc: Developed a double-difference body-wave tomography algorithm incorporating Variation of Information (VI) constraints between Vp and two Vp/Vs formulations.
Produced high-resolution (0.2°–0.5°), internally consistent 3D Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs models for the southeastern margin of the Tibetan Plateau.
Established a quantitative geological modeling workflow using feature-weighted K-means (W-K-means) clustering to partition seismic models into 8 petrophysical domains.
开发了结合信息变差（VI）约束的双差体波走时层析成像算法，增强了Vp与两种Vp/Vs模型之间的一致性。
构建了藏东南地区高分辨率（0.2°–0.5°）且内在自洽的三维Vp、Vs和Vp/Vs速度模型。
建立了基于特征加权K均值（W-K-means）聚类的定量地质建模框架，将速度结构划分为8个岩石物理地质域。
me: Double-difference (DD) seismic travel-time tomography using P, S, and S-P arrival times.
Variation of Information (VI) regularization computed via Gaussian kernel density estimation in generalized parameter space with dynamic weight updating.
Feature-weighted K-means (W-K-means) unsupervised clustering on 5D features (longitude, latitude, depth, Vp, Vp/Vs) optimized via elbow and silhouette criteria.
利用P波、S波和S-P到时数据的双差（DD）地震走时层析成像。
在广义参数空间中通过高斯核密度估计计算信息变差（VI）正则化项，并采用动态权重更新策略。
基于五维特征（经度、纬度、深度、Vp、Vp/Vs）的特征加权K均值（W-K-means）无监督聚类，结合肘部法则和轮廓系数优选参数。
de: 556,693 P-wave, 431,658 S-wave, and 335,004 S-P arrival times from 41,843 events recorded at 1,032 stations (China National Seismic Network, ChinArray-Himalaya Phases I & II, western Sichuan Array, 2008–2016).
Initial reference model from the Southwest China Community Velocity Model v1.0 (SWChinaCVM1.0) on a 0.2° × 0.2° horizontal grid and depth nodes from -5 to 70 km.
Checkerboard resolution tests with ±5% velocity perturbations and 5% Gaussian noise, plus comparative inversions against tomoDDMC and CVM2.0.
收集2008–2016年间中国国家数字地震台网及密集流动台阵（喜马拉雅一期、二期及川西台阵）1,032个台站记录的41,843个地震事件，共556,693条P波、431,658条S波和335,004条S-P走时数据。
采用西南地区公共速度模型1.0版（SWChinaCVM1.0）作为初始模型，水平网格0.2°×0.2°，深度节点-5至70 km。
开展添加±5%微扰和5%高斯噪声的检测板分辨率测试，并与tomoDDMC方法及CVM2.0模型进行对比实验。
li: Below ~20 km depth, ray coverage is poor in the Songpan-Ganzi Terrane due to sparse seismicity, reducing lateral resolution from 0.2° to ~0.5°.
VI regularization trades off slight data fit against cross-parameter consistency, emphasizing statistically common structures rather than local complexities.
Compositional interpretations of the upper mantle remain qualitative due to the lack of comprehensive deep crustal and upper-mantle rock-physics constraints in the region.
在约20 km深度以下，松潘-甘孜地块因地震活动稀疏导致射线覆盖较差，水平分辨率从0.2°降至约0.5°。
VI正则化在数据拟合与跨参数一致性之间存在折衷，侧重于提取统计共性结构而非局部复杂细节。
由于缺乏该地区深部地壳和上地幔系统的岩石物理实验约束，地震参数向组分变量的转换仍停留在定性阶段。

tm.why: The paper develops a new double-difference body-wave travel-time tomography method constrained by variation of information to invert for Vp, Vs, and Vp/Vs models.
The inverted models and petrophysical clusters are used to delineate lithospheric geological domains and tectonic evolution of the southeastern margin of the Tibetan Plateau.
It introduces variation of information (VI) constraints into the seismic tomographic inversion objective function to enhance statistical correlation among physical parameters.

ev.notes: Extracted from the provided EPSL 2026 PDF text (pages 1–8 and 13–16; note that pages 9–12 were omitted in the provided PDF text extract, so figure details for Figs. 6–10 are grounded in their detailed in-text citations on pages 5–8 and 13).

sum: Earthquake source time functions (STFs) exhibit diverse shapes whose physical origins remain incompletely understood. Using 3D spectral boundary-integral dynamic rupture simulations (UGUCA) of idealized overstressed patches, this study systematically isolates and combines four controls: rupture initiation location, background stress gradient, overstress zone geometry, and bilinear slip-weakening (BLSW) friction. Results show that each mechanism governs a largely separable STF feature across growth, steady, and arrest phases. Initiation offset shifts early growth from quadratic to nearly linear; rectangular aspect ratio produces quasi-steady plateaus and spontaneous pulse-like slip via short-axis confinement without explicit frictional self-healing; and steeper background stress gradients or shorter geometric tapers cause more abrupt arrest. Crucially, macro-scale structural controls cannot reproduce the early-peaking, long-tailed STFs observed in large natural earthquakes. Such long tails and super-quadratic growth emerge only when the secondary frictional weakening distance approaches or exceeds total fault slip, supporting scale-dependent breakdown.
本研究利用三维谱边界积分动力学破裂模拟（UGUCA），系统量化了起裂位置、背景应力梯度、高应力区几何形态及双线性滑移弱化（BLSW）摩擦对震源时间函数（STF）生长、稳态和终止阶段的控制机制。结果表明这四种机制对STF特征具有高度可分离的控制作用：起裂位置偏心度使生长阶段从二次方转变为近线性；狭长矩……

t: Spontaneous 3D dynamic rupture simulations using the spectral-boundary-integral code UGUCA, fitting power-law exponents to STF growth and arrest phases delineated at 75% of peak moment rate.
利用UGUCA进行三维谱边界积分自发破裂模拟，以75%峰值矩率为界拟合STF生长与终止幂律指数。

Synthetic dynamic rupture suites varying initiation offset (0–1.00a), background stress gradient (18.75–300 MPa/m), rectangular aspect ratio (1–30), pentagonal taper (L2/W=0–6), and secondary slip-weakening distance (12.5–2000 µm).
改变起裂偏心距、背景应力梯度、矩形长宽比、五边形尖灭长度和二次弱化距离的合成破裂模拟数据集。

Edge initiation lowers n_rise from 2.04 to ~1.15; steeper stress gradients raise n_decay from 2.46 to 4.12; L/W=30 extends plateau to 3.7 ms; and delta_c2=2000 µm lowers n_decay to 1.22 and shifts peak time to 0.43.
边缘起裂使生长指数从2.04降至1.15；陡应力梯度使衰减指数从2.46升至4.12；大δc2产生0.43早峰值与长尾。
Simulations use a single smooth overstressed patch in a homogeneous elastic medium with uniform slip-weakening friction, neglecting multi-scale fault heterogeneity, subevents, and off-fault damage.
采用均匀介质单平滑凹凸体和均匀滑移弱化摩擦，忽略了多尺度非均质性、子事件和断层带损伤。

Jointly quantifies four physical controls across STF growth, steady, and arrest phases, proving long-tailed STFs and super-quadratic growth arise from extended secondary frictional weakening comparable to total slip.
系统分离并联合量化了STF三阶段的四种物理控制，揭示与总滑移相当的二次弱化产生长尾和超二次方生长。

kc: Decomposes the earthquake source time function (STF) into growth, steady, and arrest phases and maps four physical controls to distinct, largely separable quantitative shape metrics.
Demonstrates that short-axis geometric confinement in elongated overstress zones spontaneously generates pulse-like slip and STF plateaus without explicit frictional self-healing.

Shows that macro-scale structural controls alone cannot produce early-peaking, long-tailed STFs; instead, an extended secondary slip-weakening distance comparable to total slip is required, supporting scale-dependent breakdown and explaining super-quadratic growth via local slip re-acceleration.
将地震震源时间函数（STF）分解为生长、稳态和终止三个阶段，并将四种物理控制机制映射到清晰且基本可分离的量化形状指标上。
证明了狭长高应力区的短轴几何限制无需显式的摩擦自愈机制即可自发产生脉冲式滑移和STF稳态平台。
表明仅靠宏观结构控制无法产生早峰值、长尾型STF；必须引入与总滑移量相当的二次滑移弱化距离，从而支持尺度依赖的破裂耗散并利用局部滑移重加速解释了超二次方生长。
me: 3D spectral-boundary-integral dynamic rupture modeling on a 2D planar fault in a homogeneous linear elastic medium using the open-source code UGUCA.
Parametric variation of circular, rectangular (aspect ratios L/W from 1 to 30), and pentagonal tapered overstress patches surrounded by a linearly decaying background stress gradient.
Comparison of conventional linear slip-weakening (LSW) and bilinear slip-weakening (BLSW) friction laws with varying secondary weakening distance.
Quantitative STF partitioning using a 75% peak-amplitude threshold and nonlinear least-squares power-law fitting for growth and arrest curvature exponents.
使用开源代码UGUCA，在三维均匀线弹性介质中的二维平面断层上进行谱边界积分动力学破裂模拟。
对被线性衰减背景应力梯度包围的圆形、矩形（长宽比L/W为1至30）和五边形尖灭高应力区进行参数化变分实验。
对比传统线性滑移弱化（LSW）与改变二次弱化距离的双线性滑移弱化（BLSW）摩擦准则。
以75%峰值振幅为阈值划分STF阶段，并采用非线性最小二乘幂律拟合提取生长和终止阶段的曲率指数。
de: Suite of synthetic spontaneous rupture simulations nucleated via a slowly expanding circular seed crack.

Independent and combined parameter suites varying initiation offset (0 to 1.00a), stress decay rate beta (18.75 to 300 MPa/m), rectangular aspect ratio (1 to 30), pentagonal taper length (L2/W from 0 to 6), and secondary weakening distance delta_c2 (12.5 to 2000 micrometers).
通过缓慢扩展的圆形种子裂纹触发的一系列合成自发破裂数值模拟实验。
独立及联合改变起裂偏心距（0至1.00a）、应力衰减率β（18.75至300 MPa/m）、矩形长宽比（1至30）、五边形尖灭长度（L2/W从0至6）以及二次弱化距离δc2（12.5至2000微米）的参数实验组。
li: Adopts an idealized, smooth single-patch stress distribution, omitting multi-scale fault stress/strength heterogeneity and multiple subevents.
Assumes a homogeneous elastic medium and planar fault, neglecting off-fault damage zones, inelasticity, fault roughness, and dynamic pore pressure effects.
Uses spatially uniform slip-weakening friction rather than rate-and-state or thermally activated weakening laws.
采用了理想化、平滑的单凹凸体应力分布，忽略了多尺度断层应力/强度非均质性及多子事件过程。
假设介质为均匀弹性且断层为平面，未考虑断层外损伤带、非弹性变形、断层粗糙度及动态孔隙水压效应。
假设断层面摩擦性质空间均匀且遵循滑移弱化，未包含速率-状态摩擦或热激活弱化机制。

tm.why: The paper systematically investigates the physical controls on earthquake source time functions (moment rate functions) using dynamic rupture simulations.
It examines fault frictional weakening laws (linear vs. bilinear slip-weakening), scale-dependent breakdown work, and geometric confinement on a fault plane.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 30-page manuscript PDF (preprint submitted to JGR: Solid Earth), including abstract, main text, equations, and all 7 main figures.

sum: This study applies a rate-and-state friction (RSF) block-slider framework to 19 rainfall-triggered landslides in Aizawl, Mizoram (2016–2025) to predict slope failure timing in Miocene shale-dominated lithology. Satellite-derived (GPM IMERG) half-hourly rainfall is propagated to a 2 m failure depth via a 1D pore-pressure diffusion model across three hydraulic conductivity scenarios, and RSF parameters (a, b, Dc) are inverted to match observed failure dates. The dimensionless normalized pore-pressure χ cleanly separates events into two regimes: synchronous failure (χ ≳ 4, zero delay from peak pore-pressure), exemplified by the eight simultaneous landslides triggered by Cyclone Remal in May 2024, and delayed failure (χ ~ 1–3.7, delays up to 10 days), jointly governed by χ and the velocity-weakening ratio a/b. Scaling pore-pressure with CMIP6 extreme precipitation projections shows the fraction of zero-warning synchronous landslides rising from ~56% currently to ~72% under SSP5-8.5.
本研究将速率-状态摩擦（RSF）滑块模型应用于印度米佐拉姆邦艾藻尔2016至2025年的19起降雨触发滑坡。利用1D孔隙水压力扩散模型将GPM卫星降雨数据传播至2米滑动面深度，并反演RSF参数以匹配观测破坏时间。无量纲归一化孔隙压力χ将滑坡清晰划分为同步破坏（χ≳4，零延迟，如2024年气旋Rema……

t: Applies a 1D rainfall-diffusion pore-pressure model coupled with a rate-and-state friction (RSF) block-slider simulation, inverting frictional parameters (a, b, Dc) to match observed failure dates of 19 landslides.
耦合一维降雨扩散孔隙压力模型与速率-状态摩擦滑块模拟，反演19起滑坡的摩擦参数以匹配破坏日期。
An inventory of 19 shallow (~2 m depth) rainfall-triggered landslides in Aizawl, Mizoram (2016–2025), paired with 15-day antecedent half-hourly NASA GPM IMERG satellite precipitation data.
2016至2025年艾藻尔19起浅层降雨滑坡目录，结合滑坡前15天的NASA GPM半小时卫星降水数据。

Normalized pore-pressure χ separates failures into synchronous (χ ≳ 4, zero delay, e.g., 8 Cyclone Remal events) and delayed (χ ~ 1–3.7, up to 234.5 hrs delay) regimes; SSP5-8.5 shifts synchronous failures from 56% to 72%.
归一化孔隙压力χ将滑坡分为同步（χ≳4，零延迟）和延迟破坏；SSP5-8.5下同步破坏从56%升至72%。

RSF parameter inversion is non-unique without laboratory or field instrumentation; the 1D rigid-block model neglects lateral flow, unsaturated dynamics, internal deformation, and non-linear infiltration scaling.
缺乏实验约束导致反演具多解性；一维刚体模型忽略了侧向流、非饱和流、内部变形及非线性入渗。

First physics-based landslide failure-timing analysis in Mizoram, demonstrating cyclone-driven synchronous multi-slope failure and linking CMIP6 extreme rainfall projections to RSF warning-time collapse.
首次对米佐拉姆滑坡进行物理时间预测，揭示气旋群发同步破坏并将CMIP6预测与预警时间坍缩关联。

kc: Applies a physics-based rate-and-state friction (RSF) block-slider model to 19 historical landslides in Mizoram, India, inverting for basal shear zone frictional parameters.
Validates a clean bimodal separation between synchronous (zero-delay) and delayed slope failures governed by normalized pore-pressure χ and friction parameter ratio a/b.
Demonstrates that extreme rainfall from Cyclone Remal (May 2024) pushed eight slopes simultaneously into the far-above-steady-state synchronous failure regime (χ ≈ 4.4).
Projects via CMIP6 scenarios that climate-driven extreme rainfall intensification will increase zero-warning synchronous failures from 56% to 72% under SSP5-8.5.
将基于物理的速率-状态摩擦（RSF）滑块模型应用于印度米佐拉姆邦19起历史滑坡，反演了基底剪切带摩擦参数。
验证了由归一化孔隙压力χ和摩擦参数比a/b共同控制的同步（零延迟）与延迟滑坡破坏的双模态分离。
证明2024年5月气旋Remal的极端降雨使8个边坡同时进入远超稳态的同步破坏机制（χ ≈ 4.4）。
通过CMIP6情景预测，在SSP5-8.5下气候驱动的极端降雨增强将使零预警同步滑坡比例从56%增加到72%。
me: 1D vertical pore-pressure diffusion modeling driven by half-hourly NASA GPM IMERG satellite rainfall across three hydraulic conductivity scenarios.
Quasi-static rate-and-state friction (RSF) rigid block-slider numerical simulation using the Dieterich aging law.
Forward-modeling optimization/inversion of RSF parameters (a, b, Dc) to match exact observed failure dates at a slip velocity threshold of 10^-3 m/s.
Climate change impact scaling of peak pore-pressure perturbations using CMIP6 extreme precipitation (R99p) multiplication factors for SSP2-4.5, SSP3-7.0, and SSP5-8.5.
基于NASA GPM IMERG半小时卫星降雨数据，在三种水力传导率情景下进行一维垂向孔隙水压力扩散建模。
采用Dieterich老化律进行准静态速率-状态摩擦（RSF）刚体滑块数值模拟。
通过正演模拟优化反演RSF参数（a, b, Dc），以10^-3 m/s滑动速度为阈值精确匹配观测滑坡发生日期。
利用CMIP6极端降水（R99p）在SSP2-4.5、SSP3-7.0和SSP5-8.5情景下的比例因子，对峰值孔隙压力扰动进行气候变化影响缩放。
de: Inventory of 19 shallow planar rainfall-triggered landslides (~2 m depth) in and around Aizawl, Mizoram (September 2016 to May 2025) hosted in the Miocene Bhuban Formation.
NASA Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) IMERG version 06B half-hourly precipitation data (0.1° resolution) extracted over 15-day windows prior to each landslide.
CMIP6 regional extreme rainfall scaling factors for northeast India under SSP2-4.5 (1.10x), SSP3-7.0 (1.20x), and SSP5-8.5 (1.30x).
2016年9月至2025年5月米佐拉姆邦艾藻尔及周边中新统Bhuban组地层中19起浅层平面型降雨触发滑坡（深度约2米）目录。
每次滑坡前15天窗口内提取的NASA全球降水测量（GPM）IMERG 06B版半小时降水数据（0.1°分辨率）。
CMIP6在SSP2-4.5（1.10倍）、SSP3-7.0（1.20倍）和SSP5-8.5（1.30倍）情景下印度东北部的区域极端降雨缩放因子。
li: Inversion of RSF parameters (a, b, Dc) and hydraulic conductivity (K) from failure dates alone is inherently non-unique without independent in-situ pore-pressure or laboratory friction measurements.
The 1D vertical diffusion model neglects lateral flow, unsaturated-zone dynamics, and strong centimeter-scale permeability heterogeneity in interbedded sandstone-shale.
The rigid-block approximation ignores internal deformation and spatial stress variations within the sliding mass.
Climate projections assume linear scaling between extreme rainfall and pore-pressure perturbation, ignoring infiltration non-linearities and antecedent saturation states.
在缺乏原位孔隙压力监测或实验室摩擦测量的情况下，仅凭破坏日期反演RSF参数（a, b, Dc）和水力传导率（K）存在固有的多解性。
一维垂向扩散模型忽略了侧向流、非饱和带动力学以及砂岩-页岩互层中厘米尺度的强渗透率非均质性。
刚体滑块近似忽略了滑动体内部的变形和空间应力变化。
气候预测假设极端降雨与孔隙压力扰动之间呈线性缩放，忽略了入渗非线性和前期饱和状态的影响。

sum: This study introduces a 4D geometric analysis framework to investigate the spatial-temporal evolution of seismic source clouds preceding large earthquakes. By analyzing earthquake catalogs, the author identifies universal 'V-transition' pathways in the geometric configuration of seismicity. These pathways represent a systematic contraction and subsequent expansion or reorganization of seismic source distributions prior to mainshocks. Empirical scaling relationships are established linking the characteristics of these 4D geometric transitions to the magnitude and timing of the impending large earthquakes, offering potential new insights for earthquake forecasting and understanding precursory fault-zone dynamics.
本研究引入了一种四维几何分析框架，用于研究大地震前地震源云的时空演化。通过分析地震目录，作者在地震活动的几何配置中识别出了通用的“V型转变”路径。这些路径代表了主震前地震源分布的系统性收缩以及随后的扩张或重组。研究建立了将这些四维几何转变特征与即将发生的大地震的震级和时间联系起来的经验比例关系，为地……

sum: This dataset compiles lithospheric structure models across the East African Rift System (EARS) using active and passive seismic data. It includes key parameters such as sediment thickness, Moho depths, Vp/Vs ratios, and Negative Velocity Gradients (NVG). Additionally, the repository provides newly developed crustal and lithospheric mantle thinning factors. This compilation serves as a critical resource for understanding continental rifting, geodynamics, and crustal evolution in East Africa.
该数据集整合了东非裂谷系统（EARS）的主动和被动地震学研究成果，包含沉积层厚度、莫霍面深度、Vp/Vs比值及负速度梯度（NVG）等关键岩石圈结构参数。此外，还提供了新估算的地壳与岩石圈地幔减薄因子。该编译数据集为研究大陆裂谷作用、地球动力学及地壳演化提供了重要基础数据。

t: Compilation of lithospheric structural parameters (Moho, Vp/Vs, NVG) and calculation of crustal and lithospheric mantle thinning factors from active and passive seismic data.

Active and passive seismic experiment datasets across the East African Rift System, including sediment thickness, Moho depths, and velocity gradients.

A unified repository of lithospheric models and derived thinning factors to characterize the rifting processes in East Africa.

First systematic compilation of both crustal and lithospheric mantle thinning factors alongside multiple seismic observables for the entire East African Rift.

sum: This didactic, application-oriented textbook introduces the principles and methods of digital signal processing (DSP) through seismic data analysis. Developed for graduate students and researchers, it bridges fundamental DSP theory with practical MATLAB implementations. The book covers core concepts including sampling, Fourier analysis, convolution, deconvolution, and digital filtering. It also presents advanced seismological applications such as spectral magnitude estimation, source-time function retrieval, ambient-noise cross-correlation, and horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratio (HVSR) site-response analysis. Each topic is accompanied by worked examples using synthetic and real seismic data to enable reproducible research.
这是一本面向应用的地震学数字信号处理教学教科书。该书将数字信号处理（DSP）的基础理论与MATLAB实际编程相结合，涵盖了采样、傅里叶分析、卷积、反褶积和数字滤波等核心概念。此外，书中还介绍了谱震级估算、震源时间函数检索、背景噪声互相关以及基于H/V谱比法的场地响应分析等先进地震学应用，并配有合成与……

t: Digital signal processing methods including Fourier analysis, filtering, deconvolution, ambient-noise cross-correlation, and HVSR spectral ratio analysis implemented in MATLAB.
在MATLAB中实现的数字信号处理方法，包括傅里叶分析、滤波、反褶积、背景噪声互相关和HVSR谱比分析。
Synthetic and real seismic waveform data recorded by dense seismic networks, used for hands-on exercises and reproducible research.

A comprehensive didactic framework enabling students and researchers to transform raw seismic observations into quantitative insights on sources and Earth structure.
一个全面的教学框架，使学生和研究人员能够将原始地震观测转化为对震源和地球结构的定量认识。

一本现代的、面向应用的教科书，直接将基础DSP理论与地震学实际工作流及MATLAB代码相连接。
