sum: Passive full-waveform inversion (FWI) suffers from strong coupling between velocity structure and unknown source locations, often failing when starting from rough initial models. This paper introduces a joint inversion workflow utilizing both virtual and actual passive seismic data. First, full-field multidimensional deconvolution (MDD) seismic interferometry retrieves broadband surface virtual reflection responses without needing source locations. Multiscale passive virtual-source FWI using a global normalized cross-correlation objective function reconstructs a reliable background velocity model. Next, using this model as a starting point, the workflow alternates between reverse-time wavefield scanning for source localization and L2-norm passive actual-source FWI with a hybrid-source strategy to refine deep structures via internal illumination. Synthetic tests on a modified Marmousi2 model and a Luzong Basin metal ore body model demonstrate robust velocity recovery and event localization even under inhomogeneous source distributions and signal-to-noise ratios down to -20 dB.
针对被动源全波形反演中速度与震源位置强耦合及依赖初始模型的问题，本文提出联合虚拟源和实际被动源数据的反演框架。首先利用全波场多维反褶积（MDD）地震干涉术重构地表宽频带虚拟反射响应，在不依赖震源位置的情况下通过全局归一化互相关多尺度虚拟源FWI建立可靠背景速度模型；随后以此为初始模型，交替进行逆时波……

t: Retrieves virtual reflections via full-field MDD for multiscale normalized cross-correlation virtual-source FWI, then alternates reverse-time wavefield scanning and L2-norm hybrid-source actual-source FWI to jointly refine velocity and source locations.
通过全波场MDD提取虚拟反射进行多尺度虚拟源FWI，再交替进行逆时扫描定位与实际源FWI联合更新速度和震源位置。
Synthetic 2D acoustic finite-difference datasets on a rescaled Marmousi2 model (12x2.8 km, 201 receivers) and a Luzong Basin metal ore model (8x2.4 km, 171 receivers) with 6–12 Hz Ricker sources.
在缩放Marmousi2模型（12×2.8 km）和庐枞盆地金属矿模型（8×2.4 km）上合成6-12 Hz二维声波有…

Joint inversion accurately reconstructs deep low-velocity layers and complex ore bodies from linear initial models, maintaining clear structural delineation and precise source localization across inhomogeneous distributions and SNRs down to -20 dB.
从线性初始模型准确重构深部低速层和复杂矿体，在非均匀震源及-20 dB低信噪比下仍保持清晰成像与高定位精度。
Assumes known source time functions in numerical tests, is restricted to 2D acoustic media, and would incur high computational costs for 3D full-field MDD.
假设震源时间函数已知，仅限于二维声介质，扩展至三维时全波场MDD计算成本高昂。

Decouples initial velocity modeling from unknown source locations via full-field MDD virtual-source FWI before alternating actual-source FWI and reverse-time scanning to exploit deep internal illumination.
利用全波场MDD虚拟源FWI解耦初始建模与未知震源位置，再串联实际源FWI与逆时扫描补充深部内部照明。

kc: Proposed a sequential joint FWI workflow combining MDD-based passive virtual-source FWI and passive actual-source FWI with reverse-time source scanning.
Decoupled initial velocity model building from unknown passive source parameters by leveraging full-field MDD virtual reflection responses.
Demonstrated high robustness against inhomogeneous source distributions (clustering, one-sided illumination) and severe random noise (down to -20 dB SNR).
提出了串联基于MDD的被动虚拟源FWI与结合逆时扫描的被动实际源FWI的联合反演流程。
利用全波场MDD虚拟反射响应，将初始速度建模与未知的被动震源参数解耦。
在非均匀震源分布（簇状聚集、单侧照明）和强随机噪声（信噪比低至-20 dB）下验证了方法的稳健性。
me: Full-field multidimensional deconvolution (MDD) via regularized weighted least-squares to retrieve virtual surface reflection responses.
Multiscale passive virtual-source FWI using a global normalized cross-correlation objective function and self-defined Ricker wavelets.
Alternating passive actual-source L2-norm FWI (with hybrid-source random sub-stage stacking) and reverse-time wavefield maximum-energy scanning for source localization.
采用正则化加权最小二乘求解全波场多维反褶积（MDD），提取地表虚拟反射响应。
结合自定义雷克子波和全局归一化互相关目标函数，开展多尺度被动虚拟源全波形反演。
采用混合源随机子阶段叠加策略，交替进行基于L2范数的实际被动源FWI与逆时波场最大能量聚焦扫描震源定位。
de: 2D synthetic time-domain finite-difference acoustic tests on a rescaled Marmousi2 model (12 km x 2.8 km) with a deep low-velocity layer.
2D synthetic tests on a complex metal ore body model based on the Luzong Basin metallogenic area (8 km x 2.4 km).
Sensitivity experiments evaluating three passive source spatial distributions (ideal random, reservoir/fault-clustered, one-sided deep) and Gaussian noise at SNRs of -5 dB, -10 dB, and -20 dB.
在含深部低速层的缩放Marmousi2模型（12 km × 2.8 km）上进行二维时间域有限差分声波合成测试。
在基于中国庐枞盆地成矿区构建的复杂金属矿体模型（8 km × 2.4 km）上进行二维合成测试。
开展三种震源空间分布（理想随机、储层/断层聚集、单侧深部）及-5 dB、-10 dB和-20 dB高斯噪声下的敏感性实验。
li: Assumes passive source time functions are known a priori during passive actual-source FWI.
Formulated and tested only in 2D acoustic media; extension to 3D and elastic media faces high MDD computational cost and P/S wavefield separation challenges.
One-sided passive-source illumination still degrades velocity recovery on the unilluminated side despite improvements over standalone methods.
在被动实际源全波形反演阶段假设被动源的震源时间函数先验已知。
仅在二维声学介质中推导和测试，扩展至三维和弹性介质面临全波场MDD计算成本高及P/S波场分离难题。
单侧被动源照明仍会导致未照明侧的速度恢复质量下降，尽管优于单一反演方法。

sum: Whether Large Low-Velocity Provinces (LLVPs) in the lowermost mantle represent radiogenically enriched reservoirs is a fundamental question in Earth's thermal evolution. Conventional continental geoneutrino detectors measure only angle-integrated event rates, creating a parameter degeneracy that cannot distinguish a chemically homogeneous mantle from one with enriched LLVPs. This study quantifies the capability of directional geoneutrino detection using a simulated 1.5-kt Ocean Bottom Detector (OBD) in the South Pacific directly above the Pacific LLVP. Using realistic LLVP geometries derived from the SPiRaL global seismic tomography model, alongside crustal (ECM1) and reactor background models, the authors apply a binned Poisson profile likelihood analysis on nadir-angle event distributions. They show that an angular resolution of 20 degrees over 20 years successfully closes the likelihood contours, breaking the degeneracy between ambient mantle and LLVP uranium abundances and rejecting a homogeneous mantle at 1.8 to 2.6 sigma for realistic mass-balance models.
本文探讨了利用方向性地球中微子探测器解析深部地幔大型低速省（LLVP）化学异质性的潜力。传统全向探测器仅测量积分通量，存在严重的参数简并。作者基于SPiRaL全球地震层析成像模型构建了真实的LLVP几何形态，结合地壳模型与非地球中微子背景，利用分箱泊松剖面似然方法模拟了位于南太平洋的1.5千吨海底探……

t: The authors simulate directional geoneutrino nadir-angle event distributions by convolving 3D spatial integrations of U and Th decay fluxes with a Gaussian angular resolution kernel, then evaluate parameter sensitivity via a binned Poisson profile likelihood framework.
将三维U和Th衰变通量积分与高斯角分辨率核卷积模拟天底角事件分布，并用分箱泊松剖面似然评估参数灵敏度。

Earth models combine PREM, ECM1 crust, and LLVP geometries from the SPiRaL seismic tomography model below 1000 km depth, evaluated for a simulated 1.5-kt Ocean Bottom Detector at 15°S, 150°W with 2024 IAEA reactor backgrounds.
结合PREM、ECM1地壳和SPiRaL层析成像LLVP模型，模拟南太平洋1.5千吨海底探测器及2024年反应堆背景。

A 1.5-kt OBD operating for 20 years with 20° angular resolution breaks the rate-only parameter degeneracy, excluding a homogeneous mantle at 1.8σ, 2.2σ, and 2.6σ for δVs thresholds of -0.5%, -0.75%, and -1.0%, respectively.
具20°角分辨率的1.5千吨OBD运行20年可打破简并，在三种波速阈值下分别以1.8σ、2.2σ和2.6σ排除均匀地幔。

While directional geoneutrino detection can identify HPE-enriched chemical heterogeneities, lower enrichment values cannot be statistically excluded from a homogeneous mantle, and thermal-only LLVP features remain an open question.
低富集因子下难以在统计上排除均匀地幔假说，且仅凭该方法无法直接表征纯热成因的LLVP特征。

Advances beyond idealized cylindrical LLVP approximations and background-free assumptions by evaluating realistic seismic tomography topologies, empirical reactor/detector backgrounds, and varying angular resolutions to break flux-only degeneracy.
超越前人理想圆柱体和无背景假设，结合真实地震层析成像LLVP拓扑结构、实测背景和多角分辨率打破简并。

kc: Demonstrates mathematically and numerically that even an idealized 10-detector global network of rate-only geoneutrino detectors suffers from a fundamental degeneracy between ambient mantle and LLVP radiogenic abundances.
Evaluates directional geoneutrino sensitivity using realistic 3D LLVP geometries from the SPiRaL seismic tomography model rather than idealized cylinders.

Quantifies the statistical significance of a 1.5-kt South Pacific Ocean Bottom Detector (OBD) across varying angular resolutions, exposure times, seismic velocity thresholds, and HPE enrichment factors.
从数学和数值上证明，即使是由10个理想化仅测率探测器组成的全球网络，在环境地幔和LLVP生热元素丰度之间仍存在根本的参数简并。
使用来自SPiRaL地震层析成像模型的真实三维LLVP几何结构（而非理想圆柱体）评估了方向性地球中微子的探测灵敏度。
量化了南太平洋1.5千吨海底探测器（OBD）在不同角分辨率、曝光时间、地震波速阈值和生热元素富集因子下的统计显著性。
me: Mass-balance Earth modeling combining PREM density, ECM1 crust, and two-domain mantle (ambient depleted MORB-source mantle plus LLVP domains defined by SPiRaL shear-wave velocity thresholds).
Forward numerical integration of inverse beta decay (IBD) geoneutrino fluxes and nadir-angle spectra with Gaussian spherical convolution to simulate finite detector angular resolution.
Binned Poisson deviance profile likelihood analysis using the Asimov dataset with Gaussian nuisance parameter penalties for crustal and non-geoneutrino backgrounds.
结合PREM密度模型、ECM1地壳模型和双域地幔（亏损环境地幔加SPiRaL剪切波速度阈值定义的LLVP区域）的质量平衡地球建模。
逆β衰变（IBD）地球中微子通量及天底角谱的正演数值积分，并通过球面高斯卷积模拟有限的探测器角分辨率。
使用Asimov数据集的分箱泊松偏差剖面似然分析，并对地壳和非地球中微子背景引入高斯讨厌参数惩罚项。
de: Earth Crustal Model 1 (ECM1), GLOSS-II sediment model, PREM mantle density profile, and SPiRaL global seismic tomography model (thresholds dVs <= -0.5%, -0.75%, -1.0% below 1000 km depth).
Synthetic simulations of an idealized 10-detector global omnidirectional network and a 1.5-kt Ocean Bottom Detector (OBD) situated at 15°S, 150°W in the South Pacific.
Background modeling incorporating 2024 IAEA operational nuclear reactor data and KamLAND-like internal radioactive impurity levels.
地球地壳模型1（ECM1）、GLOSS-II沉积物模型、PREM地幔密度剖面以及SPiRaL全球地震层析成像模型（1000公里深度以下dVs <= -0.5%、-0.75%、-1.0%阈值）。
针对10个探测器的理想化全球全向网络以及位于南太平洋（15°S, 150°W）的1.5千吨海底探测器（OBD）的合成模拟实验。
结合2024年国际原子能机构（IAEA）核反应堆运行数据和类似KamLAND内部放射性杂质水平的背景建模。
li: Total event rates at the oceanic site are very low (~15 events/year), requiring long operational durations (20 years) and azimuthal integration to accumulate sufficient statistics.
Directional geoneutrino detection can identify LLVPs as chemical heterogeneities enriched in HPEs, but cannot directly characterize their thermal structure if they are not radiogenically enriched.
大洋站点的总事件率非常低（约每年15个事件），需要长达20年的运行时间并对方法角进行积分以积累足够的统计量。
方向性地球中微子探测可以识别富集生热元素的LLVP化学异质性，但如果LLVP没有生热元素富集，则无法直接表征其纯粹的热结构特征。

tm.why: The paper investigates deep-mantle compositional heterogeneity, specifically whether Large Low-Velocity Provinces (LLVPs) defined by seismic tomography host enriched heat-producing elements.
The study evaluates the observational sensitivity of a proposed Ocean Bottom Detector (OBD) deployed on the seafloor to measure directional geoneutrino fluxes.

ev.notes: Full 22-page arXiv preprint PDF analyzed including all equations, 6 figures, and 3 tables.

sum: Bridges crossing active faults face coupled demands from transient ground shaking and permanent tectonic offset, yet spatially consistent near-fault records and multi-support experimental setups are scarce. This study evaluates two practical equivalent seismic input frameworks—quasi-static and time-dependent dynamic—that decompose excitation into a uniform dynamic inertial component without permanent displacement and a fault-induced relative displacement component, combined via response-level superposition. Using a 3D OpenSees finite element model of a six-span simply supported segment of the Haiwen Bridge crossing a strike-slip fault, four input modes are tested under synthesized near-fault ground motions based on the 1992 Landers earthquake (PGA 0.60 g, permanent displacements of 0.81 m and 1.465 m). Uniform excitation severely underestimates peak and residual demands near the fault. Both equivalent methods closely match the non-uniform benchmark (pier displacement deviations within ±15%, bearing deformations within 3.3%), offering a reliable, shake-table-compatible engineering solution.
跨断层桥梁面临瞬态地面振动与永久断层错动的耦合需求。本研究提出并评估了准静态和动态两种实用等效地震输入框架，将激励分解为无永久位移的均匀动力分量和断层相对位移分量，并通过响应级叠加获取总响应。基于海文大桥六跨简支梁段建立OpenSees三维有限元模型，采用以1992年Landers地震为种子合成的近……

t: Decomposes fault-crossing bridge excitation into uniform dynamic shaking without permanent displacement and fault-induced relative displacement (quasi-static or dynamic), combining their separate OpenSees structural responses via response-level superposition.
将跨断层激励分解为无永久位移均匀振动与断层相对位移，通过OpenSees分别计算并进行响应级叠加。

A 6-span simply supported segment of the Haiwen Bridge modeled in OpenSees, excited by two synthesized near-fault ground motion sets based on the 1992 Landers earthquake (PGA 0.60 g, permanent displacements 0.81 m and 1.465 m).
海文大桥六跨简支梁段模型，输入基于1992年Landers地震合成的两组近断层记录（永久位移0.81 m和1.465 m…

Uniform input severely underestimates near-fault demands, whereas quasi-static and dynamic equivalent inputs match benchmark non-uniform excitation within ±15% for peak pier displacements and 3.3% for bearing deformations, with up to -17.3% deviation in pier torsional moment.
均匀输入严重低估响应；等效方法墩位移偏差在±15%内，支座变形偏差在3.3%内，扭矩最大偏差-17.3%。
Response superposition relies on moderate nonlinearity (elastic piers) and is only evaluated on one simply supported bridge model under two ground-motion scenarios.
叠加法依赖弱非线性假设（弹性桥墩），且仅在单一简支梁桥和两组地震动下验证。

Systematically evaluates response-level superposition of uniform shaking with both quasi-static and time-dependent dynamic fault slip, clarifying the role of fault loading history for shake-table-compatible bridge analysis.
系统评估了均匀振动与准静态及动态断层滑移的响应叠加，明确了加载速率影响并提供单振动台兼容方案。

kc: Formulated and validated quasi-static and dynamic equivalent seismic input frameworks based on response-level superposition of uniform ground motion and fault-induced relative displacement.
Demonstrated that uniform seismic input systematically underestimates peak and residual demands in near-fault piers and bearings.
Showed that fault displacement loading rate has a limited effect under moderate nonlinearity, making quasi-static superposition sufficient for practical engineering and single shaking-table tests.
提出并验证了基于均匀地震动与断层相对位移响应级叠加的准静态和动态等效地震输入框架。
证明了传统均匀地震输入会系统性低估近断层桥墩和支座的峰值与残余地震需求。
揭示了在中等非线性下断层位移加载速率影响有限，准静态叠加即可满足实际工程分析及单振动台试验需求。
me: Conceptual decomposition of total bridge response into dynamic inertial response (uniform motion without permanent displacement) and fault-induced relative displacement deformation.
3D finite element modeling in OpenSees of a six-span simply supported bridge with nonlinear Giuffré-Menegotto-Pinto (Steel02) isolation bearings and elastic piers/girders.
Time-domain synthesis of near-fault ground motions with permanent displacement from the 1992 Landers seed record to match target response spectra and tectonic offsets.
将桥梁总响应概念性分解为无永久位移均匀激励引起的动力惯性响应与断层相对位移引起的变形响应。
在OpenSees中建立包含非线性Steel02隔震支座及弹性主梁/桥墩的六跨简支梁桥三维有限元模型。
以1992年Landers地震记录为种子，在时域内合成匹配目标反应谱和指定永久位移的近断层地震动。
de: Prototype structural design of a six-span simply supported segment (2×58 m + 60 m + 3×58 m) of the Haiwen (Puqian) Bridge in Hainan, China.
Two synthesized cross-fault ground motion scenarios derived from NGA Record No. 879 (1992 Mw 7.3 Landers earthquake) scaled to 0.60 g PGA with 0.81 m and 1.465 m permanent transverse displacements.
中国海南海文（铺前）大桥跨走滑断层的六跨简支梁段（2×58 m + 60 m + 3×58 m）原型结构设计参数。
基于1992年Mw 7.3 Landers地震记录（NGA 879）合成的两组跨断层地震动情景（PGA为0.60 g，横向永久位移分别为0.81 m和1.465 m）。
li: Piers and steel box girders are modeled as linear elastic elements, restricting nonlinearity strictly to the isolation bearings.
Response-level superposition assumes weak coupling and may lose accuracy under severe structural nonlinearity such as pier yielding or large geometric displacements.
Analysis is limited to a single simply supported bridge configuration crossing a perpendicular strike-slip fault under only two ground-motion scenarios.
桥墩和钢箱梁采用线弹性单元建模，结构非线性仅集中在隔震支座。
响应级叠加假设弱耦合，在桥墩屈服或大位移等强非线性情况下适用性可能降低。
研究仅针对正交跨越走滑断层的单一简支梁桥构型及两组合成地震动情景，结论偏向机理导向而非统计规律。

tm.why: The paper evaluates equivalent seismic input frameworks for bridges crossing active faults subjected to strong ground shaking and permanent fault displacement.

ev.notes: Full 23-page accepted manuscript PDF analysed, including all sections (§1–§7), Tables 1–2, and Figures 1–11.

sum: The authors present a new iterative two-step inversion technique to resolve the nodal plane ambiguity of focal mechanisms and estimate heterogeneous site-specific P-wave quality factors (Q_P) using P-wave rise times and pulse widths. Applied to 21 small-magnitude earthquakes (3 <= ML <= 4) from the 2016 Amatrice-Visso-Norcia sequence in Central Italy, the method successfully discriminates the fault plane for 13 events. It reveals a complex system of synthetic and antithetic normal faults striking NNW-SSE, consistent with regional tectonics. The inversion also yields site-specific Q_P values showing that Q_P < Q_S in the region, which matches previous attenuation studies.
本文提出了一种新型迭代两步反演技术，利用P波上升时间和脉冲宽度来解决震源机制解的断层面多解性，并估算非均匀场地P波品质因子（Q_P）。该方法被应用于意大利中部2016年Amatrice-Visso-Norcia序列的21个中小地震（3 <= ML <= 4）。结果成功判定了其中13个地震的断层面，揭……

t: An iterative two-step inversion technique using grid-search for fault radius and background Q, followed by residual perturbation for site-specific Q_P corrections.
采用两步迭代反演技术，先网格搜索断层半径和背景Q，再通过残差扰动计算场地Q_P修正。
P-wave rise times and pulse widths from 21 small earthquakes (3 <= ML <= 4) of the 2016 Amatrice-Visso-Norcia sequence.
来自2016年Amatrice-Visso-Norcia序列21个小地震（3 <= ML <= 4）的P波上升时间和脉冲…
Successfully discriminated the fault plane for 13 events, showing NNW-SSE striking normal faults and confirming Q_P < Q_S.
成功判定了13个事件的断层面，揭示了NNW-SSE走向的正断层，并证实Q_P < Q_S。
Fault plane discrimination was not possible for 8 of the 21 analyzed events.
在分析的21个事件中，有8个事件无法进行断层面判定。
Incorporates a heterogeneous Q_P structure into pulse-width inversion to reduce misfit below the mean data error.
在脉冲宽度反演中引入非均匀Q_P结构，使拟合残差降低至数据平均误差以下。

kc: Developed a two-step inversion method using rise times and pulse widths to resolve nodal plane ambiguity and heterogeneous Q_P.
Successfully discriminated the active fault plane for 13 out of 21 analyzed earthquakes in the Amatrice-Visso-Norcia sequence.
Obtained site-specific Q_P estimates confirming that Q_P < Q_S in the Central Apennines crust.
开发了一种利用上升时间和脉冲宽度的两步反演方法，可同时解决断层面多解性与非均匀Q_P结构。
成功判定了Amatrice-Visso-Norcia序列中21个被分析地震中13个地震的实际破裂断层面。
获得了场地特异性Q_P估算值，证实了中亚平宁地壳中Q_P < Q_S的特征。
me: Grid-search inversion for fault radius and background homogeneous Q.
Residual-based perturbation to compute site-specific Q_P corrections.
F-test statistical analysis to select the best-fitting nodal plane.
网格搜索反演断层半径和背景均匀Q值。
基于残差的扰动法计算各台站的场地特异性Q_P修正值。
F检验统计分析用于筛选最佳拟合断层面。
de: Seismic waveform data from 21 earthquakes (3 <= ML <= 4) of the 2016 Amatrice-Visso-Norcia sequence in Central Italy.
来自意大利中部2016年Amatrice-Visso-Norcia序列的21个中小地震（3 <= ML <= 4）的地震波形数据。
li: The method was unable to confidently discriminate the fault plane for 8 out of the 21 studied events.
在研究的21个地震事件中，该方法无法对其中8个事件的断层面进行高置信度的判定。

tm.why: The paper develops an inversion technique to infer fault plane orientation and fault radius from rise times and pulse widths of earthquakes.
The method simultaneously inverts for a frequency-independent P-wave quality factor (Q_P) at each recording site.

ev.notes: No PDF was available, so the analysis is strictly based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata.

sum: This study investigates the crustal and magmatic architecture beneath Taupō supervolcano in the Taupō Volcanic Zone (TVZ), New Zealand, using P-to-S and S-to-P receiver functions from the 14-station temporary ECLIPSE broadband network (2019–2022). Extended-time multitaper deconvolution, 1-D depth migration, and reflectivity synthetic modeling resolve multiple crustal discontinuities directly beneath Lake Taupō for the first time. Results reveal a shallow positive discontinuity (2–6 km) at the base of volcaniclastic infill, which deepens and broadens (10–16 km) beneath the collapse caldera, marking the base of an upper-crustal silicic mush zone with a maximum estimated volume of ~800 km³. A widespread negative phase (13–24 km) indicates a mid-to-lower crustal partial melt zone (2–10% melt), alongside localized deeper layering (30 km) in the southeast. The Moho deepens from 28–33 km in the northwest to 33–39 km in the southeast, reflecting a balance between extensional rifting and magmatic crustal thickening.
本研究利用ECLIPSE临时宽频带台网（14个台站，2019–2022年）记录的远震数据，通过P-S和S-P接收函数多窗反褶积、深度偏移及反射率法合成波形建模，首次直接对新西兰陶波超火山湖下方的地壳与岩浆结构进行精细成像。研究揭示了2–6 km深度的火山碎屑层底界正相间断面；在破火山口下方该界面加深……

t: Extended-time multitaper deconvolution is applied to compute P-to-S (0.03–1.5 Hz) and S-to-P (0.03–0.5 Hz) receiver functions, migrated using the NZWM 1-D model and validated via reflectivity synthetic forward modeling.
采用延时多窗反褶积计算P-S和S-P接收函数，结合NZWM模型深度偏移与反射率法正演验证。
Teleseismic earthquakes (Mw ≥ 6.0) recorded by 14 broadband stations of the temporary ECLIPSE network around Lake Taupō (2019–2022), yielding 213 P-to-S and 97 S-to-P high-quality receiver functions.
陶波湖周边14个ECLIPSE台站（2019–2022）记录的远震波形，筛选出213条P-S和97条S-P记录。

Imaged a volcanoclastic base (2–6 km), a silicic mush base beneath the caldera (10–16 km, ~800 km³ volume), a mid-crustal negative discontinuity (13–24 km), and a Moho deepening southeastward from 28–33 to 33–39 km.
识别出2–6 km碎屑层、10–16 km晶粥底界（~800 km³）、13–24 km负界面及28–39 km莫霍面。
Strong northwestern back-azimuthal bias limits evaluation of dipping or anisotropic layers, and shallow reverberations may contaminate apparent Moho depths in the northwest.
西北向反方位角偏差限制了各向异性评估，浅层多次波可能干扰西北部视莫霍面深度。
Provides the first direct seismic discontinuity imaging beneath Lake Taupō using the temporary ECLIPSE network, constraining the trans-crustal magma reservoir geometry and mush volume.
首次直接对陶波湖下方进行接收函数间断面成像，约束了穿地壳岩浆房几何形态与体积。

kc: First direct receiver function imaging beneath Lake Taupō and the Young Taupō caldera using the temporary ECLIPSE seismic network.
Constrained the base of the upper-crustal silicic mush zone at 10–16 km depth and estimated a maximum mush volume of ~800 km³ (836 km³ in synthetic modeling).
Identified a widespread mid-crustal negative discontinuity at 13–24 km depth representing the top of a lower-crustal partial melt zone (2–10% melt fraction).
Mapped Moho depth variations deepening from 28–33 km in the northwest to 33–39 km in the south and southeast, supporting a trans-crustal magmatic architecture.
利用ECLIPSE临时地震台网首次直接对陶波湖和年轻陶波破火山口下方的地壳间断面进行接收函数成像。
将上地壳硅质晶粥带的底界约束在10–16 km深度，并通过波形建模估算其最大晶粥体积约为800 km³（模型计算值为836 km³）。
识别出13–24 km深度广泛存在的地壳中部负速度间断面，代表下地壳部分熔融带（熔体比例为2–10%）的顶界。
绘制了莫霍面深度变化图，显示其从西北部的28–33 km加深至南部和东南部的33–39 km，支持穿地壳岩浆系统模型。
me: Extended-time multitaper frequency-domain deconvolution to compute P-to-S (filtered at 0.03–1.5 Hz) and S-to-P (filtered at 0.03–0.5 Hz) receiver functions.
Free-surface transform rotation into theoretical P and S components prior to deconvolution.
Depth migration using a 1-D velocity profile extracted from the New Zealand Wide Velocity Model (NZWM) and Fresnel-zone stacking into 0.035° × 0.035° × 1 km bins.
Reflectivity synthetic seismogram forward modeling and Vp/Vs perturbation (±0.1) error analysis to test layer thicknesses, velocity contrasts, and reverberation artifacts.
应用延时多窗频域反褶积方法计算P-S（0.03–1.5 Hz带通滤波）和S-P（0.03–0.5 Hz带通滤波）接收函数。
在反褶积前使用自由表面变换将三分量波形旋转至理论P波和S波分量。
使用从新西兰广域速度模型（NZWM）提取的一维速度剖面进行深度偏移，并基于菲涅尔带在0.035° × 0.035° × 1 km网格内叠加。
采用反射率法正演合成理论地震图，并通过扰动Vp/Vs（±0.1）进行误差分析，以检验层厚、速度对比度及多次波假象。
de: Teleseismic waveforms from the temporary ECLIPSE network (FDSN code 2B, 14 broadband stations around Lake Taupō) recorded between 2019 and 2022.
P-to-S dataset: 89 unique earthquakes (Mw ≥ 6.0, epicentral distance 35–80°), yielding 213 high-quality receiver functions after manual quality control.
S-to-P dataset: 78 unique earthquakes (Mw ≥ 6.0, epicentral distance 55–80°), yielding 97 high-quality receiver functions stacked at northwestern and southeastern caldera edges.
Synthetic reflectivity forward modeling experiments at four representative structural locations (Points W, X, Y, Z).
2019至2022年间环绕陶波湖布设的ECLIPSE临时台网（FDSN代码2B，含14个宽频带台站）记录的远震波形数据。
P-S数据集：89个独立远震事件（Mw ≥ 6.0，震中距35–80°），经人工质量控制后保留213条高质量接收函数记录。
S-P数据集：78个独立远震事件（Mw ≥ 6.0，震中距55–80°），筛选出97条高质量接收函数并在破火山口西北和东南缘进行叠加。
在四个代表性构造位置（W、X、Y、Z点）开展的反射率法合成接收函数正演建模实验。
li: Strong back-azimuthal bias (majority of events from the northwest, 270–360°) prevents full assessment of dipping layers and seismic anisotropy.
Cannot completely rule out reverberation contamination from the shallow volcaniclastic layer affecting apparent Moho depths in the northwest.
Vertical resolution limits prevent resolving separate phases for the base of the volcaniclastic layer and the base of the mush zone directly beneath Young Taupō.
震源反方位角分布严重偏向西北方向（270–360°），无法全面评估倾斜界面和地震各向异性的影响。
在研究区西北部，无法完全排除浅部火山碎屑层产生的多次波对视莫霍面深度的干扰。
受垂向分辨率限制，在年轻陶波破火山口正下方无法将火山碎屑层底界与更深的晶粥带底界完全区分为两个独立震相。

tm.why: The paper applies P-to-S and S-to-P receiver function analysis, migration, and synthetic waveform modeling to image crustal and Moho discontinuities.
The primary goal is to investigate the trans-crustal magma reservoir, silicic mush zone, and volcanic debris layer beneath Taupō supervolcano.
The study maps Moho depth variations (28-39 km) across the Taupō Volcanic Zone and interprets competing rifting thinning and magmatic thickening processes.

ev.notes: Full 18-page PDF provided and analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§5), and all 8 figures.

sum: Surface-rupturing earthquakes record fault segmentation and slip distribution in the landscape, but surface processes degrade these features over time. Using 0.5 m/pix post-earthquake lidar DEMs from the 2019 Ridgecrest and 2010 El Mayor-Cucapah ruptures, the authors simulate landscape degradation over 100, 1k, 5k, and 10k years using 2D linear diffusion (transport rate 1 m²/kyr) in Landlab, supplemented by 2024 UAV/SfM field validation at Ridgecrest. They quantify information loss via mappable fault trace length, fault zone width, and a 68th-percentile slope change degradation coefficient. After 10k years, 20–80% of original fault trace length remains and mean fault zone width shrinks from ~30–40 m to ~2–7 m, with fastest degradation in the first 100 years. Simple single-strand faults retain more mappable length than complex multi-strand zones. This novel 2D quantification demonstrates that degraded fault maps systematically underestimate rupture width and distributed deformation, directly informing probabilistic fault displacement hazard models.
地表破裂型地震在地貌中记录了断层分段与滑移分布，但地表过程会随时间抹去这些特征。本文利用2019年Ridgecrest和2010年El Mayor-Cucapah地震的0.5米分辨率震后激光雷达DEM，在Landlab中采用二维线性扩散模型（输运率1 m²/kyr）模拟了100至1万年间的地貌退化，……

t: 2D linear diffusion modeling in Landlab with diffusivity k = 1 m²/kyr over 0 to 10,000 years, paired with reverse-chronological geomorphologic fault trace mapping in QGIS.
利用Landlab进行0至1万年的二维线性扩散模拟（k=1 m²/kyr），并在QGIS中按时间逆序进行断层测绘。
0.5 m/pix lidar DEMs (~120x140 m clips) at 20 sites from the 2019 Ridgecrest and 2010 El Mayor-Cucapah ruptures, plus a 2024 0.014 m/pix UAV SfM DEM at Ridgecrest.
2019年Ridgecrest和2010年El Mayor-Cucapah破裂20个场地的0.5米激光雷达DEM，及20…
After 10,000 years, 20–80% of initial fault trace length remains (72% for simple traces vs 23% for complex), and mean fault zone width narrows from ~30–40 m to ~2–7 m.
1万年后保留20%–80%原始断层迹线长度，平均断层带宽度从30–40米缩减至约2–7米，前100年退化最快。
Diffusing the entire DEM smooths non-tectonic roughness (bushes, boulders), which biases the 68th-percentile slope degradation coefficient φ and reduces sensitivity to small scarps.
对整个DEM进行扩散会平滑灌木和巨石等非构造粗糙度，导致坡度变化系数产生偏差并降低对小陡坎的敏感性。
Applies 2D (rather than 1D profile) landscape evolution modeling to post-earthquake lidar DEMs to quantify along-strike continuity, distributed fracture erasure, and fault zone narrowing.
将二维（而非一维剖面）地貌演化模型应用于震后激光雷达DEM，量化了分布式破裂擦除与断层带变窄过程。

kc: Quantified earthquake surface rupture erasure over 10,000 years across 20 desert sites using 2D linear diffusion models on post-earthquake lidar DEMs.
Demonstrated that 20–80% of original fault trace length remains after 10 kyr while mean fault zone width narrows dramatically from ~30–40 m to ~2–7 m.
Introduced a topographic slope change coefficient (ratio of 68th percentile slopes) alongside systematic geomorphologic fault mapping to track degradation.
Validated early-stage scarp and distributed fracture degradation using a 0.014 m/pix UAV Structure-from-Motion DEM collected 4.5 years after the 2019 Ridgecrest earthquake.
利用震后激光雷达DEM的二维线性扩散模型，量化了20个沙漠场地在1万年间地震地表破裂的擦除过程。
证明1万年后仍保留20%–80%的原始断层迹线长度，而平均断层带宽度从约30–40米急剧缩减至约2–7米。
提出了地形坡度变化系数（第68百分位坡度之比），并结合系统的地貌断层测绘方法来追踪退化状态。
利用2019年Ridgecrest地震4.5年后采集的0.014米/像素无人机运动恢复结构（SfM）DEM，验证了早期陡坎和分布式裂缝的退化。
me: 2D linear and nonlinear hillslope diffusion modeling implemented in the Landlab toolkit with a diffusivity k = 1 m²/kyr over 0, 100, 1000, 5000, and 10000 years.
Systematic geomorphology-based fault trace mapping in QGIS conducted reverse-chronologically (from most to least diffused DEMs) to minimize prior-knowledge bias.
Statistical fitting of temporal evolution curves for the 68th-percentile slope degradation coefficient (φ), remaining mappable fault length, and maximum fault zone width.
Synthetic scarp diffusion experiments incorporating stochastic surface noise renewal to evaluate vegetation and non-tectonic roughness biases.
在Landlab工具包中实施二维线性和非线性山坡扩散模拟，扩散率k = 1 m²/kyr，时间步长为0、100、1000、5000和10000年。
在QGIS中按时间逆序（从扩散最严重到最轻微的DEM）进行系统的基于地貌的断层迹线测绘，以最小化先验知识偏差。
对第68百分位坡度退化系数（φ）、剩余可测绘断层长度和最大断层带宽度的时间演化曲线进行统计拟合。
开展包含随机地表噪声更新的合成陡坎扩散实验，以评估植被和非构造粗糙度偏差。
de: 0.5 m/pix post-earthquake airborne lidar DEMs from 10 sites along the 2019 Mw 7.1 and 6.4 Ridgecrest ruptures and 10 sites along the 2010 Mw 7.2 El Mayor-Cucapah rupture (~120 x 140 m clips).
High-resolution 0.014 m/pix UAV Structure-from-Motion (SfM) DEM and field observations collected in April 2024 along the 2019 Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest rupture.
Published coseismic surface rupture line shapefiles from the 2019 Ridgecrest, 2010 El Mayor-Cucapah, and 1892 Laguna Salada earthquakes.
Synthetic DEMs with 1 to 5 m high central scarps subjected to linear diffusion with and without 1% amplitude random noise renewal.
2019年Mw 7.1和6.4 Ridgecrest破裂沿线10个场地及2010年Mw 7.2 El Mayor-Cucapah破裂沿线10个场地的0.5米/像素震后机载激光雷达DEM（约120 x 140米裁剪区）。
2024年4月沿2019年Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest破裂采集的高分辨率0.014米/像素无人机运动恢复结构（SfM）DEM及野外考察数据。
已发表的2019年Ridgecrest、2010年El Mayor-Cucapah和1892年Laguna Salada地震同震地表破裂线矢量文件。
包含1至5米高中央陡坎的合成DEM，用于开展包含和不包含1%振幅随机噪声更新的线性扩散实验。
li: The 2D linear diffusion model neglects runoff-driven erosion, fluvial channel responses, debris flows, and nonlocal particle transport like ravel and sheetwash.
The slope change coefficient (φ) is calculated across the entire DEM, making it sensitive to non-tectonic roughness (bushes, boulders) and less sensitive to small scarps.
Linear diffusion is less appropriate for early-stage degradation of tall, steep normal fault scarps where nonlinear soil flux dominates.
二维线性扩散模型忽略了径流驱动的侵蚀、河道响应、泥石流以及崩落和片流等非局域颗粒输运过程。
坡度变化系数（φ）在整个DEM上计算，因此对非构造粗糙度（灌木、巨石）敏感，而对小陡坎不够敏感。
线性扩散不太适合高大陡峭正断层陡坎的早期退化阶段，该阶段以非线性土壤通量为主。

tm.why: The paper explicitly aims to provide quantitative constraints on landform degradation to inform probabilistic fault displacement hazard analysis (PFDHA) and seismic hazard assessments.
It investigates surface fault zone structure, trace complexity, distributed deformation, and fault zone width evolution following surface-rupturing earthquakes.

ev.notes: Full text and all 10 figures from the 17-page Seismica PDF were analyzed in detail.

sum: Earthquake doublets have puzzled seismologists for decades regarding whether they are simply large aftershocks or result from distinct physical mechanisms. Analyzing over 2,000 M≥6 doublets from the gCMT catalog across 12 major subduction zones, this study demonstrates that doublets universally follow Omori-type aftershock decay lasting 2.5 to 5 months before merging into background seismicity. However, the Solomon-Vanuatu trench produces half of the world's doublets—ten times the average of other trenches—and exhibits a low corner magnitude of M~7.8. Using statistical catalog analysis, tapered Gutenberg-Richter fitting, and Coulomb stress modeling, the authors show that abundant near-vertical tear faults in the slab and forearc promote doublets via efficient static stress transfer with the megathrust interface. Simultaneously, these tear faults segment the megathrust, hampering great (M≥8) earthquake propagation. This reveals how structural complexity mediates both doublet fertility and maximum earthquake size.
本研究分析了全球12个主要俯冲带gCMT目录中2000余对M≥6双震，探讨其成因机制。结合余震序列模拟（ETAS等）、截断古登堡-里克特分布拟合及库仑应力计算，发现所有俯冲带双震均遵循大森衰减（持续2.5-5个月），但所罗门-瓦努阿图海沟产生了全球一半的双震（其他海沟均值的10倍），且角震级偏低（M……

t: The authors extract M≥6 doublets from the gCMT catalog within Slab2 contours, model temporal decay with Reasenberg-Jones and ETAS simulations, fit tapered Gutenberg-Richter distributions via maximum likelihood, and compute Coulomb stress changes.
从gCMT目录提取12个俯冲带M≥6双震，结合ETAS余震模拟、截断G-R分布最大似然拟合及库仑应力传递计算。

Over 2,000 M≥6.0 earthquake doublets since 1976 from the Global Centroid Moment Tensor (gCMT) catalog across 12 major subduction zones, supplemented by Slab2 geometry, GEM historical records, and NOAA tsunami data.
1976年以来全球12个俯冲带2000余对M≥6.0双震的gCMT目录，辅以Slab2模型、GEM历史目录及海啸数据。

All subduction doublets undergo Omori decay for 2.5–5.0 months. Solomon-Vanuatu produces 10 times the average doublet rate, 29 times more thrust–strike-slip doublets, and has a low corner magnitude of M 7.8.
双震普遍呈2.5-5个月的大森衰减；所罗门-瓦努阿图双震率高出均值10倍，逆冲-走滑双震高29倍，角震级低至7.8。

Most tear faults lack bathymetric expression or are blind, preventing direct counting or spatial doublet forecasting; furthermore, instrumental tsunami and earthquake records are relatively short (50 years).
多数撕裂断层位置未知或隐伏，难以直接统计或预测双震位置；且现代地震与海啸仪器记录仅约50年。

Reconciles the 50-year debate on earthquake doublets by proving they are an universal Omori process whose extreme regional abundance and coupled low corner magnitude are mediated by megathrust-tear fault interactions.
调和了50年来的双震争论，证实双震遵循普遍的大森过程，而撕裂断层与巨型逆冲断层互馈控制了高双震率与低角震级。

kc: Demonstrated that subduction zone earthquake doublets universally obey Omori decay over 2.5–5.0 months before blending into coincidental background rates.
Showed that the Solomon-Vanuatu trench generates 10 times more doublets than the average of other trenches, which cannot be explained solely by its higher seismicity rate.
Linked high doublet rates and low corner magnitudes (M 7.8 in Solomon-Vanuatu) to abundant slab and forearc tear faults that segment the megathrust and efficiently transfer Coulomb stress.
证明俯冲带双震普遍遵循大森衰减规律，在2.5至5个月内衰减至背景巧合双震率。
揭示所罗门-瓦努阿图海沟的双震率是其他海沟平均值的10倍，证明其并非单纯由高地震活动率引起。
将高双震率与低角震级（M 7.8）归因于丰富的板片和前弧撕裂断层，它们不仅高效传递库仑应力，还分割巨型逆冲断层以限制巨震破裂。
me: Systematic space-time-magnitude filtering of the gCMT catalog within Slab2 geometries to identify M≥6 doublet pairs across 12 subduction zones.
Synthetic doublet time-series modeling combining Reasenberg-Jones / ETAS aftershock decay models with Poissonian background rates from GEAR1.
Maximum-likelihood estimation of b-values and corner magnitudes using standard and tapered Gutenberg-Richter distributions.
Static Coulomb stress transfer modeling (Coulomb 4.0) using USGS finite-fault models and idealized orthogonal megathrust-tear fault geometries.
基于Slab2几何模型对12个俯冲带的gCMT目录进行时空震级筛选，识别M≥6双震对。
结合Reasenberg-Jones/ETAS余震衰减模型与GEAR1泊松背景率，开展合成双震时间序列模拟。
采用最大似然法拟合标准和截断古登堡-里克特分布，估算b值与角震级。
利用USGS有限断层模型和理想正交巨型逆冲-撕裂断层几何模型，通过Coulomb 4.0计算静态库仑应力传递。
de: Global Centroid Moment Tensor (gCMT) catalog for M≥6.0 earthquakes since 1976 across 12 major subduction zones.
GEM Global Historical Earthquake Catalog extending back to 1863 and NOAA NCEI tsunami records.
Coulomb stress transfer experiments on historical sequences (2000 New Ireland M 8.0-7.8 and 2010-2024 Vanuatu sequences) and idealized fault pairs.
1976年以来全球12个主要俯冲带M≥6.0地震的全球矩心矩张量（gCMT）目录。
追溯至1863年的GEM全球历史地震目录及NOAA NCEI海啸记录。
针对历史序列（2000年新爱尔兰和2010-2024年瓦努阿图序列）及理想断层对的库仑应力传递实验。
li: The locations of most tear faults are blind, deep within the slab, or covered by sediments, making it difficult to count them directly or forecast specific future doublets.
The 50-year instrumental catalog and uncertain pre-instrumental historical records limit definitive proof of long-term corner magnitudes and tsunami hazard levels.
大多数撕裂断层为隐伏断层、位于板片深部或被沉积物覆盖，难以直接统计其数量或预测特定未来双震的位置。
50年的现代仪器目录和不确定的历史地震记录限制了对长期角震级和海啸危险性水平的绝对确证。

tm.why: The paper analyzes earthquake doublet triggering, Coulomb stress transfer between megathrusts and tear faults, and structural controls on rupture containment and corner magnitude.
It investigates static Coulomb stress interactions between subduction megathrust interfaces and orthogonal near-vertical tear faults in the slab and forearc.
The core analysis relies on statistical evaluation of global earthquake catalogs (gCMT), Omori decay, ETAS modeling, and tapered Gutenberg-Richter distributions across 12 subduction zones.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete provided PDF manuscript text, including main sections, methods, references, figure captions (Figs. 1–8), and Table 1.

sum: This is a formal correction notice for the paper 'Sedimentary structures of the western part of the Indo-Gangetic Plain and Siwalik Himalaya inferred from receiver function inversion'. It addresses errors in the original publication to ensure scientific accuracy regarding the sedimentary and crustal structure models derived from receiver function inversion in the Himalayan region.
该文献是针对《通过接收函数反演推断印度-恒河平原西部和西瓦利克喜马拉雅的沉积结构》一文的正式勘误通知。它修正了原出版物中的错误，以确保该地区接收函数反演所得沉积与地壳结构模型的科学准确性。

t: Receiver function inversion applied to image sedimentary and crustal structures.
应用接收函数反演来成像沉积和地壳结构。
Teleseismic earthquake waveforms recorded across the Indo-Gangetic Plain and Siwalik Himalaya.
在印度-恒河平原和西瓦利克喜马拉雅记录到的远震地震波形。
Correction of specific parameters or figures in the original sedimentary structure models.

仅限于纠正先前发表论文中的错误。
Provides the necessary corrections to maintain the scientific integrity of the original study.

纠正了原出版物中关于印度-恒河平原沉积结构模型的相关错误。

sum: This study presents a new 3D crustal velocity model for a 4° × 4° region in the northwestern Himalayas and Siwalik basin, incorporating regional geological heterogeneity. The model was constructed by compiling 423 1D velocity-depth profiles from five previous crustal studies and interpolating them using kriging. After validation against three historical earthquakes, the model was used to perform 25 physics-based rupture simulations of the 1905 Mw ~7.8 Kangra earthquake, accounting for source geometry and slip uncertainties. The simulations reveal significant basin amplification, with peak ground velocities reaching 100 cm/s and spectral accelerations up to 0.2g at 2–3 s periods in the Siwalik basin, demonstrating the model's utility for regional seismic hazard assessment.
本研究构建了西北喜马拉雅及西瓦利克盆地4°×4°区域的新型三维地壳速度模型。该模型整合了5项地壳研究中的423个一维速度-深度剖面，并通过克里金插值法进行构建。在利用三次历史地震记录进行验证后，研究对1905年康格拉地震开展了25次基于物理的破裂情景模拟，考虑了震源几何与滑移分布的不确定性。结果表明……

t: Development of a 3D crustal velocity model using kriging spatial interpolation of 423 compiled 1D velocity-depth profiles, followed by physics-based 3D ground-motion simulations.
对汇编的423个一维速度-深度剖面进行克里金空间插值构建三维模型，并进行基于物理的地面运动模拟。
A comprehensive dataset of 423 1D velocity-depth profiles from five crustal studies, along with seismic records from three regional earthquakes (Mw 4.1 to 5.54) for validation.
包含来自五项研究的423个一维速度剖面，以及用于验证的三次区域地震（Mw 4.1-5.54）的波形数据。
Rupture simulations of the 1905 Kangra earthquake show mean peak ground velocities up to 100 cm/s and spectral accelerations up to 0.2g at 2-3 s periods in the Siwalik basin.
1905年康格拉地震模拟表明，西瓦利克盆地平均峰值地面速度达100 cm/s，2-3秒周期谱加速度达0.2g。
The model's accuracy is dependent on the spatial density of the 423 compiled 1D profiles and simplified representation of complex basin geometries.
模型精度受限于所收集的一维速度剖面的空间分布密度及盆地几何的简化。
First regional 3D velocity model for this part of the Himalayas integrating multiple 1D datasets, validated and applied to 1905 Kangra earthquake scenario simulations.
首次整合多源一维数据构建该区域三维速度模型，并应用于1905年康格拉大地震的情景模拟。

kc: Developed a new 3D crustal velocity model for the northwestern Himalayas and Siwalik basin using kriging interpolation.
Compiled a comprehensive dataset of 423 1D velocity-depth profiles from five prior crustal investigation studies.
Validated the 3D model against recorded waveform data from three historical regional earthquakes.
Conducted 25 physics-based rupture simulations of the 1905 Kangra earthquake to quantify ground-motion hazards and basin amplification.
利用克里金插值法构建了西北喜马拉雅和西瓦利克盆地的新型三维地壳速度模型。
汇编了来自五项前期地壳调查研究的423个一维速度-深度剖面的综合数据集。
利用三次历史区域地震的记录波形数据对该三维模型进行了验证。
对1905年康格拉地震进行了25次基于物理的破裂模拟，以量化地面运动灾害和盆地放大效应。
me: Kriging spatial interpolation to merge 1D velocity profiles into a coherent 3D model.
Physics-based 3D ground-motion simulation incorporating source geometry and slip distribution uncertainties.
采用克里金空间插值方法将一维速度剖面融合为统一的三维模型。
结合震源几何和滑移分布不确定性，进行基于物理的三维地面运动模拟。

Waveform data from the 1986 Mw 5.54 Dharamshala, 2009 Mw 4.7 Uttarkashi, and 2020 Mw 4.1 earthquakes for validation.
25 scenario earthquake simulations of the 1905 Kangra earthquake.
来自五项地壳研究的423个一维速度-深度剖面数据集。
用于模型验证的1986年Mw 5.54达兰萨拉地震、2009年Mw 4.7乌塔尔卡希地震及2020年Mw 4.1地震的波形数据。
针对1905年康格拉地震的25次情景地震模拟。

sum: This study applies a Conditional Variational Auto-Encoder (CVAE) to 28,393 high-frequency vertical-component coda wave envelopes from the eastern margin of the Tibetan Plateau. By conditioning on epicentral distance, the CVAE extracts two latent variables representing intrinsic-like decay and scattering-like broadening. Spatial mapping reveals low intrinsic attenuation in the stable Sichuan Basin and high attenuation in the active Tibetan Plateau, while scattering effects correlate with sedimentary cover and fault fracturing. Synthetic tests confirm that CVAE successfully extracts physically interpretable, attenuation-related patterns from large seismic datasets.
本研究将条件变分自编码器（CVAE）应用于青藏高原东缘的28,393个高频垂直向尾波包络线。通过以震中距为条件，CVAE提取出两个潜在变量，分别表征与固有衰减相关的衰减行为和与散射相关的包络展宽。空间分布显示，四川盆地呈低固有衰减，而活动青藏高原呈高衰减；散射效应则与盆地沉积覆盖及高原断裂带相关。合……

t: A Conditional Variational Auto-Encoder (CVAE) conditioned on epicentral distance is used to extract latent variables from high-frequency coda wave envelopes.
利用以震中距为条件的条件变分自编码器（CVAE）从高频尾波包络线中提取潜在变量。
The dataset consists of 28,393 high-frequency, vertical-component coda wave envelopes from the eastern margin of the Tibetan Plateau, supplemented by synthetic test data.
使用青藏高原东缘记录的28,393个高频垂直向尾波包络线，并结合合成测试数据。
The CVAE extracted two latent variables representing intrinsic-like decay and scattering-like broadening, showing spatial patterns consistent with the stable Sichuan Basin and active Tibetan Plateau.
提取出代表固有衰减和散射展宽的两个潜在变量，其空间分布与四川盆地和青藏高原特征一致。
The latent variables show cross-sensitivities, meaning the method extracts attenuation-related features rather than directly decoupling intrinsic and scattering parameters.
潜在变量之间存在交叉敏感性，该方法提取的是衰减相关特征而非直接完全解耦物理参数。
Using a CVAE to isolate distance effects and extract physically interpretable, coupled attenuation features from large-scale coda wave envelope datasets.
利用CVAE隔离震中距影响，从大规模尾波包络数据中提取出具有物理可解释性的衰减特征。

kc: Applied a Conditional Variational Auto-Encoder (CVAE) to isolate distance-independent coda envelope features.
Extracted two latent variables that qualitatively map to intrinsic attenuation and scattering-related broadening.
Mapped the spatial variations of these attenuation features across the transition from the Sichuan Basin to the Tibetan Plateau.
应用条件变分自编码器（CVAE）隔离了与震中距无关的尾波包络特征。
提取出两个潜在变量，分别定性对应于固有衰减和与散射相关的包络展宽。
绘制了四川盆地向青藏高原过渡带上这些衰减特征的空间变化图。
me: Conditional Variational Auto-Encoder (CVAE) conditioning on epicentral distance.
Coda wave envelope analysis of high-frequency (> 1Hz) vertical-component seismograms.
Synthetic data testing to evaluate latent variable cross-sensitivity and physical interpretation.
以震中距为条件约束的条件变分自编码器（CVAE）。
高频（> 1Hz）垂直向地震记录的尾波包络分析。
用于评估潜在变量交叉敏感性与物理可解释性的合成数据测试。
de: Dataset of 28,393 high-frequency, vertical-component coda wave envelopes recorded across the eastern margin of the Tibetan Plateau.
Synthetic coda envelope dataset generated to validate the physical meaning of the CVAE latent variables.
青藏高原东缘记录的28,393个高频垂直向尾波包络线数据集。
用于验证CVAE潜在变量物理意义的合成尾波包络数据集。
li: The extracted latent variables exhibit some cross-sensitivities rather than achieving perfect decoupling of intrinsic and scattering attenuation parameters.
提取的潜在变量存在一定的交叉敏感性，未能实现固有衰减和散射衰减参数的完美解耦。

tm.why: The paper focuses on extracting attenuation-related envelope features from high-frequency coda waves.
The study applies a Conditional Variational Auto-Encoder (CVAE) to extract latent variables from coda wave envelopes.

sum: Establishing a baseline seismic catalog for offshore CO2 storage at the Horda Platform (Norwegian North Sea) is difficult using only land stations due to poor azimuthal coverage. This study integrates one year of continuous data (October 2021–September 2022) from three broadband ocean-bottom seismometers (OBSs) with onshore networks. Ambient noise cross-correlations verified linear OBS clock drift and revealed slow (250–500 m/s), high-amplitude Scholte waves modeled as propagating through poorly consolidated near-seafloor sediments (VP/VS ≈ 3.0). Applying EQTransformer with manual verification added 154 natural events and lowered the catalog magnitude of completeness from 1.1 to 0.8. Bayesian hierarchical relocation (Bayesloc) accounted for offshore-onshore path heterogeneity and reduced horizontal and depth location uncertainties by 30% and 26%, respectively. While no events occurred inside the Aurora storage license, newly detected scattered offshore microseismicity north of the Horda Platform provides an essential baseline prior to CO2 injection.
为给挪威北海Horda平台CO2封存项目建立基线地震目录，本研究将2021年10月至2022年9月布设的3台宽频带海底地震仪（OBS）与陆地台网结合。利用背景噪声互相关验证了OBS线性钟差，并发现群速度250–500 m/s的Scholte波，正演表明其源于海底高波速比（VP/VS≈3.0）的松散沉……

结合背景噪声互相关钟差验证与面波分析、EQTransformer深度学习拾取及Bayesloc贝叶斯分层重定位。

Three broadband OBSs deployed at 280–316 m depth near the Aurora CO2 license (Oct 2021–Sept 2022) integrated with onshore stations from NNSN, NORSAR, HNAR, and Shetland, plus 14 calibration air-gun shots.
Aurora碳封存区3台宽频带OBS一年连续观测数据、挪威及周边陆地台网数据，以及14次气枪定向信号。

Combining OBS and land data added 154 events, lowered Mc from 1.1 to 0.8, and reduced horizontal and depth errors by 30% and 26%; EGFs revealed 250–500 m/s Scholte waves requiring shallow VP/VS ≈ 3.0.

Higher seafloor noise levels (up to 20 dB above land stations at 10 Hz) due to shallow water and thick sediments limit standalone OBS detection, and the 1-year deployment cannot capture long-term changes.

First broadband OBS passive monitoring deployment in the Horda Platform region, combining ML detection, Bayesian relocation, and Scholte-wave sediment characterization to establish a pre-injection baseline for the Aurora CO2 site.
首次在Horda平台开展宽频带OBS被动源监测，融合深度学习检测、贝叶斯定位与Scholte波浅层结构表征。

Identified prominent Scholte waves (250–500 m/s) in OBS ambient noise cross-correlations, constraining shallow poorly consolidated marine sediments with VP/VS ≈ 3.0.

The entire study is designed to establish baseline seismicity monitoring in preparation for offshore CO2 storage at the Aurora site on the Horda Platform.

sum: Surface-wave dispersion analysis is widely used for near-surface geotechnical characterization, yet higher modes are often obscured by noise or overwhelmed by the dominant fundamental mode. Standard supervirtual interferometry (SVI) boosts only the strongest arrival, diminishing weaker modes when applied iteratively. This study adapts iterative SVI for surface waves by using cross-coherence instead of cross-correlation, applying offset windowing, and subtracting each iteration's SVI output from the input data via least-squares adaptive subtraction before feeding the remainder into the next iteration. All iteration outputs are then summed. Tested on a 2D finite-difference synthetic dataset and two active-source field datasets (the Dutch SCAN dataset and a noisy South Dakota dataset), the method significantly increases the signal-to-noise ratio and broadens the frequency band over which both fundamental and higher modes can be picked, while restoring shots previously unusable due to secondary events.
面波频散分析常用于近地表工程勘察，但高阶模式易受噪声干扰或被基阶模式掩盖。传统迭代超虚拟干涉测量（SVI）仅放大最强事件，会削弱较弱的高阶模式。本文提出一种改进的迭代SVI方法：采用互相关相干代替互相关、限制偏移距范围，并通过最小二乘自适应减法从输入数据中减去每次SVI的输出，将残差作为下一次迭代的……

t: Iterative SVI using cross-coherence and offset windowing, where each iteration's SVI output is removed from the input via global least-squares adaptive subtraction (15-sample filter), and the residual is fed into the next iteration before summing all outputs.
采用互相关相干和偏移距限制的迭代SVI，通过全局最小二乘减法提取残差作为下次迭代输入，最后叠加结果。

Evaluated on three datasets: a 2D elastic finite-difference synthetic dataset with two welded layer stacks and 10% Gaussian noise, a 302-shot subset of the Dutch SCAN line, and a noisy 517-shot South Dakota glacial-valley dataset.
使用含10%高斯噪声的二维合成数据、荷兰SCAN项目302炮子集及南达科他州冰川谷517炮高噪数据。

The first iteration strongly boosts SNR and dominant modes; subsequent iterations on synthetic data reveal the first higher mode (12–20 Hz) and second higher mode (23–30 Hz), while combined iterations broaden pickable dispersion bands across all datasets.
首次迭代显著提升信噪比；后续迭代在合成数据中清晰分离出12–20 Hz一阶和23–30 Hz二阶高阶面波。

SVI cannot completely isolate single modes, suffers from inter-mode correlation crosstalk, and turns large noise spikes or Gaussian noise into sloping spurious events and traveltime-increasing noise gradients.
无法完全分离单一模式，存在模式间交叉项串扰，且强尖峰或高斯噪声会产生倾斜伪影和走时噪声梯度。
Adapts iterative SVI for multimodal surface waves by feeding the adaptively subtracted data remainder—rather than the direct SVI output—into subsequent iterations to recover weaker higher modes.
将自适应减法后的残差而非直接输出输入后续SVI迭代，从而在增强面波信噪比的同时提取微弱高阶模式。

kc: Adapted iterative SVI workflow that feeds the least-squares subtracted data remainder (rather than the direct output) into subsequent iterations to enhance weaker surface-wave higher modes.
Incorporated cross-coherence and data-dependent minimum/maximum offset constraints to stabilize SVI and mitigate near-field and attenuation artifacts.
Demonstrated on synthetic and two contrasting field datasets that the combined iterations improve SNR, broaden pickable dispersion frequency bands, and recover corrupted shots.
改进了迭代SVI工作流，将最小二乘自适应减法后的数据残差（而非直接输出）输入后续迭代，从而增强较弱的面波高阶模式。
引入互相关相干（cross-coherence）以及依赖于数据的最小/最大偏移距限制，以稳定SVI结果并减轻近场和衰减伪影。
通过合成数据和两个野外数据集验证了叠加多次迭代结果能提高信噪比、拓宽频散曲线可拾取频带并恢复受污染的炮集。
me: Iterative supervirtual interferometry (SVI) combining cross-coherence (step 1) and convolution (step 2).
Global least-squares adaptive subtraction using a 15-sample filter length to separate dominant modes from residual wavefields between iterations.
Spatial Hamming windowing and frequency-domain beamforming to compute phase velocity–frequency dispersion spectra.
结合互相关相干（第一步）与褶积（第二步）的迭代超虚拟干涉测量（SVI）。
使用15个采样点长度的滤波器进行全局最小二乘自适应减法，在迭代间分离优势模式与残余波场。
采用空间汉明窗和频域波束形成方法计算相速度-频率频散谱。
de: 2D elastic finite-difference synthetic dataset (51 shots, 250 receivers, 10% Gaussian noise) featuring a lateral contact and a high-velocity surface layer to excite higher modes.
Dutch SCAN geothermal exploration subset (302 shots at 25 m spacing, 1500 receivers, 100 Hz sampling) dominated by fundamental-mode surface waves in a sandy near-surface.
Noisy onshore 'Farm' dataset from a glacial valley in South Dakota, USA (517 interleaved shots, 3 m geophone spacing) with strong refracted/air waves and glacial sediment over limestone.
二维弹性有限差分合成数据集（51炮，250个检波器，含10%高斯噪声），包含横向接触带和激发高阶模式的表层高速层。
荷兰SCAN地热勘探子数据集（302炮，炮距25米，1500个检波器，100 Hz采样），近地表为砂层，以基阶面波为主。
美国南达科他州冰川谷高噪声“Farm”陆上数据集（517炮，检波器间距3米），存在灰岩上覆冰川沉积物结构及强折射波/空气波干扰。
li: Strong random noise or amplitude spikes generate acausal spurious events sloping away from the source and a linear noise gradient over traveltime.
Interferometric cross-terms (crosstalk) between closely spaced surface-wave modes can bias dispersion picks in later iterations.
When random noise is very high, SVI fails to accurately isolate the dominant mode in the first iteration, preventing extraction of weaker higher modes in subsequent iterations.
强随机噪声或振幅尖峰会产生向远离震源方向倾斜的非因果虚假事件，并导致噪声随走时呈线性梯度增加。
相近面波模式之间的干涉交叉项（串扰）会在后续迭代中使频散拾取产生偏差。
当随机噪声极高时，SVI无法在首次迭代中准确分离优势模式，导致后续迭代无法提取较弱的高阶模式。

tm.why: The core methodology adapts iterative supervirtual seismic interferometry (cross-coherence and convolution) to enhance surface-wave modes.
The paper focuses on extracting fundamental and higher-mode surface-wave dispersion curves for near-surface shear-wave velocity characterization.

sum: This study investigates the temporal variations of shallow subsurface seismic velocity associated with the 2021 Ms 6.4 Yangbi earthquake in Yunnan, China. By applying deconvolution interferometry to continuous ambient noise and earthquake records, the authors extract stable reflection phases to track coseismic velocity drops and subsequent postseismic recovery. The results reveal complex, localized patterns of velocity changes that reflect stress perturbation, damage, and healing processes within the shallow crust and fault zone.
本研究探讨了2021年云南漾濞Ms 6.4级地震相关的浅表地震波速度随时间的变化。作者对连续背景噪声和地震记录应用反褶积干涉法，提取稳定的反射相，以追踪同震速度下降及随后的震后恢复。结果揭示了复杂且局部的速度变化特征，反映了浅部地壳和断裂带内的应力扰动、介质损伤及愈合过程。

Continuous seismic waveform data spanning the period before, during, and after the 2021 Ms 6.4 Yangbi earthquake.
跨越2021年漾濞Ms 6.4级地震前、中、后时段的连续地震波形数据。
Detection of complex coseismic velocity drops and postseismic recovery patterns in the shallow subsurface near the fault zone.
检测到断裂带附近浅表复杂的同震速度下降和震后恢复模式。
Potential sensitivity to environmental factors and localized station coverage limitations.
可能对环境因素敏感，且受限于局部的台站覆盖范围。
Application of deconvolved autocorrelations to resolve high-resolution temporal variations of shallow velocity during a major earthquake sequence.
应用反褶积自相关方法解析大震序列期间浅部速度的高分辨率时间变化。

将观测到的速度变化与断裂带损伤及应力释放等物理过程联系起来。

Deconvolution analysis of continuous ambient noise and earthquake waveforms to isolate shallow reflections.
Monitoring of relative velocity changes (dv/v) over time.
利用单台自相关的地震干涉测量法。
对连续背景噪声和地震波形进行反褶积分析以提取浅部反射波。
监测相对速度随时间的变化（dv/v）。

2021年漾濞Ms 6.4级地震震源区周围记录的连续地震波形数据。

sum: This study presents a passive Scholte-wave imaging method using a 51-km seabed distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) cable on the Texas Gulf Coast. By processing the uncorrelated ambient noise wavefield with long-duration frequency-wavenumber stacking and a multi-aperture strategy, the authors extract broadband dispersion curves (0.3-4.5 Hz). They perform 400 1D shear-wave velocity inversions to construct a pseudo-2D shear-wave velocity model down to 2 km depth. The model successfully identifies shallow low-velocity zones corresponding to soft incised-valley fill. This work demonstrates that existing seabed fiber infrastructure can leverage ocean-forcing passive noise for deep regional shear-wave imaging, though active sources remain necessary for the uppermost meters.
本研究利用德克萨斯州墨西哥湾沿岸51公里的海底分布式声学传感（DAS）光缆，提出了一种被动Scholte波成像方法。通过对未相关环境噪声波场进行长时频域-波数（f-k）叠加和多孔径处理，提取了0.3-4.5 Hz的宽频散曲线。通过400个一维剪切波速度反演，构建了深达2公里的伪二维剪切波速度模型，成……

直接处理未相关被动波场，结合长时频域-波数叠加和多孔径策略提取宽频Scholte波频散。
Passive ambient noise data recorded by a 51-km seabed distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) cable segment on the Texas Gulf Coast.
利用德克萨斯州墨西哥湾沿岸51公里长的海底分布式声学传感（DAS）光缆记录的被动环境噪声数据。
Extracted 0.3-4.5 Hz Scholte-wave dispersion curves to perform 400 1D inversions, creating a pseudo-2D shear-wave velocity model down to 2 km depth.
提取了0.3-4.5 Hz的频散曲线并进行400次一维反演，构建了深达2公里的伪二维剪切波速度模型。
Passive Scholte-wave imaging lacks the high-frequency resolution needed to resolve the uppermost several meters of the seafloor.

Combines a multi-aperture strategy with seabed DAS to resolve both low-frequency modes and high-frequency spatial localization from passive ocean forcing.
将多孔径策略与海底DAS结合，利用被动海洋强迫同时解析低频模式和保持高频空间定位。

Extracted broadband Scholte-wave dispersion (0.3-4.5 Hz) from passive shallow-water ocean forcing.
Constructed a 51-km-long pseudo-2D shear-wave velocity model down to 2 km depth on the Texas Gulf Coast.
开发了一种海底DAS多孔径策略，在保持高频空间定位的同时解析低频模式。

sum: This study addresses the lack of constraints on magnesium-chloride complexing in deep planetary fluids. The authors analyzed published experimental data for silicate mineral solubilities (talc, quartz, tremolite, and forsterite) in chloride-rich fluids at high temperatures and pressures (500–900°C, 2–10 kb). By regressing these data, they obtained new and revised equilibrium constants for magnesium-, calcium-, and silicon-bearing species. They then applied the Deep Earth Water (DEW) model to extend these constants across wide temperature and pressure ranges. The resulting robust thermodynamic dataset enables the modeling of magnesium transport and volatile cycling in the ultramafic mantles of terrestrial planets and exoplanets.
本研究针对深部行星流体中镁-氯络合物缺乏约束的问题，分析了富氯流体中硅酸盐矿物的实验溶解度。通过回归分析获得了镁、钙和硅物种的新平衡常数，并利用DEW模型外推至更宽温压范围。该研究构建了上地幔条件下稳健的热力学数据集，为模拟类地行星及系外行星超基性地幔中的元素运移提供了关键工具。

t: Thermodynamic regression of published experimental mineral solubilities combined with Deep Earth Water (DEW) modeling to determine equilibrium constants for aqueous complexes.
结合已发表实验矿物溶解度的热力学回归与深部地球水（DEW）模型来确定水相络合物的平衡常数。
Published experimental solubilities of talc + quartz and tremolite + talc + quartz (2 kb, 500–700°C) and forsterite (10 kb, 800–900°C).
已发表的滑石+石英、透闪石+滑石+石英（2 kb, 500–700°C）和橄榄石（10 kb, 800–900°C）的实…
New and revised equilibrium constants for magnesium-, calcium-, and silicon-bearing species, producing a robust thermodynamic dataset for upper mantle conditions.

sum: Monitoring continental-scale crustal deformation using extensive GNSS networks is computationally prohibitive with standard Gaussian maximum-likelihood estimation (MLE) due to large covariance matrices, missing data, and complex long-memory stochastic noise. This study introduces Wavelet Moment Regression (WAMORE), a scalable statistical framework built on the Generalized Method of Wavelet Moments. WAMORE explicitly models missing data via a stationary Markov process, derives exact and approximate theoretical wavelet variances and their covariance matrices for estimated residuals, and introduces a fast covariance-penalty model selection criterion. Applied to 4,793 North American GNSS stations (14,379 three-component daily time series) and 6,313 global stations from the Nevada Geodetic Laboratory, WAMORE achieves two-to-three orders of magnitude speedups over the benchmark Hector MLE software while maintaining or improving confidence interval calibration under non-stationary random walk noise. An open-source R package (gmwmx2) and interactive web application are provided to support Open Science.
针对大规模GNSS网地壳形变监测中极大似然估计（MLE）因大协方差矩阵、缺失数据和长记忆噪声导致的计算瓶颈，本文提出了基于广义小波矩方法的可扩展统计框架WAMORE。该方法利用平稳马尔可夫过程显式建模缺失数据，推导了残差理论小波方差及其协方差矩阵的高效近似算法，并构建了无需似然评估的噪声模型选择准则……

t: Wavelet Moment Regression (WAMORE) combines least-squares trajectory estimation with the Generalized Method of Wavelet Moments on residuals, explicitly modeling missing observations via a stationary Markov chain and selecting noise models via a likelihood-free covariance-penalty criterion.
WAMORE结合最小二乘轨迹估计与残差广义小波矩方法，利用平稳马尔可夫链显式建模缺失数据，并通过无似然协方差惩罚准则选择…

Daily 3-component GNSS position time series from the Nevada Geodetic Laboratory (>10 years duration, <40% missing data), comprising 4,793 stations (14,379 signals; 90,122,118 data points) across North America and 6,313 stations globally.
来自NGL的北美4,793个台站（14,379条序列，观测>10年，缺失<40%）及全球6,313个台站的每日三分量GN…

On a 300-station (900-signal) subsample with 6 candidate noise models, WAMORE took 12.7 hours versus >49 days for Hector MLE (~100x speedup), agreeing on trend significance in 85.11% of signals (>92% when selecting identical models).
在900条序列6种候选模型测试中，WAMORE耗时12.7小时，比Hector（>49天）快约百倍，趋势显著性一致率达8…

For residual theoretical wavelet variance, evaluating all diagonal/superdiagonal sums is costly; thus WAMORE linearly interpolates across a logarithmic subset of lags, which currently lacks a formal theoretical approximation error bound.
残差理论小波方差通过在对数滞后子集上线性插值近似对角线和，该插值策略目前尚缺乏形式化的理论误差界。

Delivers the first explicit closed-form covariance matrix of the empirical wavelet variance for Gaussian processes and a consistent, linear-time GMWM regression framework accounting for missing data and estimated residuals.
首次推导出高斯过程经验小波方差协方差矩阵的显式解析形式，并建立了兼顾缺失数据与估计残差的线性时间GMWM回归与模型选择框…

kc: Develops Wavelet Moment Regression (WAMORE), achieving linear-time estimation and uncertainty quantification for GNSS time series with missing data and long-memory noise.
Derives explicit theoretical wavelet variance (WV) and WV covariance matrix expressions, alongside O(n^-1)-accurate fast approximations for estimated regression residuals.
Introduces a likelihood-free model selection criterion for composite stochastic noise models that matches AIC accuracy at a fraction of the computational cost.
Delivers the first joint uncertainty-quantified crustal velocity field across 4,793 North American GNSS stations and provides the open-source R package gmwmx2.
开发了小波矩回归（WAMORE）框架，对含缺失数据和长记忆噪声的GNSS时间序列实现线性时间估计与不确定性量化。
推导了理论小波方差（WV）及WV协方差矩阵的显式表达式，以及针对回归残差的O(n^-1)精度快速近似算法。
提出了无需似然计算的复合随机噪声模型选择准则，在大幅降低计算成本的同时达到了与AIC相当的精度。
首次联合给出了北美4,793个GNSS台站的不确定性量化地壳速度场，并提供了开源R软件包gmwmx2。
me: Ordinary least-squares trajectory regression for intercept, linear velocity, seasonal harmonics, offsets, and post-seismic exponential decay.
Stationary binary Markov chain modeling of the missing data mechanism independent of the geodetic signal.
Generalized Method of Wavelet Moments (GMWM) matching empirical Haar wavelet variances of residuals to theoretical wavelet variances.
Out-of-sample covariance-penalty criterion (Mallows' Cp / AIC-type GMM analog) for selecting stochastic error models (white, flicker, power-law, Matérn, random walk).
针对截距、线性速度、季节性谐波、阶跃偏置和震后指数衰减的最小二乘轨迹回归。
独立于大地测量信号的缺失数据机制平稳二元马尔可夫链建模。
将残差经验Haar小波方差与理论小波方差进行匹配的广义小波矩方法（GMWM）。
用于选择随机误差模型（白噪声、闪烁噪声、幂律、Matérn、随机游走）的样本外协方差惩罚准则。
de: Monte Carlo simulations (10 to 30 years daily data, 0%–40% missingness) comparing WAMORE against Hector v2.0 MLE under WN+PL, WN+FL, and WN+MAT+RW noise.
Model selection simulations (20 and 40 years daily data) testing detection of an added random walk component against AIC.
Continental case study on 4,793 North American GNSS stations (14,379 three-component signals, >10 years length, <40% missing data) from the Nevada Geodetic Laboratory.
Global scalability test on 6,313 GNSS stations (18,939 signals) and an emulation study based on station ACU5 near Boston.
蒙特卡洛模拟（10至30年日数据，0%–40%缺失率），在WN+PL、WN+FL和WN+MAT+RW噪声下对比WAMORE与Hector v2.0 MLE。
模型选择模拟（20年和40年日数据），测试相对于AIC检测附加随机游走分量的能力。
内华达大地测量实验室（NGL）北美4,793个GNSS台站（14,379条三分量序列，观测超10年，缺失率低于40%）的大陆尺度实例研究。
全球6,313个GNSS台站（18,939条序列）的可扩展性测试，以及基于波士顿附近ACU5台站的仿真研究。
li: Relies on linear interpolation across selected lags andapproximates R*Sigma*R by R*Sigma without a formal theoretical error bound for the interpolation step.
Fixes post-seismic exponential relaxation time tau_k to 1 year and requires user-provided offset/earthquake epoch times.
Assumes the missing-data mechanism is stationary and independent of the underlying displacement signal.
依赖特定滞后步长间的线性插值并用R*Sigma近似R*Sigma*R，插值步骤尚无严格理论误差界。
将震后指数松弛时间tau_k固定为1年，且需要用户预先提供阶跃或地震发生时间。
假设缺失数据机制是平稳的且独立于潜在的位移信号。

The work develops a scalable statistical estimation and uncertainty quantification framework (WAMORE) based on the Generalized Method of Wavelet Moments for correlated time-series parameter inference.

sum: Probabilistic seismic hazard and risk analyses (PSHA/PSRA) are critical for engineering and disaster management, yet open engines like OpenQuake require specialist expertise. This paper introduces the first agentic interface for end-to-end PSHA and PSRA via a five-layer open-source Python server using the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It exposes 24 typed endpoints wrapping OpenQuake and the 2020 European Seismic Hazard and Risk Models (ESHM20/ESRM20). The large language model acts solely as an orchestrator that plans, translates, and explains, delegating all numerical calculations to validated code with strict JSON Schema checking and full provenance tracking. Benchmarked across 73 European cities, replicated 475-year spectral accelerations match official ESHM20 values within a median of 5%. Novel capabilities beyond existing web services include custom empirical or machine-learning ground-motion model (GMM) substitution per tectonic region, surface site-amplified spectra, conditional mean spectra, per-building loss, retrofit evaluation, and ESM strong-motion record selection.
针对概率地震危险性与风险分析（PSHA/PSRA）门槛高的问题，本文提出了首个基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的端到端智能体（Agentic AI）开源五层架构服务。该方法将大语言模型限制为规划与解释的协调器，通过24个类型化端点调用OpenQuake引擎及欧洲ESHM20/ESRM20模型完成数值计算……

t: A five-layer Python server implementing the Model Context Protocol (MCP) wraps OpenQuake and ESHM20/ESRM20 behind 24 schema-validated endpoints, confining the LLM to orchestration while caching spatial results.
构建基于MCP协议的五层Python服务器，封装OpenQuake与欧洲模型并限制LLM仅作协调器。

Uses ESHM20 NRML source models and GMM trees, ESRM20 fragility/vulnerability and exposure libraries, USGS Global Vs30 Mosaic, regional site amplification, and Engineering Strong-Motion (ESM) database records.
采用ESHM20震源与GMM树、ESRM20易损性与暴露度库、USGS全球Vs30及ESM强震记录。

Across 73 European cities, replicated 475-year spectral accelerations match official ESHM20 values within a median absolute ln-residual of 0.05 (~5%), with first-call median runtime of 80 s and sub-second cache hits.
73个欧洲城市的475年反应谱复现中位对数残差仅0.05（约5%），首次中位耗时80秒，缓存命中小于1秒。
Default deterministic top-branch and three-point GMM quadrature approximations omit higher-order epistemic branches, under-predicting deep Vrancea seismicity; single-core first runs take up to 488 s.
默认确定性高权重分支与三点求积近似省略了高阶分支，低估深源地震区，且单核首次计算最慢达488秒。

First MCP-based agentic interface for end-to-end probabilistic seismic hazard and risk analysis, enabling conversational custom GMM substitution and engineering extensions without LLM numerical hallucination.
首个端到端概率地震危险性与风险分析MCP智能体接口，支持对话式替换GMM且无数值幻觉。

kc: Replicates the full ESHM20/ESRM20 hazard-to-loss chain via 24 typed MCP endpoints within a single conversational session with full provenance.
Allows per-tectonic-region substitution of custom empirical or machine-learning GMMs into the published regional logic tree.
Provides engineering extensions omitted by EFEHR web services: surface hazard, conditional mean spectra, deterministic scenarios, per-building loss, retrofit benefit, and ESM waveform selection.
Prevents LLM numerical hallucination by confining the language model to orchestration while validated code and schema checks handle all calculations.
通过24个类型化MCP端点在单次对话中复现完整的ESHM20/ESRM20地震危险性到损失链条，并提供完整数据溯源。
支持按构造区域将自定义经验或机器学习地面运动模型（GMM）替换进已发布的区域逻辑树中。
提供现有EFEHR网络服务未涵盖的工程扩展：地表放大危险性、条件均值谱、确定性情景、单栋建筑损失、加固效益及ESM波形记录选取。
将大语言模型限制为协调器，由经过验证的代码和模式检查处理所有计算，从设计上杜绝LLM数值幻觉。
me: Five-layer Python MCP server architecture: protocol adapter (L1), engineering-domain translator (L2), engine-agnostic hazard kernel (L3), two-tier spatial cache (L4), and OpenQuake numerical core (L5).
Three-branch Gauss-Hermite quadrature approximation of the ESHM20 ground-motion logic tree for fast interactive PSHA evaluation.
JSON Schema input validation and canonical skill descriptions to prevent invalid tool calls and mitigate LLM hallucination.
Integration of conditional mean spectrum (CMS) calculation, lognormal fragility/vulnerability convolution for Average Annual Loss (AAL), and ESM strong-motion record selection.
五层Python MCP服务器架构：协议适配器（L1）、工程领域转换器（L2）、引擎无关危险性内核（L3）、双层空间缓存（L4）及OpenQuake数值核心（L5）。
采用三分支高斯-埃尔米特求积近似ESHM20地面运动逻辑树，实现快速交互式PSHA评估。
利用JSON Schema输入验证和规范技能描述防止无效工具调用并抑制LLM幻觉。
集成条件均值谱（CMS）计算、对数正态易损性/脆弱性卷积计算年均损失（AAL），以及ESM强震记录优化选取。
de: 2020 European Seismic Hazard Model (ESHM20) NRML source models and GMM logic trees, plus 2020 European Seismic Risk Model (ESRM20) fragility, vulnerability, and SERA exposure datasets.
USGS Global Vs30 Mosaic and regional site-amplification models, alongside strong-motion waveforms from the Engineering Strong-Motion (ESM) database.
Multi-city benchmark across 73 European cities comparing 475-year and 2,475-year response spectra against official EFEHR full-tree Monte-Carlo references.
Custom GMM substitution experiments at Istanbul (interpretable ML GMM for shallow crust) and Bucharest (regional Manea et al. 2022 model for Vrancea deep seismicity).
2020年欧洲地震危险性模型（ESHM20）NRML震源模型与GMM逻辑树，以及2020年欧洲地震风险模型（ESRM20）易损性、脆弱性与SERA暴露度数据集。
USGS全球Vs30拼接图与区域场地放大模型，以及来自工程强震数据库（ESM）的强震波形。
跨越73个欧洲城市的多城市基准测试，将475年和2475年重现期反应谱与官方EFEHR完整逻辑树蒙特卡洛参考值进行对比。
在伊斯坦布尔（浅源地壳可解释机器学习GMM）和布加勒斯特（弗朗恰中源地震Manea等2022区域模型）开展的自定义GMM替换实验。
li: Default configuration evaluates a deterministic subset of highest-weighted branches and three-branch GMM quadrature rather than full Monte-Carlo sampling, causing under-prediction at deep-seismicity Vrancea sites.
Area sources are discretized on a 20 km grid with finite distance cutoffs, and first-call computation at source-dense sites takes up to 488 s on a single CPU core.
Relies on uncertain topographic-slope Vs30 proxies when site-specific measurements are unavailable, and ESM database sparsity limits record selection for deep far-field scenarios.
默认配置评估高权重分支的确定性子集和三分支GMM求积而非全树蒙特卡洛采样，导致在受弗朗恰中源地震控制的场点出现低估。
面源按20 km网格离散且采用有限距离截断，震源密集场点的首次单核CPU计算耗时高达488秒。
缺乏实测值时依赖存在不确定性的地形坡度Vs30代理值，且ESM数据库在深源远场情景下的稀疏性限制了记录选取。

tm.why: The paper develops an end-to-end computational workflow for probabilistic seismic hazard and risk analysis (PSHA/PSRA) wrapping OpenQuake, ESHM20, ESRM20, and strong-motion record selection.

The study integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) as agentic orchestrators via the Model Context Protocol and allows substituting machine-learning ground-motion models into regional hazard logic trees.

sum: This study addresses the high noise levels in real-time GNSS data, which often degrade peak ground displacement (PGD) magnitude estimation in earthquake early warning (EEW) systems like ShakeAlert's GFAST. The authors develop a deep-learning model to detect earthquakes in GNSS data, acting as a high-quality data filter. To overcome limited real event data, they train the model on over 700,000 synthetic displacement waveforms combined with real-time GNSS noise. Tested on the Ridgecrest, California, earthquake sequence, the model successfully filters out low-quality data, outperforming traditional signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) filters. This selective filtering reduces errors in real-time magnitude estimation, demonstrating the potential of deep learning to enhance geodetic EEW reliability.
本研究针对实时GNSS数据中高噪声干扰地震预警（EEW）系统（如GFAST）中峰值地表位移（PGD）震级估算的问题，开发了一种用于GNSS地震检测的深度学习模型。为解决真实数据有限的问题，研究者利用超70万条合成位移波形与真实GNSS噪声混合进行模型训练。在加州Ridgecrest地震序列的测试中，……

t: A deep-learning model trained on synthetic displacement waveforms combined with real GNSS noise to detect earthquakes in real-time geodetic data.
一种利用合成位移波形与真实GNSS噪声混合训练的深度学习模型，用于实时大地测量数据中的地震检测。
Over 700,000 synthetic displacement waveforms and real-time GNSS noise, validated on real data from the Ridgecrest, California, earthquake sequence.
超过70万条合成位移波形和实时GNSS噪声，并在加州Ridgecrest地震序列的真实数据上进行了验证。
The deep-learning filter successfully identifies earthquake signals in noisy GNSS data, outperforming SNR-based filters and reducing real-time magnitude estimation errors.
深度学习滤波器成功识别了高噪声GNSS数据中的地震信号，优于基于信噪比的滤波器，降低了实时震级估算误差。
Performance is constrained by the fidelity of synthetic training data and potential challenges in extremely high-noise or low-magnitude scenarios.
性能受限于合成训练数据的逼真度，且在极高噪声或极低震级场景下可能面临挑战。
First application of a deep-learning detector as a pre-filter for GNSS-based earthquake early warning to improve PGD magnitude estimation.
首次将深度学习检测器作为基于GNSS的地震预警前置滤波器，以提高PGD震级估算的准确性。

Demonstrated that deep-learning filtering outperforms traditional SNR-based filters for geodetic EEW.
Improved the accuracy of real-time PGD magnitude estimation by filtering out low-quality data.
开发了一种用于在嘈杂的实时GNSS数据中检测地震的深度学习模型。
证明了深度学习滤波在大地测量地震预警中优于传统的基于信噪比的滤波器。
通过过滤低质量数据，提高了实时PGD震级估算的准确性。

Synthetic waveform generation combined with real GNSS noise for training.
Performance comparison against traditional signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) filters.
深度学习分类/检测模型。
结合真实GNSS噪声生成合成位移波形进行模型训练。
与传统信噪比（SNR）滤波器进行性能对比。
de: Over 700,000 synthetic displacement waveforms combined with real-time GNSS noise.
Real-time GNSS data from the Ridgecrest, California, earthquake sequence used for inference and validation.
超过70万条合成位移波形与实时GNSS噪声相结合的数据集。
使用加州Ridgecrest地震序列的实时GNSS数据进行推理和验证。

May still face challenges with very low-magnitude events or extremely high-noise environments.

在极低震级事件或极高噪声环境中可能仍面临挑战。

The core objective is detecting earthquakes in real-time geodetic data streams.
The application is earthquake early warning and peak ground displacement (PGD) magnitude estimation.

sum: This Zenodo repository provides a dataset of local earthquake focal mechanisms for the Macquarie Island region. The dataset includes key parameters such as longitude, latitude, depth, strike, dip, rake, magnitude, and event ID/time. It distinguishes between standard-quality solutions and lower-quality focal mechanisms, which are stored separately in 'MT-macq-lq.txt'. This dataset is valuable for studying active tectonics, stress fields, and fault mechanics along the Macquarie Ridge Complex, a major strike-slip plate boundary.
该Zenodo仓库提供了麦夸里岛地区的局部地震震源机制解数据集。数据包含经纬度、深度、走向、倾角、滑动角、震级和事件ID等参数。低质量的震源机制解被单独分类在'MT-macq-lq.txt'文件中。该数据集对于研究麦夸里脊这一重大走滑板块边界的活动构造、应力场和断层力学具有重要价值。

t: Determination of local earthquake focal mechanisms (strike, dip, rake) from seismic waveform data.
利用地震波形数据确定局部地震的震源机制解（走向、倾角、滑动角）。
A dataset of local earthquake parameters near Macquarie Island, including location, depth, magnitude, and focal mechanisms.

sum: Acoustic impedance inversion from band-limited seismic data is severely ill-posed due to unknown wavelets and extreme scarcity of labeled well-log traces (<1%). Existing semi-supervised deep learning approaches rely on inaccurate prior wavelets or auxiliary forward networks, causing unstable optimization. This paper introduces Regularized Deconvolution Semi-Supervised Cross-Learning (RD-SCL). Its core is a differentiable, closed-form first-order Tikhonov deconvolution operator in the frequency domain that dynamically estimates the latent seismic wavelet from predicted impedance during training. Using the estimated wavelet as a bridge variable, a symmetric cross-learning loss enforces bidirectional forward-modeling consistency between labeled and abundant unlabeled traces using a single lightweight network (56.5k parameters). Evaluated on SEAM, Marmousi 2, and a Sichuan Basin field dataset, RD-SCL outperforms six supervised and semi-supervised baselines in SNR, SSIM, R², MAE, and MSE while reducing computational runtime and maintaining robustness against noise, wavelet variations, and extreme label sparsity.

Validated on two synthetic benchmarks (SEAM and Marmousi 2) and a field seismic dataset from the Sichuan Basin, China, using sparse well-log labels (<1% of total traces).

Treats the unknown wavelet as a dynamically estimated latent bridge variable via closed-form regularized deconvolution, enabling bidirectional semi-supervised cross-learning without auxiliary forward networks or fixed wavelet priors.

kc: Designed a differentiable, closed-form first-order Tikhonov regularized deconvolution operator in the frequency domain for dynamic latent wavelet estimation during network training.

Proposed a symmetric semi-supervised cross-learning paradigm that transfers dynamically estimated wavelets between labeled and unlabeled traces to enforce bidirectional physical consistency without auxiliary networks.
Demonstrated superior accuracy, training stability, and computational efficiency (only 56.5k parameters) over six state-of-the-art baselines on SEAM, Marmousi 2, and Sichuan Basin field datasets.
设计了基于Tikhonov正则化的频域可微闭式反褶积算子，可在网络训练迭代中高效、稳定地动态估计隐式子波变量。
提出了结合上述算子的对称半监督交叉学习框架，在有标签和无标签数据间传递估计子波以建立双向互约束，有效缓解少样本过拟合且无需辅助网络。
在SEAM、Marmousi 2基准数据集及四川盆地实际工区数据上验证了方法优越性，仅用56.5k参数即在精度、稳定性和计算效率上超越六种主流基线方法。
me: Frequency-domain first-order Tikhonov regularized deconvolution with Wirtinger calculus and batch-level averaging to estimate the time-domain latent seismic wavelet.

Symmetric cross-learning loss that convolves predicted reflection coefficients from labeled/unlabeled traces with the wavelet estimated from the opposite branch to reconstruct observed seismic traces.
Lightweight deep inversion network (56.5k parameters) comprising four dilated TCN blocks, three Bi-GRU layers, and a linear output layer.
利用频域一阶Tikhonov正则化反褶积结合Wirtinger微商与批次平均，闭式求解并逆傅里叶变换恢复时域隐式地震子波。
构建对称交叉学习损失，将有标签和无标签分支预测的反射系数分别与对方分支估计的子波褶积，重构观测地震道以实现无监督物理约束。
采用轻量级深度反演网络（56.5k参数），由4个扩张时间卷积网络（TCN）块、3层双向门控循环单元（Bi-GRU）和1个线性层组成。
de: Synthetic benchmarks: SEAM elastic earth model (35 km survey line) and Marmousi 2 (13.6 km survey line) with <1% labeled well-log traces.
Field dataset: Oil and gas exploration dataset from the Sichuan Basin, China, using 3 wells (~1% of traces) for training and 1 blind well for validation.
Robustness and ablation tests evaluating Gaussian noise (SNR 5, 10, 15 dB), wavelet types (Ricker, Generalized, Berlage), well counts (4, 6, 8 wells), and Tikhonov regularization orders/weights.
合成基准数据集：SEAM弹性地球模型（35 km测线）和Marmousi 2模型（13.6 km测线），训练标签样本少于总道数的1%。

li: Restricted to time-invariant seismic wavelets; cannot currently account for time-varying wavelet attenuation and dispersion in complex media.
Optimal Tikhonov regularization order and penalty coefficient lambda vary slightly across different datasets, requiring empirical balancing (fixed at lambda = 0.01).
局限于时不变地震子波假设，尚未扩展到更具挑战性的时变子波情况。

The core contribution integrates a closed-form first-order Tikhonov regularized deconvolution operator in the frequency domain to solve the ill-posed inverse problem of acoustic impedance and wavelet estimation.
