sum: Serpentine stability governs deep water cycling in subduction zones. Using in-situ synchrotron X-ray diffraction (in diamond-anvil cells and multi-anvil presses) and ultrasonic P-wave velocity measurements up to 13.1 GPa and 785 °C, the authors investigated lizardite and antigorite breakdown under cold-slab P-T paths with varying excess water (0.9–31.5 wt.%). Along cold-core (or ultracold Moho) geotherms with >6.9 wt.% excess water, serpentinite undergoes a hydration reaction above 9.3 GPa and 420 °C (~280 km depth) to form the 3.65-Å phase and phase E, increasing structurally bound water from 13.0 to 19.3 wt.%. Under fluid-limited (<6.9 wt.%) cold-core conditions, it transforms directly into phase E without water loss. Along warmer cold-Moho geotherms, serpentinite dehydrates above 7.4 GPa and 585 °C (~220 km) into phase E and clinoenstatite, bypassing phase A. These divergent paths create up to 7.1% density and 17–20% P-wave velocity jumps, tripling estimated water transport into the mantle transition zone.
本研究利用原位同步辐射X射线衍射（金刚石对顶砧与大腔体压机）及超声波速测量，在高达13.1 GPa和785 °C及不同过量水（0.9–31.5 wt.%）条件下探究了冷俯冲板片中蛇纹石的分解路径。结果显示，在富水（>6.9 wt.%）冷核地温线下，蛇纹石在~280 km深处发生水化反应生成3.65-……

t: Combined in-situ high-pressure/high-temperature synchrotron X-ray diffraction (AD-XRD in resistive-heated diamond-anvil cells and ED-XRD in a multi-anvil press), X-ray radiography, and pulse-echo overlap ultrasonic P-wave velocity measurements along cold subduction geotherms.
结合原位高温高压同步辐射X射线衍射（DAC与大腔体压机）、X射线成像及超声P波测速。
Natural lizardite and antigorite powders compressed with 0.9–31.5 wt.% excess H2O up to 13.1 GPa and 785 °C across three synchrotron facilities (APS, PLS-II, and PETRA-III).
在0.9–31.5 wt.%过量水、达13.1 GPa和785 °C下测试的天然利蛇纹石和叶蛇纹石样品。

Under water-rich cold-core geotherms (>9.3 GPa, 420 °C), serpentinite hydrates into 3.65-Å phase + phase E (water rises to 19.3 wt.%, Vp increases ~17%); along cold Moho (>7.4 GPa, 585 °C), it dehydrates to phase E + clinoenstatite (Vp increases ~20%).
富水冷核下水化生成3.65-Å相+E相（含水量19.3%，Vp增17%）；冷莫霍下脱水为E相+斜顽辉石（Vp增20%）。

The spatial extent of fluid-induced reactions in natural slabs cannot be directly quantified, making global water flux estimates an upper bound; ultrasonic S-waves were not analyzed due to solid-liquid mixtures.
板片内流体反应空间范围难以直接量化（通量为上限）；固液混合使超声S波无法解析。

First experimental demonstration that excess water stabilizes a deep hydration pathway (3.65-Å phase + phase E) and bypasses phase A in subducting serpentinites, tripling estimated cold-slab deep water transport.
首次揭示过量水促使蛇纹石绕过A相发生深部水化生成3.65-Å相+E相，将冷板片深部水通量评估提高3倍。

kc: Discovered a deep hydration reaction of serpentinite into the 3.65-Å phase + phase E above 9.3 GPa and 420 °C (~280 km) under water-rich cold-core geotherms, increasing crystal water content from 13.0 wt.% to 19.3 wt.%.

Demonstrated that in excess water, serpentinite transforms directly into phase E-bearing assemblages (water-retention in fluid-limited cold core; partial dehydration into phase E + clinoenstatite along cold Moho), bypassing phase A.
Measured in-situ ultrasonic P-wave velocities and sample volume changes across breakdown reactions, showing ~17% and ~20% Vp increases for cold-core hydration and cold-Moho dehydration, respectively.

Re-evaluated global cold subduction water fluxes, showing that serpentine water transport efficiency to 300 km depth reaches 83–92% (1.0–1.1 × 10^15 g/yr), ~3.1–3.3 times higher than conventional phase-A-based estimates.
发现在富水冷核地温线下，蛇纹石在9.3 GPa和420 °C（~280 km）以上发生深部水化反应生成3.65-Å相和E相，使结晶水含量从13.0 wt.%增至19.3 wt.%。
证明在含水条件下蛇纹石绕过A相直接转化为含E相矿物组合（贫水冷核下保水转化为E相；冷莫霍下部分脱水为E相+斜顽辉石）。
原位测量了相变过程中的超声P波速度和体积变化，发现冷核水化和冷莫霍脱水反应分别伴随约17%和20%的P波速度跃升。
重新评估了全球16个冷俯冲带的水通量，表明蛇纹石向300 km深处输运水的效率达83–92%（1.0–1.1 × 10^15 g/yr），是传统基于A相脱水评估值的3.1–3.3倍。
me: In-situ high-pressure, high-temperature synchrotron angle-dispersive X-ray diffraction (AD-XRD) using resistive-heated diamond-anvil cells (RH-DAC) up to 13.1 GPa and 785 °C.
In-situ synchrotron energy-dispersive X-ray diffraction (ED-XRD), X-ray radiography, and pulse-echo overlap ultrasonic P-wave velocity measurements in an Aster-15 multi-anvil press (MAP).
Rietveld refinement and SEM-EDS analysis to determine non-stoichiometric phase E compositions, crystal densities, and water contents.
Voigt-Reuss-Hill (VRH) averaging and Hashin-Shtrikman (HS) bounds modeling to compare theoretical solid-fluid mixture P-wave velocities with experimental ultrasonic data.
利用电阻加热金刚石对顶砧（RH-DAC）开展高达13.1 GPa和785 °C的原位高温高压同步辐射角散X射线衍射（AD-XRD）实验。
利用Aster-15大腔体压机（MAP）同步开展原位能散X射线衍射（ED-XRD）、X射线成像及脉冲回波重叠法超声P波速度测量。
采用Rietveld精修和扫描电镜能谱（SEM-EDS）分析确定非化学计量E相的化学成分、晶体密度及含水量。
结合Voigt-Reuss-Hill（VRH）平均和Hashin-Shtrikman（HS）界限模型计算固-液混合物理论P波速度并与实验测量结果对比。
de: Natural powdered lizardite (Boryeong, Korea) and antigorite (Huelva, Spain) characterized by XRF, TGA, FE-SEM, Raman, and synchrotron XRD.
RH-DAC experiments at APS (13-BM-C), PLS-II (5A), and PETRA-III (P02.2) with 0.9 wt.% (silicone oil), 6.9 wt.%, 8.4 wt.%, 9.4 wt.%, 16.4 wt.%, and 31.5 wt.% excess H2O.

Multi-anvil press ultrasonic + ED-XRD + radiography experiments at PETRA-III (P61B) with 20.9 wt.% H2O (cold core path up to 10.1 GPa, 523 °C) and 25.9 wt.% H2O (cold Moho path up to 7.7 GPa, 573 °C).
经XRF、TGA、FE-SEM、拉曼及同步辐射XRD表征的天然利蛇纹石（韩国保宁）和叶蛇纹石（西班牙韦尔瓦）粉末样品。
在APS (13-BM-C)、PLS-II (5A)和PETRA-III (P02.2)开展的RH-DAC实验，设置了0.9 wt.%（硅油）、6.9 wt.%、8.4 wt.%、9.4 wt.%、16.4 wt.%和31.5 wt.%等不同过量水条件。
在PETRA-III (P61B)开展的大腔体压机超声+ED-XRD+X射线成像实验，包含20.9 wt.%水（冷核路径至10.1 GPa, 523 °C）和25.9 wt.%水（冷莫霍路径至7.7 GPa, 573 °C）。
li: Only P-wave velocities could be analyzed in the ultrasonic experiments due to the solid–liquid nature of the water-saturated samples (S-waves were not analyzed).
Spatial extent and degree of progress of fluid-induced reactions in natural slabs cannot be directly quantified, making the global water flux calculation an upper-bound scenario.
Further studies are needed to account for the influence of actual subduction zone topography and heterogeneous fault networks on seismic velocities and fluid accumulation.
由于含水样品呈固-液混合态，超声实验仅能分析P波速度（未能解析S波速度）。
自然俯冲板片中流体诱发反应的空间范围和反应程度难以直接量化，因此全球水通量估算代表上限情景。
仍需进一步研究实际俯冲带地形和非均质断层网络对地震波速结构及流体富集的影响。

sum: Detecting weak rockfall microseismic signals amidst strong background noise is critical for assessing rockslide hazards. This paper proposes a two-stage, seismic-attribute-guided 1D convolutional encoder-decoder network that formulates rockfall detection as a time-series segmentation task. In Stage 1, the network undergoes self-supervised pre-training to map noisy waveforms to the Sum of Squared Differences (SSD) attribute, embedding physical noise-suppression properties into the encoder. In Stage 2, the encoder is frozen and the decoder is fine-tuned for event segmentation. Trained on 2013 data from the Séchilienne rockslide (France), the model outperforms STA/LTA and U-Net baselines on 2014 continuous data while maintaining power-law energy scaling (b=1.13). In a zero-shot transfer to the Illgraben rockslide (Switzerland), it maintains physical consistency (b=1.23) and uncovers a distinct four-stage pre-failure evolutionary pattern ('growth–acceleration–quiescence–burst') driven by freeze-thaw and precipitation forcing.
本文提出一种地震属性引导的双阶段深度学习框架，将落石微震检测转化为时间序列分割任务。通过以平方差之和（SSD）属性为目标的自监督预训练并冻结编码器，模型在低信噪比下表现出优异的抗噪性能。基于法国Séchilienne滑坡数据的测试表明，该方法优于传统STA/LTA和U-Net基线，且检出事件符合幂律……

t: A dual-task 1D convolutional encoder-decoder network with GRU/attention bottleneck and adaptive skip fusion. Task A pre-trains the network via self-supervised regression on the Sum of Squared Differences (SSD) attribute; Task B freezes the encoder to train the decoder for segmentation.
包含GRU/注意力瓶颈与自适应跳跃融合的双任务1D卷积网络，先进行SSD属性自监督预训练，再冻结编码器训练分割解码器。

Trained on 2013 continuous waveforms (9,874 rockfall and 61,208 noise samples) from the Séchilienne rockslide (France), benchmarked on full-year 2014 records, and zero-shot transferred to the Illgraben rockslide (Switzerland) prior to its January 2013 collapse.
采用法国Séchilienne滑坡2013年数据训练、2014年连续数据测试，并零样本迁移至瑞士Illgraben滑坡2…

Achieved 0.8832 F1 score in synthetic tests, 88.25% recall and 66.70% IoU on 2014 Séchilienne records (r=0.93 daily correlation, power-law b=1.13), and b=1.23 on zero-shot Illgraben data, revealing a four-stage collapse precursor pattern.

Missed detections occur when SSD responses are multi-peaked or short-duration under strong noise; the four-stage precursor model is based on one Alpine hard-rock collapse and needs broader validation.
多峰或短时信号易漏检；四阶段模式仅源于单一高山硬岩崩塌序列，普适性需更多案例验证。

Recasts rockfall identification as a seismic-attribute-guided time-series segmentation task using asynchronous two-stage pre-training, avoiding raw-waveform autoencoder negative transfer and enabling zero-shot cross-regional rockslide evolution tracking.
将落石识别转化为地震属性引导的时序分割任务，利用双阶段异步训练克服负迁移并实现跨区域零样本演化追踪。

kc: Formulates rockfall microseismic detection as a continuous time-series segmentation task using a two-stage, asynchronously trained encoder-decoder network.
Proves theoretically and empirically that self-supervised pre-training guided by the Sum of Squared Differences (SSD) seismic attribute bounds noise perturbation and prevents negative transfer.
Demonstrates superior cross-regional zero-shot generalization from the Séchilienne (France) to the Illgraben (Switzerland) rockslide while preserving brittle-fracture power-law energy scaling.
Identifies a four-stage rockslide failure evolution pattern (growth, acceleration, quiescence, burst) linked to meteorological freeze-thaw forcing.
利用双阶段异步训练的编码器-解码器网络，将落石微震检测转化为连续时间序列分割任务。
从理论和实验上证明了以平方差之和（SSD）属性引导的自监督预训练可约束噪声扰动并避免负迁移。
实现了从法国Séchilienne到瑞士Illgraben滑坡的跨区域零样本泛化，并保持了脆性破裂的幂律能量标度一致性。
揭示了与冻融和降水强迫相关的岩崩前兆“增长—加速—平静—爆发”四阶段演化模式。
me: Two-stage dual-task 1D convolutional encoder-decoder neural network with a Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) and channel attention bottleneck.
Adaptive fusion skip-connection module using local channel attention to prevent high-frequency noise propagation during upsampling.
Self-supervised pre-training (Task A) via Mean Squared Error regression on 22 candidate sliding-window single-station seismic attributes (selecting SSD as optimal).
Encoder parameter freezing followed by supervised Binary Cross-Entropy training of the decoder (Task B) for temporal onset/offset segmentation.
Physical verification of predicted catalogs using complementary cumulative energy distributions (power-law exponent b) and temporal correlation.
构建包含门控循环单元（GRU）和通道注意力瓶颈层的双阶段双任务一维卷积编码器-解码器网络。
设计基于局部通道注意力的自适应融合跳跃连接模块，抑制上采样过程中的高频噪声传播。
基于22种单台滑动窗口地震属性开展均方误差回归自监督预训练（任务A），优选出SSD作为最佳属性。
冻结编码器参数，利用二元交叉熵损失对解码器进行监督训练（任务B），实现事件起止时间分割。
利用互补累积能量分布（幂律指数b）与时间序列相关性对生成目录进行物理一致性验证。
de: Controlled feature-screening and ablation experiments on an open-source seismic dataset (1,747 rockfalls, 1,834 earthquakes, 193 vehicle signals, 290 noise samples) injected with Gaussian white noise (-5 to 5 dB SNR).
Training on 2013 continuous 3-component waveforms (9,874 rockfall and 61,208 non-rockfall samples, 1-50 Hz, 100 Hz sampling) from station THE at the Séchilienne rockslide, French Alps.
Full-year benchmarking on 2014 continuous seismic records from Séchilienne against STA/LTA, raw-waveform U-Net, and STFT spectrum-based U-Net.

Zero-shot cross-regional transfer application to seismic station STA6 at the Illgraben rockslide, Switzerland, prior to the 2 January 2013 collapse, integrated with Montana station meteorological records.
在叠加高斯白噪声（信噪比-5至5 dB）的开源数据集（1747个落石、1834个地震等）上进行22种特征筛选与消融实验。
使用法国Séchilienne滑坡THE台站2013年连续三分量波形（9874个正样本，61208个负样本，1-50 Hz滤波，100 Hz采样）进行模型训练。
在Séchilienne台站2014年全年连续记录上与STA/LTA、原始波形U-Net和时频谱U-Net进行基准对比测试。
零样本跨区域迁移至瑞士Illgraben滑坡STA6台站（2013年1月2日崩塌前），并结合Montana气象站温度与降水数据进行演化阶段分析。
li: Feature screening relied on synthetic Gaussian white noise, lacking class-specific quantitative evaluation across distinct non-Gaussian real noise types (e.g., traffic, wind, rain, footsteps).
The SSD attribute fails to constrain event boundaries when multiple pulses mix with background disturbances or when effective event durations are very short under strong interference.

The four-stage evolutionary pattern and quiescence precursor are derived from a single complete collapse sequence at Illgraben in Alpine hard rock, requiring validation across diverse lithologies and slope types.
特征筛选依赖合成高斯白噪声，缺乏针对交通、风、降雨、脚步等不同非高斯真实噪声类型的分类定量评估。
当多脉冲信号与背景干扰混叠，或强干扰下事件有效持续时间过短时，SSD属性难以提供清晰集中的事件边界约束。
四阶段演化模式与平静期前兆仅基于高山硬岩环境下Illgraben单次完整崩塌序列得出，需在软岩、火山堆积物等不同岩性滑坡中进一步验证。

tm.why: The paper develops a two-stage seismic-attribute-guided deep learning framework with self-supervised pretraining for time-series segmentation of rockfall microseismic signals.
The study focuses on environmental seismology, specifically detecting rockfall microseismicity to understand rockslide destruction processes and precursory slope instability.
The methodology formulates seismic event detection as a continuous time-series segmentation task to build and validate complete microseismic rockfall catalogs.

ev.notes: Full 22-page research article PDF from JGR: Machine Learning and Computation (2026) was read and analyzed, including mathematical derivations, 5 tables, and 7 figures.

sum: The Main Marmara Fault (MMF) near Istanbul exhibits both locked and creeping segments, posing major seismic hazards. This study uses a published seismic tomography model to constrain the 3D thermal and rheological structure of the crust and lithospheric mantle beneath the Sea of Marmara via GOLEM modeling, combined with compiled surface helium isotope data. Results show that the locked eastern segment (Princess Islands) is controlled by a mechanically strong, mafic Istanbul Zone crust underlain by a hot, ductile mantle root that promotes interseismic stress buildup. Conversely, aseismic creep along the central segment is driven by upwelling mantle-derived fluids sourced from a dehydrating fossil NeoTethyan slab, imaged as an upper-mantle high shear-wave velocity anomaly. This deep fluid circulation elevates pore pressure, enhances fault permeability within the seismogenic depth (10–15 km), reconciles high surface helium isotope signatures, and explains fault segmentation without requiring arbitrary along-strike frictional variations.
伊斯坦布尔附近的马尔马拉主断层（MMF）兼具闭锁和蠕滑段。本研究利用已发表的地震层析成像模型约束三维热-流变模型（GOLEM），并结合地表氦同位素数据，探究控制MMF震间行为的因素。结果表明，东段（王子群岛段）的闭锁受控于坚硬的伊斯坦布尔带镁铁质地壳及其下伏热而韧性的地幔根，这促进了震间应力积累。相……

t: 3D thermal modeling with GOLEM software constrained by tomography-derived LAB isotherms, integrated with long-term frictional-viscous yield strength and dynamic fault permeability calculations.
基于层析成像LAB等温线利用GOLEM进行三维热建模，结合长期摩擦-粘滞屈服强度与动态断层渗透率计算。

Published 3D mantle seismic tomography (Blom et al., 2020), lithospheric density/velocity structure (Fernandez et al., 2024), seismicity catalogs (Becker et al., 2023), and compiled helium isotope measurements.
已发表的三维地幔层析成像、岩石圈密度/速度结构、地震目录，以及汇编的土耳其西北部氦同位素测量数据。

The 300°C and 450°C isotherms lie at 10–12 km and 17–21 km depths; fluid upwelling creates a secondary deep frictional domain and peaks permeability enhancement between 10 and 15 km in the creeping segment.
300°C和450°C等温线位于10–12 km和17–21 km；流体上涌在蠕滑段形成次级深部摩擦域并在10–15 k…
Confirming a fossil subduction slab below NW Türkiye is challenging since subduction ceased in the Eocene, and predicted deep tremors in the MMF remain undetected.
由于始新世俯冲已停止，古板片较难证实，且模拟预测的MMF深部颤动尚未被观测到。

Explains MMF locked-versus-creeping segmentation via deep mantle fluid upwelling from a dehydrating fossil NeoTethyan slab and host-rock rheological contrasts, without invoking arbitrary friction variations.
通过古新特提斯板片脱水上涌的深部地幔流体与围岩流变差异解释MMF分段行为，无需假设断层摩擦系数变化。

kc: Demonstrates that the locked eastern MMF segment is controlled by a strong mafic crust (Istanbul Zone) overlying a hot, low-viscosity mantle root.
Identifies a >200 km upper-mantle high shear-wave velocity anomaly beneath the central Sea of Marmara as a dehydrating fossil NeoTethyan slab.
Shows that mantle-derived fluid upwelling elevates pore pressure, enhances permeability at 10–15 km depth, and creates a secondary deep frictional domain that promotes central MMF creep.
证明马尔马拉主断层（MMF）东段闭锁受控于下伏热且低粘度地幔根的坚硬镁铁质地壳（伊斯坦布尔带）。
将马尔马拉海中部下方的>200 km上地幔高剪切波速异常识别为正在脱水的古新特提斯俯冲板片残余。
表明地幔流体上涌提高了孔隙压力，增强了10–15 km深度处的渗透率，并形成促进中段蠕滑的次级深部摩擦域。
me: 3D crustal thermal configuration modeling using GOLEM software constrained by the 1,300°C/1,330°C LAB isotherm derived from mantle tomography.
Long-term lithospheric yield strength integration combining rock-frictional behavior and solid-state secondary creep.
1D fault shear strength (frictional plus viscous) and dynamic stress-dependent permeability modeling incorporating mantle fluid upwelling.
利用GOLEM软件进行三维地壳热结构建模，以地幔层析成像推导的1300°C/1330°C岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）等温线为约束。
结合岩石摩擦行为与固态次生蠕变，计算岩石圈与地壳的垂直积分长期屈服强度。
结合地幔流体上涌，进行一维断层剪切强度（摩擦加粘滞）及动态应力相关渗透率建模。
de: Published 3D seismic waveform tomography model (CSEM_EastMed by Blom et al., 2020) and lithospheric structural model (Fernandez et al., 2024).
Compiled regional surface helium isotope ratio (3He/4He) measurements across NW Türkiye.
Microseismicity catalog from Becker et al. (2023) used to compare P85/P95 seismogenic depths against modeled isotherms and permeability profiles.
已发表的三维地震波形层析成像模型（Blom et al., 2020的CSEM_EastMed）及岩石圈结构模型（Fernandez et al., 2024）。
汇编并均一化的土耳其西北部区域地表氦同位素比值（3He/4He）测量数据。
Becker et al. (2023) 的微震目录，用于将P85/P95发震深度与模拟等温线及渗透率剖面进行对比。
li: Confirming a fossil subduction slab beneath NW Türkiye is difficult because regional subduction is believed to have ceased by Eocene times.
Deep tectonic tremors predicted by the secondary deep frictional domain have not yet been observationally detected along the MMF, possibly falling below detection thresholds.
由于土耳其西北部俯冲被认为在始新世已停止，证实古俯冲板片存在具有一定难度。
次级深部摩擦域预测的深部构造颤动尚未在MMF被观测到，可能低于当前检测阈值。

tm.why: The paper investigates the mechanisms controlling locked versus aseismic creeping segments along the Main Marmara Fault using rheological and fluid-pressure modeling.
The study models the 3D thermal and rheological configuration of the crust and lithospheric mantle, linking fault creep to a fossil subducted slab.

ev.notes: Full 14-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text (§1–§4), and all 6 figures.

sum: This study investigates the 19-year seismic evolution following the 2004 Mw 6.3 Les Saintes earthquake in Guadeloupe. By combining high-resolution ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) data, a relocated catalog (2004-2023) using NLL-SSST, and repeating earthquake analysis, the authors characterize the post-seismic behavior. They identify a persistent seismic gap along the central Roseau Fault, surrounded by repeating earthquakes. Over time, seismicity migrated to a Northern Sector beneath the Les Saintes islands, forming a volumetric cluster with persistent repeating events. Supported by high Vp/Vs anomalies, this long-term seismicity is interpreted as fluid-driven, triggered by post-seismic hydrothermal perturbations and fluid redistribution. The study highlights how moderate-to-large earthquakes in volcanic arcs can initiate decades-long, fluid-influenced seismic activity.
本研究结合OBS数据、19年重定位地震目录及重复地震分析，研究了2004年圣特斯Mw 6.3地震后的长期地震演化。研究发现Roseau断层中部存在持久地震空区，且地震活动随时间向北部区域迁移，形成无明显断层面的密集地震丛集。结合高Vp/Vs异常，表明该长期地震由震后流体重新分布和流体-断层相互作用维……

t: Relocation of a 19-year seismic catalog using the NonLinLoc Source-Specific Station Corrections (NLL-SSST) method, combined with repeating earthquake analysis.
使用NonLinLoc源特定台站偏差改正（NLL-SSST）方法对19年地震目录进行重定位，并结合重复地震分析。
Ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) data (25-66 days post-mainshock) and a 19-year regional seismic catalog (2004-2023).
主震后25-66天的海底地震仪（OBS）数据以及19年（2004-2023年）的区域地震目录。
Discovery of a persistent seismic gap on the Roseau Fault and a long-term migration of seismicity to a fluid-driven volumetric cluster in the Northern Sector.
发现Roseau断层上存在持久地震空区，且地震活动长期向北部区域受流体驱动的体状丛集迁移。
Absence of direct geodetic measurements to confirm whether the seismic gap is creeping or locked.
缺乏直接的大地测量数据来证实该地震空区是处于蠕滑还是锁定状态。
Demonstrating a 19-year transition from classical aftershocks to fluid-driven seismicity triggered by a moderate volcanic-arc earthquake.
证实了火山弧中强地震可触发从经典余震向流体驱动地震的19年长期演化过渡。

kc: Constructed a high-resolution 19-year relocated seismic catalog (2004-2023) for the Les Saintes region using NLL-SSST.
Identified a persistent seismic gap on the central Roseau Fault corresponding to the maximum coseismic slip zone.
Documented the long-term migration of seismicity from the main fault to a volumetric, fluid-influenced cluster in the Northern Sector.
利用NLL-SSST方法构建了圣特斯地区19年（2004-2023年）的高分辨率重定位地震目录。
识别出Roseau断层中部存在一个与最大同震滑动区域重合的持久地震空区。
记录了地震活动从主断层向北部区域体状、受流体影响的地震丛集的长期迁移过程。
me: Relocation of the 19-year seismic catalog using the NonLinLoc Source-Specific Station Corrections (NLL-SSST) method.
Analysis of repeating earthquakes to identify creep and fault patch properties.
Integration of short-term high-resolution OBS data (25-66 days post-mainshock) with long-term regional network data.
使用源特定台站偏差改正（NLL-SSST）方法对19年地震目录进行重定位。
分析重复地震以识别蠕滑和断层斑块特征。
将震后短期（25-66天）高分辨率OBS数据与长期区域台网数据相结合。
de: Ocean-bottom seismometer (OBS) data acquired 25 to 66 days after the 2004 mainshock.
Nineteen-year seismic catalog (2004-2023) from the regional network.
Repeating earthquake datasets identified from waveform similarity.
主震后25至66天采集的海底地震仪（OBS）数据。
区域台网记录的19年（2004-2023年）地震目录。
通过波形相似性识别的重复地震数据集。

Resolution of fluid migration pathways is limited by the spatial distribution of seismic stations.
缺乏连续的大地测量（GNSS/InSAR）数据来直接证实地震空区内的无震蠕滑。
流体运移路径的分辨率受限于地震台站的空间分布。

tm.why: The study utilizes a nineteen-year relocated seismic catalogue (2004-2023) and high-resolution OBS data to analyze seismicity.
It investigates repeating earthquakes, a persistent seismic gap, and fluid-fault interactions indicating potential aseismic creep or locked patches.

sum: The opening mechanism and crustal nature of the northern Red Sea (NRS) remain debated. This study integrates a new grid of 2D multi-channel reflection seismic (MCS) profiles and 30 m resolution multibeam bathymetry off the Al Wajh carbonate platform with vertical gravity gradient, magnetic, and seismicity data. The authors identify a major NNW-SSE trending meandering graben system along the proposed rift axis that exhibits negative and positive flower structures diagnostic of a sinistral transtensional strike-slip zone active since ~5 Ma. At the Mabahiss Mons, this master fault steps over and bends southward, forming the Mabahiss Deep as a rhombic pull-apart basin at the northern terminus of the Zabargad Fracture Zone. Subsurface salt structures of the Miocene Mansiyah Formation form three distinct tectonic domains reflecting thick-skinned extension and oblique shear. Discrete magmatic intrusions and submarine volcanoes indicate oblique continental rifting transitioning toward breakup, without true oceanic crust.
针对红海北部张裂机制与地壳性质的争议，本研究结合Al Wajh碳酸盐台地外新采集的2D多道反射地震、30米分辨率多波束测深以及重力梯度、磁异常和地震目录数据进行了综合分析。研究沿拟议裂谷轴识别出一个呈NNW-SSE走向的曲折地堑系统，具有典型的负花状和正花状构造，表明其为约5 Ma以来活动的左旋张扭……

t: 2D multi-channel seismic reflection profiles were processed using ProMAX (DMO, post-stack time migration, 20-60 Hz subsalt filtering) and interpreted via sequence stratigraphy in Petrel alongside 30 m multibeam bathymetry and gravity gradient data.
利用ProMAX处理2D多道地震剖面（DMO、叠后时间偏移、20-60 Hz滤波），结合30米多波束测深与重力梯度进行层…

A grid of 2D MCS data (144-channel, 600 m streamer, two GI-guns) and multibeam bathymetry (EM710/EM122, 30 m grid) acquired off the Al Wajh platform during RV Meteor cruise M193 and RV Thuwal cruises.
M193与Thuwal航次在Al Wajh台地外采集的144道2D反射地震、30米分辨率多波束测深及重磁震综合数据。

Identified a 2 to >10 km wide NNW-SSE sinistral transtensional graben system with flower structures active since ~5 Ma, stepping over into the 50 km by 16 km Mabahiss Deep pull-apart basin (>2 km infill, -40E gravity low).
识别出宽2至>10 km的NNW-SSE向左旋张扭花状构造带（约5 Ma以来活动），并在阶跃处形成50×16 km的Ma…
Massive halite of the Mansiyah Formation and magmatic bodies strongly attenuate seismic energy, preventing imaging of deeper syn-rift strata or potential oceanic basement.
巨厚中新统盐层和岩浆岩强烈衰减地震波信号，无法对更深部同裂谷沉积或基底直接成像。
Demonstrates that the northern Red Sea axis is a post-Miocene left-lateral transtensional strike-slip shear zone with a pull-apart basin (Mabahiss Deep) rather than an oceanic spreading ridge.
揭示红海北部裂谷轴为中新世后左旋张扭走滑剪切带与拉分盆地，而非海底扩张脊。

kc: Mapped a major post-Miocene NNW-SSE left-lateral transtensional strike-slip fault system along the northern Red Sea rift axis using high-resolution 2D MCS and multibeam bathymetry.
Demonstrated that the Mabahiss Deep is a rhombic pull-apart basin formed at a fault stepover at the northern end of the Zabargad Fracture Zone.
Classified subsurface Miocene salt structures into three distinct structural domains that reflect thick-skinned basement extension and oblique strike-slip shearing.
Provided seismic, gravity, and magnetic evidence that the northern Red Sea is undergoing oblique continental rifting with discrete magmatic intrusions rather than continuous seafloor spreading.
利用高分辨率2D多道地震和多波束测深，在红海北部裂谷轴沿线揭示了中新世后形成的NNW-SSE向左旋张扭走滑断层系统。
证明Mabahiss海渊是在Zabargad断裂带北端断层阶跃处形成的菱形拉分盆地。
将地下中新统盐构造划分为三个不同的构造域，反映了厚皮基底伸展和斜向走滑剪切作用。
提供了地震、重力和磁异常证据，表明红海北部正经历伴随孤立岩浆侵入的斜向大陆裂谷作用，而非连续的海底扩张。
me: 2D multi-channel seismic (MCS) reflection profiling processed with pre-stack DMO, post-stack time migration, and 20-60 Hz bandpass filtering for subsalt imaging.
Sequence-stratigraphic and seismic facies analysis tied to regional Red Sea lithostratigraphy and DSDP Leg 23B well data.
High-resolution (30 m) multibeam bathymetric mapping integrated with global vertical gravity gradient (VGG), shipborne/satellite magnetic anomalies, and earthquake catalogs.
开展2D多道反射地震剖面处理，采用叠前倾角时差校正（DMO）、叠后时间偏移及20-60 Hz带通滤波以增强盐下成像。
结合红海区域岩相地层学与DSDP Leg 23B钻井数据，进行层序地层学与地震相分析。
将30米高分辨率多波束测深图与全球垂向重力梯度（VGG）、船载/卫星磁异常及地震目录数据进行综合解释。
de: 2D MCS dataset acquired during RV Meteor cruise M193 in 2023 using a 144-channel streamer (600 m active length) and a two-GI-gun cluster.
Multibeam echosounder bathymetry from RV Thuwal (2019, Kongsberg EM710) and RV Meteor cruise M193 (2023, EM710 and EM122) gridded at 30 m resolution.
Published vertical gravity gradient (SIO V32.1), compiled magnetic anomaly grids (LCS-1), USGS historical earthquakes (M > 4), and local OBS seismicity catalogs.
2023年RV Meteor M193航次采集的2D多道地震数据，使用144道数字拖缆（有效长度600米）和双GI气枪震源阵列。
2019年RV Thuwal航次（EM710）与2023年M193航次（EM710和EM122）采集的多波束测深数据，网格分辨率为30米。
公开的垂向重力梯度（SIO V32.1）、磁异常网格（LCS-1）、USGS历史地震（M > 4）以及局部海底地震仪（OBS）重定位目录。
li: Thick, mobile Miocene salt layers (Mansiyah Formation) and magmatic rocks strongly attenuate acoustic signals, preventing MCS imaging of deeper syn-rift units (Maqna Group and Burqan Formation) and crystalline basement.
Bouguer gravity anomalies are unavailable in the northern Red Sea, and terrain density corrections are poorly constrained due to complex massive salt bodies.
Magnetic anomaly track lines have limited spatial coverage in parts of the study area, failing to cross magmatic intrusion MI4 directly.
巨厚且流动的中新统盐层（Mansiyah组）和岩浆岩强烈衰减声波信号，限制了多道地震对更深部同裂谷沉积（Maqna群和Burqan组）及结晶基底的成像。
红海北部缺乏公开的布格重力异常数据，且复杂的巨厚盐体使得地形密度校正难以准确约束。
部分研究区的船载磁异常测线空间覆盖有限，未能直接跨越岩浆侵入体MI4。

tm.why: The paper investigates the tectonic opening mechanism, continental rifting, salt tectonics, and crustal structure of the northern Red Sea using reflection seismics, bathymetry, gravity, and magnetic data.
It maps and characterizes a major transtensional left-lateral strike-slip fault system, flower structures, and the Mabahiss Deep pull-apart basin.

ev.notes: Full 25-page PDF analyzed in detail, including abstract, methodology, seismic profiles (Figs. 1-12, Table 1), discussion, and conclusions.

sum: This paper presents an optimized method for predicting the boundaries and filling degrees of fault-controlled fracture-cave reservoirs in the Middle Permian Maokou Formation, southern Sichuan Basin. Using 1D wave equation and AVA forward modeling, the authors optimized prestack gathers and computed gradient structure tensor attributes to delineate boundaries. Prestack simultaneous inversion was then applied to obtain elastic parameters (Vp/Vs and P-impedance). A rock physics interpretation panel classified filling degrees into fully filled, partially filled, and unfilled categories. The results show that unfilled and partially filled fracture-caves are concentrated near faults, making up 48.81% of the total volume. The workflow was validated with an 83.3% concordance rate in dynamic verification wells, demonstrating a significant improvement in prediction accuracy for complex carbonate reservoirs.
针对川南茅口组断控缝洞型储层，本文提出预测边界和充填度的优化方法。利用梯度结构张量确定缝洞边界，通过叠前同时反演获取纵横波速度比和纵波阻抗，并构建岩石物理图版，将充填度划分为未充填、半充填和全充填。结果表明，未充填和半充填缝洞主要发育在断裂附近，占总发育体积的48.81%，验证井吻合率达83.3%。

t: An optimized workflow combining gradient structure tensor attributes for boundary detection and prestack simultaneous inversion for elastic parameter estimation to predict fracture-cave filling degrees.
结合梯度结构张量属性确定边界，并利用叠前同时反演获取弹性参数以预测缝洞充填度。
Multi-source seismic data, prestack gathers, and dynamic verification well data from the Middle Permian Maokou Formation in the Luzhou area, southern Sichuan Basin.
四川盆地南部泸州地区中二叠统茅口组的多源地震数据、叠前道集及动态验证井数据。
Unfilled and partially filled fracture-caves comprise 48.81% of the total volume, concentrated near faults, with the prediction validated by an 83.3% concordance rate in wells.
未充填和半充填缝洞占总发育体积的48.81%，集中在断裂附近，预测结果井吻合率达83.3%。
The workflow's accuracy is constrained by prestack data quality and the simplified 1D wave equation forward modeling assumption.

sum: This paper proposes a novel full-waveform inversion (FWI) method, SSIM-FWI, which utilizes a multi-scale structural similarity index measure (SSIM) as the objective function to mitigate cycle skipping. To address issues of inaccurate background velocity and missing low-frequency components, the method extracts multi-scale structural features of seismic data in both time and space. Additionally, anisotropic total variation regularization with the lp quasi-norm (ATpV) is incorporated to suppress artifacts and preserve sharp geological boundaries. The optimization is efficiently implemented using automatic differentiation (AD). Synthetic and field data tests demonstrate that the proposed method accurately reconstructs complex velocity structures under noisy and crude initial model conditions.

sum: This study applies ambient noise differential adjoint tomography to 53 days of continuous transverse-component records from 30 ocean-bottom seismometers along line KI04 in the Nankai Trough. By inverting Love wave differential phase times (0.14–0.25 Hz) with a 2D SH-wave finite-frequency formulation, the authors obtain a high-resolution shear-wave velocity (Vs) model for the upper 5 km below the seafloor. Results reveal a high-Vs, low-Vp/Vs zone in the shallow imbricate thrust zone (0–2 km bsf) overlying a low-Vs, high-Vp/Vs underthrust sediment region. This upper high-Vs layer likely acts as a low-permeability seal that traps upward-migrating fluids, elevating pore pressure and promoting shallow slow earthquakes. Conversely, a widespread low-Vs, high-Vp/Vs anomaly at 2–5 km bsf beneath the Kumano basin suggests that deep dehydration fluids migrate upward through permeable pathways, indicating the absence of an impermeable barrier above the locked seismogenic zone.

sum: Traditional aftershock forecasting relies on statistical point-process models like Reasenberg–Jones (R-J) and ETAS, which prescribe fixed temporal decays and isotropic spatial kernels that fail to capture fault-aligned anisotropy early in a sequence. This paper introduces QuakeGen, a conditional denoising diffusion model that recasts earthquake forecasting as the generation of 2D spatiotemporal fields of event log-count and maximum magnitude. Conditioned on nested windows of past seismicity and the forecast horizon, a U-Net generates an ensemble of realizations capturing forecast uncertainty and granular fault structure. Trained on 2,046 global mainshock sequences (1990–2023) and tested on 80 held-out sequences (2024–2025), QuakeGen outperforms the operational USGS-RJ baseline in spatial information gain, Wasserstein distance, and MSESS by inferring fault geometry from the first 1.6 hours of aftershocks. On southern California's QTM catalog, a single QuakeGen model matches locally tuned ETAS models and generalizes across catalog types without retraining.
传统余震预测依赖ETAS和R-J等统计点过程模型，其固定时间衰减和各向同性空间核难以捕捉断层控制的各向异性空间模式。本文提出条件去噪扩散模型QuakeGen，将地震预测重构为地震频次和最大震级二维时空场的条件生成。基于U-Net架构并以历史地震活动和预测时效为条件，模型可生成反映不确定性和断层精细结……

sum: This study investigates how continental crust responds to complex mantle flow in the Northeast China back-arc system. The authors develop a robust Bayesian working-likelihood approach to estimate crust-averaged azimuthal anisotropy from P-wave receiver functions (Pms phase). By combining a first-order Taylor expansion for isotropic ray-parameter moveout with first- and second-harmonic back-azimuthal terms, the method separates Moho-dip apparent anisotropy from crustal velocity anisotropy without requiring a prescribed velocity model. Applied to 36,945 radial receiver functions across 131 stations, the inversion reveals a regionally coherent E–W crustal fast-axis direction, consistent with extension driven by Pacific-slab rollback. Conversely, published XKS splitting and anisotropic tomography show locally variable mantle anisotropy. This contrast supports partial crust–mantle anisotropic decoupling, compatible with a 'caramel pudding' rheological model where a weak lithospheric mantle filters localized mantle flow stresses before they reach the crust.
本研究探讨了中国东北大陆弧后系统中地壳如何响应复杂的地幔流。作者开发了一种稳健的贝叶斯工作似然方法，利用远震P波接收函数（Pms震相）估计地壳平均方位各向异性。该方法结合一阶泰勒展开校正各向同性动校正残差，并通过谐波分解分离莫霍面倾斜引起的视各向异性与地壳速度各向异性，无需预设速度模型。应用于131……

Anisotropy observations do not directly constrain lithospheric strength, so the weak-mantle rheological interpretation is plausible but not uniquely demonstrated by the data.

sum: Understanding magma emplacement requires simulating complex crustal and magma rheologies in scaled laboratory experiments. This study characterizes Laponite RD (LRD, 3 wt%) gels across short curing times (30 to 240 min) as viscoelastic host rock analogues and aqueous hydroxyethyl cellulose (HEC, 0.50–1.00 wt%) solutions as shear-thinning magma analogues. To achieve reproducible LRD rheometry, the authors introduce a strict protocol combining serrated parallel plates, in-situ curing, and a 3D-printed humidity envelope. Results show LRD storage modulus increases 35-fold (4.4 to 155 Pa) and yield stress increases from 0.21 to 4.87 Pa with curing time, without altering density or surface tension. Furthermore, pendant-drop tensiometry and Hele-Shaw injection tests reveal that interfacial tension and subtle density contrasts (~20 kg/m³) strongly control intrusion morphology in weak viscoelastic hosts. Pairing LRD with salt- and powder-dye-adjusted HEC eliminates capillary and buoyancy artefacts, enabling robust simulation of volcanic plumbing systems.
本研究表征了固定浓度（3 wt%）Laponite RD（LRD）在30至240分钟短固化时间内的流变特性，以及0.50–1.00 wt%羟乙基纤维素（HEC）溶液作为岩浆模拟材料的性质。通过采用锯齿平行板、原位固化和3D打印保湿罩，解决了LRD流变测量中的壁面滑移、触变结构破坏和失水问题。结果表明……

Experiment duration is restricted to a few minutes due to continuous LRD ageing, deformed thixotropic gel cannot be reused, and sequential pouring produces inverted crustal stiffness stratification.

Tunes LRD rheology via short curing times (30–240 min) at fixed concentration while matching magma-host surface tension and neutral buoyancy to eliminate capillary and buoyancy artefacts.

Showed that a ~2% density contrast (~20 kg/m³) switches intrusion morphology from buoyant ascent to neutral lateral spreading, requiring precise salt-based density matching.

sum: This study analyzes historical paper marigrams of the tsunami triggered by the 1971 Mw 7.8 La Ligua earthquake in central Chile. By modeling the tsunami propagation and comparing synthetic waveforms with observed records, the authors show that the earthquake rupture occurred deeper along the megathrust than previously estimated, specifically downdip of the main aftershock zone. This finding challenges traditional assumptions about the seismogenic coupling zone and depth limits of tsunamigenic ruptures in the Chilean subduction zone, highlighting the potential for deep megathrust events to generate significant tsunamis.

sum: This study investigates the volcano-tectonic interactions at Mount Slamet, an active stratovolcano in Central Java, Indonesia. By integrating high-resolution Digital Elevation Model (DEM) morphometric analysis with tectonic strain analysis, the authors delineate the structural features, fault networks, and volcanic lineaments of the volcano. The results reveal how regional tectonic stress fields influence volcanic growth, flank instability, and magma plumbing pathways. This work provides crucial insights into the structural evolution of Mount Slamet and highlights the utility of high-resolution geomorphological data in assessing volcano-tectonic hazards in active volcanic arcs.

sum: This study combines a refined GNSS velocity field and elastic block modeling to investigate the deformation partitioning of the Datong basin-range system in North China. The authors find that left-lateral shear (~2 mm/yr) and NW-SE extension (~1 mm/yr) are distributed across multiple faults and coherent block rotations, rather than localized on a single structure. Integrating these geodetic observations with mantle tomography reveals a low-velocity anomaly beneath Datong. This suggests that upwelling-driven thermal weakening interacts with far-field stresses from the India-Asia collision and Pacific plate rollback. The deep-shallow coupling highlights the role of mantle dynamics in driving continental intraplate deformation and indicates a non-negligible seismic hazard in the region.

sum: Conventional convolutional neural networks (CNNs) struggle with overfitting on small, class-imbalanced infrasound datasets and fail to provide predictive confidence. This study introduces a model-agnostic Bayesian CNN framework that treats network weights as probability distributions inferred via variational approximation and the local reparameterization trick. Using Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) spectrograms from 2,306 recordings across 595 events (nuclear tests, chemical explosions, volcanic eruptions, rocket launches, earthquakes, and lightning) with strict event-level data splitting, the authors convert LeNet-5, AlexNet, and a custom multi-scale 4Conv3Fc network into Bayesian counterparts. Without data augmentation, Bayes 4Conv3Fc achieves 99.14% overall accuracy, outperforming deterministic and class-weighted cross-entropy baselines in F1-score, PR-AUC, and Brier score (reducing Brier scores by 28.9%–42.0%). The novelty lies in jointly decomposing epistemic and aleatoric uncertainties for infrasound monitoring, enabling reliable confidence assessment and diagnosing whether errors stem from model capacity or intrinsic signal variability.
针对小样本、类别不平衡次声数据集中传统CNN易过拟合且无法量化不确定性的问题，本文提出一种基于变分推断与局部重参数化技巧的贝叶斯CNN框架。研究采用来自595个事件（核试验、化爆、火山喷发、火箭发射、地震、闪电）的2306条次声记录，经STFT转换为时频谱图，并采用严格的事件级划分策略。在无需数据增……

t: Transforms deterministic CNNs (LeNet-5, AlexNet, and a custom multi-scale 4Conv3Fc network) into Bayesian CNNs using variational inference, local reparameterization, and STFT spectrograms to classify imbalanced infrasound events and decompose epistemic and aleatoric uncertainties.
利用变分推断、局部重参数化和STFT谱图将确定性CNN转化为贝叶斯CNN，进行不平衡次声分类与不确定性分解。

2,306 infrasound waveforms from 595 events across six imbalanced classes (nuclear tests, chemical explosions, volcanic eruptions, rocket launches, earthquakes, lightning) recorded at 96 stations from 1952 to 2022, partitioned strictly at the event level.
1952至2022年96个台站记录的595个事件共2306条六类不平衡次声波形，采用严格的事件级划分。

Bayes 4Conv3Fc achieves 99.14% accuracy, 99.05% F1-score, and 98.98% Cohen's Kappa without data augmentation. Across architectures, Bayesian CNNs improve F1-scores by up to 7.2 percentage points and reduce Brier scores by 28.9%–42.0% over class-weighted baselines.
Bayes 4Conv3Fc无需数据增强即达99.14%准确率和99.05% F1分数，比加权基线降低28.9%–42.…
Lacks computational cost analysis for Monte Carlo sampling overhead and omits direct empirical comparisons with MC Dropout, explicit deep ensembles, focal loss, and expected calibration error.
缺乏蒙特卡洛采样计算成本分析，以及与MC Dropout和深度集成等方法的对比。

First application of Bayesian CNNs to jointly decompose epistemic and aleatoric uncertainties and verify probability calibration in multi-class infrasound event classification without relying on synthetic data augmentation.
首次在无数据增强的次声事件分类中应用贝叶斯CNN联合量化认知与偶然不确定性并验证校准度。

kc: Proposed a model-agnostic Bayesian CNN framework with variational inference and local reparameterization for imbalanced multi-class infrasound classification without data augmentation.
Designed a custom multi-scale 4Conv3Fc architecture (using 7x7, 5x5, and 3x3 kernels) that achieves 99.14% accuracy and 0.9859 average PR-AUC under Bayesian training.
Implemented strict event-level stratified dataset partitioning across 595 events (2,306 recordings) to prevent multi-station data leakage.
Decomposed predictive uncertainty into epistemic and aleatoric components and verified superior probabilistic calibration via Brier score reductions of 28.9% to 42.0% over class-weighted models.
提出了结合变分推断和局部重参数化的模型无关贝叶斯CNN框架，无需数据增强即可处理不平衡多类别次声分类。
设计了自定义多尺度4Conv3Fc网络架构（结合7x7、5x5和3x3卷积核），在贝叶斯训练下实现99.14%的准确率和0.9859的平均PR-AUC。
在595个事件（2306条波形记录）上实施严格的事件级分层数据划分，防止多台站同事件记录导致的数据泄露。
将预测不确定性分解为认知不确定性和偶然不确定性，并通过比类别加权模型降低28.9%至42.0%的Brier分数验证了其优越的概率校准性能。
me: Shape-preserving piecewise cubic interpolation to unify sampling rates to 100 Hz, followed by Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) with a 1 s Hann window and 50% overlap to generate 256x256 log-power spectrograms.
Custom 4Conv3Fc CNN architecture utilizing coarse-to-fine multi-scale convolutional blocks (7x7, 5x5, and two 3x3 kernels), batch normalization, max-pooling, and LeakyReLU activations.
Variational inference maximizing the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO) with KL annealing (weighted by 1/N) and Gaussian weight priors, accelerated via the local reparameterization trick.
Predictive uncertainty decomposition into aleatoric and epistemic variance components across T=50 Monte Carlo forward passes, evaluated alongside macro-averaged PR-AUC and Brier scores.
采用保形分段三次插值将采样率统一为100 Hz，随后使用1秒汉宁窗和50%重叠的短时傅里叶变换（STFT）生成256x256对数功率谱图。
构建自定义的4Conv3Fc卷积神经网络架构，采用由粗到细的多尺度卷积块（7x7、5x5和两个3x3卷积核）、批归一化、最大池化和LeakyReLU激活函数。
通过最大化证据下界（ELBO）进行变分推断，结合KL退火（按1/N加权）、高斯权重先验以及局部重参数化技巧。
通过T=50次蒙特卡洛前向采样将预测方差分解为偶然不确定性和认知不确定性，并结合宏平均PR-AUC与Brier分数进行评估。
de: 2,306 infrasound waveform recordings from 595 independent events recorded between October 1952 and January 2022 across 96 fixed stations (IMS arrays and laboratory stations) at distances of 34 km to 16,180 km.

Six highly imbalanced event categories: chemical explosions (282 events, 1,084 samples), volcanic eruptions (86 events, 543 samples), nuclear tests (96 events, 257 samples), lightning (84 events, 252 samples), earthquakes (19 events, 137 samples), and rocket launches (28 events, 33 samples).

Event-level 80%/10%/10% train/validation/test partitioning and 10-fold event-grouped cross-validation comparing deterministic baselines (LeNet-5, AlexNet, 4Conv3Fc), inverse-frequency class-weighted cross-entropy models, and Bayesian CNN variants.
1952年10月至2022年1月期间由96个固定台站（IMS台阵和实验室台站）在34至16,180公里距离内记录的595个独立事件的2306条次声波形。
六个高度不平衡的事件类别：化学爆炸（282个事件，1084个样本）、火山喷发（86个事件，543个样本）、核试验（96个事件，257个样本）、闪电（84个事件，252个样本）、地震（19个事件，137个样本）和火箭发射（28个事件，33个样本）。
采用事件级80%/10%/10%训练/验证/测试划分及10折交叉验证，对比确定性基线（LeNet-5、AlexNet、4Conv3Fc）、逆频率类别加权交叉熵模型和贝叶斯CNN变体。
li: Detailed computational cost analysis and optimization of training/inference overhead from drawing 50 Monte Carlo samples are not yet included.

Direct empirical comparisons against alternative uncertainty and ensembling methods such as Monte Carlo Dropout, explicit deep ensembles, focal loss, and reliability diagrams are left for future work.
尚未提供详细的计算成本分析，也未对50次蒙特卡洛采样带来的训练与推理时间开销进行轻量化优化。
缺乏与蒙特卡洛Dropout、显式深度集成、Focal Loss以及可靠性图（ECE）等其他不确定性或集成方法的直接实验对比。

tm.why: The paper develops a Bayesian convolutional neural network (CNN) framework for classifying geophysical and anthropogenic infrasound waveforms including earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, and nuclear tests.
The core contribution is introducing variational Bayesian inference over CNN weights to quantify epistemic and aleatoric predictive uncertainties and evaluate probabilistic calibration.
The study focuses on seismo-acoustic and atmospheric infrasound monitoring of volcanic eruptions, earthquakes, lightning, explosions, and rocket launches.

ev.notes: Full 32-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, methodology, equations, 10 figures, and 11 tables.

sum: Io, Europa, and Ganymede orbit in the Laplace mean-motion resonance, strongly coupling their orbital and thermochemical evolution. Previous studies have not modeled this coupled evolution in a self-consistent framework constrained by modern observations. Here, the authors integrate Laplace-resonance equations with layered thermochemical models of Io and Europa, using an 80,000-simulation Monte Carlo ensemble constrained by modern measurements of migration rates, surface heat fluxes, tidal Love numbers, and moments of inertia. The joint observations select an ongoing late-time limit cycle established ~0.8–2.0 Gyr ago that repeats every ~95–150 Myr. The present state—where Io experiences high dissipation and migrates inward while Europa and Ganymede migrate outward—recurs within this oscillatory branch. Across the cycle, Io's mean mantle melt fraction varies between ~10–30% without requiring a magma ocean, while Europa's ice-shell thickness varies by ~3–15 km over a relatively cold mantle.
本研究将拉普拉斯共振轨道方程与木卫一、木卫二的分层热化学演化模型耦合，结合约8万次蒙特卡洛模拟，利用迁移率、热流、潮汐响应和转动惯量等现代天体测量与地球物理观测进行约束。结果表明，伽利略卫星在约0.8–2.0 Gyr前进入了周期约95–150 Myr的热-轨道极限环。当前木卫一向内迁移而木卫二、木卫……

t: Coupled ODE integration of Laplace-resonance orbital migration equations with layered thermochemical models of Io and Europa, using Andrade viscoelastic Love-number solvers and Monte Carlo ensemble sampling (~80,000 runs).
耦合拉普拉斯共振迁移方程与分层热化学模型，采用Andrade粘弹性求解器并进行8万次蒙特卡洛采样。
Constrained by modern astrometric migration rates and resonance drift, Io's tidal Love numbers and surface heat flux, and Europa's conductive ice-shell thickness, heat flux, and moments of inertia.
联合现代天体测量迁移率、共振漂移率、木卫一潮汐响应与热流、木卫二冰壳厚度与转动惯量。

31% of 80,000 runs develop oscillations; 100% of the top 1% scoring models require an ongoing ~95–150 Myr limit cycle starting ~0.8–2.0 Gyr ago, with 10–30% Io melt and 3–15 km Europa ice-shell variations.
前1%高分模型均表明存在始于0.8–2.0 Gyr前、周期95–150 Myr的极限环，木卫一熔融分数为10–30%。
Heat-pipe volcanism and melt migration in Io are omitted, Ganymede is modeled as a point mass, and Europa's cold mantle inference depends on assuming an iron-rich core composition.
忽略了木卫一热管火山作用与熔体迁移，木卫三被视为质点，且木卫二核成分假设存在非唯一性。

First self-consistent coupled orbital-thermochemical evolution model of the Galilean moons jointly constrained by modern astrometric migration and geophysical data, incorporating silicate latent heat.
首次建立受现代天体测量与地球物理联合约束的自洽热-轨道耦合演化模型，并引入硅酸盐潜热。

kc: Demonstrates that joint astrometric and geophysical observations require an ongoing thermal-orbital limit cycle in the Galilean moons with a period of ~95–150 Myr.
Shows that Io's present inward migration and Europa's outward migration represent a recurring transient phase within this oscillatory cycle rather than a steady state.
Constrains Io's volume-averaged mantle melt fraction to vary by ~10–30% during the cycle (median 15% today) concentrated in the upper mantle, precluding the need for a magma ocean.
Predicts Europa's total ice-shell thickness is 22–33 km today with cyclic variations of 3–15 km, underlain by a cold, predominantly conductive rocky mantle and late-forming metallic core.
证明联合天体测量和地球物理观测要求伽利略卫星处于周期约95–150 Myr的持续热-轨道极限环中。
表明木卫一当前的向内迁移与木卫二的向外迁移并非稳态，而是该振荡周期中反复出现的瞬态阶段。
约束木卫一地幔平均熔融分数在周期内变化约10–30%（当前中位数为15%），集中在上地幔，无需岩浆洋。
预测木卫二当前总冰壳厚度为22–33 km，周期性变化为3–15 km，下伏寒冷且以传导为主的岩石地幔及晚期形成的金属核。
me: Coupled ODE integration of reduced Laplace-resonance migration equations with 1D radial finite-volume layered thermochemical models for Io and Europa.
Viscoelastic tidal response computation using a degree-2 matrix-propagation Love-number solver with Andrade anelasticity and empirical melt-weakening rheology.
Enthalpy formulation for silicate phase change to self-consistently account for latent heat and pressure-dependent Fe-FeS core differentiation in Europa.
Monte Carlo ensemble sampling (~80,000 simulations) over initial orbital, thermal, and rheological parameters, ranked against joint near-present observational constraints.
将简化的拉普拉斯共振迁移方程与木卫一、木卫二的一维径向有限体积分层热化学模型进行耦合常微分方程积分。
采用结合Andrade非弹性和经验熔融弱化流变学的二阶矩阵传播Love数求解器计算粘弹性潮汐响应。
采用硅酸盐相变焓公式自洽计算潜热，并结合压力相关的Fe-FeS相图模拟木卫二核分异过程。
对初始轨道、热和流变参数进行约80,000次蒙特卡洛集合采样，并根据近似当代的联合观测约束进行评分排序。
de: Long-baseline astrometric measurements of orbital migration rates (n_dot/n) and Laplace-resonance drift rate (nu_dot) from Lainey et al. (2009).
Geophysical observations of Io's tidal Love numbers Re(k2) and k2/Q (Park et al., 2025) and infrared surface heat flux.
Europa's conductive ice-shell thickness from Juno microwave radiometry (Levin et al., 2026) and normalized moment of inertia C/(MR^2) from Galileo radio tracking.
来自长基线天体测量的轨道迁移率（n_dot/n）和拉普拉斯共振漂移率（nu_dot）数据（Lainey等，2009）。
木卫一的潮汐Love数Re(k2)与k2/Q（Park等，2025）以及红外观测表面热流等地球物理观测数据。
来自Juno微波辐射计的木卫二传导冰壳厚度（Levin等，2026）以及来自Galileo无线电跟踪的归一化转动惯量C/(MR^2)。
li: Ganymede is treated as a point mass without a separate local dissipation term in the migration equations.
Magma migration and heat-pipe volcanism in Io are omitted for simplicity, which could modify the temperature profile and cycle timing.
Inferred cold mantle in Europa depends on the assumed iron-rich core composition; a lighter, sulfur-enriched core could allow a hotter, convecting mantle.
木卫三在迁移方程中被简化为质点，未分配独立的局部潮汐耗散项。
为简化起见忽略了木卫一的岩浆迁移和热管火山作用，这可能会改变温度剖面及周期的时序。
木卫二寒冷地幔的推论依赖于富铁核成分假设；若核部富含轻元素且密度较低，则可能允许更热的对流地幔。

tm.why: The paper investigates the interior structure, tidal dissipation, volcanism, and ice-shell thickness of the Galilean moons (Io, Europa, and Ganymede).
The study models coupled orbital and thermochemical evolution, mantle partial melting, viscoelastic rheology, and core differentiation.

sum: Submarine telecom cables equipped with distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) enable large-scale marine mammal monitoring, yet transforming massive raw recordings into interpretable bioacoustic parameters remains challenging. This paper presents an unsupervised end-to-end workflow for fin whale song detection, characterization, and localization, tested on the Tarifa-Ceuta and Estepona-Tetouan cables in the Strait of Gibraltar and western Alboran Sea. The novelty lies in adapting the seismic Kurtosis-Value Picker (KVP) with a Morlet wavelet for narrow-band calls, combined with DBSCAN clustering, bounding-box agglomeration, and hyperbolic moveout fitting to isolate coherent notes. Dual-resolution spectrograms then extract temporal, spectral, and energy descriptors to classify type-A and type-B notes, followed by 2D grid-search localization. Evaluated against six manually annotated songs, the method achieves 0.990 pick-level precision (0.744 recall) and 0.880 cluster-level precision (0.806 recall), successfully separating overlapping singers and tracking whale swimming trajectories.
本文提出了一套利用海底分布式声学传感（DAS）光缆进行长须鲸歌声自动检测、音符特征表征与声源定位的无监督端到端工作流，并在直布罗陀海峡和阿尔沃兰海的两条海底通信光缆上进行了验证。创新点在于采用Morlet小波改进地震峰度值拾取器（KVP）以适应窄带鲸鸣，结合DBSCAN聚类、层次凝聚及双曲线走时拟合……

t: Adapts the multiscale Kurtosis-Value Picker (KVP) using a Morlet wavelet, groups channel picks via DBSCAN and hierarchical bounding-box agglomeration, validates arrivals with hyperbolic moveout fitting, extracts dual-spectrogram features, and localizes sources via 2D grid search.
用Morlet小波改进KVP拾取器，结合DBSCAN与层次凝聚聚类及双曲线拟合，提取双时频谱特征并进行二维网格定位。

Submarine DAS strain recordings from the Tarifa-Ceuta (34.1 km, Strait of Gibraltar, 2022) and Estepona-Tetouan (59.8 km, western Alboran Sea, 2023–2024) telecom cables, acquired with 10 m channel spacing and resampled to 100 Hz.
直布罗陀海峡Tarifa-Ceuta（34.1 km）和西阿尔沃兰海Estepona-Tetouan（59.8 km）海…

Evaluated on six manually annotated fin whale songs, the detector achieved median pick-level precision of 0.990 (recall 0.744) and cluster-level precision of 0.880 (recall 0.806), while successfully tracking swimming speeds of 3.31–6.48 km/h.
6段人工标注歌声评估显示拾取级中位精确率0.990（召回率0.744），簇级精确率0.880（召回率0.806），推断游…
Linear cable geometries cause bilateral localization ambiguity, and the workflow lacks automated track association to assign separated note clusters to continuous trajectories of individual whales.
直线光缆存在左右对称定位模糊性，且缺乏将音符簇自动关联为连续个体运动轨迹的跟踪模块。

Provides an unsupervised, training-free end-to-end DAS workflow combining Morlet-adapted KVP picking, spatio-temporal hyperbolic clustering, automated note-type characterization, and grid-search localization.
提出无需监督训练的端到端DAS工作流，集成Morlet-KVP拾取、时空双曲线聚类、音符特征提取与声源定位。

kc: Adapted the multiscale Kurtosis-Value Picker (KVP) to narrow-band, multi-cycle fin whale vocalizations by replacing the Ricker wavelet with a frequency-selective Morlet wavelet.

Developed a multi-stage association pipeline combining DBSCAN clustering, bounding-box hierarchical agglomeration, and time-weighted hyperbolic moveout fitting to isolate individual whale notes and reject noise.

Implemented an automated dual-spectrogram feature extraction scheme that characterizes temporal, spectral, and energy descriptors, enabling type-A/B note discrimination and inter-note interval estimation.
Demonstrated 2D horizontal grid-search source localization and apparent movement inference using relative arrival times on two submarine DAS datasets, releasing the open-source DASWhaleCalls code.
将Ricker小波替换为具有更高频率选择性的Morlet小波，使多尺度峰度值拾取算法（KVP）适应窄带多周期的长须鲸发声。
开发了结合DBSCAN聚类、边界框层次凝聚和加权双曲线走时拟合的多阶段关联流程，有效分离单个鲸鱼音符并剔除不相干噪声。
实现了基于双分辨率时频谱的自动特征提取方案，量化时间、频谱和能量描述符，支持A/B型音符区分及音符间隔估计。
利用两条海底DAS数据集的相对到时实现了二维水平网格搜索定位与游动轨迹推断，并开源了DASWhaleCalls代码。
me: Preprocessing with median filtering for optical noise reduction and a 10–40 Hz fourth-order Butterworth band-pass filter, followed by channel-wise Morlet-wavelet KVP detection.
Density-based spatio-temporal clustering (DBSCAN) in velocity-scaled coordinates, followed by complete-linkage hierarchical agglomeration of expanded bounding boxes and union-find transitive merging.
Time-weighted hyperbolic arrival-time fitting via grid search over apex position with outlier rejection to validate coherent acoustic arrivals.
Feature extraction using both time-oriented (NFFT=32) and frequency-oriented (NFFT=64) spectrograms within 16–28 Hz to compute centroids, spreads, spectral slope, decay time, and SNR.
2D horizontal source localization on a 6x6 km grid (25 m spacing) at fixed shallow depth using L1 relative arrival-time residuals with MAD outlier rejection.
采用中值滤波去除光学共模噪声并进行10–40 Hz四阶Butterworth带通滤波预处理，随后逐道应用Morlet小波KVP算法进行检测。
在参考速度缩放的距离坐标下进行DBSCAN时空密度聚类，再对扩展边界框进行完全连接层次聚类与并查集（union-find）合并。
采用基于顶点位置网格搜索的时间加权双曲线走时拟合与残差异常值剔除，验证相干声学到时。
结合时间导向（NFFT=32）和频率导向（NFFT=64）双时频谱，在16–28 Hz频段内提取质心、展宽、频谱斜率、衰减时间和信噪比等特征。
固定浅水声源深度，在6×6 km网格（间距25 m）上利用L1范数相对到时残差和MAD异常值剔除进行二维水平声源定位。
de: Submarine DAS recordings on 34.1 km of the Tarifa-Ceuta telecom cable (Strait of Gibraltar, June–October 2022) and 59.8 km of the Estepona-Tetouan cable (western Alboran Sea, September 2023–February 2024).
Interrogated with chirped-pulse HDAS systems using 10 m gauge length and 10 m channel spacing, recorded at 100 or 250 Hz (resampled to 100 Hz).
Quantitative detection evaluation on six manually annotated fin whale song recordings, plus case studies on note characterization, source tracking, and overlapping singers.
直布罗陀海峡Tarifa-Ceuta海底通信光缆（34.1 km，2022年6–10月）与西阿尔沃兰海Estepona-Tetouan光缆（59.8 km，2023年9月–2024年2月）的DAS记录。
使用啁啾脉冲HDAS询问器采集，标距长度10 m，道间距10 m，采样率100或250 Hz（统一重采样至100 Hz）。
在6段人工标注的长须鲸歌声记录上进行定量检测评估，并开展音符表征、声源追踪及双鲸同时发声分离的案例分析。
li: Single linear cable segments suffer from inherent bilateral (left-right) localization ambiguity.
The workflow does not automatically link note clusters into continuous individual whale trajectories or assign tracks across multiple individuals.
Spatial variations in cable coupling and uncalibrated axial strain response prevent conversion to absolute acoustic pressure units.
Localization assumes a constant 1500 m/s sound speed and fixed horizontal 2D search depth, and matching-score maps do not represent calibrated probabilistic uncertainty.
近似直线的单根光缆段存在固有的左右两侧（双侧）定位模糊性。
工作流尚未自动将音符簇关联为连续的个体游动轨迹，也未在多头鲸鱼之间自动分配轨迹。
光缆耦合条件的空间变化及未标定的轴向应变响应限制了向绝对声压单位的转换。
定位假设1500 m/s恒定声速和固定深度二维平面，且匹配得分图不能直接作为标定后的概率不确定度。

tm.why: The paper develops an end-to-end signal processing workflow specifically designed for submarine telecom fiber-optic cables instrumented with Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS).
The application belongs to environmental and marine bioacoustics, detecting, characterizing, and tracking fin whale songs in ocean environments.
The workflow processes dense linear underwater sensor arrays and is directly adaptable to ocean bottom seismometer (OBS) networks and hydrophone arrays.

ev.notes: Full 14-page preprint PDF analyzed, including abstract, 6 main sections, 8 figures, and 2 tables.

sum: This study presents the first field application of 2D time-domain viscoacoustic full-waveform inversion (Q-FWI) to active-source seismic refraction data to simultaneously image P-wave velocity and attenuation (1/Q) in the critical zone. Using sledgehammer data from the Garner Run site (Susquehanna Shale Hills Critical Zone Observatory), the authors apply 3D-to-2D geometric corrections, early-arrival windowing, adaptive source wavelet estimation, and a multiscale Newton-CG inversion based on fractional Laplacians while converting modeled pressure into vertical particle velocity. The recovered meter-scale models delineate colluvium, fractured sandstone, and intact bedrock, revealing asymmetric weathering depths (~40 m vs. ~20 m) and strong attenuation anomalies (1/Q up to 0.2) down to ~20 m beneath hillslopes. Integrating these results with Pride's dry-rock and White's patchy-saturation models quantifies porosity and air/water saturation alongside mapping uncertainties, identifying partially saturated vadose zones, dry boulder fields, and preferential groundwater pathways.
本研究首次将二维时域粘声全波形反演（Q-FWI）应用于主动源折射地震数据，在宾夕法尼亚州Garner Run关键带观测站联合反演了近地表高分辨率P波速度与衰减（1/Q）结构。方法基于分数阶拉普拉斯算子与牛顿-共轭梯度法，结合三维到二维转换、初至波窗截取及压力场向垂直质点速度转换策略。反演揭示了坡积物……

t: 2D time-domain viscoacoustic Q-FWI using fractional Laplacians and Newton-CG optimization, converting modeled pressure into vertical particle velocity to invert early-arrival refraction waveforms across three frequency bands.
基于分数阶拉普拉斯算子与牛顿-共轭梯度法的二维时域粘声Q-FWI，将模拟压力场转换为垂直质点速度分三个频带反演初至波。

Active-source refraction survey at Garner Run (Pennsylvania) across three lines of 48 vertical geophones (4 m spacing) and 64 sledgehammer shots (8 m spacing), processed with 3D-to-2D corrections and early-arrival windowing.
Garner Run场地3条测线的主动源折射地震数据（48道4米间距垂直检波器，64炮大锤震源），经3D-2D转换与初至…

Q-FWI resolves three layers (colluvium, fractured sandstone, intact bedrock) with asymmetric weathering (~40 m vs. ~20 m), high hillslope attenuation (1/Q up to 0.2), and fractured aquifer porosity of 10%–20%.
揭示三层结构与不对称基岩风化深度（约40米对20米），山坡浅部呈现强衰减异常，裂隙含水层孔隙度达10%–20%。
The 2D viscoacoustic approximation neglects elastic P-S conversions in the complex weathered zone, potentially causing P-wave energy leakage that leads Q-FWI to overestimate intrinsic attenuation.
二维粘声近似忽略了复杂风化带中的P-S弹性波转换，能量泄漏可能导致Q-FWI高估本征衰减。

First field application of viscoacoustic Q-FWI to near-surface seismic refraction data, linking true-amplitude early-arrival attenuation and velocity models with patchy-saturation rock physics to quantify critical-zone hydrogeology.
首次将粘声Q-FWI应用于近地表折射地震数据，并结合斑块饱和岩石物理模型定量刻画关键带水文地质属性。

kc: First application of viscoacoustic full-waveform inversion (Q-FWI) to near-surface active-source seismic refraction data to jointly recover P-wave velocity and attenuation.
Practical true-amplitude data processing and modeling workflow converting modeled pressure wavefields to vertical particle velocity and adaptively updating source wavelets.
Quantitative rock-physics mapping combining Pride's consolidation model and White's patchy-saturation theory with ensemble uncertainty analysis to estimate porosity and water saturation.
首次将粘声全波形反演（Q-FWI）应用于近地表主动源折射地震数据，联合恢复高分辨率P波速度与衰减模型。
提出了实用的保幅折射数据处理与正反演流程，包括将模拟压力波场转换为垂直质点速度及自适应更新震源子波。
结合Pride固结模型与White斑块饱和理论开展岩石物理反演与不确定性评估，定量估算近地表孔隙度与含水饱和度。
me: 2D time-domain viscoacoustic full-waveform inversion using fixed-order fractional Laplacians and staggered-grid finite-difference / pseudospectral forward modeling.
Newton-conjugate gradient (Newton-CG) optimization using adjoint-state gradients, Gauss-Newton Hessian approximation, and pseudo-Hessian diagonal preconditioning.
Multiscale frequency continuation (5–25 Hz, 5–35 Hz, 5–50 Hz) with 3D-to-2D transformation, apparent-velocity windowing (>600 m/s), and vertical derivative pressure-to-velocity conversion.
One-way wave-equation extended split-step poststack depth migration of near-offset PP reflections.
Nonlinear least-squares rock-physics inversion using Pride's dry-rock modulus model and White's mesoscopic patchy-saturation model with relative-likelihood ensemble weighting.
基于固定阶分数阶拉普拉斯算子及交错网格有限差分/伪谱法的二维时域粘声全波形反演。
结合伴随状态梯度、高斯-牛顿海森近似与伪海森对角预条件的牛顿-共轭梯度（Newton-CG）优化算法。
多尺度频率反演策略（5–25、5–35、5–50 Hz），配合3D到2D转换、视速度时窗截取（>600 m/s）及压力向垂直质点速度转换。
利用近偏移距PP反射波开展基于单程波方程的扩展裂步法叠后深度偏移成像。
融合Pride干岩石模量模型与White介观斑块饱和模型的非线性最小二乘岩石物理反演及似然加权集成不确定性分析。
de: Active-source seismic refraction dataset at the Garner Run site (SSHCZO, Pennsylvania) along three 2D lines, each with 48 vertical geophones at 4 m spacing and 74 sledgehammer shots at 8 m spacing (64 shots used).
2D multiscale synthetic checkerboard resolution tests with two perturbation sizes: Type A (50 m × 25 m) and Type B (25 m × 12 m) for ±8% velocity and ∓100% 1/Q perturbations.
Grid search and multi-start optimization over permeability (0.1, 1, 10 D) and consolidation parameter (32, 64, 128) integrated with 9-m HV-1 borehole core and water-table constraints.
宾夕法尼亚州SSHCZO观测站Garner Run场地3条测线的主动源折射地震数据（每条48个4米间距垂直检波器，8米间距大锤震源共74炮，选用64炮）。
针对A型（50 m × 25 m）和B型（25 m × 12 m）微扰尺度的二维多尺度合成棋盘格分辨率测试（速度±8%，衰减∓100%）。
结合9米深HV-1钻孔岩芯与潜水面约束，对渗透率（0.1、1、10 D）和固结参数（32、64、128）开展网格搜索与多初值优化实验。
li: The 2D viscoacoustic approximation neglects 3D structure and elastic effects such as P-S mode conversions in the complex weathered zone, which can cause energy leakage and overestimate attenuation.

Translating velocity and attenuation into porosity and water saturation via White's patchy-saturation model is inherently nonunique and sensitive to prescribed permeability, consolidation parameter, and constant-Q assumptions.
二维粘声近似忽略了三维结构及复杂风化带中的P-S波型转换等弹性效应，能量泄漏可能导致衰减被高估。
基于White斑块饱和模型将速度与衰减映射为孔隙度和饱和度存在固有多解性，且受预设渗透率、固结参数及常Q假设影响。

tm.why: The core method is a 2D time-domain viscoacoustic full-waveform inversion (Q-FWI) using adjoint-state gradients and a Gauss-Newton Hessian within a Newton-CG framework.
The paper specifically focuses on simultaneously inverting for seismic attenuation (1/Q) and P-wave velocity and interpreting attenuation anomalies via mesoscopic patchy-saturation rock physics.
The application targets near-surface critical zone architecture, bedrock weathering, vadose zone fluid saturation, and hydrological pathways at the Susquehanna Shale Hills Critical Zone Observatory.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 23-page PDF text, equations, and all 11 figures.

sum: This study presents the first comprehensive crustal coda-wave attenuation tomography of continental China across the 3–30 s period band. Utilizing Empirical Green's Functions retrieved from ambient noise cross-correlations, the authors measure Rayleigh-wave coda attenuation and apply a bound-constrained Gauss-Newton inversion scheme to construct a high-resolution, frequency-dependent Qc model. The results reveal strong lateral variations in crustal attenuation that correlate with major tectonic blocks: sedimentary basins and active tectonic zones exhibit high attenuation, whereas stable cratons show low attenuation (high Qc). These spatial patterns correspond well with active fault systems and seismicity, providing new constraints on regional tectonic processes and seismic hazard assessment.
本研究利用背景噪声互相关提取的经验格林函数，首次构建了中国大陆3-30秒周期的地壳尾波衰减（Qc）层析成像模型。研究采用有约束的高斯-牛顿反演算法，获得了高分辨率、随频率变化的Qc模型。结果表明，地壳衰减存在显著的横向变化，且与主要构造单元密切相关：沉积盆地和活动构造带表现为高衰减，而稳定克拉通表现……

t: Bound-constrained Gauss-Newton inversion of Rayleigh-wave coda attenuation measured from ambient noise cross-correlation empirical Green's functions.
基于背景噪声互相关经验格林函数测量的Rayleigh波尾波衰减，进行有约束的高斯-牛顿反演。
Ambient noise cross-correlation data across continental China, targeting Rayleigh-wave coda in the 3–30 s period band.
覆盖中国大陆的背景噪声互相关数据，目标为3-30秒周期的Rayleigh波尾波。
A high-resolution frequency-dependent Qc model showing high attenuation in sedimentary basins/active zones and low attenuation in stable cratons.
获得了高分辨率频变Qc模型，显示沉积盆地和活动带呈高衰减，稳定克拉通呈低衰减。
Potential trade-offs between scattering and intrinsic attenuation, and resolution limits in areas with sparse station density.
散射衰减与固有衰减之间可能存在权衡，且台站稀疏地区分辨率受限。
First comprehensive, high-resolution coda-wave attenuation tomographic model of continental China using ambient noise correlations.
首次利用背景噪声互相关构建了中国大陆全面、高分辨率的尾波衰减层析成像模型。

kc: Establishes the first comprehensive 3–30 s period Rayleigh-wave coda attenuation (Qc) tomographic model across continental China.
Reveals a systematic relationship between crustal attenuation structures and major tectonic blocks (basins, active zones, cratons).
Provides a robust reference model that complements existing velocity models for integrated tectonic interpretation.
首次构建了中国大陆3-30秒周期的Rayleigh波尾波衰减（Qc）层析成像模型。
揭示了地壳衰减结构与主要构造单元（盆地、活动带、克拉通）之间的系统性关联。
提供了一个稳健的参考模型，与现有的速度模型互补，用于综合构造解释。
me: Ambient noise cross-correlation to retrieve Empirical Green's Functions (EGFs).
Rayleigh-wave coda attenuation measurements.
Bound-constrained Gauss-Newton inversion scheme for frequency-dependent Qc tomography.
利用背景噪声互相关提取经验格林函数（EGFs）。
测量Rayleigh波尾波衰减。
采用有约束的高斯-牛顿反演方法进行频变Qc层析成像。

覆盖中国大陆的背景噪声数据，用于提取3-30秒周期的Rayleigh波尾波。
li: Resolution may be limited in regions with sparse station coverage.
Coda attenuation measurements can be sensitive to scattering versus intrinsic attenuation trade-offs.
在台网覆盖稀疏的地区，分辨率可能会受到限制。
尾波衰减测量可能受到散射衰减与固有衰减之间权衡的影响。

tm.why: The paper focuses on measuring and modeling coda-wave attenuation (Qc) across continental China.
The study utilizes Empirical Green's Functions retrieved from ambient noise cross-correlations to measure Rayleigh-wave coda.
The resulting Qc model is used to investigate crustal heterogeneity and tectonic structures across continental China.

sum: This study reprocesses continuous waveforms from the 160-station International Maule Aftershock Dataset (February–December 2010) following the Mw 8.8 Maule, Chile earthquake. Using the PhaseNet deep-learning picker, HEX associator, NonLinLoc, Simul2000 3D relocation, and two-step GrowClust3D double-difference relocation, the authors compile a catalog of 146,950 well-constrained events—more than tripling prior catalogs. The seismicity confirms two distinct plate-interface belts at 15–40 km and 40–55 km depth. Focusing on the deep transition zone (40–55 km), semivariogram analysis shows that although 90% of seismicity spans a ~1.6 km thick band, locally events occur on single or non-overlapping meter-thick planes rather than an overlapping fault network. Furthermore, ~20% of deep interface events form 100 m to km-scale streaks aligned along dip, coinciding with regions of postseismic afterslip. These streaks are interpreted as brittle fractures within individual smeared blocks or jammed force chains of clasts within a subduction channel mélange.
本研究重新处理了2010年智利Maule Mw 8.8级地震后160个陆地台站的连续波形数据。结合PhaseNet深度学习拾取、HEX震相关联、三维速度模型定位（Simul2000）及双差相对定位（GrowClust3D），构建了包含146,950个高质量事件的余震目录，事件数达以往目录的三倍以上。……

t: PhaseNet picks P/S arrivals, HEX associates events, NonLinLoc and Simul2000 provide 1D/3D locations, and GrowClust3D performs two-step relative relocation using waveform cross-correlation differential times.
利用PhaseNet拾取、HEX关联、Simul2000三维定位及GrowClust3D波形互相关双差相对定位构建目录。
Continuous seismic waveforms from the International Maule Aftershock Dataset (IMAD), consisting of 160 temporary land stations operating between 27 February and 31 December 2010.
2010年2月至12月期间160个IMAD临时陆地台站的连续地震波形数据及局部三维速度模型。

Obtained 146,950 well-constrained events (34,271 with 31 m median relative error). Deep interface events (40–55 km) span a ~1.6 km zone on <1 m thick non-overlapping planes, with 20% forming dip-aligned streaks.
获得146,950个高质量事件（最高相对定位精度31米），发现40–55 km深部地震分布于非重叠薄层及顺倾向条带。
Offshore and outer-rise earthquakes have poorly constrained depths due to large azimuthal gaps and the lack of publicly available Ocean Bottom Seismometer data.
因缺乏公开的海底地震仪数据且方位角空隙大，近海及外隆区地震深度约束较差。
More than triples the 2010 Maule aftershock catalog size and resolves meter-scale non-overlapping fault planes and 100 m–km dip-aligned streaks at the 40–55 km deep subduction transition zone.
余震目录规模扩大三倍以上，首次解析出深部俯冲过渡带米级非重叠断层面及顺倾向微震条带。

kc: Compiled a new high-resolution catalog of 146,950 well-constrained aftershocks (61,750 relatively relocated) for the 2010 Mw 8.8 Maule earthquake, more than tripling previous catalogs.
Demonstrated via semivariogram analysis that deep plate-interface seismicity (40–55 km depth) occurs locally on non-overlapping, meter-thick fault planes within an overall ~1.6 km thick zone.

Identified 100 m to km-scale dip-aligned earthquake lineations (streaks) comprising ~20% of events in the lower seismicity belt, interpreted as signatures of aseismic afterslip and mélange block jamming.
构建了2010年Maule Mw 8.8级地震包含146,950个高质量事件（其中61,750个经相对重定位）的新余震目录，规模达前人目录的三倍以上。
通过半变异函数分析证实，深部板块界面（40–55 km）地震在整体约1.6 km厚的带内局部集中于米级厚度的非重叠断层面上。
在深部地震带识别出占事件总数约20%的百米至千米级顺倾向线性条带，将其解释为无震滑移及混杂岩块卡阻破裂的标志。
me: Deep-learning phase picking using PhaseNet (trained on INSTANCE) via SeisBench and hyperbolic phase association using HEX.
Initial 1D location and split-event merging using NonLinLoc, followed by 3D absolute relocation in Simul2000 with 27 starting grid perturbations.
Waveform cross-correlation (2–15 Hz, augmented with 3D synthetic picks) and two-iteration 3D relative relocation using GrowClust3D.
Local magnitude calculation with SNR-moveout outlier rejection and relative magnitude inversion, plus spatial semivariogram and Fisher-statistics lineation analysis.
通过SeisBench调用PhaseNet（基于INSTANCE训练）进行深度学习震相拾取，并使用HEX进行双曲线震相关联。
使用NonLinLoc进行初始一维定位与分裂事件合并，随后通过27个初始位置扰动在Simul2000中进行三维绝对重定位。
补充三维理论到时后进行2–15 Hz波形互相关，并使用GrowClust3D开展两轮三维双差相对定位。
结合信噪比走时剔除异常台站与相对震级反演计算地方震级，并利用半变异函数和Fisher统计分析断层厚度与地震线性条带。
de: Continuous waveform data from the publicly available International Maule Aftershock Dataset (IMAD), comprising 160 temporary broadband and short-period land stations from 27 February to 31 December 2010.
Local 1D and 3D velocity models of the Maule region derived by Hicks et al. (2012, 2014).
公开的国际Maule余震数据集（IMAD），包含2010年2月27日至12月31日期间160个陆地临时宽频带及短周期台站的连续波形数据。
Hicks等（2012, 2014）建立的Maule地区局部一维和三维速度模型。
li: Offshore and outer-rise events suffer from large azimuthal gaps and poor depth constraints because temporary Ocean Bottom Seismometer (OBS) data were not publicly available.
Station network density varied significantly over time (peaking at ~120 stations in April–June and dropping to ~40 stations later), modulating catalog completeness.
Repeating earthquake families and focal mechanisms within the deep streaks were not analyzed, leaving the exact mechanical origin of the lineations untested.
由于临时海底地震仪（OBS）数据未公开，近海及外隆区事件存在较大方位角空隙，深度约束较差。
台网密度随时间变化显著（4至6月约120个台站，后期降至约40个），影响了目录完备性的时空均匀性。
未对深部条带内的重复地震簇及震源机制进行分析，尚无法直接检验条带成因的力学假说。

tm.why: The paper builds a new high-resolution catalog of 146,950 aftershocks of the 2010 Mw 8.8 Maule earthquake using AI phase picking, HEX association, 3D relocation, and GrowClust3D relative relocation.
The study investigates the fine-scale fault structure and dip-aligned earthquake streaks at the deep transition zone (40–55 km depth), linking them to aseismic afterslip and mélange block mechanics.
The workflow relies on the deep-learning phase picker PhaseNet via SeisBench to detect events across continuous data from 160 stations.

ev.notes: Full 16-page PDF and abstract analyzed in detail, including all methods, catalog statistics, variogram equations, and 8 figures plus 1 table.

sum: This paper (Part II) focuses on determining the absolute locations, origin times, and event identification of newly-detected small seismic events in and near the Northern Korean Peninsula from 2004 to 2010. Building on the detection results from Part I, the authors employ high-precision location techniques and seismic discrimination methods to characterize these low-magnitude events, distinguishing between natural earthquakes and potential anthropogenic sources (such as explosions). This work contributes to a more complete and accurate seismic catalog for the Korean Peninsula, which is critical for regional tectonics and nuclear test monitoring.
本文（第二部分）重点研究2004年至2010年期间朝鲜半岛北部及其周边地区新检测到的微小地震事件的绝对位置、发震时刻和事件性质识别。在第一部分检测结果的基础上，作者采用高精度定位技术和地震识别方法对这些低震级事件进行表征，区分自然地震与潜在的人工震源（如爆炸）。该研究为朝鲜半岛提供了更完整、更精确的……

t: Employs high-precision seismic location and event discrimination methods to determine absolute locations, origin times, and source types of small seismic events.
采用高精度地震定位和事件识别方法，确定微小地震事件的绝对位置、发震时刻和震源性质。
Seismic waveform data from regional networks in and around the Northern Korean Peninsula spanning 2004 to 2010, focusing on newly-detected small events.
2004至2010年间朝鲜半岛北部及周边区域台网的地震波形数据，重点针对新检测到的微小事件。
Provides a refined seismic catalog with precise absolute locations and origin times, successfully identifying and discriminating natural earthquakes from anthropogenic events.
提供了精细的地震目录，给出了精确的绝对位置和发震时刻，并成功区分了自然地震与人工事件。
Location accuracy and discrimination reliability are constrained by regional station distribution and the low signal-to-noise ratio of small events.
定位精度和识别可靠性受限于区域台站分布以及微小事件较低的信噪比。
First systematic absolute location and identification of a large number of newly-detected small seismic events in the Northern Korean Peninsula.
首次对朝鲜半岛北部大量新检测到的微小地震事件进行系统的绝对定位和性质识别。

kc: Determines high-precision absolute locations and origin times for newly-detected small seismic events in the Northern Korean Peninsula.
Performs event identification to distinguish between natural earthquakes and anthropogenic explosions.
Enhances the completeness and resolution of the regional seismic catalog for the period 2004–2010.
确定了朝鲜半岛北部新检测到的微小地震事件的高精度绝对位置和发震时刻。
进行事件性质识别，以区分自然地震与人工爆炸。
提高了2004-2010年期间区域地震目录的完整性和分辨率。

Seismic event identification and discrimination techniques (e.g., amplitude ratios, waveform characteristics).

地震事件识别与区分技术（例如，振幅比、波形特征）。
de: Seismic waveform data from regional stations in and around the Korean Peninsula from 2004 to 2010.
Newly-detected small seismic events identified in Part I of the study.
2004年至2010年朝鲜半岛及其周边区域台站的地震波形数据。
本研究第一部分中识别出的新检测到的微小地震事件。
li: Limited station coverage in certain parts of North Korea may affect the precision of absolute locations.
Sparse regional data for very small events makes discrimination challenging.
朝鲜部分地区有限的台站覆盖可能会影响绝对定位的精度。
极微小事件的区域数据稀疏，给事件性质识别带来挑战。

tm.why: The paper focuses on determining absolute locations, origin times, and performing event identification for newly-detected small seismic events.

sum: Matched-filter detection via waveform cross-correlation (WCC) performs optimally when ambient noise is purely stochastic, but natural seismic noise contains template-coherent components that degrade sensitivity. This study enhances an automated WCC, local association (LA), and conflict resolution (CR) pipeline by adding computer-simulated random noise scaled to peak waveform amplitude (optimal factor StN = 0.075) prior to cross-correlation. Applied to International Monitoring System (IMS) arrays and three-component stations using 100 master events in the Kamchatka subduction zone between July 6 and July 31, 2025, the noise-enhanced pipeline reduces the magnitude threshold and increases detected cross-correlation standard event list (XSEL) counts by up to a factor of two during background seismicity. sum: This paper introduces CDS-Polytope, a parameter-free framework for detecting critical transitions in 4D event clouds by discretizing the unit 3-sphere onto the 24-cell regular polytope. The method provides 24 axis-labeled reference directions with F4 symmetry, enabling an intrinsically explainable similarity measure (cosD) and effective dimension estimator (D_eff) without training data. The authors validate the framework across three domains: seismology (recovering the 2011 Tohoku foreshock migration sequence), typhoon climatology, and ENSO dynamics. However, an author's note downgrades the seismological validation to 'undetermined' due to a depth-axis normalization vulnerability. Despite this, the framework offers a novel, auditable approach to explainable AI (XAI) and multi-dimensional event analysis.

sum: This Zenodo repository contains the supplementary code and dataset for the study 'Decade of ice shelf pinning point area change driven by basal melt in Antarctica'. It provides the necessary data and time-series analysis tools to investigate how basal melting influences the area and stability of ice shelf pinning points across Antarctica over a ten-year period, facilitating reproducibility and further research in cryospheric sciences.

sum: This study investigates the impact of Earth's secular cooling on deep mantle dynamics using 3D spherical thermochemical mantle convection models (CitcomS) driven by a continuous plate tectonic reconstruction extending back 1.8 billion years. For the first time in plate-driven 3D global models, the authors incorporate both radiogenic decay of internal heating and a self-consistent, time-dependent core-mantle boundary (CMB) temperature governed by core energy balance. Results show that while imposed plate reconstructions (subducting slab flux) exert first-order control on lower-mantle structure with a 50–250 Myr delay, secular cooling plays a key second-order role. Specifically, secular cooling reduces present-day CMB heat flow by over 30%, yields a global plume cooling rate of ~110°C/Gyr (matching petrological constraints), predicts ~4–5.2 TW of lower-mantle plume heat flux, and produces a larger present-day African basal structure (LLSVP/BLOBS) that better matches global S-wave seismic tomographic models.

Driven by the continuous 1.8 Ga global plate tectonic reconstruction C24 in OPT and NNR reference frames, and evaluated against seven global S-wave seismic tomographic models and reconstructed volcanic eruptions.

Demonstrated a strong anti-correlation between CMB heat flux and basal thermochemical structure (BLOBS) fractional area, regulated by slab subduction with a 50–250 Myr delay.

tm.why: The paper models 3D global thermochemical mantle convection over 1.8 billion years to study secular cooling, core-mantle boundary heat flux, mantle plumes, and basal mantle structures compared against seismic tomography.
