sum: Forecasting induced seismicity is hindered by an observational impasse: statistics-based, physics-based, and machine-learning-based Epidemic Type Induced Seismicity (ETIS) models all fit retrospective data (such as the Basel enhanced geothermal system) nearly equally well by trading off injection forcing and aftershock triggering, yet yield drastically different future forecasts. To resolve this ambiguity, this study introduces a "model differencing" framework that uses Markov chain Monte Carlo (McMC) optimization to maximize an adversarial log-likelihood between pairs of forecasting paradigms. The resulting optimal injection protocols are consistently two-phased, exploiting fundamental modeling assumptions (such as rate independence vs. convolutional lag) by forcing one model to dominate in phase one and flipping dominance in phase two. Synthesizing these common themes, the authors design a two-period prototype for a standardized Seismogenic Fault Injection Test (SFIT) to calibrate parameters and refute invalid forcing assumptions prior to full-scale fluid injection operations.
诱发地震预测面临观测困境：基于统计、物理和机器学习的流行病型诱发地震（ETIS）模型在回顾性拟合（如巴塞尔增强型地热系统数据）中表现相近，但对后续注水的预测差异巨大。为此，本文提出“模型差分”框架，利用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（McMC）方法最大化模型对之间的对抗对数似然函数，从而优化注水方案。优化后的注……

t: The authors define an adversarial log-likelihood metric between competing Epidemic Type Induced Seismicity (ETIS) models and use Markov chain Monte Carlo (McMC) optimization to find injection rate protocols that maximize forecast differences.
定义竞争ETIS模型间的对抗对数似然指标，利用McMC优化搜索最大化预测差异的注水速率方案。
Three ETIS forecasting models are calibrated on the injection rate and seismicity catalog from the enhanced geothermal system at Basel, followed by 20 McMC realizations of 1,000 iterations each.
利用巴塞尔增强型地热系统注水与地震目录率定三种模型，并进行20次各1000步的McMC优化实验。

Retrospective fits to Basel show ~0.4% log-likelihood difference and 0.01%–1.0% cumulative count error across models, whereas McMC model differencing yields two-phased protocols that sharply separate competing forecasts.
三种模型对巴塞尔数据的回顾性对数似然差异仅约0.4%，而模型差分获得了两阶段高区分度注水方案。
The surrogate models are overly simplistic, neglecting non-linearities like the Kaiser effect, poroelasticity, spatial pressure diffusion, and non-stationary temporal changes in model parameters.
代理模型过于简化，忽略了凯泽效应、孔隙弹性、空间扩散及非平稳时变参数等复杂过程。

Introduces the 'model differencing' framework to actively design fluid injection protocols that maximize divergence between competing seismicity models, establishing the prototype Seismogenic Fault Injection Test (SFIT).
首次提出“模型差分”主动实验设计框架，构建了标准化震源断层注水测试（SFIT）原型。

kc: Formulated the 'model differencing' framework using an adversarial log-likelihood objective and McMC optimization to design injection protocols that maximize forecast divergence.

Demonstrated that optimal discriminative injection protocols between statistics-based, physics-based, and ML-based surrogates follow a two-phased structure exploiting rate-dependence and history/lag assumptions.
Synthesized the optimization insights into a practical, two-period step-by-step pseudo-algorithm for the Seismogenic Fault Injection Test (SFIT) prototype.
提出了基于对抗对数似然目标函数和McMC优化的“模型差分”框架，用于设计最大化预测差异的注水方案。
证明了区分统计、物理和机器学习代理模型的最优注水方案具有两阶段结构，有效利用了速率依赖性和历史/滞后假设的差异。
将优化结果综合为实用的两周期震源断层注水测试（SFIT）原型分步伪算法。
me: Epidemic Type Induced Seismicity (ETIS) point-process modeling combining an ETAS aftershock term with three distinct injection forcing surrogates (statistical linear-Omori, physics-based convolutional, and ML on/off step).
Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) to calibrate baseline model parameters θ on retrospective catalog and injection data.
Adversarial log-likelihood (aLL) maximization via Markov chain Monte Carlo (McMC, 1,000 iterations across 20 random seeds) to find optimal injection rate histories v(t).
流行病型诱发地震（ETIS）点过程建模，结合ETAS余震项与三种注水驱动代理项（统计线性-大森模型、物理卷积模型、机器学习开关阶跃模型）。
利用最大似然估计（MLE）在历史地震目录和注水数据上率定基准模型参数θ。
基于对抗对数似然（aLL）和马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（McMC，20个随机种子各迭代1000次）搜索最优注水速率历史v(t)。
de: Retrospective fitting of the three ETIS models to the 2006 Basel Enhanced Geothermal System (EGS) injection rate and seismicity catalog (and supplementary verification on Utah FORGE).
Synthetic McMC optimization experiments for three adversarial pairings: statistics vs. ML (SvM), physics vs. ML (PvM), and statistics vs. physics (SvP).
对巴塞尔增强型地热系统（EGS）注水速率和地震目录进行三种ETIS模型的回顾性拟合（并在Utah FORGE数据上进行补充验证）。
针对三种模型对抗配对（统计vs机器学习SvM、物理vs机器学习PvM、统计vs物理SvP）开展合成McMC注水优化实验。
li: The surrogate forcing models are overly simplistic and neglect non-linearities such as the Kaiser effect, slip-dependent permeability, hysteresis, poroelasticity, and 3D spatial diffusion.
The optimization holds earthquake-earthquake interaction complexities aside and cannot constrain non-stationary processes where model parameters θ or forcing functions change over time.
Practical implementation requires refined hydraulic control over fault injection and sufficient span of seismically discernible injection rates above background detection limits.
代理模型过于简化，忽略了凯泽效应、滑移相关渗透率变化、滞后、孔隙弹性及空间扩散等非线性物理过程。
无法约束模型参数θ或注水驱动函数随时间变化的非平稳过程。
实际执行需要精细的断层注水控制，且可观测地震响应的注水速率跨度受背景噪声检测极限限制。

tm.why: The paper develops a standardized fluid-injection test (SFIT) to probe fault seismic response and discriminate among induced seismicity forecasting paradigms.
The core objective is improving real-time earthquake rate forecasting and risk management frameworks for injection-induced seismicity.
It uses a Markov chain Monte Carlo (McMC) optimization procedure guided by an adversarial log-likelihood metric to maximize information gain across competing models.

sum: RelMT is a software tool (v0.6.0-beta) designed for computing relative seismic moment tensors. Relative moment tensor inversion is a powerful method to resolve earthquake source mechanisms by utilizing amplitude ratios or relative waveforms, which effectively cancels out complex path effects. This release introduces several updates, including new configuration options for excluding files, a 'constrained' amplitude filter method, improved plotting capabilities for moment tensors and residuals, and updated example notebooks to facilitate user adoption.
RelMT（v0.6.0-beta）是一款用于计算相对震源矩张量的开源软件。相对矩张量反演通过利用振幅比或相对波形，有效消除了复杂的路径效应，从而精确求解地震群的震源机制。该版本引入了多项更新，包括用于排除特定文件的配置选项、‘约束’振幅过滤方法、改进的矩张量与残差绘图功能，以及更新的示例 Note……

t: Relative seismic moment tensor inversion using amplitude ratios and constrained filtering to resolve source mechanisms.
利用振幅比和约束过滤进行相对地震矩张量反演，以解析震源机制。
Synthetic or real earthquake waveform amplitude data processed through example notebooks.
通过示例 Notebook 处理的合成或实际地震波形振幅数据。
Software release v0.6.0-beta providing improved plotting, residual reporting, and configuration options.
发布 v0.6.0-beta 版本，提供改进的绘图、残差报告和配置选项。
Limited to relative inversion of clustered events and currently in beta development.
仅限于地震群的相对反演，且目前处于测试开发阶段。
An accessible, open-source Python-based tool specifically tailored for relative moment tensor computations.
一款专为相对矩张量计算量身定制的、易于使用的开源 Python 工具。

sum: This study proposes the IPAC-CCDM framework to simulate nonstationary, non-Gaussian horizontal ground motions for strike-slip earthquake scenarios conditioned on moment magnitude (M), rupture distance (Rrup), and VS30. Using 4,084 horizontal components from 77 strike-slip earthquakes in the PEER NGA-West2 database, the authors decompose waveforms via the S-transform into standardized time-frequency power spectral density (TFPSD) images. A continuous conditional diffusion model (CCDM) is trained on these 256×256 images alongside empirical regression models for total energy, record duration, and generalized Gaussian kurtosis. Time histories are then synthesized using the iterative power and amplitude correction (IPAC) algorithm. Unlike previous fixed-duration generative models, this approach captures event-dependent duration and non-Gaussianity. Validations against NGA-West2 ground motion models, actual records, and 202 unseen event records demonstrate accurate reproduction of pseudospectral accelerations, Arias intensity, significant duration, peak ground velocity, cumulative absolute velocity, and Bouc-Wen inelastic ductility demands.
本研究提出IPAC-CCDM框架，基于震级M、断层距Rrup和VS30模拟走滑地震的非平稳非高斯水平地震动。利用PEER NGA-West2数据库中77次走滑地震的4084条水平记录，通过S变换获取标准化时频功率谱密度（TFPSD）图像并训练连续条件扩散模型（CCDM），同时建立总能量、持时及广义高……

t: The IPAC-CCDM framework combines statistical regression for duration, energy, and kurtosis with a Continuous Conditional Diffusion Model generating standardized S-transform TFPSD images, reconstructing nonstationary non-Gaussian waveforms via the IPAC algorithm.
结合预测持时、能量和峰度的统计回归方程、生成标准化TFPSD图像的CCDM扩散模型及合成非高斯时程的IPAC算法。

4,084 horizontal ground motion record components from 2,042 records across 77 strike-slip earthquakes in the PEER NGA-West2 database, filtered by M > 4.5, Rrup between 30–300 km, and VS30 between 180–1500 m/s.
选用PEER NGA-West2数据库77次走滑地震的4084条非近断层水平分量及6次独立地震的202条验证分量。

Simulated ground motions match NGA-West2 GMMs, historical intensity measures, and Bouc-Wen inelastic ductility demands; on 202 unseen validation components, mean log errors are 0.01–0.09 and correlation matrix RMSE is 0.09.
合成地震动的反应谱、强度指标及非弹性延性需求与实际记录吻合，独立验证集相关矩阵RMSE仅0.09。
Restricted to non-near-fault (Rrup ≥ 30 km) horizontal strike-slip records conditioned only on M, Rrup, and VS30, and slightly overestimates intensity measure dispersion on unseen events.
仅适用于非近断层走滑水平分量，且在独立事件验证中略微高估部分指标离散度。

First diffusion-based ground motion generator that accounts for variable event-dependent duration, energy consistency in time and time-frequency domains, and non-Gaussian amplitude distributions via IPAC.
首次将连续条件扩散模型用于考虑变持时、时频能量一致性及非高斯分布的地震动模拟。

kc: Developed the IPAC-CCDM framework integrating statistical regression, continuous conditional diffusion models, and the IPAC algorithm for scenario ground motion simulation.
Overcame fixed-duration and Gaussian assumptions of prior diffusion models by explicitly modeling variable record duration, total energy, and non-Gaussian marginal distributions.
Validated synthetic waveforms against NGA-West2 GMMs, historical records, and 6 unseen earthquakes across elastic spectra, intensity measures, and nonlinear Bouc-Wen ductility demands.
开发了结合统计回归、连续条件扩散模型（CCDM）与IPAC算法的IPAC-CCDM设定地震动模拟框架。
通过显式建模变持时、总能量和非高斯边缘分布，克服了以往扩散模型固定持时和高斯假设的局限。
通过弹性反应谱、强度指标及非线性Bouc-Wen延性需求，与NGA-West2地震动模型、历史记录和6个未见地震事件进行了全面验证。
me: S-transform time-frequency decomposition and square-root hyperbolic tangent mapping to 256×256 standardized TFPSD images.
Statistical regression and Gaussian copula modeling for lognormal total energy (ET) and duration (T), plus truncated Burr Type XII fitting for kurtosis (γ4).
Continuous Conditional Diffusion Model (CCDM) with Improved Label Input (ILI), hard vicinal loss, classifier-free guidance, and DDIM sampling.
Iterative Power and Amplitude Correction (IPAC) algorithm to reconstruct time histories matching both target TFPSD and Generalized Gaussian Distribution (GGD) marginal CDFs.
利用S变换进行时频分解，并通过平方根双曲正切映射生成256×256标准化TFPSD图像。
建立对数正态总能量（ET）和持时（T）的统计回归与高斯Copula模型，以及峰度系数（γ4）的截断Burr XII型分布拟合。
采用带有改进标签输入（ILI）、硬邻域损失、无分类器引导和DDIM采样的连续条件扩散模型（CCDM）。
应用迭代功率与幅值修正（IPAC）算法重构同时匹配目标TFPSD和广义高斯分布（GGD）边缘累积分布函数的时程。
de: Training set: 2,042 two-component horizontal records (4,084 components) from 77 strike-slip earthquakes in the PEER NGA-West2 database (M > 4.5, 30 ≤ Rrup ≤ 300 km, 180 ≤ VS30 ≤ 1500 m/s).
Out-of-sample validation set: 202 horizontal components from 6 additional unseen strike-slip earthquakes in NGA-West2.
Numerical validation comparing PSA (5% damping), IA, DS(5-95%), DS(5-75%), PGV, CAV, and Bouc-Wen SDOF inelastic ductility demands (n = 1 and 25).
训练集：来自PEER NGA-West2数据库77次走滑地震的2042组双分量水平记录（共4084条分量，M > 4.5，30 ≤ Rrup ≤ 300 km，180 ≤ VS30 ≤ 1500 m/s）。
样本外验证集：来自NGA-West2数据库另外6次未参与训练的走滑地震的202条水平分量记录。
数值验证：对比5%阻尼比伪加速度反应谱（PSA）、IA、DS(5-95%)、DS(5-75%)、PGV、CAV以及Bouc-Wen单自由度非弹性延性需求（n = 1和25）。
li: Excludes near-fault ground motions (Rrup < 30 km) that exhibit pulse-like velocity characteristics and rupture directivity effects.
Restricted to horizontal components of strike-slip earthquakes conditioned only on M, Rrup, and VS30, omitting fault type, Ztor, basin depth, vertical components, and spatial correlation.
Slightly overestimates the dispersion of total energy (ET), PGV, and CAV in out-of-sample event validations.
排除了具有脉冲特征和破裂方向性效应的近断层地震动记录（Rrup < 30 km）。
仅限于以M、Rrup和VS30为条件的走滑地震水平分量，未考虑断层类型、断层顶深Ztor、盆地深度、竖向分量及台站间空间相关性。
在样本外独立事件验证中，对总能量（ET）、PGV和CAV的离散度略有高估。

tm.why: The paper develops and validates a generative framework to simulate horizontal strike-slip strong ground motions and engineering intensity measures for scenario seismic events.
The core of the framework trains a continuous conditional diffusion model (CCDM) on S-transform time-frequency power spectral density images conditioned on earthquake and site parameters.

ev.notes: Full 36-page Accepted Manuscript PDF analyzed, including equations, 17 figures, and 3 tables.

sum: To constrain the rheologic and hydrologic structure of the shallow northern Hikurangi megathrust—which hosts both tsunami earthquakes and slow slip events (SSEs)—the authors performed triaxial shear (constant displacement rate and slide-hold-slide up to 10^6 s) and flow-through permeability experiments on pelagic marl (34% clay) and chalk (2% clay) from IODP Site U1520C at effective pressures of 8–70 MPa and temperatures of 25–75 °C. Marl permeability (10^-19 to 10^-21 m^2) is 1–2 orders of magnitude lower than chalk (10^-16 to 10^-20 m^2), and is more sensitive to effective pressure than shear strain. Surprisingly, higher clay content in marl inhibits mechanical compaction and chemical weakening, making marl frictionally stronger than chalk at low effective pressure (21 MPa) and elevated temperature (75 °C). Both lithologies lack Dieterich-type transient healing peaks and instead show non-Dieterich residual strength hysteresis, promoting strain localization into chalk and maintaining high fluid pressures associated with SSEs.
为约束北希库朗伊浅部俯冲带（孕育海啸地震和慢滑移事件）的流变与水文结构，本文对IODP U1520C站位的远洋泥灰岩（34%黏土）和白垩（2%黏土）在8–70 MPa有效压力和25–75 °C下开展了三轴剪切（恒定速率及长达10^6 s的滑动-保持-滑动）和渗透率实验。结果显示泥灰岩渗透率比白垩低1……

t: Triaxial sawcut shear deformation tests—including constant displacement rate (0.12 μm/s) and long-duration (10^2–10^6 s) slide-hold-slide experiments—combined with steady-state flow-through permeability measurements before and after shearing.
开展三轴锯切恒定速率（0.12 μm/s）及长时（10^2–10^6 s）滑动-保持-滑动实验，结合剪切前后稳态渗透率测…
Simulated gouges (<80 μm) of pelagic marl (34 wt% clay, 53 wt% calcite) and muddy chalk (2 wt% clay, 97 wt% calcite) from IODP Expedition 375 Site U1520C, tested at 8–70 MPa and 25–75 °C.
IODP 375航次U1520C站位的远洋泥灰岩（34%黏土）和泥质白垩（2%黏土）断层泥，在8–70 MPa和25–7…

Marl permeability (10^-19 to 10^-21 m^2) is 1–2 orders of magnitude lower than chalk (10^-16 to 10^-20 m^2); marl is stronger than chalk at 21 MPa (25 °C) and after high strain at 70 MPa (75 °C), and both lack Dieterich-type healing.
泥灰岩渗透率比白垩低1–2个数量级；在21 MPa（25 °C）及70 MPa（75 °C）高应变下泥灰岩更强；均无Di…

Pore fluid system leaks and room fluctuations during long holds prevented reliable volumetric strain tracking in most experiments except chalk at 75 °C, and low marl permeability risks transient undrained states.
长时间保持期间孔隙流体系统微漏导致多数实验体积应变失真，且泥灰岩低渗透率易引发重剪切初期的瞬态不排水。

Shows that higher clay content in marl unexpectedly yields higher drained frictional strength than chalk at low effective pressure or elevated temperature, and documents non-Dieterich residual strength hysteresis over 10^6 s holds.
发现黏土抑制压实和热化学弱化使泥灰岩在低压或高温下比白垩更强，并首次记录了长时保持下残余强度的先增后减滞回。

kc: Measured frictional strength, long-duration healing (up to 10^6 s), and permeability of subducting marl and chalk from IODP Site U1520C at in-situ conditions around the Pāpaku Seamount.
Demonstrated that marl permeability is 1–2 orders of magnitude lower than chalk and caps the chalk layer, trapping fluids and promoting pore fluid overpressure.

Discovered that clay-bearing marl is frictionally stronger than clay-poor chalk at low effective pressure (21 MPa) and elevated temperature (75 °C) because clay inhibits mechanical compaction and thermally enhanced weakening.
Documented the absence of Dieterich-type transient healing peaks and revealed a path-dependent hysteresis in residual strength (strengthening followed by dissolution-induced weakening at 10^6 s).
在代表Pāpaku海山周围原位温压条件下，测量了IODP U1520C站位俯冲泥灰岩和白垩的摩擦强度、长时愈合（达10^6秒）和渗透率。
证明泥灰岩渗透率比白垩低1–2个数量级，覆盖在白垩之上可封存流体并维持孔隙流体超压。
发现在低有效压力（21 MPa）和高温（75 °C）下，含黏土泥灰岩比贫黏土白垩摩擦强度更高，因为黏土抑制了机械压实和热化学弱化。
记录了Dieterich型瞬态愈合峰的缺失，并揭示了残余强度的路径依赖滞回现象（先随保持时间强化，在10^6秒后因溶解作用发生弱化）。

Steady-state flow-through permeability measurements before and after triaxial shear using Darcy's Law.

X-ray diffraction (XRD), laser diffraction particle size analysis, and post-deformation microstructural scanning of epoxy-impregnated gouges.

CDR and SHS (hold durations 10^2 to 10^6 s) experiments at effective pressures of 21 and 70 MPa, temperatures of 25 and 75 °C, and shear velocity of 0.12 μm/s.

sum: This study addresses the computational cost of physics-based ground-motion simulations (PBS) for probabilistic seismic hazard assessment (PSHA). By evaluating the Castro-Cruz and Mai (2025) kinematic rupture generator, the authors perform over 2,000 simulations of Mw 6.5 strike-slip and dip-slip earthquakes to quantify confidence intervals for peak ground velocity (PGV) median and standard deviation. To optimize computational resources, they introduce a new directivity parameter into the statistical characterization of ground motions. This innovation reduces the required number of simulations by up to 80% for sites sensitive to rupture directivity (e.g., reducing required simulations from over 200 to just 35 for stations along strike-slip faults). The findings provide a scalable framework for efficient and accurate seismic hazard assessments.
本文针对基于物理的地动模拟（PBS）在概率地震危险性分析（PSHA）中的高计算成本问题，评估了CM2025运动学破裂生成器。通过对Mw 6.5走滑和倾滑地震进行2000多次模拟，量化了峰值地动速度（PGV）中值和标准差的置信区间。为提高效率，引入了全新的破裂方向性参数，使对方向性敏感场地的模拟需求量……

sum: This study utilizes 3D thermomechanical models to investigate how the viscoelastic behavior of thermally weakened host rock, magma transport, and magma compressibility affect volcanic overpressure and surface deformation. Unlike traditional elastic models that assume an internal pressure source, the authors implement a cylindrical feeding system to self-consistently track overpressure. The results show that thermal weakening causes more deformation for a given overpressure but less overpressure for a given injected volume, resulting in a net reduction in surface uplift. Magma compressibility further decreases overpressure. Combined, these effects can reduce surface deformation by up to 80% compared to elastic assumptions. Consequently, intrusion volumes calculated using traditional elastic inversions may be significantly underestimated, particularly in young or cold magmatic systems, while overpressure is overestimated in mature systems. The authors propose first-order modifications to elastic solutions to account for these thermal weakening effects.
本研究利用三维热力学模型，研究了热软化围岩粘弹性及岩浆压缩性对火山形变的影响。模型引入柱状补给系统以自洽追踪超压。结果表明，热软化与岩浆压缩性叠加可使地表形变比传统弹性假设减少高达80%。因此，传统弹性反演会显著低估岩浆侵入体积或高估超压。研究提出了修正弹性解的首次近似方法。

sum: This study investigates the decadal-scale ground deformation patterns observed at GNSS stations in the Yellowstone volcanic system. By utilizing viscoelastic numerical modeling, the authors demonstrate that the spatial and temporal variations in ground motion—including opposing directions of movement—are heavily influenced by magmatic weakening of the crust. The viscoelastic response of a hot, partially molten crustal reservoir to pressure changes explains the observed decadal geodetic signals, highlighting the critical role of rheological heterogeneity over purely elastic models in interpreting volcanic deformation.

sum: Determining continental-scale crustal thickness typically requires dense local seismic networks for receiver function analysis. This study introduces an automated method using dynamically formed 2.5°-aperture teleseismic ad-hoc arrays to detect near-source Moho underside reflections (pmP) from intermediate-depth and deep-focus earthquakes. Using pP-pmP differential travel times from 2,588 detections across 541 earthquakes, the authors generate a high-resolution Moho depth map for the South American Subduction Zone without requiring local instrumentation. The map shows crustal thicknesses up to 80.8 km beneath the Altiplano and agrees well with prior receiver function studies while providing smaller Fresnel zones (up to 0.57°) and broader coverage. Additionally, analyzing normalized pmP/pP amplitude ratios reveals high Moho impedance above the Peruvian flat slab at <100-120 km slab depths, indicating a cold, dry, mechanically uncoupled mantle wedge that becomes viscously coupled at the distal slab bend.
本研究提出了一种无需当地地震台网即可自动测定大陆尺度地壳厚度的新方法。作者利用全球远震数据动态构建2.5°孔径的自适应台阵，通过相位加权聚束和慢度谱识别中深源地震的近源莫霍面反射震相pmP与深度震相pP。基于541个地震的2588个pmP拾取，利用pP-pmP走时差构建了南美俯冲带高分辨率地壳厚度图……

Processed teleseismic vertical-component waveforms from SASZ intermediate-depth and deep-focus earthquakes (1995–2024, mb 4.7–6.5, depths 40–700 km), yielding 2,588 pmP detections from 29,987 candidate ad-hoc arrays across 541 events.

Phase-weighted vespagram and optimum beam calculation (0.1–1.0 Hz) to automatically pick P, pmP, and pP arrivals within a ±2.5 s window around predicted pmP times.
Forward modeling of pP-pmP differential times using a modified ak135 1D velocity model with a uniform 5.9 km/s crustal Vp to determine Moho depth.
Normalization of linear-beam pmP/pP amplitude ratios using Zoeppritz/Shuey reflection and transmission coefficients to probe Moho impedance contrast.
利用DBSCAN和Ball Tree算法将全球远震台站动态聚类为2.5°孔径的自适应台阵（至少10个台站）。

Assumes a uniform crustal P-wave velocity (5.9 km/s) and flat-layered 1D geometry, which can introduce errors in regions with steep Moho gradients or strong velocity anomalies.
Low overall detection yield (8.63% of candidate arrays with P and pP picks) and lack of automated outlier removal for misidentified intracrustal or slab-top reflections.

假设地壳P波速度均匀（5.9 km/s）且为一维水平层状几何，在莫霍面倾角较大或强烈速度异常区会引入误差。

tm.why: The paper presents an automated methodology to map the Moho discontinuity (crustal thickness) using near-source underside reflections (pmP) and validates the results against receiver function studies.

The core detection technique relies on dynamically creating medium-aperture ad-hoc teleseismic arrays and applying phase-weighted beamforming and vespagrams.

sum: InSAR and GNSS provide complementary spatiotemporal observations of crustal deformation, yet deep learning signal extraction methods have previously treated them independently. This study develops a convolutional neural network (CNN)-based autoencoder that jointly processes 24 InSAR interferograms (plus DEM) and 121-day 3-component GNSS time series to reconstruct denoised, spatially continuous 3D displacement fields. The network is trained on 200,000 synthetic datasets built from 77,112 rectangular megathrust fault models in the Hyuga-nada subduction zone combined with realistic tropospheric, ionospheric, decorrelation, Gaussian, and random-walk noise. In 10,000 synthetic tests, the joint model achieves >60% variance reduction for maximum displacements >2 mm and >90% for >1 cm, outperforming a GNSS-only model in capturing complex fault-parallel (NS) patterns. Applied to the 2019 Mw 6.2 Hyuga-nada earthquake, the model yields smooth 3D coseismic displacements whose inverted fault location lies within 10 km of the JMA seismic CMT solution.
针对InSAR和GNSS时空互补但此前深度学习方法各自独立处理的问题，本文开发了基于卷积神经网络（CNN）自编码器的联合模型，融合24幅干涉图、DEM与121天GNSS三维时间序列，重建去噪且空间连续的三维位移场。模型使用基于日向滩俯冲带77,112个矩形断层模型及多种真实噪声合成的20万组数据训练……

t: A three-block CNN-based autoencoder separately encodes 24 InSAR interferograms (concatenated with a DEM) and 121 daily 3-component GNSS images using 3D/2D convolutions and temporal max pooling, then concatenates feature maps to decode denoised 3D displacement fields.
采用三模块CNN自编码器分别编码24幅InSAR干涉图（含DEM）与121天GNSS图像，拼接特征图解码输出去噪三维位移…

Trained on 200,000 synthetic datasets from 77,112 rectangular fault models plus realistic InSAR/GNSS noise, tested on 10,000 synthetic cases, and applied to 24 Sentinel-1 interferograms and 21 GEONET GNSS stations for the 2019 Hyuga-nada earthquake.
利用77,112个断层模型合成20万组训练集和1万组测试集，并应用于2019年日向滩地震24幅Sentinel-1干涉图…

Synthetic tests yielded >60% variance reduction for maximum displacements >2 mm and >90% for >1 cm. For the 2019 Mw 6.2 earthquake, the inverted rectangular fault model was located within 10 km of the JMA CMT solution.
合成测试在位移>2 mm时方差缩减>60%，>1 cm时>90%；实测反演的断层模型位置与JMA CMT解距离在10 k…
The CNN model requires a fixed number of input interferograms (24) and uses a simple architecture, requiring prior removal of seasonal and common-mode GNSS noise.
模型受限于固定数量的InSAR输入，且需预先手动滤除季节项和共模误差。
First deep-learning autoencoder to jointly fuse multi-interferogram InSAR and daily GNSS time series to reconstruct denoised, spatially interpolated 3D crustal displacement fields.
首次利用深度学习自编码器联合融合InSAR与GNSS数据以重建高分辨率去噪三维位移场。

kc: Developed a three-block CNN autoencoder that jointly fuses multi-interferogram InSAR and daily 3-component GNSS time series to output continuous 3D displacement fields.
Demonstrated via 10,000 synthetic tests that joint InSAR+GNSS inference achieves >60% variance reduction above 2 mm and >90% above 1 cm, outperforming GNSS-only models in the NS component.
Successfully extracted ~1 cm coseismic 3D displacements of the 2019 Mw 6.2 Hyuga-nada earthquake and estimated a fault source model within 10 km of the JMA CMT epicenter.
开发了三模块CNN自编码器，联合融合多幅InSAR干涉图和每日三分量GNSS时间序列，输出连续三维位移场。
通过1万次合成测试证明联合模型在位移>2 mm时方差缩减率>60%（>1 cm时>90%），在南北分量上显著优于纯GNSS模型。
成功提取2019年Mw 6.2日向滩地震约1厘米的同震三维形变场，反演断层位置与JMA地震CMT解距离在10公里以内。
me: Three-block CNN autoencoder: InSAR block (3D convolutions, temporal max pooling, DEM feature map concatenation, 2D convolutions), GNSS block (larger spatial kernels 3x9x9 and 9x9 on 121x46x46 daily images), and Joint decoding block.
Synthetic training dataset generation using Okada (1992) rectangular dislocation models on the Philippine Sea plate interface plus four InSAR noise types and GNSS Gaussian + random-walk noise.
Real data preprocessing using GACOS for InSAR tropospheric delay and STEL (Loess seasonal-trend-episodic decomposition) plus spatial filtering for GNSS.
Grid-search rectangular fault source inversion with analytical weighted linear least-squares estimation of 3D translational offsets.
三模块CNN自编码器：InSAR处理模块（3D卷积、时间最大池化、拼接DEM特征图、2D卷积）、GNSS处理模块（针对稀疏台站采用大空间卷积核处理121×46×46日图像）及联合解码模块。
利用菲律宾海板块界面Okada矩形位错模型结合四类InSAR噪声及GNSS高斯+随机游走噪声生成20万组合成训练数据。
实测数据预处理：InSAR采用GACOS削弱对流层延迟，GNSS采用STEL去季节项及空间滤波去除共模误差。
结合三维平移向量解析加权最小二乘估计的矩形断层参数网格搜索反演。
de: 200,000 synthetic datasets (8:2 train/validation split) and 10,000 synthetic test cases derived from 77,112 rectangular fault models and 2,000 noise realizations.
24 descending Sentinel-1 interferograms (within ±60 days of the event) processed via LiCSAR/LiCSBAS and resampled to a 46x46 grid at 0.02° spacing.
Daily F5.0 GNSS position time series from 273 GEONET stations (2017–2021) for preprocessing, with 21 stations in the target area (±60 days around May 9, 2019) used for model input.
基于77,112个矩形断层模型和2,000种噪声模式生成的20万组合成训练/验证集（8:2划分）和1万组独立合成测试集。
LiCSAR/LiCSBAS处理的24幅Sentinel-1降轨干涉图（震前震后±60天内），重采样至0.02°间距的46×46网格。
日本国土地理院273个GEONET台站（2017–2021年）F5.0日解坐标用于预处理，提取研究区内21个台站震前震后±60天数据作为输入。
li: The trained CNN requires a fixed number of input interferograms (24) and specific grid configuration, limiting direct application to continuous arbitrary-interval fault monitoring.
Real geodetic data still require manual preprocessing to remove seasonal oscillations and common-mode errors not modeled in the synthetic training noise.
The inverted seismic moment for the 2019 earthquake is ~2.8 times larger than the JMA CMT solution, and offshore pixels exhibit higher displacement uncertainty.
模型要求输入固定数量（24幅）的干涉图，限制了其在任意采样间隔连续断层监测中的直接应用。
实测数据仍需预先手动滤除合成训练集中未包含的季节性振荡和共模误差。
反演得到的2019年地震矩约为JMA CMT解的2.8倍，且近海像素的位移不确定度较大。

tm.why: The study develops a convolutional neural network-based autoencoder to denoise and interpolate 3D crustal displacement fields from joint InSAR and GNSS data.
The method is motivated by extracting small millimeter-to-centimeter transient fault slip signals on subduction megathrusts and compares the 2019 source location with tectonic tremor zones.
The authors invert the denoised 3D coseismic displacement fields for a rectangular fault source model of the 2019 Mw 6.2 Hyuga-nada earthquake.

ev.notes: Full preprint PDF including main text (pages 1–53) and Additional File 1 supporting information (pages 54–73, Figures S1–S17 and Tables S1–S5) was read and analyzed.

sum: This study reinterprets 13 magnitude-equivalent values (Mj 7.5–8.0) from electromagnetic precursor anomaly No.1778 (detected via FM radio propagation at the Yatsugatake South Base Observatory) as aggregate indicators of crustal stress release beneath the Kanto Basin. Using empirical scaling relations by Matsuda (1975) and Wells & Coppersmith (1994), the subevents convert to a cumulative rupture area of approximately 5.6×10⁴ km², equivalent to Mw 8.7. Because the forearc weak suture zone alone is structurally limited to Mw 8.0–8.3, accounting for an Mw 8.7 scenario requires a composite rupture model mechanically linking the forearc suture zone with the subducting Pacific Plate interface (dipping 30–40°). Rather than predicting a specific earthquake, the paper novely bridges non-seismic precursor aggregate quantities with regional subduction geometry to evaluate theoretical upper-bound structural rupture limits.
本研究重新解释了八岳南麓天文台发布的1778号电磁前兆异常数据（基于FM无线电传播观测的13个Mj 7.5–8.0级等效震级值），将其作为地壳应力释放的总量指标。通过应用Matsuda (1975)和Wells & Coppersmith (1994)的经验标度律，计算出总破裂面积约5.6×10⁴……

t: Empirical scaling laws (Matsuda, 1975; Wells & Coppersmith, 1994) are used to convert 13 precursor magnitude-equivalent values into cumulative rupture length and area to evaluate tectonic structural feasibility.
利用Matsuda (1975)和Wells & Coppersmith (1994)经验标度律，将13个前兆等效震级转…
Precursor anomaly No.1778 from the Yatsugatake South Base Observatory (Report No.471), consisting of 13 magnitude-equivalent subevents (Mj 7.5 to Mj 8.0) derived from anomalous FM radio propagation.
八岳南麓天文台第471号报告中的1778号前兆异常，含13个FM无线电传播异常等效震级子事件（Mj 7.5–8.0）。

Rupture area scaling yields a cumulative area of 5.6×10⁴ km² (Mw 8.7). Because the forearc suture zone alone is limited to Mw 8.0–8.3, an Mw 8.7 rupture requires composite participation of the Pacific Plate interface.
总破裂面积达5.6×10⁴ km²（Mw 8.7），超出弧前缝合带上限（Mw 8.0–8.3），需与太平洋板块界面复合破…
Precursor data do not indicate timing or certainty of earthquake occurrence, and it remains unresolved whether a single asperity can undergo multiple micro-failure episodes.
前兆数据不具时间或发生确定性预测能力，且同一凹凸体能否发生多次微破裂仍未解决。
Reinterprets electromagnetic FM precursor anomalies not as earthquake predictions, but as aggregate crustal stress release inputs to constrain upper-bound composite rupture models beneath Kanto.
将电磁前兆异常作为地壳应力释放总量指标而非地震预测，用于约束关东下方复合破裂上限模型。

kc: Converts 13 FM-radio precursor magnitude-equivalent values (No.1778) into cumulative rupture length and area using empirical scaling laws.
Estimates an upper-bound total rupture area of 5.6×10⁴ km², corresponding to a moment magnitude of Mw 8.7.
Proposes a composite rupture model mechanically linking the forearc weak suture zone and the 30–40° dipping Pacific Plate interface beneath the Kanto Basin.
利用经验标度律将13个FM无线电前兆等效震级值（No.1778）转换为累积破裂长度和破裂面积。
估算出上限总破裂面积约为5.6×10⁴ km²，对应矩震级Mw 8.7。
提出了将关东盆地下方弧前薄弱缝合带与30–40°倾角太平洋板块界面机械连接的复合破裂模型。
me: Rupture length empirical scaling using Matsuda (1975) relationship.
Rupture area empirical scaling using Wells & Coppersmith (1994) relationship.
Tectonic structural feasibility comparison comparing distributed versus single composite rupture scenarios.
使用Matsuda (1975)经验关系进行破裂长度标度分析。
使用Wells & Coppersmith (1994)经验关系进行破裂面积标度分析。
对比分布式破裂与单一复合破裂情景的构造可行性评估。
de: Precursor anomaly No.1778 from Yatsugatake South Base Observatory (Report No.471), comprising 13 PBF-type FM radio anomaly subevents (Mj 7.5 to 8.0).
Published seismological and tomographic constraints on the Kanto Fragment, Philippine Sea Plate, and Pacific Plate subduction geometry.
八岳南麓天文台发布的1778号前兆异常数据（第471号报告），包含13个PBF型FM无线电异常子事件（Mj 7.5至8.0）。
已发表的关于关东碎块、菲律宾海板块和太平洋板块俯冲几何形态的地震学与层析成像约束。
li: Precursor anomalies do not indicate the timing or certainty of earthquake occurrence and cannot be used as predictive warnings.
Linear summation of Matsuda rupture lengths (yielding M 9.7) likely overestimates the true rupture potential.
It remains unresolved whether the same fault asperity can undergo multiple micro-failure episodes, which could affect aggregate scaling.
前兆异常不能指示地震发生的时间或确定性，不能作为预测预警使用。
Matsuda破裂长度的线性累加（得出M 9.7）可能高估了真实的破裂潜力。
同一断层凹凸体是否能经历多次微破裂事件仍未解决，这可能影响总量标度评估。

tm.why: Evaluates the tectonic geometry and structural feasibility of composite rupture across the forearc weak suture zone and the subducting Pacific Plate interface beneath the Kanto Basin.
Applies empirical rupture scaling laws (Matsuda, 1975; Wells & Coppersmith, 1994) to evaluate upper-bound rupture length, area, and moment magnitude scenarios.
Assesses theoretical upper-bound rupture potential (up to Mw 8.7) beneath the metropolitan Kanto region for urban disaster mitigation considerations.

sum: To clarify how basal shear from the northward underthrusting Indian lower crust is transmitted upward to drive E–W extension in southern Tibet, this study applies ambient noise adjoint tomography to data from 51 temporary and 7 permanent broadband stations spanning three major rifts (Tangra Yum Co, Pumqu–Xianza, and Yadong–Gulu). By inverting 5–50 s Rayleigh and Love wave empirical Green's functions using spectral-element simulations, the authors construct high-resolution crustal shear-wave velocity (Vs) and radial anisotropy (RA) models. The results reveal pervasive positive RA (>5%) in the mid-to-lower crust (30–55 km), reflecting widespread N–S ductile shear. Conversely, in the mid-to-upper crust (10–30 km), low Vs anomalies (3.2–3.3 km/s, indicating ~3.7%–5.2% partial melt) and strong positive RA (>6%) are strictly localized beneath the rift axes. This demonstrates that deep basal shear preferentially focuses into pre-existing, melt-weakened mid-to-upper crustal zones rather than transmitting uniformly upward.
为阐明印度下地壳向北俯冲产生的底剪切如何向上传递并控制藏南裂谷的近东西向伸展，本研究利用跨越三个主要裂谷的51个流动台和7个固定宽频带台站背景噪声数据，开展伴随层析成像研究。通过谱元法模拟并反演5–50秒瑞利波与勒夫波经验格林函数，构建了高分辨率地壳横波速度（Vs）和径向各向异性（RA）模型。结果显……

t: Ambient noise adjoint tomography using spectral-element simulations (SPECFEM3D_ANAT) and multi-taper frequency-dependent phase traveltime misfits across three period bands (5–10 s, 10–20 s, 20–50 s) to invert for VSV, VSH, and radial anisotropy.
采用基于谱元模拟的背景噪声伴随层析成像，在5–50秒多周期频带内反演VSV、VSH及径向各向异性。

Continuous ambient noise from 51 temporary broadband stations (~12 km spacing, July 2021–February 2023) and 7 permanent stations across three southern Tibetan rifts, yielding 1,481 Z–Z and 1,263 T–T cross-correlation pairs.
跨越藏南三个裂谷的51个流动台和7个固定台连续背景噪声，获取1,481对Z–Z和1,263对T–T互相关函数。

Pervasive positive RA (>5%) occurs in the mid-to-lower crust (30–55 km), whereas low Vs (3.2–3.3 km/s, implying 3.7%–5.2% partial melt) and strong positive RA (>6%) at 10–30 km depth are confined beneath rift axes.
中下地壳（30–55 km）具广泛正RA（>5%），而10–30 km深度的低Vs（3.2–3.3 km/s）和强正RA…
Because of the near E–W linear array geometry, Love waves mainly constrain N–S horizontal polarization, yielding profile-dependent quasi-RA and limiting interpretation to the 2-D profile.
受近东西向线性台阵几何限制，反演结果为依赖测线的准径向各向异性，且解释局限于二维剖面。

First high-resolution ambient noise adjoint tomography of crustal radial anisotropy across the southern Tibetan rifts, demonstrating upward focusing of basal shear into localized mid-to-upper crustal weak zones.
首次利用背景噪声伴随层析成像揭示藏南裂谷地壳径向各向异性，证实底剪切向中上地壳弱带集中。

kc: Constructed high-resolution crustal Vs and radial anisotropy models across three southern Tibetan rifts using ambient noise adjoint tomography.
Identified pervasive positive RA (>5%) in the mid-to-lower crust (30–55 km), supporting widespread N–S ductile shear driven by Indian lower-crustal underthrusting.
Revealed discrete low-Vs anomalies (3.2–3.3 km/s, ~3.7%–5.2% melt) and strong positive RA (>6%) confined beneath rift axes at 10–30 km depth, showing strain localization.
利用背景噪声伴随层析成像构建了跨越藏南三个裂谷的高分辨率地壳Vs和径向各向异性模型。
发现拉萨地块中下地壳（30–55 km）存在普遍的正RA（>5%），支持印度下地壳俯冲驱动的广泛近南北向韧性剪切变形。
揭示了裂谷轴下方10–30 km深度处局域分布的低速异常（3.2–3.3 km/s，约3.7%–5.2%熔融）和强正RA（>6%），证实了应变局部化机制。
me: Three-component ambient noise cross-correlation (Z–Z and T–T components) to extract empirical Green's functions (EGFs) in the 5–50 s period band.
Spectral element method (SPECFEM3D_ANAT) to compute synthetic Green's functions and 3-D finite-frequency sensitivity kernels.
Multi-scale, frequency-dependent phase traveltime adjoint tomography using multi-taper measurements and pre-conditioned gradient optimization to invert for VSV and VSH.
三分量背景噪声互相关（Z–Z和T–T分量）提取5–50秒周期范围内的经验格林函数（EGFs）。
采用谱元法（SPECFEM3D_ANAT）计算合成格林函数和三维有限频灵敏度核。
利用多窗口测量和预处理梯度优化算法，开展多尺度、频率相关的相位走时伴随层析成像，反演VSV和VSH。
de: Continuous ambient noise recordings from 51 temporary broadband stations (~12 km spacing, July 2021 to February 2023) along an E–W profile at ~29.9°N.
Contemporaneous continuous data from 7 permanent broadband seismic stations from the International Earthquake Science Data Center.
A total of 1,481 Z–Z and 1,263 T–T quality-controlled station-pair cross-correlation functions across the Tangra Yum Co, Pumqu–Xianza, and Yadong–Gulu rifts.
沿约29.9°N近东西向测线布设的51个流动宽频带台站（台间距约12 km，2021年7月至2023年2月）连续背景噪声记录。
国际地震科学数据中心7个同期固定宽频带地震台站的连续波形数据。
跨越当惹雍错、朋曲-申扎和亚东-谷露三个裂谷的质量控制后的1,481对Z–Z分量和1,263对T–T分量互相关函数。
li: Due to the near E–W linear array geometry, Love waves mainly sample near N–S horizontal polarization, yielding a profile-dependent 'quasi-RA' rather than full 3-D fabric.
Off-profile N–S resolution is qualitative, restricting robust tectonic interpretations to the immediate 2-D profile AA' and requiring future 2-D/3-D dense arrays.
由于近东西向的线性台阵几何分布，勒夫波主要约束近南北向水平极化，所得各向异性为依赖测线的“准径向各向异性”，无法完全解析三维组构。
测线外的南北向分辨率仅具定性约束，可靠的构造解释仅限于二维测线AA'，未来需结合密集二维台阵观测进一步验证。

tm.why: The study uses high-resolution ambient noise adjoint tomography with spectral element modeling to invert Rayleigh and Love wave velocities.
The primary focus is constructing and interpreting a crustal shear-wave radial anisotropy (RA) model beneath the southern Tibetan rifts.
The paper investigates crustal deformation, partial melt, and the geodynamic link between Indian lower-crustal underthrusting and Tibetan rift formation.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF of the Geophysical Research Letters article used, including all sections, equations, references, and Figures 1-4.

sum: This study investigates the rupture process of the 2025 Mw 8.8 Kamchatka megathrust earthquake. By comparing high-frequency energy radiation (imaged via back-projection) with low-frequency slip distribution, the authors demonstrate a clear depth-dependent partitioning of seismic energy. High-frequency radiation is concentrated at deeper parts of the megathrust, while low-frequency slip dominates the shallower updip region. This frequency-dependent behavior provides critical insights into the frictional properties and rupture dynamics of the Kamchatka subduction zone.
本研究分析了2025年堪察加Mw 8.8特大逆冲地震的破裂过程。通过对比高频能量辐射（采用反向投影成像）与低频滑动分布，研究揭示了明显的深度依赖性地震能量分异特征：高频辐射主要集中在俯冲带较深部，而低频滑动则主导了较浅部的区域。这种频率依赖性行为为理解堪察加俯冲带的摩擦属性和破裂动力学提供了关键见解……

t: Back-projection of teleseismic P-waves combined with finite-fault slip inversion to resolve frequency-dependent rupture characteristics.
结合远震P波反向投影与有限断层滑动反演，以解析频率相关的破裂特征。

sum: Standard Vision Transformers treat prestack seismic gathers as 2D images, ignoring acquisition geometry crucial for tasks like first-arrival picking. This paper introduces GeoFormer, a Geometry-Aware Transformer designed for 5D prestack seismic data. Instead of 2D patches, GeoFormer uses trace-level tokenization combining the seismic waveform, 4D source-receiver coordinates, and two derived geometric attributes (offset and relative elevation). It incorporates 4D positional encoding, Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE), and three novel geometry injection mechanisms: GeomMLP (token-level additive spatial prior), GeomAdaLN (normalization-level feature modulation), and GeomAttnBias (parameter-free attention bias favoring geometrically proximate traces). Evaluated on four field reflection datasets (Brunswick, Halfmile Lake, Lalor, and Dongbei), GeoFormer reduces picking RMSE by 7–9x compared to Vision Transformer and outperforms Attention U-Net, HU-Net, and zero-shot SAM, particularly under severe noise and missing traces.
针对传统视觉Transformer忽略地震观测几何的问题，本文提出面向五维叠前地震数据的GeoFormer架构。该方法采用道级分词，联合编码地震波形、四维炮检点坐标以及偏移距和相对高程两个几何属性，并引入三种几何注入机制：词元级的GeomMLP、归一化级的GeomAdaLN和注意力级的无参先验Geo……

t: GeoFormer tokenizes individual seismic traces with 4D coordinates and injects offset and relative elevation into a Transformer via token-level MLP (GeomMLP), adaptive normalization (GeomAdaLN), and parameter-free distance attention bias (GeomAttnBias).
对单道波形与4D坐标分词，通过GeomMLP、GeomAdaLN和GeomAttnBias在三层级注入偏移距与高程。

Four field prestack seismic datasets (Brunswick, Halfmile Lake, Lalor, and Dongbei) ranging from 10 to 1,541 shots, offsets up to 14 km, partitioned by shot into 80/10/10 train/validation/test splits.
四个野外叠前地震数据集（10至1541炮，最大偏移距14km），按炮集以8:1:1划分训练、验证与测试集。
GeoFormer achieves the lowest RMSE across all datasets: 1.73 (Brunswick), 1.84 (Halfmile), 5.32 (Lalor), and 1.61 samples (Dongbei), reducing RMSE by 7–9x compared to Vision Transformer.
在所有数据集上取得最低RMSE（1.61–5.32采样点），相比标准ViT误差降低7至9倍，抗噪性显著提升。
Experiments train and test models on the same survey site; cross-site generalization and integration into large pre-trained foundation models remain for future work.
模型仅在同一工区内训练和测试，尚未验证跨工区泛化能力及大规模预训练底座结合。
Replaces 2D image patch tokenization with 5D trace-level tokenization and embeds physical acquisition geometry (offset and elevation) directly into token, normalization, and attention layers.
以五维道级分词取代二维图像块分词，将观测几何物理先验直接嵌入词元、归一化与注意力层。

kc: Proposes GeoFormer, a trace-level Transformer architecture that preserves the 5D structure of prestack seismic data by jointly encoding waveforms and 4D source-receiver coordinates.
Introduces three geometry injection mechanisms—GeomMLP, GeomAdaLN, and GeomAttnBias—at the token, normalization, and attention levels using offset and relative elevation.
Demonstrates superior first-arrival picking accuracy and noise robustness across four field datasets, reducing RMSE by 7–9x over standard Vision Transformers.
提出了GeoFormer架构，通过道级分词联合编码地震波形与四维炮检点坐标，完整保留叠前地震数据的五维结构。
提出了GeomMLP、GeomAdaLN和GeomAttnBias三种几何注入机制，分别在词元、归一化和注意力层级融入偏移距与相对高程。
在四个野外实际数据集上验证了其优异的初至拾取精度与抗噪鲁棒性，相比标准视觉Transformer将RMSE降低了7至9倍。
me: 5D trace-level tokenization combining waveform samples with 4D source-receiver coordinates and derived offset and relative elevation.
Geometry-aware positional encoding combining 4D sinusoidal absolute coordinate encoding with Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) on trace indices.
GeomMLP for additive token-level geometric representation, GeomAdaLN for multiplicative RMSNorm modulation, and GeomAttnBias for distance-based attention weighting.
Per-sample binary segmentation trained with masked binary cross-entropy loss and post-processed via Nearest-Point Picking (NPP).
五维道级分词，将地震波形样本与四维炮检点坐标及导出的偏移距、相对高程相结合。
几何感知位置编码，结合四维正弦绝对坐标编码与道索引上的旋转位置编码（RoPE）。
利用GeomMLP提供加性词元级几何表征，GeomAdaLN实现乘性RMSNorm特征调制，GeomAttnBias施加基于几何距离的注意力偏置。
采用掩码二元交叉熵损失训练逐采样点二元分割模型，并通过最近点拾取（NPP）提取初至波到时。
de: Evaluated on four field datasets: Brunswick (1,541 shots), Halfmile Lake (690 shots), Lalor (905 shots) from a hardrock reflection benchmark, plus Dongbei (10 shots, northeastern China).
Partitioned strictly at the shot gather level (80% train, 10% validation, 10% test) to prevent spatial information leakage across adjacent traces.
Compared against Attention U-Net, HU-Net, Vision Transformer, and zero-shot Segment Anything Model (SAM), plus ablation studies on Halfmile.
在四个野外数据集上进行评估：硬岩反射基准数据集中的Brunswick（1,541炮）、Halfmile Lake（690炮）、Lalor（905炮），以及中国东北数据集（10炮）。
严格按炮集划分数据集（80%训练、10%验证、10%测试），以防止相邻地震道之间的空间信息泄露。
与Attention U-Net、HU-Net、Vision Transformer及零样本SAM模型进行了对比，并在Halfmile数据集上开展了消融实验。
li: Evaluated only within-site (models trained and tested on the same survey site); cross-site generalization performance is not experimentally tested.
First-arrival picking is formulated via dense per-sample binary mask segmentation rather than direct lightweight traveltime regression.
仅在同一工区内进行了训练与测试评估，尚未通过实验验证跨工区的泛化能力。

tm.why: The paper proposes a Geometry-Aware Transformer deep learning architecture specifically designed for prestack seismic data and first-arrival picking.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete text and tables on pages 1-29 of the provided PDF (note: the extracted text terminates after Figure 3 on p. 29, while Figures 4-11 are referenced in the body text on pages 17-20).

sum: This Zenodo repository presents an earthquake catalog for the Coso geothermal field in California, accompanied by declustering analysis results. Created by Yu-Fang Hsu, Xiaofeng Meng, and Yehuda Ben-Zion, the dataset is designed to support studies on geothermal seismicity, fault mechanics, and earthquake triggering. Declustering is a crucial step in seismic hazard analysis and statistical seismology to separate independent background earthquakes from dependent cluster events (such as aftershocks or swarms). This dataset serves as a valuable resource for researchers analyzing the spatio-temporal evolution of seismicity in highly active geothermal environments.
该Zenodo数据存储库提供了加州Coso地热区的地震目录及去群震分析结果。该数据集由Yu-Fang Hsu、Xiaofeng Meng和Yehuda Ben-Zion创建，旨在支持地热地震活动性、断层力学和地震触发机制的研究。去群震是统计地震学中的关键步骤，用于将独立的背景地震与相关的群发事件区分……

t: Declustering algorithms applied to an earthquake catalog of the Coso geothermal field to separate background seismicity from clusters.
对Coso地热区地震目录应用去群震算法，以分离背景地震与群发地震。
Seismic catalog data from the Coso geothermal area, California.

Includes declustering results to separate background seismicity from clustered events.

sum: This study combines high-pressure, high-temperature experiments with molecular dynamics simulations to demonstrate that silicate magma can incorporate significantly more oxygen than allowed by traditional cation stoichiometry. This excess oxygen behaves as a volatile component, increasing from near zero at 1 atm to over 5 wt.% above 5 GPa. As these oxygen-rich magmas ascend and decompress, their capacity to retain excess oxygen decreases, triggering the release of O2. This provides a direct mechanism linking mantle melting to the oxidation of Earth's shallow interior and atmosphere, establishing magma as a dynamic reservoir in planetary oxygen cycles.
本研究结合高温高压实验与分子动力学模拟，发现硅酸盐岩浆可融入远超传统阳离子化学计量限制的超量氧。这种超量氧作为一种新型挥发分，在5 GPa以上压力下含量可达5 wt.%以上。当富氧岩浆上升减压时，其储氧能力下降并释放氧气。该机制直接将地幔熔融与地球浅部及大气的氧化联系起来，揭示了岩浆在行星氧循环中的……

t: High-pressure, high-temperature experiments combined with molecular dynamics simulations to analyze oxygen incorporation in silicate magmas.
结合高温高压实验与分子动力学模拟，分析硅酸盐岩浆中的氧融入行为。
Experimental and simulated solubility data of oxygen in silicate melts from 1 atmosphere up to pressures exceeding 5 GPa.
硅酸盐熔体在1大气压至5 GPa以上压力范围内的氧溶解度实验与模拟数据。
Silicate magma incorporates >~5 wt.% excess oxygen above 5 GPa, which is released as O2 during decompression and ascent.
硅酸盐岩浆在5 GPa以上可融入超5 wt.%的超量氧，并在减压上升时释放O2。
The study does not fully resolve the exact chemical species of excess oxygen across all magma compositions.
未完全解析所有岩浆组分中超量氧的具体化学存在形式。
Identifies magma as a dynamic reservoir for non-stoichiometric oxygen, challenging the assumption that magma oxygen is fixed by cation stoichiometry.
挑战了岩浆氧含量由阳离子化学计量固定的传统假设，提出岩浆是动态氧储库。

kc: Discovered that silicate magma can incorporate non-stoichiometric excess oxygen at high pressures (>5 GPa).
Demonstrated that decompression of ascending magma drives the release of molecular oxygen (O2).
Established a direct link between mantle melting and the oxidation of Earth's shallow interior and atmosphere.
发现硅酸盐岩浆在高压（>5 GPa）下可融入非化学计量的超量氧。
证实了上升岩浆在减压过程中会释放分子氧（O2）。
建立了地幔熔融与地球浅部及大气氧化之间的直接联系。
me: High-pressure and high-temperature experiments to study silicate magma under mantle conditions.
Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations to support experimental observations of oxygen incorporation.
高温高压实验，用于研究地幔条件下硅酸盐岩浆的性质。
分子动力学（MD）模拟，用于支持超量氧融入的实验观测。
de: Experimental measurements of oxygen solubility in silicate melts up to and above 5 GPa.
Molecular dynamics simulations of silicate melt structures with excess oxygen.
在高达及超过5 GPa压力下硅酸盐熔体中氧溶解度的实验测量数据。
含超量氧硅酸盐熔体结构的分子动力学模拟。

The quantitative efficiency of this oxygen transport mechanism in diverse tectonic settings remains to be fully modeled.

该氧输送机制在不同构造背景下的定量效率仍有待完整建模。

tm.why: The paper investigates the oxygen-carrying capacity of silicate magma at high pressures and temperatures, which has major implications for mantle melting and planetary geodynamics.

sum: This study introduces a novel, fully automated baseline correction framework for strong-motion seismic records to recover coseismic permanent ground displacement. Traditional methods rely on empirical, visual adjustments, making them unsuitable for large-scale datasets. By reformulating baseline correction as an inverse problem inspired by robot trajectory planning, the authors incorporate physical jerk constraints. This physically grounded approach successfully handles complex scenarios, including velocity pulses, waveform distortions, and non-ideal instrument states. The framework's robustness and cross-event adaptability are validated using strong-motion data from major earthquakes, including the Chi-Chi, Wenchuan, and Kahramanmaraş events. This method eliminates empirical subjectivity, providing a robust tool for automated large-scale strong-motion data processing.
本研究提出一种全自动强震记录基线校正框架以恢复同震永久位移。该方法将基线校正重构为机器人轨迹规划逆问题，并引入物理加加速度（Jerk）约束。该方法能有效处理速度脉冲、复杂波形畸变和非理想仪器状态，消除了对经验调整的依赖。通过集集、汶川和卡赫拉曼马拉什地震数据验证，展示了其强大的跨事件适应性。

t: Reformulating baseline correction as an inverse problem in robot trajectory planning with physical jerk constraints to achieve fully automated processing.
将基线校正重构为机器人轨迹规划中的逆问题，并引入物理加加速度（Jerk）约束进行自动处理。
Strong-motion seismic records from major earthquakes, specifically the Chi-Chi, Wenchuan, and Kahramanmaraş events, featuring velocity pulses and waveform distortions.
来自集集、汶川和卡赫拉曼马拉什地震的强震动地震记录，包含速度脉冲和波形畸变。
Successful recovery of coseismic permanent ground displacements and effective handling of velocity pulses, complex waveform distortions, and nonideal instrument states across multiple events.
成功恢复了同震永久地面位移，并有效处理了多个地震事件中的速度脉冲、复杂波形畸变和非理想仪器状态。
Performance under extremely sparse data or highly anomalous noise conditions not explicitly detailed in the abstract.
在极度稀疏的数据或高度异常的噪声条件下的表现未在摘要中详细说明。
First framework to reformulate seismic baseline correction using robot trajectory planning and physical jerk constraints, eliminating empirical, image-based adjustments.
首次利用机器人轨迹规划和物理Jerk约束重构地震基线校正，消除了对经验性图像调整的依赖。

kc: Proposed a novel baseline correction framework based on robot trajectory planning and physical jerk constraints.
Achieved fully automated recovery of coseismic permanent ground displacement without empirical visual inspection.
Demonstrated strong cross-event adaptability on Chi-Chi, Wenchuan, and Kahramanmaraş earthquake datasets.

sum: This thesis assesses the feasibility of moment tensor inversion using Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) during volcanic unrest on the Reykjanes Peninsula, Iceland. Using reference moment tensors derived from conventional seismometers via MTUQ, the author simulates velocity waveforms in a 1D Earth model and converts them into synthetic DAS nano-strain rate along an 8 km fiber-optic cable for two Mw > 3 events. Because raw synthetic amplitudes are approximately two orders of magnitude smaller than observations, an event- and channel-dependent logarithmic least-squares amplitude coupling correction is introduced. Moment tensor inversion is then executed using a precomputed six-component linear basis and Simulated Annealing on the Tape and Tape lune parameters. Despite amplitude corrections, the inverted moment tensors exhibit poor waveform fits and unrealistic mechanisms inconsistent with the tectonic setting, demonstrating that unmodeled 3D volcanic heterogeneity and complex fiber coupling severely limit standalone DAS moment tensor inversions.
本论文评估了在冰岛雷克雅内斯半岛火山动荡期间利用分布式声学传感（DAS）进行矩张量反演的可行性。研究基于常规地震仪通过MTUQ获得的参考矩张量，在一维介质模型中合成速度波形，并转换为沿8公里光缆的合成DAS纳应变率数据。针对合成振幅远小于观测值的问题，提出了一种基于最小二乘法的事件与通道依赖型振幅耦……

t: Velocity seismograms from 1D FK Green's functions are rotated parallel to the fiber, integrated to displacement, differenced across gauge length to obtain DAS strain rate, corrected for channel coupling, and inverted via Simulated Annealing using a six-component linear basis.
将一维FK格林函数合成速度旋转至光缆方向并积分求差得到合成DAS应变率，经通道耦合校正后结合六分量线性基函数与模拟退火进…

DAS nano-strain rate data recorded on an 8 km telecommunication cable (10 m gauge length, 16 m channel spacing) near Grindavík from Nov 2023 to Apr 2024, focusing on two Mw > 3 earthquakes (Mw 3.70 and Mw 3.90).
2023年11月至2024年4月冰岛Grindavík附近8公里通信光缆采集的DAS纳应变率数据，重点分析两个Mw>3地…

Simulated DAS amplitudes are roughly 100 times smaller than observations (channel correction factors R = 100–900). Simulated Annealing inversions yield poor waveform fits and complex non-tectonic mechanisms that fail to recover the reference moment tensors.
合成DAS振幅比观测小约百倍（通道校正因子R为100–900）；反演所得矩张量波形拟合差且机制复杂，未能恢复参考震源机制…
Using a 1D velocity model forces filtering at low frequencies (0.033–0.10 Hz) where DAS SNR is low, while unmodeled 3D volcanic heterogeneity and two-event coupling calibration degrade waveform fits.
一维模型迫使采用DAS信噪比较低的低频段（0.033–0.10 Hz），且未建模的三维火山非均匀性及仅用两事件标定耦合限…

Evaluates standalone DAS moment tensor inversion in an uncontrolled, highly heterogeneous volcanic unrest environment on the Reykjanes Peninsula, paired with a custom event-channel amplitude coupling correction and linear basis acceleration.
首次在非受控的冰岛火山动荡强非均匀环境中评估纯DAS矩张量反演，并提出事件-通道振幅耦合校正与线性基函数加速策略。

kc: Formulated and analytically validated a forward modeling workflow converting MTUQ 3-component velocity synthetics into gauge-length-averaged DAS nano-strain rate.
Developed a logarithmic least-squares amplitude coupling scheme separating event magnitude corrections and channel-dependent fiber coupling factors.
Accelerated DAS moment tensor inversion from over 2 hours to under 10 minutes using a precomputed six-component linear moment tensor basis with Simulated Annealing.
Demonstrated that standalone DAS moment tensor inversion in a heterogeneous volcanic setting using 1D Green's functions fails to reliably recover reference source mechanisms.
建立并解析验证了将MTUQ三分量合成速度波形转换为标距平均DAS纳应变率的正演工作流。
开发了对数最小二乘振幅耦合校正方案，分离了事件震级校正因子与随通道变化的光缆耦合因子。
结合预计算的六分量矩张量线性基函数与模拟退火算法，将反演计算时间从2小时以上缩短至10分钟以内。
证实了在复杂非均匀火山环境中仅使用一维格林函数和纯DAS数据难以可靠反演真实的地震矩张量。
me: Reference moment tensor inversion of conventional seismometer data using MTUQ grid search and 1D frequency-wavenumber (FK) Green's functions.

Synthetic DAS strain-rate formulation via horizontal waveform rotation along cable geometry, time integration to displacement, finite-difference spatial differencing over gauge length, and time differentiation.
Least-squares logarithmic decomposition to estimate channel-dependent coupling factors (R ranging from ~100 to 900) and event-dependent factors.
Simulated Annealing moment tensor inversion utilizing a precomputed six-component linear basis and Tape & Tape (2015) lune parameterization.
利用MTUQ网格搜索和一维频率-波数（FK）格林函数对常规地震仪数据进行参考矩张量反演。
通过沿光缆方向水平旋转波形、时间积分求位移、标距内空间差分及时间求导构建合成DAS应变率。
利用对数最小二乘分解估算随通道变化的耦合因子（R介于100至900之间）及事件依赖因子。
基于预计算六分量线性基函数、Tape & Tape (2015) 经纬参数化及模拟退火算法进行矩张量反演。
de: Observed DAS nano-strain rate recordings on an 8 km telecommunication fiber cable near Grindavík, Iceland (10 m gauge length, 16 m channel spacing) acquired between Nov 2023 and Apr 2024.
Two volcanic unrest earthquakes with reference seismometer moment tensors: 2023/11/19 (Mw 3.70, depth 9.0 km, passband 10–33 s) and 2023/12/18 (Mw 3.90, depth 4.0 km, passband 15–33 s).
Analytical verification test on a 10 km straight fiber using synthetic sinusoidal radial and transverse velocity waveforms.
2023年11月至2024年4月在冰岛Grindavík附近8公里通信光缆上采集的DAS纳应变率观测数据（标距10米，道间距16米）。
两个具有常规地震仪参考矩张量的火山动荡期地震事件：2023/11/19（Mw 3.70，深度9.0 km，滤波频带10–33 s）和2023/12/18（Mw 3.90，深度4.0 km，滤波频带15–33 s）。
在10公里直光缆模型上使用正弦径向和切向合成速度波形进行的解析验证实验。
li: Green's functions are computed using a simplified 1D velocity-density model, ignoring strong 3D lateral heterogeneity in the volcanic crust.
Amplitude coupling factors are calibrated using only two reference earthquakes, leaving large channel-to-channel waveform and phase discrepancies.
Low-frequency passbands (0.033–0.10 Hz) required by the 1D point-source assumption exclude the 0.5–1.6 Hz band where DAS signal-to-noise ratio is highest.

sum: This work addresses the challenge of detecting and locating microearthquakes using sparse seismic networks. By developing advanced computational workflows (likely incorporating machine learning or template matching), the authors demonstrate how to significantly lower detection thresholds and build dense, high-fidelity earthquake catalogs. This is crucial for monitoring seismicity in regions with limited instrumentation, improving our understanding of fault zone processes, induced seismicity, and seismic hazards.

sum: This study evaluates the seasonal vertical crustal deformation in the Ganges-Brahmaputra-Meghna (GBM) river basin using ~12 years of daily GPS and GRACE data. The authors find a peak-to-peak vertical deformation of 3.50 to 6.65 cm. Reducing GRACE-derived seasonal deformation from GPS observations yields a weighted root mean square reduction of 41% in the Brahmaputra-Meghna basin and 47% in the Nepal Himalayas. Spectral analysis reveals a significant semi-annual cycle (SAC) in the Nepal Himalayas. By comparing the SAC power with total precipitation simulated by a high-resolution atmospheric general circulation model, the study demonstrates that the SAC is a robust geophysical signal associated with snow loading rather than a processing artifact. The spatial variations of vertical hydrological deformation correlate well with the East-West contrast in total precipitation.
本研究利用约12年的每日GPS和GRACE数据，评估了恒河-布拉马普特拉-梅格纳（GBM）流域的季节性垂直地壳形变。结果显示，该区域存在3.50至6.65厘米的峰峰值垂直形变。扣除GRACE推导的季节性形变后，GPS观测的加权均方根在布拉马普特拉-梅格纳流域减少了41%，在尼泊尔喜马拉雅地区减少了4……

t: Joint analysis of ~12 years of daily GPS observations and GRACE gravity data combined with spectral analysis and atmospheric general circulation model simulations.
联合分析约12年的每日GPS观测与GRACE重力数据，并结合谱分析和大气环流模型模拟。
~12 years of daily GPS observations, GRACE-derived seasonal vertical deformation, and simulated precipitation from the Japan Meteorological Research Institute's atmospheric general circulation model.
约12年的每日GPS观测、GRACE推导的季节性垂直形变，以及日本气象研究所大气环流模型模拟的降水数据。
Identified 3.50-6.65 cm peak-to-peak vertical deformation, with GRACE reducing GPS seasonal variance by 41-47%, and confirmed the semi-annual cycle in Nepal Himalayas is a real snow-loading signal.
识别出3.50-6.65厘米的峰峰值垂直形变，GRACE使GPS季节性方差减少41-47%，并证实尼泊尔喜马拉雅的半载周…
Resolution mismatch between GRACE and GPS, and reliance on simulated precipitation rather than extensive direct in-situ snow measurements.
GRACE与GPS之间的空间分辨率不匹配，且依赖模拟降水而非广泛的直接原位积雪测量。
First to robustly confirm that the semi-annual cycle in geodetic vertical deformation over the Nepal Himalayas is a physical signal of snow loading rather than a processing artifact.

sum: Atmospheric re-entries of human-made spacecraft are increasing, yet independent verification is limited by undisclosed operator telemetry. This study applies seismoacoustic localization to the 25 May 2025 controlled re-entry of the SpaceX CRS-32 Cargo Dragon off Southern California. Using vertical-component waveforms from 95 open-access seismic stations across five networks—including 22 Raspberry Shake citizen-science instruments—the authors manually pick sonic boom N-wave arrivals, apply elevation corrections, and use structure-tensor analysis on the arrival-time delay field to recover the spacecraft's ground track. The reconstructed trajectory closely matches SpaceX's publicly communicated splashdown corridor. Furthermore, the authors release the first public N-wave pick dataset for a commercial crew-class capsule and evaluate deep-learning models (PhaseNet and SeisLM) on 220 combined waveforms from CRS-32 and Shenzhou-15. PhaseNet trained from scratch achieves a 0.197 s onset MAE and 1.00 recall, proving its utility as a human-in-the-loop screener for continental-scale re-entry monitoring.
针对商業航天器再入缺乏独立验证的问题，本研究利用5个台网的95个开放地震台站（含22个Raspberry Shake公众科学台站）垂直分量波形，对2025年5月25日SpaceX CRS-32货运龙飞船受控再入进行了地震声学定位。通过手动拾取音爆N波初至、高程校正及延迟场结构张量分析，成功恢复了与官……

t: Applies elevation correction to 1–18 Hz filtered N-wave arrival times, uses 2x2 structure-tensor analysis on the delay gradient field to infer trajectory, and trains PhaseNet and SeisLM models for automated picking.
对1-18Hz滤波的N波到时做高程校正，用延迟场结构张量分析反演轨迹，并训练PhaseNet和SeisLM自动拾取。

One-hour vertical-component waveforms from 95 stations across five networks (CI, BK, AM, NC, AZ) in California for CRS-32, combined with 125 Shenzhou-15 station waveforms for machine learning training.
加州5个台网95个台站的CRS-32垂直分量波形，结合125条神舟十五号波形用于机器学习训练。

Recovered a northwest-to-southeast trajectory matching SpaceX's splashdown corridor; PhaseNet trained from scratch achieved an onset MAE of 0.197 s, F1 score of 0.706 at 0.05 s tolerance, and 1.00 recall across thresholds 0.05–0.70.
重建轨迹与SpaceX预测一致；从头训练PhaseNet初至MAE为0.197秒，F1达0.706，召回率达1.00。
No public ground-truth telemetry exists for quantitative error validation, offshore station coverage is absent, and ML models were trained only on 30 s segmented windows with event-stratified splits.

kc: First published seismoacoustic trajectory recovery of a controlled commercial crew-class spacecraft (SpaceX CRS-32 Dragon) using only open seismic data.
Demonstrated that citizen-science Raspberry Shake instruments meaningfully complement research-grade networks, contributing 23% (22/95) of the final station picks despite higher noise floors.

证明了Raspberry Shake公众科学仪器能有效补充专业台网，尽管本底噪声较高，仍贡献了23%（22/95）的有效台站拾取。
公开发布了人工标注的CRS-32再入N波初至与结束时间数据集，为未来自动化检测提供基准。
证明在双事件小样本（220条波形）上从头训练的PhaseNet可实现0.197秒的初至MAE、0.706的F1分数及1.00的召回率。

构建包含220条标注N波波形的机器学习数据集（95条来自SpaceX CRS-32，125条来自2024年4月2日神舟十五号再入）。
检验Whitham音爆标度律，将N波持续时间与顺轨距离、高度代理和时延代理进行对比分析。
对比1–18 Hz频段内Raspberry Shake（AM）与专业地震台网的初至前均方根（RMS）本底噪声水平。

sum: This study develops a covariance-propagation framework to evaluate the physical detection limits of dense arrays of low-cost, dual-band GNSS sensors for monitoring prerupture transient crustal deformation. By fitting regional offset and planar fields as nuisance modes and incorporating independent receiver noise and residual locally correlated noise into an explicit covariance matrix, the framework estimates localized deformation amplitudes using minimum-variance weighting. Using reference, favorable, and conservative design scenarios for a 20x20 km domain, the author demonstrates how spatial-search-adjusted detection thresholds scale with node density (N = 900 to 4900). The framework is validated using GNSS data from the 2014 Iquique earthquake sequence and Monte Carlo simulations. The results highlight that persistent local correlation creates a detection floor, emphasizing the need for field calibration and false-alarm testing before operational deployment of dense GNSS arrays.

Lack of field calibration for the proposed hardware and a detection floor imposed by persistent local noise correlation.

sum: This Zenodo repository shares a seismic waveform dataset of repeating earthquake clusters along the North Anatolian Fault following the 1999 Izmit and Düzce, Turkey earthquakes. The dataset includes SAC-format waveforms for 40 clusters (with 36 used in Peng & Ben-Zion, 2006), pre-aligned by P-wave arrivals, along with hypoDD relocation catalogs (292 events). These data are highly valuable for studying temporal variations in shallow seismic velocity, crustal anisotropy, and fault zone structures.
该Zenodo仓库共享了1999年土耳其伊兹密特和迪兹杰地震后，北安纳托利亚断裂带重复地震序列的波形数据集。数据包含40个重复地震簇的SAC格式波形（已按P波到时对齐）及292个事件的hypoDD重定位目录。该数据集对研究断裂带浅部波速随时间的变化及地壳各向异性具有重要价值。

t: Waveform alignment based on P-wave arrivals and double-difference relocation (hypoDD) to identify and group repeating earthquake clusters.
基于P波到时的波形对齐以及双差定位（hypoDD）方法，用于识别和划分重复地震簇。

A curated dataset of repeating earthquake waveforms and relocation catalogs (hypoDD) ready for temporal velocity change and anisotropy analyses.

sum: This study presents a continental-scale probabilistic electrical resistivity model of Australia's shallow crust (down to ~650 m) with quantified uncertainty. The authors invert more than 26.6 million airborne electromagnetic (AEM) soundings acquired along 352,609 line-kilometers from the AusAEM program (using TEMPEST and SkyTEM systems). To overcome the massive computational bottleneck of traditional Markov chain Monte Carlo (McMC) methods, they train 11 system-specific invertible neural networks (INNs) on a shared synthetic resistivity model pool. Training took 37.43 GPU hours and predicting 500 posterior samples per sounding across the entire continent took only 4.37 GPU hours on a single GPU. They also introduce a posterior uncertainty-based depth of investigation (DOI) metric. The resulting resistivity model reveals clear transitions from shallow regolith and aquifer systems to deeper basement and tectonic provinces, offering a national baseline for geological mapping, groundwater assessment, and critical mineral exploration.
本研究构建了澳大利亚大陆尺度浅层地壳（深达约650米）的概率电阻率模型并量化了不确定性。作者利用可逆神经网络（INN）对AusAEM项目的2660余万个航空电磁（AEM）测深点（共352,609测线公里）进行了概率反演。针对不同采集系统，采用共享合成模型池训练了11个INN网络，总训练耗时37.43……

t: Supervised invertible neural networks (INNs) construct a bijective mapping between 1D resistivity models and AEM responses paired with Gaussian latent variables, enabling rapid posterior sampling via backward propagation.

Probabilistic inversion is performed on 26,602,503 time-domain AEM soundings acquired along 352,609 line-km across Australia from 10 AusAEM surveys using TEMPEST and SkyTEM systems.

Sequential training of 11 INNs took 37.43 GPU hours and full-continent posterior prediction (500 samples/sounding) took 4.37 GPU hours, resolving basin aquifers (<30 Ohm-m) and resistive cratons (>500 Ohm-m).

Thick conductive near-surface overburden in basins strongly attenuates electromagnetic signals, limiting the effective depth of investigation to less than ~300 m.

sum: This study develops a regionalized ground-motion model (GMM) for Northern Vietnam (NVN) by adjusting the global ASK14 GMM. Using a local dataset of 229 shallow crustal earthquakes recorded at 83 stations, the authors modify small-magnitude scaling and distance attenuation while retaining large-magnitude and short-distance scaling. They introduce spatially varying coefficients to construct a nonergodic GMM, which reduces the aleatory standard deviation from 1.0 (ergodic) to 0.72 (nonergodic). This model improves ground-motion estimation accuracy for seismic hazard assessment in NVN, where geological conditions vary from deep sediment basins near Hanoi to hard-rock in northwestern mountainous areas.

sum: This work addresses the generalization challenge of deep learning models in classifying local earthquakes and explosions. By combining seismic scalograms (time-frequency representations) with phase detection probabilities, the authors improve classification performance across diverse geological settings. The accompanying dataset on Zenodo (ASDF_16_regions.tar.gz) provides preprocessed seismic waveforms, source-receiver metadata, and signal-to-noise ratios for 16 distinct localities (e.g., ALCUDIA, MSH, TIBET), serving as a benchmark for testing model generalization.

sum: This study investigates the lithospheric shear-wave velocity structure of the Northern Tan-Lu fault zone (TLFZ) using two- and three-station interferometry tomography. By applying these advanced interferometric techniques to seismic data, the authors overcome traditional resolution limits of standard ambient noise or earthquake tomography. The resulting high-resolution 3D Vs model reveals the fine-scale structural features of the crust and uppermost mantle, providing new insights into the tectonic evolution, fault geometry, and lithospheric deformation of the Northern TLFZ.
