sum: This study evaluates the consistency and epistemic uncertainty of earthquake stress-drop (Δσ) estimates for the 2016–2017 Amatrice–Visso–Norcia seismic sequence in Central Italy. The authors compare five independent methods: spectral fitting, spectral ratios, generalized inversion technique (GIT), coda spectral calibration, and coda envelope spectral ratios. By analyzing common subsets of ~100 and 22 events, they find that while absolute values differ, the scaling relations and M0–fc trends are highly correlated across methods. GIT yields the highest stress drops (average bias of +0.185 log10 units), while spectral ratios show the largest negative deviation (-0.203). The overall intermethod standard deviation is moderate (~0.16 to 0.2 log units), demonstrating broad consistency and providing a framework to quantify epistemic uncertainty for seismic hazard modeling.
本研究评估了2016-2017年意大利中部地震序列应力降估计的一致性与认知不确定性。对比了谱拟合、谱比法、广义反演、尾波校准及尾波包络比五种方法。分析表明，尽管绝对值有差异，但各方法的标度关系高度相关。GIT结果偏高，谱比法偏低，方法间标准差约0.16-0.2。该框架有效量化了源参数的认知不确定性。

t: Five independent methods (spectral fitting, spectral ratios, generalized inversion, coda calibration, and coda envelope ratios) are compared to estimate seismic moment, corner frequency, and stress drop.
对比了谱拟合、谱比法、广义反演、尾波校准和尾波包络比五种独立方法来估计震源参数。
Seismic waveforms from the 2016–2017 Amatrice–Visso–Norcia sequence, analyzing subsets of ~100 and 22 common events (Mw 1.7–6.3).
使用2016-2017年意大利中部地震序列，分析了~100个和22个共有地震子集。
The methods show consistent scaling trends with an intermethod standard deviation of 0.16–0.2 log10 units; GIT yields the highest stress drops (+0.185 bias) and spectral ratios the lowest (-0.203).
各方法标度趋势一致，方法间标准差为0.16-0.2；GIT结果偏高，谱比法偏低。
Epistemic uncertainties and trade-offs between path attenuation, site amplification, and source parameters still affect absolute stress-drop values.
路径衰减、场地放大与震源参数的权衡仍影响绝对应力降确定。
First systematic comparison of five distinct spectral and coda-based methods on a single seismic sequence to quantify epistemic uncertainty in stress drop.
首次在单一序列上系统对比五种方法，量化应力降认知不确定性。

kc: Compares five independent spectral and coda-based methods for estimating earthquake source parameters.
Quantifies the epistemic uncertainty and intermethod variability of stress-drop estimates using common event subsets.
Demonstrates that despite absolute differences, scaling relations and M0-fc trends are highly consistent across methods.
对比了五种独立的基于谱分析和尾波的地震源参数估计方法。
利用共有地震子集量化了应力降估计的认知不确定性和方法间变率。
表明尽管绝对值存在差异，但各方法之间的标度关系和M0-fc趋势高度一致。
me: Spectral fitting of source spectra
Spectral ratios (SR)
Generalized inversion technique (GIT) for non-parametric inversion
Coda spectral calibration (Coda Calibration Tool)
Coda envelope spectral ratios (Coda Envelope Ratio Tool)
震源谱的谱拟合
谱比法 (SR)
用于非参数反演的广义反演技术 (GIT)
尾波谱校准 (Coda Calibration Tool)
尾波包络谱比法 (Coda Envelope Ratio Tool)
de: Seismic waveform data from the 2016–2017 Amatrice–Visso–Norcia seismic sequence in Central Italy.
A subset of ~100 common events (Mw 1.7 to 6.3) and a core subset of 22 common events (Mw 3.3 to 6.3).
意大利中部2016-2017年Amatrice-Visso-Norcia地震序列的地震波形数据。
包含~100个共有地震（Mw 1.7至6.3）的子集以及22个核心共有地震（Mw 3.3至6.3）的子集。
li: The analysis is limited to a specific tectonic region (Central Italy) and may not directly generalize to other tectonic settings.
Trade-offs between path attenuation, site amplification, and source parameters remain a fundamental challenge.
分析局限于特定的构造区域（意大利中部），可能无法直接推广到其他构造背景。
路径衰减、场地放大与震源参数之间的权衡仍然是一个根本性挑战。

tm.why: The paper evaluates and compares five different methods for estimating earthquake source parameters, specifically stress drop, seismic moment, and corner frequency.
The study aims to quantify epistemic uncertainty in stress drop to support the development of physics-based seismic hazard and ground-motion models.

ev.notes: The analysis is based entirely on the abstract and metadata since no PDF was available.

sum: Seismic tomography often neglects waveform amplitudes when imaging upper-mantle anisotropy. This study computes 3D finite-frequency adjoint sensitivity kernels for fundamental-mode Rayleigh and Love wave amplitudes and phases across all 21 elastic tensor coefficients. The background model is derived from a realistic 3D geodynamic simulation of a mantle plume (CitcomCU) coupled with strain-induced crystallographic preferred orientation calculations (D-REX_M) and simulated with SPECFEM3D_GLOBE. Results show that surface-wave amplitudes are strongly sensitive to the same radial and azimuthal anisotropy parameters as phase measurements, but exhibit laterally staggered Fresnel zones shifted by roughly a quarter wavelength, plus off-path Love-Rayleigh coupling fringes. Consequently, amplitude data provide complementary structural constraints for anisotropic inversions. Furthermore, combining East and Vertical Rayleigh-wave components via phase-delay differences or horizontal-to-vertical amplitude ratios (ellipticity) concentrates sensitivity within 300–700 km of the receiver at depths <190 km, offering a powerful tool for imaging mantle flow in sparsely instrumented oceanic domains.
本研究利用伴随方法和谱元程序SPECFEM3D_GLOBE，在耦合CitcomCU动力学与D-REX_M矿物组构演化的三维各向异性地幔柱模型中，首次计算了基阶瑞利波和勒夫波振幅对全部21个弹性张量分量的三维有限频敏感核。结果表明，振幅对径向和方位各向异性参数的敏感性与相位测量一致，但两者的空间敏感性……

t: Computes 3D finite-frequency adjoint sensitivity kernels in SPECFEM3D_GLOBE for Rayleigh and Love wave amplitudes and phases with respect to all 21 elastic tensor components, recombining them into radial and azimuthal anisotropy parameters.
用SPECFEM3D_GLOBE计算面波振幅和相位对21个弹性常数的三维伴随核并重组为各向异性参数。

Uses a synthetic 3D anisotropic upper-mantle plume model generated with CitcomCU and D-REX_M mineral fabric calculations (70:30 olivine-enstatite down to 400 km depth) embedded in a 90° by 80° spectral-element mesh.
采用CitcomCU和D-REX_M生成的400 km深度三维各向异性地幔柱合成模型。

Amplitude and phase kernels are sensitive to the same anisotropic parameters but laterally shifted by roughly a quarter wavelength; differencing E and Z components localizes sensitivity within 300–700 km of the receiver at <190 km depth.
振幅与相位核横向交错约1/4波长；E和Z分量差分将敏感区集中在台站300-700 km内。
Combined E-Z measurements fail to suppress far-field sensitivity (~700 km from the ray path) for N, Ec, Mc, and Ms due to asymmetric Love-Rayleigh mode coupling between components.
因模耦合不对称，组合观测量未能压制N和Ec等在700 km处的远场敏感性。
Presents the first complete set of 3D finite-frequency adjoint amplitude kernels for all 21 anisotropic elastic constants in a realistic seismo-geodynamic mantle plume model.
首次在三维动力学地幔柱模型中计算面波振幅对全部21个弹性常数的有限频伴随敏感核。

kc: Computes the first complete gallery of 3D finite-frequency adjoint sensitivity kernels for fundamental-mode Rayleigh and Love wave amplitudes with respect to all 21 independent elastic tensor constants.

Demonstrates that amplitude and phase kernels are sensitive to the same anisotropic parameters but have laterally staggered spatial patterns (shifted by ~1/4 wavelength), offering complementary constraints for tomography.
Identifies strong off-great-circle-path oscillatory sensitivity fringes up to ~700 km away caused by Love-to-Rayleigh and Rayleigh-to-Love mode coupling.

Shows that combined single-station observables (cross-component E-Z phase differences and H/V amplitude ratios) strongly localize sensitivity beneath and near the receiver (<190 km depth, 300-700 km distance).
首次计算了基阶瑞利波和勒夫波振幅对控制完全地震各向异性的全部21个独立弹性常数的三维有限频伴随敏感核。
证明振幅核与相位核对相同的各向异性参数敏感，但空间图样在横向上交错约四分之一波长，为层析成像提供互补约束。
揭示了由勒夫-瑞利波模耦合引起的偏离大圆路径达约700 km的强振荡敏感性条纹。
证明组合跨分量观测量（E与Z分量相位差及H/V振幅比）能将敏感性强烈集中在台站下方及附近（深度<190 km，水平距离300-700 km）。
me: Adjoint-state method using spectral-element solver SPECFEM3D_GLOBE to compute Fréchet sensitivity kernels for 21 C_ijkl components.
Recombination of C_ijkl kernels into asymptotic radial (Love parameters A, C, N, L, F) and azimuthal (degree 1, 2, 3, 4) anisotropy parameters.
3D thermochemical mantle convection modeling using finite-element code CitcomCU paired with Lagrangian CPO fabric tracking via D-REX_M (ECOMAN suite).
Linear combination (differencing) of East and Vertical component kernels to construct cross-component phase-delay difference and H/V amplitude ratio (ellipticity) kernels.
利用谱元法程序SPECFEM3D_GLOBE和伴随状态法计算21个弹性张量分量C_ijkl的Fréchet敏感核。
将C_ijkl敏感核线性重组为渐近径向（Love参数A, C, N, L, F）和方位（1至4阶）各向异性参数敏感核。
利用有限元程序CitcomCU进行三维地幔热对流模拟，并结合ECOMAN套件中的D-REX_M通过拉格朗日示踪剂计算应变诱导晶格优选方位（CPO）。
通过对东向（E）和垂向（Z）分量敏感核作差，构建跨分量相位延迟差和水平/垂直振幅比（HV比/椭圆率）的组合敏感核。
de: Synthetic 3D upper-mantle plume model (2640 x 1980 x 660 km) featuring an oceanic-continental lithosphere transition, edge-driven convection, a sheared plume pancake, and Richter rolls.
Mineral physics aggregation of 70% olivine and 30% enstatite down to 400 km depth, converted to elastic tensors via Voigt-Reuss-Hill averaging and embedded into PREM.
Regional SPECFEM3D_GLOBE simulations on a 90° x 80° mesh accurate down to 30 s period, using pure strike-slip sources at 35° (Rayleigh) and 50° (Love) epicentral distances.
Kernel evaluations across three period bands: [40, 60] s (primary), [60, 80] s, and [80, 120] s.
合成三维上地幔柱动力学模型（2640 x 1980 x 660 km），包含海陆岩石圈过渡带、边缘驱动对流、受板块拖拽的扁平地幔柱头及Richter对流卷。
400 km深度以上的70%橄榄石与30%顽火辉石多晶集合体组构演化，经Voigt-Reuss-Hill平均转化为弹性张量并嵌入PREM背景模型。
在90° x 80°网格上进行准确周期至30秒的SPECFEM3D_GLOBE区域波场模拟，采用纯走滑震源，瑞利波和勒夫波震中距分别为35°和50°。
在[40, 60] s（主频带）、[60, 80] s和[80, 120] s三个周期频带内计算并评估敏感核。
li: Combined E-Z measurements do not suppress far-field sensitivity (~700 km off-path) for parameters N, Ec, Mc, and Ms due to asymmetric Love-Rayleigh and Rayleigh-Love mode coupling.
Gravity, Earth rotation, ellipticity, oceans, and surface topography are neglected in the spectral-element wavefield simulations.
Exploiting amplitude measurements in real inversions remains challenged by trade-offs with intrinsic attenuation (anelasticity) and source mechanism uncertainties.
由于Z和E分量对勒夫-瑞利波模耦合的敏感性不对称，组合观测量未能完全压制N、Ec、Mc和Ms参数在偏离路径约700 km处的远场敏感性。
波场数值模拟中忽略了重力、地球自转、扁率、海洋层以及地表地形的影响。
在实际反演中利用振幅数据仍面临固有衰减（非弹性）与波场聚焦效应耦合以及震源机制不确定性的挑战。

tm.why: The paper calculates 3D finite-frequency adjoint sensitivity kernels for surface-wave amplitude and phase measurements using SPECFEM3D_GLOBE to guide anisotropic full-waveform inversions.
The study systematically evaluates surface-wave sensitivity to all 21 independent elastic tensor coefficients governing radial and azimuthal seismic anisotropy.
The background medium is a realistic 3D seismo-geodynamic model of an upper-mantle plume interacting with edge-driven convection and strain-induced mineral fabrics.

ev.notes: Full 64-page preprint PDF (including main text, appendices A-C, and supplementary figures S1-S23) was read and analyzed.

sum: Submarine caldera-forming eruptions pose severe hazards, yet their collapse dynamics remain poorly resolved due to observation difficulties. Using repeat high-resolution multibeam bathymetry, satellite/drone photogrammetry, water-column acoustics, CTD profiles, and sub-bottom sparker seismic reflection profiles before and after the 15 January 2022 Hunga volcano eruption, the authors quantify the geomorphological and structural evolution of the caldera. The eruption displaced 8.9 ± 0.1 km³ of material, deepening the caldera from ~150 m to ~850 m (with the structural floor at ~1,000 m below sea level beneath 150 m of infill). About 6.85 ± 0.05 km³ resulted from syn-eruptive piston-style caldera collapse along reverse ring faults and outer normal fault splays, triggered by ~30 MPa underpressure after erupting ~8 km³ Dense Rock Equivalent magma (<30% of the reservoir). These observations demonstrate how rapid collapse in small, steep submarine calderas can dramatically amplify volcanic tsunami magnitude and density currents.
海底破火山口喷发极具威胁，但受限于观测条件其塌陷动力学机制尚不明确。本研究结合2022年1月15日汤加洪阿火山喷发前后的多波束测深、卫星与无人机摄影测量、水体声学、CTD剖面及浅地层电火花地震反射剖面，量化了破火山口的地貌与构造演化。喷发共造成8.9±0.1 km³物质运移，破火山口由约150米加深……

t: Constructed 10-m integrated 3D DEMs from repeat multibeam bathymetry and satellite/drone imagery to compute differential volumes validated by a cylindrical harmonic model, alongside sub-bottom sparker seismic reflection profiling and acoustic water-column analysis.
结合重复多波束测深与卫星/无人机影像构建10米DEM并利用圆柱谐波模型计算差分体积，辅以电火花地震反射剖面与水体声学分析…

Pre-eruption (2015–2016) and five post-eruption (April–October 2022) multibeam bathymetric surveys, April 2022 R/V Araon 5,000 J sparker seismic profiles, CTD hydrographic casts, water-column acoustics, and WorldView/ICESat-2/RCM satellite datasets.
2015–2016年喷发前及2022年5次喷发后多波束测深、5000 J电火花地震剖面、CTD水文剖面、水体声学及卫星测…

The eruption displaced 8.9 ± 0.1 km³, deepening the caldera from ~150 m to ~850 m (~1,000 m structural floor). Caldera collapse accounts for 6.85 ± 0.05 km³, initiated by ~30 MPa underpressure after erupting ≥8 km³ DRE magma.
喷发位移总体积8.9±0.1 km³，破火山口加深至850米（构造底界约1000米）；塌陷体积6.85±0.05 km³…

High-frequency sparker seismic penetration was limited by dense/coarse volcanic deposits, pre-eruption caldera infill thickness is unknown, and magma volume estimates exclude syn-eruptive reservoir recharge.
高频电火花地震信号受粗粒火山物质限制穿透有限，喷发前充填厚度未知，且岩浆体积估算未计入同喷发岩浆补给。

First high-resolution time-series bathymetric and sub-bottom seismic characterization of a major submarine caldera collapse, revealing syn-eruptive piston subsidence and its role in amplifying tsunami hazards.
首次通过高分辨率时序测深与浅层地震揭示大型海底破火山口同喷发活塞式塌陷动力学及其对火山海啸的放大机制。

kc: Quantified total displaced volume (8.9 ± 0.1 km³) and caldera collapse volume (6.85 ± 0.05 km³) from the 2022 Hunga eruption using repeat bathymetric and satellite DEMs.

Imaged internal caldera structure with sub-bottom sparker seismic reflection profiles, identifying a structural floor at ~1,000 m bsl, ~150 m of pyroclastic infill, intercalated landslide deposits, and ring-fault geometries.
Demonstrated that syn-eruptive piston-style subsidence was triggered by a low magmatic underpressure (~30 MPa) after withdrawing <30% (~8 km³ DRE) of the upper magma reservoir.
Mapped post-eruption hydrothermal fluid plumes and persistent two-layer water column stratification inside the newly formed caldera.
利用重复多波束测深与卫星数字高程模型，量化了2022年洪阿火山喷发的总物质位移体积（8.9 ± 0.1 km³）和破火山口塌陷体积（6.85 ± 0.05 km³）。
通过浅地层电火花地震反射剖面揭示了破火山口内部结构，识别出海平面下约1000米的构造底界、约150米厚的火山碎屑充填物、互层滑坡沉积以及环状断层形态。
证明同喷发活塞式沉降是在上部岩浆储库排出不足30%（约8 km³致密岩石当量）后由较低的岩浆欠压（约30 MPa）触发的。
测绘了新形成破火山口内部的喷发后热液流体羽流以及持续至少9个月的双层水体层化结构。
me: Differential elevation and volume modeling combining pre- and post-eruption multibeam echosounder (MBES) swath bathymetry, satellite stereo imagery, ICESat-2 lidar, and drone photogrammetry.
Cylindrical harmonic modeling of the 3D caldera topography to validate and calibrate displaced volume estimates.
Sub-bottom seismic reflection profiling using a 5,000 J Seismic Sparker system with band-pass filtering (30–60–600–650 Hz) and deconvolution.
Acoustic water-column plume detection using Echoview software and hydrographic vertical profiling via CTD casts.
Analytical mechanical and friction modeling relating caldera aspect ratio and subsidence to magma chamber underpressure and DRE eruption volume.
融合喷发前后的多波束测深（MBES）、卫星立体成像、ICESat-2激光雷达和无人机摄影测量，进行差分高程与体积建模。
对破火山口三维地形应用圆柱谐波模型，以验证和校准位移体积估算结果。
使用5000 J电火花震源系统进行浅地层地震反射剖面探测，并应用带通滤波（30–60–600–650 Hz）和反褶积处理。
利用Echoview软件进行水体声学羽流检测，并通过CTD投放获取水文垂直剖面。
结合破火山口纵横比与沉降量的解析力学与摩擦模型，估算岩浆房临界欠压及致密岩石当量（DRE）喷发体积。
de: Pre-eruption (2015, 2016) and repeat post-eruption (April, May, July–September, October 2022) multibeam bathymetry gridded at 10-m resolution.
Two sub-bottom sparker seismic reflection profiles (SPK-03 and SPK-05) collected across the caldera in April 2022 aboard R/V Araon.
MBES water-column acoustic imagery from May and October 2022 and CTD hydrographic transects from April and October 2022.
Maxar WorldView stereo satellite DEMs, CSA Radarsat Constellation Mission SAR images, NASA ICESat-2 lidar tracks, and DJI Phantom 4 drone photogrammetry.
2015和2016年喷发前以及2022年4月、5月、7–9月和10月喷发后重复采集的10米分辨率多波束测深网格数据。
2022年4月由“Araon”号科考船在破火山口采集的两条浅地层电火花地震反射剖面（SPK-03和SPK-05）。
2022年5月和10月的多波束水体声学图像，以及2022年4月和10月的CTD水文断面。
Maxar WorldView立体卫星数字高程模型、加拿大RCM合成孔径雷达图像、NASA ICESat-2激光测高轨迹以及大疆Phantom 4无人机摄影测量数据。
li: Sub-bottom seismic penetration depth was limited by the high-frequency sparker signal encountering dense and coarse volcanic material.
Volume and underpressure calculations do not account for syn-eruptive magma recharge, placing only a lower bound on erupted magma volume.
The pre-eruption caldera infill thickness is unknown, introducing uncertainty into the pre-existing subsidence ratio estimates.
高频电火花地震信号在遇到致密或粗粒火山物质时穿透深度受限。
体积和欠压计算未考虑同喷发期的岩浆补给，因此仅给出了喷发岩浆体积的下限。
喷发前的破火山口充填物厚度未知，给先存沉降比估算带来了不确定性。

tm.why: The study investigates the submarine caldera collapse, subsurface fault structures, and magmatic system of Hunga volcano using repeat bathymetry and sub-bottom seismic reflection profiling.
The paper links the rapid piston-style submarine caldera collapse and ring faulting to the generation of an exceptional volcanic tsunami and destructive density currents.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 14-page Nature Geoscience PDF including main text, Methods, Figures 1–4, and Extended Data Figures 1–4.

sum: This study presents the first coupled dataset of dissolved noble gases, halogens, and iodine isotopes from Mariana forearc borehole fluids to investigate slab devolatilization and volatile recycling. The results show that the fluids are a mixture of seawater, deep mantle, and slab-derived components, with altered oceanic crust containing carbonates and iron oxyhydroxides identified as the primary source. Iodine isotopes indicate ancient fluid reservoirs, while ultra-high-precision xenon isotopes reveal anomalies from mantle and U-rich slab lithologies. Elemental noble gases show strong fractionation, with preferential loss of light noble gases (e.g., neon depletion), demonstrating that the forearc acts as an efficient filter that limits light noble gas recycling to the deep mantle.
本研究首次结合马里亚纳前弧钻孔流体中的溶解惰性气体、卤素和碘同位素数据，探讨了俯冲带脱水与挥发分循环。结果表明，流体由海水、深部地幔及俯冲板片组分混合而成，其中含有碳酸盐和铁氢氧化物的蚀变洋壳是主要流体源。碘同位素指示了古老的流体储库，而超高精度氙同位素首次揭示了地幔与富铀板片的异常。惰性气体元素系……

t: Coupled geochemical analysis of dissolved noble gases, halogens, and iodine isotopes in Mariana forearc borehole fluids.
对马里亚纳前弧钻孔流体中的溶解惰性气体、卤素和碘同位素进行耦合地球化学分析。
Borehole fluid samples collected from the Mariana forearc subduction zone.
采集自马里亚纳前弧俯冲带的钻孔流体样品。
Altered oceanic crust is the dominant fluid source; xenon isotopes show mantle/slab anomalies, and light noble gases are preferentially lost.
蚀变洋壳为主要流体源；氙同位素显示地幔/板片异常，且轻惰性气体发生选择性丢失。
Fluid samples are localized to specific boreholes and may not capture the full spatial heterogeneity of the forearc.
流体样品局限于特定钻孔，可能无法完全捕获前弧的整体空间异质性。
First coupled noble gas-halogen-iodine dataset and first detection of ultra-high-precision Xe isotope anomalies in forearc fluids.
首次获取前弧流体惰性气体-卤素-碘耦合数据集，并首次检测到超高精度氙同位素异常。

kc: Presents the first coupled dataset of dissolved noble gases, halogens, and iodine isotopes from Mariana forearc borehole fluids.
Identifies altered oceanic crust containing carbonates and iron oxyhydroxides as the dominant source of slab-derived fluids.
Discovers ultra-high-precision xenon isotope anomalies in forearc fluids, fingerprinting mantle and U-rich slab contributions.
Demonstrates that the forearc acts as an efficient filter that selectively removes light noble gases through diffusive loss during burial.
首次提供了马里亚纳前弧钻孔流体中溶解惰性气体、卤素和碘同位素的耦合数据集。
确定了含有碳酸盐和铁氢氧化物的蚀变洋壳是俯冲板片流体的主要来源。
首次在深部前弧流体中发现超高精度氙同位素异常，指明了地幔和富铀板片的贡献。
证实了前弧系统作为一个高效过滤器，在埋藏过程中通过扩散损失选择性地移除了轻惰性气体。
me: Geochemical analysis of dissolved noble gases (He, Ne, Ar, Kr, Xe) in borehole fluids.
Measurement of halogens (Cl, Br, I) and iodine isotopes to trace fluid sources and age.
Ultra-high-precision xenon isotope mass spectrometry to detect subtle isotopic anomalies.
对钻孔流体中溶解惰性气体（氦、氖、氩、氪、氙）进行地球化学分析。
测量卤素（氯、溴、碘）及碘同位素以追踪流体来源和演化历史。
利用超高精度氙同位素质谱技术检测微小的同位素异常。
de: Borehole fluid samples collected from the Mariana forearc subduction zone.
采集自马里亚纳前弧俯冲带的钻孔流体样品。
li: The study relies on borehole fluid samples which may have localized flow paths and might not fully represent the entire 3D forearc system.
该研究依赖于钻孔流体样品，这些样品可能代表局部流体通道，无法完全代表整个三维前弧系统。

tm.why: The paper investigates slab devolatilization and volatile recycling in the Mariana subduction zone, which are key geodynamic processes affecting crust and mantle structure.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on the published abstract and metadata from OpenAlex and Crossref, as no PDF was available.

sum: On 10 March 2025, a Mw 6.5 strike-slip earthquake on the Jan Mayen Transform Fault ruptured ~40–42 km southeastward toward Jan Mayen Island. Integrating seismic waveforms, Bayesian aftershock relocation, ambient-noise interferometry, GNSS, regional infrasound arrays, satellite imagery, and 55-year temperature records, the authors reconstruct an Arctic cascading hazard chain. Within ~3 minutes of the mainshock, strong shaking (modeled PGA 0.40–0.45 g) triggered a 0.81–1.17 × 10⁶ m³ rock avalanche on Beerenberg volcano that covered 30–50% of Kjerulf Glacier and radiated infrasound detected >1,000 km away, alongside calving at Weyprecht Glacier. Single-station noise autocorrelation revealed an unusually rapid, short-lived (~30 min) ~7% drop in seismic velocity (dv/v). Four precursor rockfalls (2017–2024) and ~2 °C warming since 1970 demonstrate that Arctic amplification and permafrost degradation progressively preconditioned the slope for seismic failure.
本研究结合地震波形反演、贝叶斯余震重定位、背景噪声干涉、GNSS、次声阵列、高分辨率卫星影像及55年气温记录，重建了2025年3月10日北极扬马延转换断层Mw 6.5走滑地震触发的级联灾害链。主震向东南单侧破裂约40–42 km，产生强地面运动，在约3分钟内触发了体积约0.81–1.17×10⁶ m……

t: The authors combine Pg polarization location, ISOLA regional waveform inversion, Bayesloc MCMC aftershock relocation, single-station ambient noise autocorrelation (0.2–0.5 Hz stretching), infrasound array cross-correlation, GNSS PPP, and satellite DEM volume analysis.
结合Pg波偏振定位、ISOLA波形反演、Bayesloc余震重定位、单台噪声自相关、次声波束形成及卫星DEM分析。

Data include local/regional broadband seismograms (>1,500 aftershocks), 2 GNSS stations, CTBTO infrasound array I37N and station BORG, Sentinel-1/2, 0.5-m MAXAR imagery, 2-m ArcticDEM, and 1970–2025 Jan Mayen meteorological temperature records.
包含本地及区域宽频带地震记录、2个GNSS站、次声台阵、MAXAR/Sentinel卫星影像及55年气温记录。
The Mw 6.5 earthquake ruptured 40–42 km southeastward, shifting GNSS stations up to 2.4 cm, inducing a ~7% dv/v drop for ~30 min, and triggering a 0.81–1.17 × 10⁶ m³ rock avalanche within ~3 min.
Mw 6.5主震向东南破裂40–42 km，引起2.4 cm地表位移、持续约30分钟的7%波速下降及约百万方岩崩。
Local seismic waveforms of the rock avalanche were masked by the mainshock coda, InSAR failed due to snow decorrelation, and dv/v reflects station-vicinity crust rather than the slope itself.
主震长尾波掩盖了本地岩崩地震信号，冰雪导致InSAR失相干，且dv/v仅反映台站周边浅层地壳。

First documented earthquake-triggered rock avalanche on Jan Mayen Island and first observation of an ultrashort (<1 hour) ~7% coseismic dv/v perturbation linked to Arctic permafrost-preconditioned cascading hazards.
首次记录扬马延岛地震触发岩崩及1小时内恢复的7%同震波速骤降，揭示北极变暖预调的级联灾害。

kc: Reconstructed a complete multi-sphere hazard cascade linking a Mw 6.5 oceanic transform earthquake to a ~0.99 × 10⁶ m³ rock avalanche, glacier burial, infrasound radiation, and ice calving.
Detected an unusually transient (~30 min recovery) ~7% reduction in shallow crustal seismic velocity (dv/v) in the 0.2–0.5 Hz band following strong ground shaking.
Identified four aseismic precursor rock-slope failures between 2017 and 2024 coupled with ~2 °C local warming since 1970, linking Arctic permafrost degradation to seismic landslide susceptibility.
重建了将Mw 6.5转换断层地震与约0.99×10⁶ m³岩崩、冰川掩埋、次声辐射和冰川崩解联系起来的完整多圈层灾害链。
利用0.2–0.5 Hz背景噪声自相关，观测到震后异常短暂（约30分钟恢复）的~7%浅层地壳地震波速（dv/v）下降。
识别出2017至2024年间的四次非地震前兆岩坡崩塌及1970年以来约2°C的升温趋势，阐明了北极冻土退化对地震滑坡易发性的预调作用。
me: Pg polarization analysis for mainshock epicenter, ISOLA regional surface-wave inversion for depth, teleseismic apparent P-wave durations for directivity, and Bayesloc MCMC relocation of 1,443 aftershocks.
Single-station 3-component ambient noise autocorrelation (0.2–0.5 Hz, 1-min windows) and waveform stretching to track rapid dv/v variations.
Infrasound array cross-correlation beamforming (I37N and BORG) coupled with MAXAR/ArcticDEM Sloping Local Base-Level (SLBL) volume estimation and GNSS Precise Point Positioning.
利用Pg波偏振分析测定主震震中，ISOLA区域面波反演测定深度，远震视P波持续时间分析方向性，并用Bayesloc（MCMC）重定位1443次余震。
采用单台三分量背景噪声自相关（0.2–0.5 Hz，1分钟时窗）和波形拉伸法监测快速的波速变化（dv/v）。
结合次声阵列互相关波束形成（I37N与BORG）、基于MAXAR与ArcticDEM的斜坡局部基准面（SLBL）体积估算以及GNSS精密单点定位。
de: Seismic recordings from 4 local Jan Mayen stations (JNE, JNW, JMI, JMIC), 8–12 regional broadband stations, and teleseismic GSN stations, plus >1,500 NNSN catalog aftershocks.
Continuous 30-s GNSS time series from two island stations (JMLI, JMUM) and infrasound recordings from CTBTO array I37N (Norway, ~1,030 km) and station BORG (Iceland, ~905 km).

High-resolution MAXAR WorldView-2 (0.5 m), Sentinel-2 optical (10 m), Sentinel-1 SAR, 2-m ArcticDEM, Landsat archives (1988–2004), and local meteorological station (SN99950) air temperatures (1970–2025).
扬马延岛4个本地地震台（JNE、JNW、JMI、JMIC）、8–12个区域宽频带台站和远震GSN台站记录，以及NNSN目录中>1500次余震数据。
岛上两个GNSS连续站（JMLI、JMUM）30秒采样时间序列，以及挪威I37N次声阵列（~1030 km）和冰岛BORG台（~905 km）的次声记录。
高分辨率MAXAR WorldView-2（0.5 m）、Sentinel-2光学（10 m）、Sentinel-1 SAR、2 m ArcticDEM、Landsat历史影像及本地气象站（1970–2025年）气温数据。
li: Direct seismic waveform detection of the rock avalanche on local stations was masked by the long seismic coda of the Mw 6.5 mainshock.
InSAR displacement retrieval failed due to low coherence over the snow-covered terrain in March, and winter cloud cover prevented immediate post-earthquake optical satellite imaging.
The local seismic stations are 10–12 km from the glaciers, so the measured dv/v drop reflects upper crustal properties around the stations rather than the landslide source rockwall directly.
主震长尾波掩盖了本地地震台站对岩崩直接地震波形信号的识别。
3月冰雪覆盖导致InSAR相干性过低无法提取形变，且冬季云层遮挡阻碍了震后即刻的光学卫星观测。
本地地震台距离冰川10–12 km，测得的dv/v下降反映的是台站周围浅部地壳性质，而非滑坡源区岩壁本身。

tm.why: The paper investigates an earthquake-triggered rock avalanche, glacier burial, and ice calving on Jan Mayen Island under Arctic warming and permafrost degradation.
The authors use single-station ambient seismic noise autocorrelation and the stretching method to measure a transient ~7% dv/v drop lasting ~30 minutes after the mainshock.
The study characterizes the 2025 Mw 6.5 Jan Mayen oceanic transform fault earthquake source, ~40-42 km unilateral rupture propagation, and relocated aftershock sequence.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PNAS PDF analyzed, including main text, all 5 figures, and Methods section.

sum: This study investigates the spatiotemporal evolution of shallow fault creep along the Coachella Valley segment of the Southern San Andreas Fault (SSAF) from 2015 to 2021. Using 7 years of ascending and descending Sentinel-1 InSAR data, the authors isolate fault-parallel surface displacements and apply a Kalman-filter-based Network Inversion Filter (NIF) to invert for the full slip history and uncertainties in the top 5 km. Results show relative quiescence in 2015–2016 except at the southernmost tip, followed by a multi-year slow slip event (SSE) dynamically triggered by the 2017 Mw 8.2 Chiapas earthquake 3,000 km away. The SSE released moment equivalent to an Mw 5.2 earthquake (peak slip ~50 mm) and exhibited hybrid rupture behavior: initial bilateral crack-like propagation followed by pulse-like healing front propagation. The prolonged 4+ year elevated creep rates suggest low fault strength, dilatant velocity-strengthening, and extremely slow frictional healing rates in shallow SSAF gouge.
本研究利用2015至2021年Sentinel-1升、降轨InSAR数据，结合基于卡尔曼滤波的网络反演滤波（NIF）方法，反演了南圣安德烈斯断层（SSAF）Coachella山谷段顶部5公里的浅部蠕滑时空演化及不确定性。结果表明，2015–2016年断层相对平静，随后3000公里外的2017年Mw……

t: The authors implement a Kalman-filter-based Network Inversion Filter (NIF) using forward filtering and Rauch-Tung-Striebel backward smoothing to invert quadtree-downsampled InSAR time series for cumulative slip and slip rate on a 65°-dipping triangular fault mesh.
采用基于卡尔曼前向滤波和Rauch-Tung-Striebel后向平滑的网络反演滤波器（NIF），在65°倾角三角网格上…

The dataset comprises 171 ascending (track 166) and 269 descending (track 173) Sentinel-1 SAR scenes from April 2015 to February 2022, processed via iterative common scene stacking and decomposed into 205 fault-parallel displacement epochs at 12-day intervals.
使用2015至2022年Sentinel-1升轨171景和降轨269景数据，经迭代公共场景叠加合成205个12天间隔的断…

Total shallow slip reached ~50 mm during 2015–2021 (equivalent to Mw 5.2). The 2017 Chiapas earthquake dynamically triggered a 1–2 year primary SSE (Mw 4.8–5.0) that propagated bilaterally and maintained elevated creep rates (>2–5 mm/yr) through 2021.
2015–2021年累积峰值滑移约50毫米（Mw 5.2）；2017年恰帕斯地震触发了双向传播的Mw 4.8–5.0慢滑…
Sparse InSAR data west of the fault (due to the Salton Sea and agricultural fields) degrades depth resolution below 3 km, while CSS and backward smoothing blur rapid slip transients.
索尔顿海和农田导致断层西侧数据稀疏，限制了3公里以下分辨率；时间滤波平滑了瞬时微幅触发信号。

First high-resolution 3D spatiotemporal slip inversion of the 2015–2021 SSAF creep history, uncovering hybrid bilateral crack-to-pulse SSE propagation and multi-year post-triggering creep acceleration explained by slow fault healing.
首次获得SSAF浅部蠕滑的高分辨率三维时空演化，揭示了慢滑移裂纹向脉冲转化的双向传播机制及慢愈合特征。

kc: Generated a 7-year (2015–2021), 12-day-sampled fault-parallel InSAR displacement time series along the Southern San Andreas Fault using iterative common scene stacking.
Applied a modified Network Inversion Filter (NIF) to resolve the 3D spatiotemporal history of shallow fault slip (top 5 km) and formal model uncertainties.

Documented a multi-year slow slip event (Mw 5.2 cumulative moment, ~50 mm peak slip) dynamically triggered by the 2017 Mw 8.2 Chiapas earthquake, featuring hybrid crack-like and pulse-like bilateral propagation.
Demonstrated that elevated creep persisted for over 4 years without perturbing microseismicity, pointing to low fault strength and slow frictional healing rates in shallow clay fault gouge.
利用迭代公共场景叠加方法，生成了南圣安德烈斯断层7年（2015–2021年）、12天采样的断层平行InSAR位移时间序列。
应用改进的网络反演滤波器（NIF），解析了浅部断层（顶部5公里）滑移的三维时空演化历史及形式模型不确定性。
记录了由2017年Mw 8.2恰帕斯地震动态触发的多年慢滑移事件（累积矩Mw 5.2，峰值滑移约50毫米），揭示了兼具裂纹状与脉冲状双向传播的混合破裂行为。
证实加速蠕滑持续超过4年且未引起微震活动变化，表明浅部黏土断层泥具有低断层强度和缓慢的摩擦愈合率。
me: InSAR processing of Sentinel-1 ascending (track 166) and descending (track 173) data using phase unfiltering, circuit closure masking, and iterative Common Scene Stacking (CSS) with Savitzky-Golay filtering.
Isolation of shallow creep by removing a GNSS-derived secular interseismic deformation model, applying a 20 km high-pass filter, and side-masked 2.5 km Gaussian low-pass filtering.
Resolution-based quadtree downsampling (~5000 points) and empirical exponential semivariogram modeling of residual tropospheric noise covariance.
Time-dependent finite-fault slip inversion on a 65°-dipping triangular mesh (0–5 km depth) using a Network Inversion Filter (Kalman forward filter and Rauch-Tung-Striebel backward smoother).
使用相位去滤波、闭合环掩膜以及结合Savitzky-Golay滤波的迭代公共场景叠加（CSS），处理Sentinel-1升轨（166）和降轨（173）InSAR数据。
通过去除GNSS导出的长期震间形变模型、应用20公里高通滤波以及断层两侧掩膜的2.5公里高斯低通滤波来分离浅部蠕滑信号。
基于分辨率的四叉树降采样（约5000个数据点），并利用经验指数半变异函数构建残余对流层噪声协方差矩阵。
在倾角65°的三角形网格（0–5公里深度）上，使用网络反演滤波器（卡尔曼前向滤波与Rauch-Tung-Striebel后向平滑）进行时变有限断层滑移反演。
de: Sentinel-1 SAR catalog from April 2015 to February 2022: 171 scenes from ascending track 166 and 269 scenes from descending track 173, interpolated to 205 epochs at 12-day intervals.
Southern California GNSS secular velocity field model (Vavra et al., 2023) used to remove long-wavelength tectonic loading.
SCEC Community Fault Model v6.1 and Community Velocity Model used to define the northeast-dipping fault geometry and depth-dependent shear modulus (average 13 GPa).
2015年4月至2022年2月的Sentinel-1 SAR数据集：升轨166共171景，降轨173共269景，插值到12天间隔的205个时间步。
南加州GNSS长期速度场模型（Vavra et al., 2023），用于去除长波长构造加载信号。
SCEC断层模型（CFM v6.1）和统一速度模型（CVM），用于构建向东北倾斜的断层几何并估算平均剪切模量（13 GPa）。
li: Common Scene Stacking (CSS) and backward Kalman smoothing introduce temporal smoothing and slight acausality, blurring rapid slip onset and suppressing instantaneous millimeter-scale slip (e.g., 2019 Ridgecrest triggering).
Sparse InSAR data coverage west of the fault due to the Salton Sea and agricultural decorrelation limits depth resolution below 3 km.
Green's functions assume a homogeneous elastic half-space, which may slightly underestimate the depth extent of slip by neglecting vertical rigidity gradients.
公共场景叠加（CSS）和卡尔曼后向平滑会引入时间平滑和轻微非因果性，模糊快速滑移起始并掩盖毫米级瞬时触发滑移（如2019年Ridgecrest地震）。
索尔顿海和农田失相干导致断层西侧InSAR数据稀疏，限制了3公里以下的深度分辨率。
格林函数假设均匀弹性半空间，忽略刚度随深度增加会导致对滑移深度范围的轻微低估。

tm.why: The paper investigates the spatiotemporal evolution of shallow fault creep and a multi-year slow slip event (SSE) along the Southern San Andreas Fault dynamically triggered by the 2017 Mw 8.2 Chiapas earthquake.

The study implements a Kalman-filter-based Network Inversion Filter (NIF) with forward filtering and Rauch-Tung-Striebel backward smoothing to invert InSAR time series for time-dependent fault slip and uncertainties.

ev.notes: Full 17-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, methodology equations (NIF forward Kalman filtering and RTS backward smoothing), all 9 main text figures, and references to supporting information.

sum: This dataset supports a study investigating a potential fossil slab beneath northern Borneo using deep-focus earthquakes (Mw 4.3–7.1, 610–670 km depth) recorded between 2019 and 2026. It contains two main parts: Part I includes body waveforms, processing parameters, and configuration files used for Bayesian full-moment-tensor (FMT) and static rectangular-source inversions using the BEAT software. Part II contains vertical-component waveforms and instrument responses used for P-wave first-motion polarity picking. Additionally, the dataset provides a relocated hypocenter catalog generated using NonLinLoc and export scripts. This comprehensive dataset enables the verification and replication of source mechanisms and earthquake relocations crucial for understanding the deep tectonic structure and geodynamics of northern Borneo.
该数据集支持婆罗洲北部潜在化石板块研究，涵盖2019-2026年5个深源地震（Mw 4.3-7.1，深610-670 km）。内容包括：使用BEAT软件进行贝叶斯全矩张量和静态矩形震源反演的体波波形及配置文件；用于P波初动极性拾取的波形与仪器响应；以及NonLinLoc重定位震源目录。该数据为理解婆……

t: Bayesian full-moment-tensor and static rectangular-source inversions using the BEAT software, combined with NonLinLoc relocation.
基于BEAT软件的贝叶斯全矩张量与静态矩形震源反演，及NonLinLoc重定位。
Seismic waveforms, phase picks, and instrument responses for five deep-focus earthquakes (Mw 4.3-7.1, 610-670 km depth) beneath northern Borneo.
婆罗洲北部下方5个深源地震的地震波形、震相拾取、仪器响应及重定位目录。
Relocated hypocenter catalog and full-moment-tensor inversion products supporting the existence of a fossil slab beneath northern Borneo.
获取了精确的深源地震重定位结果与震源机制解，为化石板块存在提供约束。
Limited to five deep-focus earthquakes recorded between 2019 and 2026.
仅包含2019至2026年间的5个深源地震事件。
First open-access release of complete Bayesian source-inversion products and relocated catalogs targeting deep-focus events beneath northern Borneo.
首次开源了针对婆罗洲北部深源地震的完整贝叶斯震源反演数据集。

kc: Provides a curated dataset of seismic waveforms and phase picks for five deep-focus earthquakes beneath northern Borneo.
Shares complete Bayesian full-moment-tensor (FMT) and static rectangular-source inversion products generated via BEAT.
Delivers a relocated hypocenter catalog using NonLinLoc to support tectonic interpretations of a fossil slab.
提供了婆罗洲北部下方5个深源地震的地震波形和震相拾取数据集。
共享了通过BEAT软件生成的完整贝叶斯全矩张量（FMT）和静态矩形震源反演结果。
提供了使用NonLinLoc生成的重定位震源位置目录，以支持对化石板块的构造解释。
me: Bayesian full-moment-tensor (FMT) inversion using the BEAT software.
Static rectangular-source inversion.
P-wave first-motion polarity picking.
Earthquake relocation using NonLinLoc.
使用BEAT软件进行贝叶斯全矩张量（FMT）反演。
静态矩形震源反演。
P波初动极性拾取。
使用NonLinLoc进行地震重定位。
de: Seismic waveforms for five deep-focus earthquakes (Mw 4.3 - 7.1, depth 610 - 670 km) beneath northern Borneo recorded between 2019 and 2026.
Vertical-component waveforms and instrument responses for polarity picking.
Relocated hypocenter catalog (hypocentres.csv).
2019至2026年间记录的婆罗洲北部下方5个深源地震（Mw 4.3 - 7.1，深度610 - 670 km）的地震波形。
用于极性拾取的垂直分量波形和仪器响应。
重定位震源位置目录（hypocentres.csv）。
li: The dataset is limited to a small number of events (five deep-focus earthquakes).
Relies on external raw data sources (EarthScope, AusPass, GEOFON) which must be cited separately.
该数据集仅限于极少数事件（5个深源地震）。
依赖外部原始数据源（EarthScope、AusPass、GEOFON），这些数据源需要单独引用。

tm.why: The dataset contains body waveforms and configuration files used for Bayesian full-moment-tensor and static rectangular-source inversions using BEAT.
The dataset includes a relocated hypocenter catalog generated using NonLinLoc and phase picks.
The data supports a study investigating a potential fossil slab beneath northern Borneo using deep-focus earthquakes.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the Zenodo repository abstract and metadata as no PDF was available.

sum: This study addresses the discrepancy between 1-D mantle viscosity models inferred from glacial isostatic adjustment (GIA) and those from seismic imaging or mantle convection. By implementing realistic 3-D mantle viscosity structures derived from seismic tomography with an effective activation energy of 300-400 kJ/mol and a weak asthenosphere, the authors model GIA and fit paleo-sea level data in North America. They find that 3-D models outperform traditional 1-D models (like VM5a) and accommodate a wider range of ice sheet reconstructions. Specifically, to fit both far-field and near-field data, the North American component of the ICE-6G model must be increased in volume by 10-20%. This provides a potential solution to the LGM sea-level budget discrepancy.
本研究解决了冰期地壳均衡调整（GIA）推断的一维地幔粘度模型与地震成像或地幔对流推断之间的矛盾。通过采用基于地震结构（有效激活能为300-400 kJ/mol）和弱软流圈构建的真实三维地幔粘度结构，作者对北美古海平面数据进行了GIA建模。结果表明，三维模型比传统一维模型（如VM5a）更符合数据，并允……

t: 3-D Glacial Isostatic Adjustment (GIA) modeling incorporating lateral mantle viscosity variations derived from seismic tomography and temperature-dependent rheology.
结合基于地震断层扫描和温度相关流变学推导的横向地幔粘度变化的三维GIA建模。

sum: This paper provides a critical conceptual assessment of a proposed lunar-to-orbit neutrino transit network designed for Earth-interior monitoring and earthquake detection. The architecture involves a lunar neutrino source emitting a beam through Earth to multiple near-Earth orbit receiving stations ('neutrino walls'). While confirming transit-time kinematics (~42.5 ms) and the validity of absorption/oscillation tomography principles, the author identifies three major quantitative gaps: the lack of technology for generating directed neutrino beams without GeV-scale accelerators, severe geometric dilution of the event rate over the 384,400 km Earth-Moon distance (diluted by ~4x10^14), and extreme detector sensitivity requirements. The study concludes that while multi-station configurations improve tomographic angular coverage, the physical and technological limitations render the current proposal highly impractical for real-time earthquake precursor detection.

sum: This study investigates how hydroclimate-driven lake-level fluctuations control intrarift fault slip in the Lake Malawi Rift over 1.38 million years. Integrating a continuous sediment drill core record with high-resolution seismic reflection profiles, the authors measured throw histories across four intrarift growth faults and used 3D finite-element modeling (PyLith) to evaluate viscoelastic and poroelastic stress mechanisms. Observational results reveal a 73.0% average reduction in slip rate following the Mid-Pleistocene Transition (MPT; ~800-900 ka). Numerical modeling shows that lake-level loading generates Coulomb stress perturbations of 2.0–3.6 MPa, clamping normal faults during highstands, while slow pore-pressure diffusion during rapid drawdowns promotes transient destabilization. Because elastic clamping alone predicts only a 26.8% reduction, poroelastic coupling and the shift from high-frequency (41-kyr) pre-MPT cycles to low-frequency, high-amplitude (100-kyr) post-MPT cycles are essential to explain the prolonged fault suppression.
本研究探讨了138万年来气候驱动的湖泊水位波动如何控制马拉维湖裂谷内断层的滑动行为。作者结合连续沉积钻孔岩芯与高分辨率地震反射剖面，测量了四条裂谷内生长断层的垂直位移历史，并利用三维有限元程序（PyLith）模拟了粘弹性和孔隙弹性应力机制。观测显示，中更新世转型（MPT）后断层平均滑动率下降了73.……

sum: This study addresses the controversial subduction dynamics of the Asian lithosphere beneath northern Tibet. The authors compiled 846 helium isotope ($R_C/R_A$) data points across the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau and developed a two-stage gradient boosted tree–probabilistic fusion network (2S-GBTPFN) integrating geological, geophysical, geochemical, and hydrological parameters. The attention-based machine learning model successfully maps the spatial distribution of helium isotopes, delineating a helium boundary ($R_C/R_A > 0.1 R_A$) in northern Tibet. This boundary represents a geochemical expression of a nonuniform mantle suture along the Kunlun suture. The results indicate uneven, limited southward subduction of the Asian lithosphere, supporting a geodynamic model of dual-slab subduction, multistage lithospheric delamination, and asthenospheric upwelling. This work highlights the power of machine learning in integrating multi-disciplinary datasets to resolve complex tectonic structures.

sum: This study addresses the controversy surrounding pre-slip detection before major earthquakes, specifically the 2011 Mw 9.0 Tohoku-Oki earthquake, where common-mode errors (CMEs) in crustal deformation data often obscure tectonic signals. The authors propose Correlation Analysis (CRA) as an alternative method to detect pre-seismic signals without needing to explicitly estimate and subtract CMEs. Using synthetic model time series, they demonstrate that CRA successfully distinguishes tectonic signals from CMEs and improves the signal-to-noise ratio. Applying CRA to actual GNSS data prior to the Tohoku-Oki earthquake, they detect a consecutive, two-stage signal sequence matching the timing of previously reported slow-slip and pre-slip events. These signals exhibit physical characteristics, such as power-law decay with distance from the epicenter, suggesting a sequential, slow seismic preparation process.

sum: This study reconstructs the pressure-temperature-time-deformation (P-T-t-d) history of the Greater Himalayan Sequence (GHS) along the Zanskar Shear Zone (ZSZ) in NW India. Using pseudosection modeling, garnet geochemistry, and Fe-Mg exchange thermometry, the authors identify a four-stage clockwise P-T path: isothermal burial, heating to peak conditions, decompression, and exhumation. Metamorphism (~22-20 Ma) and anatexis (~25-20 Ma) are constrained by U-Pb SHRIMP zircon dating. Quartz crystallographic preferred orientations (CPOs) indicate high-temperature deformation at lower structural levels. The results suggest that burial (33-27 Ma) and subsequent leucogranite generation (25-20 Ma) led to a melt-weakened crust, facilitating normal faulting and rapid exhumation (24-19 Ma), supporting a hybrid critical-taper and channel flow geodynamic model.
本研究重建了印度西北部藏斯卡剪切带（ZSZ）大喜马拉雅岩系（GHS）的压力-温度-时间-变形（P-T-t-d）历史。利用相平衡视剖面图模拟、石榴石地球化学和Fe-Mg交换温压计，确定了包含埋藏、峰期加热、减压和折返的四阶段顺时针P-T路径。U-Pb SHRIMP锆石定年限制变质作用发生于22-20……

t: Thermodynamic pseudosection modeling combined with garnet geochemistry, Fe-Mg exchange thermometry, and U-Pb SHRIMP zircon geochronology to reconstruct P-T-t-d paths.
结合热力学视剖面模拟、石榴石地球化学、Fe-Mg交换温压计及锆石U-Pb定年重建P-T-t-d路径。
Metamorphic and igneous rock samples collected from the Greater Himalayan Sequence along the Zanskar Shear Zone, particularly from Malung Tokpo.

A 4-stage clockwise P-T path with metamorphism at ~22-20 Ma, anatexis at ~25-20 Ma, and rapid exhumation at ~24-19 Ma facilitated by melt-weakening.
确定了四阶段顺时针P-T路径，变质作用在~22-20 Ma，熔融在~25-20 Ma，折返在~24-19 Ma。
Absolute deformation temperatures are not well constrained due to variable deformation history and degree of foliation development.
由于变形历史和叶理发育程度的多样性，绝对变形温度未能得到良好约束。
Synthesizes P-T-t-d conditions to show that a combination of critical-taper wedge and channel flow models best explains the GHS evolution in Zanskar.

sum: Extracting multimode surface-wave dispersion curves from earthquake records is often hindered by azimuthal bias from double-couple source radiation patterns. This study introduces surface integration into the frequency-Bessel (F-J) transform framework, deriving a full set of eight cylindrical expansion coefficients from three-component seismic wavefields. These expressions simultaneously capture dispersion spectrograms of Rayleigh waves, Love waves, and P-SV leaking modes. To handle irregular station geometries in real seismic arrays, the authors implement a discretized surface integration scheme using Delaunay triangulation and combine it with dispersion compensation for mode separation. The method is validated on synthetic seismograms and applied to USArray three-component recordings of the 2011 Mw5.7 Oklahoma and 2008 Mw6.0 Nevada earthquakes. The novelty lies in theoretically eliminating azimuthal source radiation effects and enabling joint extraction of radial, tangential, and vertical multimode and leaking-mode dispersion curves from single earthquake events.
从地震事件记录中提取多阶面波频散曲线常受双力偶震源辐射花样的方位角偏差影响。本研究将面积分引入频率-贝塞尔（F-J）变换框架，基于三维层状介质半解析解推导出包含8个柱面展开系数的完整频散谱表达式，可同时提取瑞利波、勒夫波及漏能模。针对实际不规则台阵，采用Delaunay三角剖分实现离散面积分，并结合……

t: Derives eight cylindrical wavefield expansion coefficients via surface integration of three-component earthquake records, discretized on irregular arrays using Delaunay triangulation and paired with dispersion compensation for mode separation.
基于Delaunay三角剖分对三分量地震记录进行离散面积分，推导8个柱面波场展开系数并结合频散补偿分离模式。

Evaluated on synthetic seismograms (regular 73x800 array and TA geometry) and real USArray three-component records from the 2011 Mw5.7 Oklahoma (373 stations) and 2008 Mw6.0 Nevada (135 stations) earthquakes.
采用规则与TA台阵合成地震数据，以及2011年俄克拉荷马Mw5.7（373台站）和2008年内华达Mw6.0（135台站…

Successfully extracts 0–4th mode Rayleigh and Love dispersion curves and leaking modes; above 0.03 Hz, Rayleigh terms dominate cross-coupling by >3.16x, allowing reliable extraction even with incomplete azimuthal coverage.
成功提取0-4阶瑞利波、勒夫波及漏能模；高于0.03 Hz时主项幅值比耦合项大3.16倍以上，不完整方位覆盖仍可靠。
Requires strong earthquakes, struggles at shallow depths (<2 km) or large distances, and assumes horizontal isotropic layering which can be biased by strong lateral heterogeneity.
依赖强震源，难以约束浅于2 km结构，且受水平层状各向同性假设限制。

First formulation of surface-integrated F-J transforms for three-component earthquake records, mitigating double-couple radiation bias and extracting full multimode Love, Rayleigh, and leaking-mode spectrograms.
首次建立三分量地震记录的F-J面积分框架，消除震源辐射偏差并提取完整勒夫波、瑞利波与漏能模。

kc: Introduces surface integration into the frequency-Bessel (F-J) framework to theoretically mitigate azimuthal bias caused by earthquake double-couple radiation patterns.

Derives a full set of eight dispersion spectrogram expressions (uS,0, uR,0, uT,1, uS,1, uR,1, uT,2, uS,2, uR,2) from three-component earthquake records to capture Rayleigh waves, Love waves, and leaking modes.
Implements a practical discretized surface integration scheme based on Delaunay triangulation to accommodate irregular seismic array geometries.
Demonstrates successful extraction of multimode normal modes and leaking modes on synthetic datasets and real USArray recordings from Oklahoma and Nevada earthquakes.
将面积分引入频率-贝塞尔（F-J）框架，从理论上减轻了地震双力偶震源辐射花样引起的方位角偏差。
从三分量地震记录推导出8个完整的频散谱表达式，可同时提取瑞利波、勒夫波和漏能模频散曲线。
提出基于Delaunay三角剖分的离散面积分方案，适应不规则台阵分布。
在合成数据及俄克拉荷马和内华达地震的USArray实测数据中成功提取了多阶正规模和漏能模。
me: Cylindrical vector basis expansion of 3D multi-layered elastodynamic wavefields excited by a double-couple point source.
Frequency-Bessel (F-J) surface-integration transform using Hankel functions of the first kind to suppress crossed aliasing.
Discretized surface integration over irregular station arrays using Delaunay triangulation and triangular element area weighting.
Mode separation and overtone enhancement via the dispersion compensation method.
双力偶点源激发的三维多层弹性动力学波场的柱面矢量基函数展开。
采用第一类汉克尔函数的频率-贝塞尔（F-J）面积分变换以抑制交叉假频。
利用Delaunay三角剖分与三角形面积加权实现不规则台阵的离散面积分。

Synthetic test on a realistic irregular array geometry mimicking 373 USArray TA stations for the Mw5.7 Oklahoma earthquake across general, pure strike-slip, and normal-fault focal mechanisms.
Real data application to 373 three-component USArray TA recordings of the November 2011 Mw5.7 Oklahoma earthquake (azimuthal coverage [-13 deg, 90 deg]).

2008年内华达Mw6.0地震的135个XC和TA台站三分量实测记录的正规模与漏能模提取应用。
li: Requires sufficiently strong earthquake sources; extracting higher modes fails when events are weak, offshore, or at large epicentral distances due to attenuation.
Assumes a horizontally layered isotropic medium; strong lateral heterogeneity across wide azimuthal coverage degrades dispersion spectrogram clarity.
Poorly suited for imaging very shallow structures (< 2 km depth) where earthquake high-frequency overtones are heavily attenuated or scattered.
依赖足够强的地震震源，弱震、近海地震或大震中距事件因衰减难以提取高阶模。

sum: This study performs detailed geological mapping of five sites along the margin of Ishtar Terra on Venus using Magellan Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data to test five crustal plateau formation models. The mapping reveals that in four of the five sites, tessera units and associated deformations are embayed by younger lava plains, suggesting plains-forming volcanism outlasts tectonism. This observation is consistent with the pulsating continents, waning heat-pipe, and upwelling models. However, due to significant radar data uncertainties and resolution limits, deformation relationships alone cannot definitively distinguish between these models. The authors conclude that future missions with at least two times higher radar resolution (40 m/pixel) and ten times better topographic resolution (450 m/pixel) are required to rigorously test these geodynamic models.
本研究利用麦哲伦号雷达数据对金星伊师塔地边缘五个区域进行地质制图，以测试五种地壳高原形成模型。结果显示，四个区域的镶嵌地块被后期熔岩平原围限，表明火山活动晚于构造运动，支持脉动大陆、衰减热管和上涌模型。但受限于数据分辨率，仅凭变形关系无法完全区分模型。未来需更高分辨率的雷达与地形数据。

t: Geological mapping of surface units and structural lineaments along Ishtar Terra margins to analyze embayment and deformation relationships.
对金星伊师塔地边缘的五个区域进行地表单元和变形线理的地质制图与构造分析。
Magellan Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data covering five sites along the margins of Ishtar Terra, Venus.
覆盖金星伊师塔地边缘五个区域的麦哲伦号合成孔径雷达（SAR）图像数据。
Tessera units are embayed by lava plains in 4 out of 5 sites, supporting pulsating continents, waning heat-pipe, and upwelling models, but data resolution limits definitive model testing.
4/5的区域中镶嵌地块被熔岩平原围限，支持部分模型，但现有分辨率限制了确定性评估。
Magellan SAR resolution (75 m/pixel) and topography are insufficient to resolve fine-scale deformation and unambiguous embayment relationships.
麦哲伦雷达和地形数据的分辨率不足以解析微细构造和明确的围限关系。
First systematic mapping of these five specific Ishtar Terra margin sites to test five competing crustal plateau models, identifying new eye-pattern ridges.
首次系统制图五个特定边缘区域以测试五种高原模型，并发现了新型眼状脊构造。

Evaluated five competing crustal plateau formation models based on observed embayment and deformation relationships.
Identified new planetary surface features, including eye-pattern ridges and V-shape lineaments.

sum: This paper introduces the PRECODE mine-by experiment at the BedrettoLab underground research laboratory in Switzerland, which investigates the short-term development and long-term evolution of the Excavation Damage Zone (EDZ) in crystalline Rotondo Granite. The study compares two excavation techniques: controlled drill-and-blast (D&B) and line-drilling and rock-breaking (LDRB). By integrating multidisciplinary in-situ monitoring—including acoustic emission (AE), distributed acoustic and strain sensing (DAS/DSS), electrical resistivity tomography (ERT), and hydraulic monitoring—with laboratory-based fracture mechanics, the project characterizes EDZ formation and stress corrosion processes. Preliminary findings reveal distinct differences in AE activity and EDZ characteristics between the two excavation methods, and suggest ongoing time-dependent fracturing in the mature, decades-old Bedretto Tunnel. This comprehensive dataset provides critical insights for the long-term safety assessment of deep geological nuclear waste repositories.
本文介绍瑞士Bedretto实验室的PRECODE开挖试验，研究花岗岩中开挖损伤区的演化。研究对比了钻爆法和排孔钻切法，集成声发射、分布式光纤、电阻率成像等原位监测与室内实验。结果显示，不同开挖方式的声发射和损伤特征差异显著，且老隧道中存在持续时变破裂，为核废物处置安全评估提供了关键数据。

t: Multidisciplinary in-situ monitoring including acoustic emission, distributed acoustic/strain sensing, and electrical resistivity tomography combined with laboratory testing.
结合声发射、分布式声学/应变传感、电阻率成像的多学科原位监测与室内实验。
In-situ monitoring data from the PRECODE tunnel in Rotondo Granite and laboratory fracture mechanics data under varying environmental conditions.
Rotondo花岗岩PRECODE隧道的原位监测数据及不同环境条件下的室内岩石力学实验数据。
Preliminary results show clear differences in acoustic emission activity and excavation damage zone development between different excavation methods.

sum: In June 2026, a 6-day earthquake swarm of 425 matched-filter detections (up to ML 3.9) struck the central Rio Grande rift above the northern margin of the Socorro Magma Body (SMB). Although its location above an inflating mid-crustal sill suggests a magmatic or fluid driver, this study tests that hypothesis using source physics compared against a 20-year regional baseline (2002–2022). Using GrowClust relocations, aligned magnitude scales, spectral fitting, and Bayesian moment tensor inversions, the authors find a low swarm b-value of 0.51 (versus 0.83 regionally), median stress drops 2.2 times the regional baseline (reaching ~10 MPa for ML >= 3), a double-couple normal mechanism for the largest event without an isotropic component, and non-diffusive bimodal migration. Mogi modeling of InSAR uplift shows SMB inflation supplies negligible stress (0.03–0.1 MPa). Thus, the swarm represents tectonic reactivation of rift-parallel normal faults within the San Acacia accommodation zone.
2026年6月，新墨西哥州Socorro岩浆体（SMB）北缘上方发生425次地震组成的震群（最大ML 3.9）。为检验其是否为岩浆或流体驱动，本研究结合匹配滤波检测、GrowClust重定位、谱拟合及贝叶斯矩张量反演，将其震源物理参数与20年区域背景目录对比。结果显示该震群b值偏低（0.51，区域背……

t: The authors combine two-pass ObsPy matched-filter detection, GrowClust relative relocation, Aki-Utsu and b-positive estimators, Brune S-wave spectral fitting, Bayesian moment tensor inversion (MTfit), and Mogi dilatation stress modeling.
结合两步匹配滤波、GrowClust重定位、b-positive估计、Brune谱拟合、贝叶斯矩张量反演与Mogi模型。

Continuous waveforms from June 13 to 19, 2026 across local/regional broadband stations, a 3-km Raspberry Shake, western Arizona stations, a 16-node SmartSolo array, plus a 4,637-event historical catalog (2002–2022) and Sentinel-1 InSAR.

The 425-event swarm exhibits a low b-value of 0.51 (vs. 0.83 regional background), median stress drops 2.2 times the regional baseline (2.2 vs. 1.0 MPa, reaching ~10 MPa for ML >= 3), and normal faulting.
震群b值低至0.51（背景0.83），应力降中位数为区域基线2.2倍（大震约10 MPa），呈正断层机制。

A sparse, azimuthally incomplete surface network poorly resolves absolute depths and small-event mechanisms, while finite bandwidth restricts stress drops to ML >= 2.5 and curved magnitude distributions complicate single b-value fits.

First source-physics characterization of the largest modern swarm above the Socorro Magma Body, demonstrating a tectonic end-member reactivation of the San Acacia accommodation zone rather than magmatic or fluid-pulse triggering.
首次揭示SMB上方最大现代震群的纯构造端元成因，证实其为调节带正断层复活而非岩浆流体触发。

Resolved a normal double-couple mechanism with minimal isotropic component (+8%) for the ML 3.9 main event and showed that Mogi-modeled magma inflation supplies 1–2 orders of magnitude less stress than released.
利用两步匹配滤波和GrowClust算法，在2026年6月Socorro震群中检测出425个事件并重定位了401个震源。
证实该震群具有显著偏低的b值（0.51，区域背景0.83）和偏高的应力降（区域基线的2.2倍，ML>=3事件约10 MPa），表明其处于高差应力构造体制。
解析出ML 3.9主震的纯正断层双力偶机制（各向同性分量仅+8%），并通过Mogi模型证明下伏岩浆房膨胀提供的差应力比单次地震释放应力低1–2个数量级。

sum: This study presents a Spatial Correlation Recurrent Neural Network (SCRNN) to predict continental-scale geothermal heat flow (GHF) in the contiguous United States. Unlike traditional machine learning methods that treat GHF measurements as spatially independent, SCRNN explicitly incorporates spatial dependencies among multiple geological and geophysical variables. The resulting high-resolution GHF map shows elevated heat flow in tectonically active western regions (characterized by crustal thinning and faulting) and lower heat flow in the stable central and eastern Craton. SHAP analysis reveals that lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary depth, Moho depth, Curie-point depth, and fault systems are the primary controls on GHF patterns. This demonstrates the model's ability to capture physically meaningful geological controls.
本研究开发了一种空间相关循环神经网络（SCRNN），用于预测美国本土大陆尺度的地热流（GHF）分布。与将地热流测量视为空间独立的传统机器学习方法不同，SCRNN显式地引入了多个地质和地球物理变量之间的空间依赖性。预测的高分辨率地热流图显示，高值集中在具有地壳变薄和断裂发育的西部活动构造区，而低值分布……

t: A Spatial Correlation Recurrent Neural Network (SCRNN) designed to explicitly incorporate spatial dependencies among multiple geological and geophysical variables for predicting geothermal heat flow.
一种显式引入空间相关性和多变量依赖性的循环神经网络（SCRNN）地热流预测方法。
Sparse and unevenly distributed geothermal heat flow measurements across the contiguous United States, integrated with lithospheric, crustal, and fault system covariates.
美国本土稀疏且分布不均的地热流测量数据，并结合了岩石圈、地壳及断裂系统等协变量。
A high-resolution GHF map of the US showing high GHF in the active west and low GHF in the stable craton, with LAB, Moho, and Curie depths identified as primary controls.

The model's predictions remain inherently limited by the sparse, uneven, and highly nonstationary nature of the available direct geothermal heat flow observations.

Explicitly incorporating spatial correlation and multi-variable dependencies in a recurrent neural network framework for continental-scale geothermal heat flow mapping, moving beyond spatially independent assumptions.

sum: Seismic data denoising is critical for enhancing signal-to-noise ratio in exploration geophysics. While existing deep learning (DL) methods perform well, most are task-specific and struggle to generalize across complex, mixed-noise field conditions. This paper first briefly reviews traditional denoising techniques and provides a comprehensive taxonomy of DL-based seismic denoising methods categorized by noise type: surface waves, random noise, erratic noise, multiples, and DAS-specific noise. Furthermore, the authors pioneer a paradigm shift by proposing SeisDeFM, a dedicated seismic denoising foundation model. SeisDeFM combines a residual U-Net backbone with a trace-wise Transformer bottleneck, pre-trained self-supervisedly on 10,000 clean field gathers via joint trace-wise masked reconstruction and InfoNCE contrastive learning. Fine-tuned with only 1,000 paired samples, SeisDeFM outperforms supervised U-Net and Transformer baselines trained on 10,000 samples across four noise categories, reducing downstream training time to 108 minutes while preserving weak reflections.
本文首先回顾了传统地震去噪方法，并按噪声类型（面波、随机噪声、异常噪声、多次波及DAS噪声）全面综述了现有的深度学习去噪技术。针对特定任务模型泛化能力差的问题，本文首次提出地震去噪基础模型（SeisDeFM）。该模型结合残差U-Net与道间Transformer瓶颈层，利用10,000道干净野外观测……

t: SeisDeFM integrates a residual U-Net backbone with a trace-wise Transformer bottleneck. It is pre-trained self-supervisedly via 50% trace-wise masked wavefield reconstruction and InfoNCE contrastive learning, then fine-tuned with L1-norm noise-residual prediction.
结合残差U-Net与道间Transformer瓶颈层，通过50%道掩码重建和InfoNCE对比学习自监督预训练，再用L1…

Field pre-stack seismic dataset from China with 12,000 samples (0.002 s sampling interval, 25 m trace spacing): 10,000 clean gathers for pre-training, 1,000 paired samples for fine-tuning, 1,000 validation, and 1,000 testing samples.

sum: This study presents experimental measurements of Ca isotopic fractionation between calcium perovskite (Ca-Pv) and co-existing silicate melt at high pressures and temperatures. The results show that Ca-Pv is enriched in heavy Ca isotopes by only 0.02 to 0.08 ‰ in the lower mantle, indicating negligible Ca isotope fractionation (<0.05 ‰) in a deep magma ocean. Consequently, the upper mantle's Ca isotope composition represents the bulk silicate Earth. Combined with Nd isotope differences between the Earth and Moon, the findings suggest that the Moon formed primarily from a partially molten proto-Earth with advanced perovskite crystallization in its lower mantle.
本研究通过高压高温实验测量了钙钛矿（Ca-Pv）与共存硅酸盐熔体之间的钙同位素分馏。结果表明，在下地幔条件下，Ca-Pv仅富集0.02‰至0.08‰的重钙同位素，这意味着深部岩浆洋中的钙同位素分馏极小（<0.05‰）。因此，上地幔的钙同位素组成可代表整个硅酸盐地球。结合地月之间的钕同位素差异，该研究……

t: High-pressure, high-temperature experiments at 1 atm and 3 GPa to measure Ca isotopic fractionation between calcium perovskite and co-existing silicate melt.
在1大气压和3 GPa下进行高温高压实验，测量钙钛矿与共存硅酸盐熔体间的钙同位素分馏。
Experimental samples of calcium perovskite and silicate glass analyzed for Ca isotope ratios (44Ca/40Ca).
分析了合成钙钛矿和硅酸盐玻璃样品的钙同位素比值（44Ca/40Ca）。
Equilibrium fractionation factors [10^3 ln alpha] of 0.04 at 1 atm and 0.50 at 3 GPa, indicating negligible (<0.05 ‰) fractionation in deep magma oceans.
获得平衡分馏系数，表明深部岩浆洋中的钙同位素分馏极小（<0.05 ‰）。
Extrapolation of low-pressure experimental data to deep lower mantle conditions relies on phase structure transition assumptions.

First experimental determination of Ca isotope fractionation between Ca-perovskite and melt, constraining early Earth and Moon formation scenarios.
首次实验测定了钙钛矿与熔体间的钙同位素分馏，约束了早期地月形成演化。

kc: Determined Ca isotopic fractionation factors between Ca-perovskite and silicate melt at high pressures.
Demonstrated that Ca isotope fractionation in the deep magma ocean is negligible (<0.05 ‰).
Proposed that the Moon formed from a partially molten proto-Earth with advanced lower-mantle perovskite crystallization.
测定了高压下钙钛矿与硅酸盐熔体之间的钙同位素分馏系数。
证实了深部岩浆洋中的钙同位素分馏可以忽略不计（<0.05 ‰）。
提出月球形成于一个半熔融、且下地幔已有钙钛矿结晶的原始地球。

sum: This paper introduces GraphSplit, a novel method for double-difference earthquake relocation that decouples the timing estimation graph from the relocation graph. By leveraging the DDSync method to fit relative arrival-time potentials, GraphSplit performs a prelocation step to improve initial locations, followed by constructing a sparse graph of neighboring events for robust double-difference relocation. This separation allows the algorithm to utilize extensive pairwise measurements without carrying them through every relocation iteration. Tested on a known-location benchmark, GraphSplit shows superior depth precision and comparable horizontal precision to hypoDD. Field applications to the Cahuilla swarm, a sparse Guyana sequence, and the Ridgecrest sequence (237,202 events relocated in 2.26 hours on a laptop) demonstrate its high computational efficiency, robustness, and ability to resolve fine-scale fault structures.
本文提出了一种名为GraphSplit的双差地震重定位新方法，该方法将时间估计图与重定位图进行了解耦。通过利用DDSync方法拟合相对走时势，GraphSplit首先进行预定位以改善初始位置，随后构建邻近地震的稀疏图进行鲁棒的双差重定位。这种分离使得算法能够利用大量的配对测量数据，而无需在每次重定位……

t: GraphSplit decouples timing estimation from relocation by using DDSync relative arrival-time potentials for prelocation, followed by double-difference relocation on a sparse graph of neighboring events.
GraphSplit通过使用DDSync相对走时势进行预定位，并在邻近事件的稀疏图上进行双差重定位，从而将时间估计与重定…
Evaluated using a known-location benchmark, and real-world datasets including the Cahuilla swarm, a station-sparse Guyana aftershock sequence, and the 237,202-event Ridgecrest earthquake catalog.
