Achieved the smallest depth error in benchmarks, resolved dipping structures in Guyana, and relocated 221,633 Ridgecrest earthquakes in 2.26 hours on an 18GB laptop.
在基准测试中获得最小的深度误差，解决了圭亚那序列的倾角结构，并在18GB内存笔记本上于2.26小时内重定位了221,63…
Requires strong timing-graph support, which can remove local updates for over half of the population when strict thresholds are applied.
需要较强的时间图支撑，在应用严格阈值时可能会移除超过一半群体的局部更新。
Splits the timing estimation from spatial relocation, making spatial connectivity and computational cost highly controllable for massive joint inversions.
将时间估计与空间重定位分离，使大规模联合反演中的空间连通性和计算成本高度可控。

kc: Introduced the GraphSplit algorithm, which decouples timing estimation from spatial relocation in double-difference problems.
Developed a prelocation step using DDSync relative arrival-time potentials to improve initial earthquake locations.
Demonstrated high computational efficiency by relocating over 237,000 events of the Ridgecrest sequence in 2.26 hours on a standard laptop.
提出了GraphSplit算法，在双差定位问题中将时间估计与空间重定位进行了解耦。
开发了利用DDSync相对走时势进行预定位的步骤，以改善初始地震位置。
通过在标准笔记本电脑上于2.26小时内重定位Ridgecrest序列的237,000多个事件，展示了极高的计算效率。
me: Decoupling of timing estimation graphs and relocation graphs.
DDSync relative arrival-time potential fitting for prelocation.
Sparse graph construction of neighboring earthquakes for double-difference relocation.
Station-phase resampling for estimating conditional location variability.
时间估计图与重定位图的解耦。
利用DDSync相对走时势拟合进行预定位。
构建邻近地震的稀疏图以进行双差重定位。
用于估计条件位置变率的台站-相位重采样。
de: Synthetic known-location benchmark testing.
Application to the Cahuilla earthquake swarm to resolve branching structures.
Application to a station-sparse Guyana aftershock sequence.
Large-scale application to the Ridgecrest earthquake sequence (237,202 input events).
合成已知位置基准测试。
应用于Cahuilla地震群以解析分支结构。
应用于台站稀疏的圭亚那余震序列。
对Ridgecrest地震序列的大规模应用（输入237,202个事件）。
li: Requiring very strong timing-graph support can remove local updates for more than half of the event population.
要求极强的时间图支撑可能会导致超过一半的事件群体失去局部更新。

tm.why: The paper introduces GraphSplit, a method specifically designed for sparse double-difference earthquake relocation of large catalogs.
It addresses the joint inversion problem of timing estimation and spatial relocation using graph-based splitting techniques.

ev.notes: No PDF was available; analysis is based on the detailed abstract from ESS Open Archive.

sum: The Aurora hydrothermal vent field (AVF) on the ultraslow-spreading Gakkel Ridge is a distinctive Arctic vent system exhibiting both volcanic hosting and ultramafic fluid signatures. Using an 11-month passive seismic dataset from eight ice-going ocean-bottom seismometers (OBS) and a helicopter-borne aeromagnetic survey, this study provides the first long-term geophysical constraints on the intersection of the Western Volcanic Zone (WVZ) and Lena Trough. Using PhaseNet, GaMMA, and NonLinLoc, the authors compile a catalog of 12,516 microearthquakes, alongside 27 SKHASH focal mechanisms and 13 HDBscan clusters. Results reveal a southward transition from magmatic to non-volcanic spreading: seismicity deepens, the shallow aseismic zone thickens, and axial positive magnetic anomalies vanish toward the Lena Trough. An oval-shaped aseismic zone northeast of AVF suggests a hot gabbroic intrusion driving hydrothermal circulation, while continuous surrounding tectonic seismicity (>4 km depth) sustains long-lived fluid pathways.
位于超慢速扩张加克尔洋脊的Aurora热液区（AVF）是兼具火山建造与超镁铁质流体特征的北极热液系统。本研究利用8台冰下海底地震仪（OBS）连续11个月的被动源地震数据及直升机航磁测量，首次对该洋脊西部火山带（WVZ）与Lena海槽交汇区进行了长期地球物理约束。结合PhaseNet拾取、GaMMA关……

t: Deep-learning phase picking (PhaseNet) and GaMMA association followed by 1D velocity inversion (HYPOCENTER), probabilistic location (NonLinLoc), SKHASH focal mechanism determination, HDBscan spatiotemporal clustering, and IGRF/MF7-corrected aeromagnetic line leveling.
结合PhaseNet拾取、GaMMA关联、HYPOCENTER一维速度反演、NonLinLoc定位、SKHASH震源机制…

Eleven months of continuous 100 Hz passive seismic waveforms from eight ice-going LOBSTER ocean-bottom seismometers (2–7 km spacing) around Aurora mound, complemented by 2,578 km of helicopter-borne aeromagnetic profiles.
8台破冰型OBS连续11个月记录的100 Hz被动源地震波形（台间距2–7 km），以及21条测线共2,578 km的直…

Located 12,516 well-constrained microearthquakes (Ml -0.67 to 4.02, Mc = 0.4, mean 22.4 events/day) and 27 normal-dominated focal mechanisms, revealing a southwestward-deepening seismicity band, an oval aseismic zone NE of AVF, and vanishing axial magnetic anomalies.
精定位12,516个微震（Ml -0.67至4.02，Mc=0.4）并获27个正断为主的震源机制，揭示向西南加深的地震带…

Large azimuthal gaps (>220°) outside the OBS array increase depth uncertainty in the WVZ and Lena Trough, while the network aperture (Mc = 0.4) cannot resolve shallow (<4 km) microcracking beneath AVF.
台网外大方位角空隙（>220°）增加了深度不确定性，且台网孔径（Mc=0.4）无法分辨热液区浅部（<4 km）极微震。

Provides the first long-term under-ice OBS microseismicity record and coincident aeromagnetic constraint for an active Arctic hydrothermal vent field at the magmatic-to-non-volcanic spreading transition on Gakkel Ridge.
首次获得北极加克尔洋脊热液区冰下长周期OBS微震目录与同步航磁约束，阐明岩浆向构造扩张过渡带的热液维持机制。

kc: First 11-month microseismicity catalog (12,516 well-constrained events, Mc = 0.4) and coincident aeromagnetic map at the Gakkel Ridge-Lena Trough intersection.

Demonstrates a clear transition from magmatic accretion at the Western Volcanic Zone to non-volcanic tectonic extension toward the Lena Trough, marked by deepening seismicity and vanishing axial magnetic anomalies.
Identifies a localized 3.5 x 2.5 km aseismic zone northeast of the Aurora Vent Field, interpreted as a cooling gabbroic intrusion providing the hydrothermal heat source.
Shows that continuous brittle tectonic deformation (>4 km depth) rather than transient magmatic swarms sustains the long-lived hydrothermal circulation at the Aurora Vent Field.
构建了加克尔洋脊与Lena海槽交汇区首个长达11个月的微震目录（12,516个高质量事件，完备震级Mc = 0.4）及同步航磁异常图。
揭示了从西部火山带的岩浆增生向Lena海槽非火山构造伸展的清晰转变，表现为地震带加深和轴部正磁异常消失。
在Aurora热液区东北侧发现一个约3.5 x 2.5 km的局部无震区，解释为向热液系统供热的未完全冷却辉长岩侵入体。
证实Aurora热液区的长期热液循环是由4 km深度以下的持续脆性构造变形维持的，而非瞬态岩浆活动。
me: Automated phase picking evaluating deep-learning models in SeisBench (selecting PhaseNet with 5 Hz highpass filter) and phase association via GaMMA.
Nonlinear OBS clock drift correction using ambient noise cross-correlation prior to earthquake location.
Probabilistic 3D earthquake location using NonLinLoc (Oct-Tree sampling) combined with 1D velocity model (Vp/Vs = 1.90) and station correction inversion via HYPOCENTER.
First-motion P-wave polarity focal mechanism inversion using SKHASH (validated with FOCMEC) and spatiotemporal clustering via HDBscan in homogenized distance-time space.
Helicopter-borne aeromagnetic data processing using IGRF removal, satellite MF7 long-wavelength trend replacement, and crossover line leveling.
基于SeisBench框架评估深度学习震相拾取模型（优选5 Hz高通滤波后的PhaseNet），并利用GaMMA进行震相关联。
在地震定位前利用背景噪声互相关对OBS进行非线性钟差校正。
利用HYPOCENTER反演最佳一维速度模型（Vp/Vs = 1.90）和台站校正项，结合NonLinLoc（八叉树采样）进行三维概率地震定位。
使用SKHASH（并用FOCMEC验证）基于P波初动极性反演震源机制解，并在均一化时空距离空间中利用HDBscan提取地震时空丛集。
直升机航磁数据处理：扣除IGRF背景场、用卫星MF7模型替换长波长趋势，并进行测线交叉点调平分析。
de: Continuous 100 Hz passive seismic waveforms recorded from late July 2022 to mid-July 2023 by 8 four-channel ice-going LOBSTER OBS (2-7 km spacing) deployed via RV Polarstern cruises PS131 and PS137.
Helicopter-borne Cs-2 aeromagnetic survey acquiring 2,578 km of profile data across 21 flight lines (3.7 km line spacing, 70 m mean sensor altitude) in June 2023.
由“极星号”PS131和PS137航次布设与回收的8台四分量破冰型LOBSTER海底地震仪（台间距2-7 km），于2022年7月底至2023年7月中旬连续记录的100 Hz被动源波形数据。
2023年6月采集的直升机航磁测量数据，包含21条测线共2,578 km测线长度（线距3.7 km，平均传感器高度70 m）。
li: Events at the westernmost Western Volcanic Zone and northern Lena Trough lie outside the OBS network (azimuthal gap > 220 degrees), leading to higher uncertainties in absolute hypocentral depths.

The 2-7 km inter-station OBS spacing yields a magnitude of completeness Mc = 0.4, preventing resolution of very shallow (uppermost 4 km), small-magnitude (Ml < -0.5) hydrothermal cracking directly beneath the vent field.
High-frequency noise from increased winter sea-ice deformation masks small earthquake signals, causing an apparent seasonal dip in seismicity rate.
西部火山带最西端和Lena海槽北部的地震位于OBS台网外（方位角空隙>220°），导致其绝对震源深度存在较大不确定性。
2-7 km的OBS台间距使完备震级受限于Mc = 0.4，无法分辨热液喷口正下方极浅部（上覆4 km内）更小震级（Ml < -0.5）的热液破裂微震。
冬季海冰变形加剧产生的高频噪声掩盖了微震信号，导致观测到的地震活动率出现表观上的季节性下降。

tm.why: The paper investigates the lithospheric structure and transition from magmatic accretion to tectonic extension along the ultraslow spreading Gakkel Ridge and Lena Trough.
The authors compile a high-resolution catalog of 12,516 microearthquakes using deep-learning phase picking (PhaseNet), association (GaMMA), NonLinLoc location, and HDBscan clustering.
The study relies on an 11-month deployment of eight ice-going ocean-bottom seismometers beneath perennial Arctic sea ice, corrected for nonlinear clock drift via ambient noise cross-correlation.

ev.notes: Full 19-page article text, figures, and captions from Geochemistry, Geophysics, Geosystems (2026) were analyzed directly from the provided PDF.

sum: This dataset supports the study of Earth's tidal response on the deep seafloor using fiber-optic sensing. It contains preprocessed Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) strain rate data from a seafloor cable, including versions with and without common-mode noise removal and high-pass filtered data. Additionally, it provides numerical predictions of solid-Earth tides (SET) and ocean tide loading (OTL) computed using FES2004 and Green's functions, represented as horizontal strain rate components (east, north, northeast). Cable geometry (coordinates, bathymetry, and azimuth) is also included. This dataset enables the validation of seafloor DAS for geodetic-scale deformation monitoring and ocean-solid Earth interaction studies.
该数据集支持利用深海光纤传感监测地球潮汐响应的研究。数据集包含：1）基于FES2004和Green函数计算的固体潮（SET）与海洋潮汐负荷（OTL）水平应变率预测模型数据；2）经过预处理的深海分布式声学传感（DAS）应变率数据，包括高通滤波及去共模噪声版本；3）光纤电缆的经纬度、水深和方位角等几何信……

t: Numerical modeling of solid-Earth tides and ocean tide loading combined with spatial mean subtraction and filtering for DAS noise reduction.
结合固体潮与海洋潮汐负荷数值模拟，以及空间均值相减和滤波进行DAS降噪。
Preprocessed deep-seafloor DAS strain rate time series, predicted tidal strain rates (SET and OTL), and cable trajectory/bathymetry coordinates.
预处理的深海DAS应变率时间序列、预测的潮汐应变率（SET和OTL）及电缆轨迹与水深数据。
Successful extraction of Earth's tidal response (SET and OTL) from deep-seafloor DAS data, supported by matching numerical predictions.
成功从深海DAS数据中提取出地球潮汐响应（SET和OTL），并与数值预测相匹配。
Observations are restricted to the single cable's geometry and local coupling conditions on the seafloor.
观测受限于单条电缆的几何形状以及海底的局部耦合条件。
First publicly shared deep-seafloor DAS dataset specifically processed and paired with predictions for tidal-scale deformation monitoring.
首次公开共享专门用于潮汐尺度形变监测并配有预测模型的深海DAS数据集。

kc: Provides a unique deep-seafloor DAS dataset specifically processed for observing long-period tidal deformation.
Delivers co-located solid-Earth tide (SET) and ocean tide loading (OTL) strain rate predictions along the cable.
Shares detailed cable geometry (bathymetry, coordinates, azimuth) to facilitate spatial analysis of directional strain.
提供了一套独特的、专门用于观测长周期潮汐形变的深海底DAS预处理数据集。
提供了沿光纤电缆共点的固体潮（SET）和海洋潮汐负荷（OTL）应变率预测模型。
共享了详细的光纤电缆几何信息（水深、坐标、方位角），便于进行方向应变的空间分析。
me: Solid-Earth tide (SET) evaluation based on Wahr's (1981) theory for an elastic, rotating spheroidal Earth with a liquid core.
Ocean tide loading (OTL) computation by convolving FES2004 ocean tide mass distribution with Green's functions.
DAS data preprocessing including spatial mean subtraction for common-mode noise removal and high-pass filtering.
基于Wahr (1981) 理论计算具有液核的弹性旋转扁球体地球模型的固体潮（SET）。
通过将FES2004海洋潮汐质量分布与格林函数进行卷积来计算海洋潮汐负荷（OTL）。
DAS数据预处理，包括通过空间均值相减去除共模噪声以及高通滤波。
de: Preprocessed DAS strain rate time series from a deep-seafloor fiber-optic cable.
Predicted horizontal strain rate components (east, north, northeast) for SET and OTL in NetCDF format.
Interpolated cable coordinates, bathymetry, and azimuth.
来自深海底光纤电缆的预处理DAS应变率时间序列。
NetCDF格式的固体潮（SET）和海洋潮汐负荷（OTL）预测水平应变率分量（东、北、东北）。
插值后的光纤电缆坐标、水深和方位角数据。
li: The dataset is regional, limited to the specific path and environment of the deployed seafloor fiber-optic cable.
DAS strain measurements can be affected by local coupling conditions between the cable and the seafloor sediment.
数据集具有区域性，仅限于所部署的海底光纤电缆的具体路径和环境。
DAS应变测量可能会受到电缆与海底沉积物之间局部耦合条件的影响。

tm.why: The dataset contains preprocessed Distributed Acoustic Sensing (DAS) strain rate data from a deep-seafloor fiber-optic cable.
The data is recorded using a fiber-optic cable deployed on the deep seafloor to monitor ocean-bottom deformation.
The dataset is designed to monitor Earth's tidal response, specifically solid-Earth tides and ocean tide loading.

ev.notes: Analyzed the Zenodo dataset abstract and metadata describing the NetCDF files and tidal models.

sum: This paper reviews the history, status, scientific applications, and preservation challenges of Canada’s legacy analog seismic data, spanning from 1897 to the digital transition in the late 1970s–1990s. Approximately one million paper seismograms survive in secure commercial storage with legal 'infinite retention value', alongside microfilms, historical station bulletins, phase cards, and macroseismic postcards. While many textual bulletins have been scanned and made publicly accessible online via Natural Resources Canada and the ISC, the paper seismograms remain difficult to access and lack a concrete mass-digitization plan. The authors summarize past reanalyses of major historical Canadian earthquakes, landslides, nuclear explosions, and episodic tremor and slip (ETS), and report preliminary tests of wide-body scanners (requiring 1000 dpi), digitization software (DigitSeis and SKATE), and metadata schemas (modified FOLDS) to guide future digitization efforts.
本文综述了加拿大1897年以来模拟地震资料的历史、现状、科学应用及保存挑战。目前约有100万张纸质地震图保存在安全的商业设施中并受法律永久保护，此外还有缩微胶卷、台站公报、震相卡片和宏观震害明信片。虽然大量台站公报已扫描并可通过NRCan和ISC公开获取，但纸质地震图调阅困难且尚无大规模数字化计划。……

t: The authors evaluate wide-body scanners, compare two waveform digitization software packages (DigitSeis and SKATE), and adapt the FOLDS metadata standard using linked instrument tables to establish a workflow for analog seismogram preservation.
评估大幅面扫描仪，对比DigitSeis和SKATE矢量化软件，并采用关联仪器表的改进FOLDS元数据标准。

The legacy collection comprises roughly one million daily paper seismograms recorded in Canada since 1897, alongside microfilm copies, unpublished phase index cards, macroseismic postcards, and digitized station bulletins.
涵盖1897年以来加拿大记录的约100万张纸质地震图、缩微胶卷、震相索引卡、宏观震害明信片及台站公报。

Testing showed waveform scanning requires 100 cm length capacity at ≥1000 dpi; scanning one million records at one minute each would take over 2,000 eight-hour workdays (~9 years), while bulletins back to 1908 are already digitally accessible.
波形扫描需100厘米幅宽和≥1000 dpi分辨率；单面扫描百万张记录需超2000个工作日（约9年），而公报已数字化公开…
There is no concrete plan or funding to scan the collection; records are in off-site commercial storage with paid retrieval, missing key earthquake dates, and undergoing slow natural deterioration.
尚无具体扫描计划与资金；档案存放于需付费调阅的商业仓库，部分大震记录缺失且面临自然老化。

Provides the first modern comprehensive assessment of Canada's one-million-record analog seismogram archive, its recent custodial rescue, publicly digitized bulletin repositories, and practical digitization roadblocks.
首次全面评估加拿大百万张模拟地震图档案的保管现状、数字公报获取途径及现代数字化面临的实际障碍。

kc: Comprehensive historical overview of Canadian analog weak-motion and strong-motion seismic networks from 1897 to the digital era.
Documentation of the storage history, legal protection ('infinite retention value'), inventory status, and current logistical access barriers for ~1 million paper seismograms.
Compilation of publicly accessible digital textual archives, including scanned Canadian seismological bulletins (1908–present) and macroseismic 'Did You Feel It' postcards.
Practical evaluation of scanning hardware requirements (100 cm width, ≥1000 dpi), digitization software (DigitSeis vs. SKATE), and metadata standards (modified FOLDS).
全面综述了1897年至数字时代加拿大模拟弱震和强震观测台网的发展历史。
记录了约100万张纸质地震图的存储历史、永久保留的法律保护地位、库存现状及当前的调阅障碍。
汇总了可公开获取的数字化文本档案，包括扫描版加拿大地震公报（1908年至今）和历史宏观有感明信片。
实际评估了扫描硬件要求（100厘米宽、≥1000 dpi）、数字化软件（DigitSeis与SKATE）及元数据标准（改进的FOLDS）。
me: Historical archival review and inventory database tracking of missing and preserved station-month analog records.
Preliminary hardware testing of wide-body color scanners (determining ≥1000 dpi resolution for waveform sides and 100 cm length capability).
Comparative pilot testing of seismogram trace digitization software packages (DigitSeis and SKATE) and design of a relational metadata table based on FOLDS.
开展历史档案梳理与库存数据库追踪，清查按台站-月份保存及缺失的模拟记录。
对大幅面彩色扫描仪进行初步硬件测试（确定波形面需≥1000 dpi分辨率及100厘米长度处理能力）。
对比测试地震图波形矢量化软件包（DigitSeis和SKATE），并基于FOLDS设计关系型元数据表。
de: Approximately one million daily analog paper seismograms (and duplicate microfilms) recorded across Canadian observatories since 1897.
Scanned historical Canadian station bulletins (1908–1968 at ISC; 1954–present at NRCan Library), 'Smith's cards' index files, and felt report postcards.
Review of historical reanalysis studies covering major M5.4–8.1 Canadian earthquakes (1918–1989), historical landslides, and pre-digital Cascadia Episodic Tremor and Slip.
1897年以来加拿大各观测台站记录的约100万张每日模拟纸质地震图（及缩微胶卷副本）。
扫描版加拿大历史台站公报（ISC收录1908–1968年；NRCan图书馆收录1954年至今）、“史密斯卡片”索引档案及有感报告明信片。
回顾了对加拿大1918–1989年间M5.4–8.1重要历史地震、历史滑坡及前数字时代卡斯卡迪亚慢滑移事件（ETS）的重分析研究。
li: No concrete funding or operational plan currently exists to scan and digitize the one million paper seismograms, which would require ~9 person-years of scanning alone.
Physical access to the commercial storage facility is restricted, slow, and incurs financial transfer fees per station-month box, with no suitable scanner at the Ottawa office.
Many historical records are missing (often corresponding to dates of major earthquakes due to unreturned loans or scrapbook cutting) and face ongoing natural deterioration.
目前尚无扫描和数字化这100万张纸质地震图的具体资金或执行计划，仅单面扫描就需约9个人年。
商业存储设施的实体调阅受限、流程缓慢且按箱收取转运费用，同时渥太华办公室缺乏合适的扫描仪。
许多历史记录缺失（常对应大震日期，源于借出未还或剪贴簿裁剪），且面临持续的自然老化风险。

tm.why: The paper extensively documents the 125-year history of Canadian analog and digital seismic stations, strong-motion networks, and data archiving practices.
It covers legacy station bulletins, historical phase cards, felt report collections, and the relocation and source analysis of major historical Canadian earthquakes.
A major focus is how legacy analog waveforms have been and can be used to constrain focal mechanisms, depths, and magnitudes of large historical earthquakes.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 14-page PDF of Bent and Cassidy (2026) in Journal of Seismology.

sum: Traditional surface-wave inversion relies on manual dispersion picking, while standard CNNs overlook non-uniqueness and oversmooth velocity structures. This paper introduces a physics-guided multi-modal variational autoencoder (PG-VAE) for automated, probabilistic near-surface shear-wave velocity (Vs) inversion. The architecture employs parallel 2D CNN encoders to fuse features from raw seismic shot gathers and spectral dispersion images into a probabilistic latent space, decoded via 1D transposed convolutions and residual blocks. Novelty lies in combining multi-modal data fusion with a frozen, pre-trained Transformer surrogate forward operator that enforces Rayleigh-wave dispersion physics during training, achieving a >18,000x speedup over numerical solvers. Trained on elastic finite-difference synthetics and applied to a 574-shot ultra-high-density field survey at the Devine test site in Texas, PG-VAE outperforms single-modality, unconstrained, and conventional inversions (achieving R2 = 0.9223 on smoothed synthetics), while providing calibrated uncertainty maps and Grad-CAM physical interpretability.

sum: This study introduces a reproducible multi-parameter ensemble framework for probabilistic earthquake forecasting in Bangladesh and the Indo-Burman region. By integrating seismicity, geodetic deformation, and hydrological observations, the framework utilizes Random Forest (RF), Gradient Boosting (GB), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models. These model outputs are combined using a Bayesian-inspired weighting strategy to produce probabilistic risk scores rather than deterministic predictions. Evaluated on data from April–August 2026, the ensemble outperformed the standard Gutenberg–Richter reference formulation, reducing RMSE by approximately 18% in one evaluation period. The study highlights the potential of multi-source machine learning for probabilistic seismic-risk characterization while emphasizing the need for prospective validation.

sum: Broadband ground-motion time histories are critical for seismic hazard and engineering analyses, yet physics-based simulations are computationally prohibitive above 1 Hz while stochastic methods lose deterministic phase and directivity. This study introduces HighFEM-2, a latent denoising-diffusion generative waveform model trained via rectified flow matching on a multi-modal diffusion transformer (MM-DiT). Conditioned on a low-frequency waveform (below the source corner frequency) and scalar metadata (Mw, hypocenter/station coordinates, elevation, VS30), HighFEM-2 synthesizes 0.1–50 Hz three-component accelerograms in ~1.3 s using 25 ODE steps. Trained on 195,138 Italian INSTANCE strong-motion records (Mw 1.4–6.5, ≤200 km), it accurately reproduces observed PGA and PGV (log10 biases of 0.042±0.088 and 0.057±0.090), 5%-damped PSA, envelopes, Fourier spectra, and integrated velocity/displacement. Unlike purely stochastic generative models, conditioning on station-specific low-frequency waveforms preserves shared event source/path terms across networks and allows seamless hybrid coupling with 3D dynamic rupture simulations.

kc: Develops HighFEM-2, a latent generative waveform model combining Variational Autoencoders (VAEs), a Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT), and rectified flow matching to synthesize 0.1–50 Hz 3-component accelerograms in 25 steps (~1.3 s/record).

Conditions synthesis on deterministic low-frequency waveforms alongside scalar source/path/site parameters, preserving long-period phase, timing, and event-shared source/path characteristics while stochastically sampling regional high-frequency scattering.
Curates and cleans 195,138 three-component Italian strong-motion records from INSTANCE using magnitude homogenization, coda exponential decay fitting, and PhaseNet multi-event filtering.

Demonstrates superior spectral and amplitude accuracy over WGAN-GP and Consistency Model baselines, and highlights strong regional specificity by showing that Japan-trained HighFEM-1 overpredicts Italian PGA by ~5x without retraining.

Validates hybrid broadband coupling using 3D dynamic rupture simulations of the 2016 Mw 6.2 Amatrice earthquake and demonstrates spectral robustness across varying low-pass cutoff frequencies (0.5 to 5 Hz).
开发了潜空间生成波形模型HighFEM-2，结合变分自编码器（VAE）、多模态扩散变换器（MM-DiT）和修正流匹配，仅需25步（约1.3秒/条）即可合成0.1–50 Hz三分量加速度记录。
将确定性低频波形与标量震源/路径/场地参数共同作为条件输入，在保留长周期相位、走时及全网共享震源路径特征的同时，随机采样区域高频散射变异性。
通过震级均一化、尾波指数衰减拟合及PhaseNet多事件剔除三层预处理，从意大利INSTANCE数据库中清洗出195,138条高质量三分量强震记录。
证明了模型在反应谱和幅值统计上显著优于WGAN-GP和一致性蒸馏模型，并通过日本训练的HighFEM-1对意大利PGA高估约5倍的现象揭示了高频生成模型的区域特异性。

me: Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT) log-spectrogram conversion followed by dual convolutional U-Net Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) compressing high- and low-frequency waveforms into 32×32×8 latent spaces.

Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT) with 12 joint-attention blocks and Adaptive Layer Normalization (adaLN-zero) processing patched latent streams modulated by MLP-embedded time and scalar metadata.

Rectified flow matching (continuous normalizing flow) regressing a straight-path ODE velocity field solved at inference with a 25-step custom Euler solver, followed by VAE decoding and phase reconstruction.

Three-stage automated data cleaning pipeline: metadata/SNR filtering, Hilbert envelope Gaussian smoothing with exponential coda decay spike detection, and PhaseNet arrival picking to reject overlapping events.
采用短时傅里叶变换（STFT）将三分量波形转换为对数时频谱，并通过两个独立的U-Net变分自编码器（VAE）将高频和低频波形压缩至32×32×8潜空间。
构建包含12个联合注意力块和自适应层归一化（adaLN-zero）的多模态扩散变换器（MM-DiT），并行处理分块潜变量流并融合时间步与物理参数嵌入。
利用修正流匹配（连续归一化流）回归直线常微分方程（ODE）速度场，推理阶段使用25步欧拉求解器积分，经VAE解码和相位重构恢复时间序列。
设计三阶段数据清洗流程：元数据与信噪比筛选、希尔伯特包络高斯平滑与尾波指数衰减异常尖峰检测、以及基于PhaseNet拾取剔除5秒内包含多次P波到时的重叠事件。

Low-frequency conditioning waveforms created by fourth-order zero-phase Butterworth low-pass filtering at Brune magnitude-dependent corner frequencies fc (0.18 to 14.7 Hz) based on Central Italy stress drops (0.1–7.9 MPa).

Architecture and objective benchmark comparing HighFEM-2 (FM-DiT) against EDM (UNet), EDM (DiT), FM (UNet), Consistency Distillation CM (DiT), and Pix2Pix WGAN-GP using PSA residuals, FID, and ASD Fréchet distance.

Hybrid simulation conditioning experiments using smooth and rough fractal dynamic-rupture simulations of the 2016 Amatrice earthquake at station IV.TERO, plus cutoff-frequency sensitivity tests (fc, 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 Hz).

Cross-regional transferability evaluation comparing un-retrained Japan HighFEM-1 (KiK-net/K-NET) against HighFEM-2 and empirical GMMs (Boore et al. 2014, Lanzano et al. 2016, Kanno et al. 2006) on Italian data.
采用意大利INSTANCE数据集（2005–2020年）经清洗后的195,138条三分量强震记录（100 Hz采样，90秒窗长，Mw 1.4–6.5，震中距≤200 km，VS30 116–1131 m/s），按9:1划分为训练/验证集与测试集。

开展模型架构与目标函数基准测试，在反应谱残差、FID和谱Fréchet距离（ASD FD）上对比HighFEM-2与EDM(UNet/DiT)、FM(UNet)、一致性蒸馏CM(DiT)及WGAN-GP。
利用2016年Amatrice地震在IV.TERO台站的平滑与粗糙分形动力学破裂模拟开展混合输入测试，并测试0.5至5 Hz不同低通截止频率的敏感性。
开展跨区域迁移评估，在意大利测试集上对比未重训练的日本HighFEM-1模型（基于KiK-net/K-NET）、HighFEM-2以及经验地震动预测方程（Boore 2014, Lanzano 2016, Kanno 2006）。
li: Training catalog is strongly skewed toward small earthquakes (mostly Mw 1–2, only three events > Mw 6 and maximum Mw 6.5), limiting reliable applicability for large magnitudes (Mw > 6.5) or other tectonic regimes without retraining.

HighFEM-2 does not correct amplitude deficiencies in its conditioning input; underpredictions in physics-based simulations (e.g., smooth fault rupture lacking mid-frequency energy) propagate directly into the broadband synthetics.
All waveforms use a fixed 90 s window with P-onset aligned at 5 s, restricting usable duration for large events at long distances where surface-wave moveout and shaking approach 90 s.
First-arrival onset timing is reconstructed from decoded log-spectrograms rather than inherited exactly from the conditioning time series, causing minor pre-arrival envelope mismatch.
训练集震级分布严重偏向小震（绝大多数为Mw 1–2，Mw>6仅3次，最大Mw 6.5），限制了模型在Mw>6.5大震或其他构造区域的直接外推应用。

所有波形固定采用90秒时间窗（P波对齐于5秒处），对于远场大震，当显著持时和晚到震相接近窗长时无法完整表征。
合成波形的初至时间是通过解码对数时频谱进行相位重构恢复的，而非直接从条件时程精确继承，导致初至前低幅值包络存在轻微偏差。

sum: The 28 March 2025 Mw 7.7 Myanmar earthquake ruptured ~480 km of the Sagaing Fault, but sparse near-field GNSS coverage and horizontal-dominated SAR measurements left vertical coseismic deformation poorly constrained. This study introduces a multi-station, multi-satellite, multi-source approach using ionospheric total electron content (TEC) perturbations recorded at 10 Indian GNSS stations located 300–500 km from the epicenter. By analyzing arrival times of three distinct acoustic wave (AW) peaks in bandpass-filtered slant TEC via an empirical travel-time relation and grid-search, the authors locate three uplift sources along the northern (~23°N), middle, and southern (~20°N) fault segments. Forward modeling of 3D electron density anomalies determines relative source strengths of 1.00, 0.36, and 1.45, matching large slip patches in seismological and InSAR models. This represents the first application of remote GNSS-TEC to simultaneously locate multiple coseismic uplift centers and constrain their relative intensities.
2025年3月28日缅甸Mw 7.7级地震沿实皆断层破裂约480公里，但因缺乏近场GNSS台站且SAR观测以水平位移为主，垂直同震形变难以约束。本研究提出一种多台站、多卫星、多震源方法，利用震中300–500公里外印缅边境10个GNSS台站的电离层总电子含量（TEC）扰动数据反演垂直隆升。通过经验走……

t: The authors apply an empirical travel-time equation (d = 0.95t - 554) and 0.1° grid-search on bandpass-filtered GNSS slant-TEC peak arrival times to locate acoustic wave sources, followed by 3D voxel-based forward modeling to determine relative source intensities.
利用经验走时方程和0.1°网格搜索拟合滤波后sTEC峰值到时以定位声源，并通过三维体元正演模拟确定相对声源强度。
1-Hz GNSS-TEC data from 10 Survey of India CORS stations along the India-Myanmar border (300–500 km from the epicenter) observing GPS satellites G14 and G22 during 06:15–07:00 UTC on 28 March 2025.
印缅边境（距震中300–500 km）10个印度CORS站观测GPS卫星G14和G22的1 Hz GNSS-TEC数据。

Three uplift sources are located along the Sagaing Fault at ~23°N (aw1), ~20°N (aw2), and the midpoint (aw3), with relative acoustic strengths of 1.00, 1.45, and 0.36, coinciding with seismological and InSAR slip patches.
在实皆断层~23°N、~20°N及中点定位三个隆升源（aw1、aw2、aw3），相对强度为1.00、1.45和0.36，…

The empirical propagation relation ignores directional anisotropy, local atmospheric variations, and neutral winds, causing ±40 km location uncertainty, while insufficient east-west azimuthal coverage poorly constrains E-W positions of aw2 and aw3.
忽略大气各向异性和中性风带来±40 km定位误差，且台站偏于一侧导致东西向约束较弱。

First multi-station, multi-satellite, multi-source application of remote GNSS-TEC data to simultaneously locate multiple coseismic uplift centers and constrain their relative acoustic intensities along an extended fault rupture.
首次实现多台站、多卫星、多源联合反演，利用远场GNSS-TEC同时定位多个同震隆升中心并约束其相对强度。

kc: Developed a multi-station, multi-satellite, multi-source grid-search and forward modeling framework using remote GNSS-TEC data to map coseismic vertical uplifts.
Identified three distinct acoustic wave sources along the ~480 km Sagaing Fault rupture of the 2025 Mw 7.7 Myanmar earthquake from stations 300–500 km away.

Quantified the relative intensities of the three uplift sources (1.00 in the north, 0.36 in the middle, and 1.45 in the south), showing strong agreement with seismological slip patches and InSAR vertical displacements.
开发了利用远场GNSS-TEC数据的多台站、多卫星、多源网格搜索与正演模拟框架，用于反演同震垂直隆升。
利用距离300–500公里的台站数据，在2025年缅甸Mw 7.7级地震约480公里的实皆断层破裂带上识别出三个独立的声波源。
量化了三个隆升源的相对强度（北段1.00、中段0.36、南段1.45），结果与地震学滑动模型及InSAR垂直位移高度一致。
me: Bandpass filtering (2–7 mHz) of 1-s slant TEC (sTEC) time series from GPS satellites G14 and G22 to isolate coseismic ionospheric perturbation (CIP) peaks.
Empirical travel-time to horizontal distance conversion (d = 0.95t - 554 for t > 900 s) derived from 3D numerical acoustic wave propagation in the US Standard Atmosphere 1976.
Spatial grid-search (0.1° resolution) minimizing root-mean-square (RMS) distance residuals across all station-satellite ionospheric piercing points (IPPs) to locate acoustic wave sources.
3D voxel-based (10 × 10 × 10 km) forward modeling of N-shaped acoustic waves (4-min period) integrated along satellite-receiver lines-of-sight to estimate relative source strengths.
对GPS卫星G14和G22的1秒采样斜TEC（sTEC）时间序列进行带通滤波（2–7 mHz），提取同震电离层扰动（CIP）峰值。
基于1976美国标准大气模型的三维声波数值模拟，建立经验走时-水平距离转换关系（t > 900 s时，d = 0.95t - 554）。
采用0.1°分辨率空间网格搜索，最小化所有台站-卫星电离层穿刺点（IPP）的均方根（RMS）距离残差以定位声源。
基于10×10×10 km三维体元对4分钟周期N型声波进行正演模拟，并沿视线方向积分以估算各声源的相对强度。
de: 1-Hz GNSS data from 10 Continuously Operating Reference Stations (CORS) operated by the Survey of India along the India-Myanmar border (300–500 km west-to-north of the epicenter).
Slant TEC observations from GPS satellites G14 and G22 between 06:15 and 07:00 UTC on 28 March 2025.
Comparison against finite-fault slip distributions derived from global seismological data and SAR imagery (Ye et al., 2025; Xu et al., 2026).
印度测量局在印缅边境（震中西至偏北300–500公里）布设的10个连续运行参考站（CORS）的1 Hz GNSS数据。
2025年3月28日06:15至07:00 UTC期间GPS卫星G14和G22的斜TEC观测数据。
与基于全球地震学数据和SAR影像反演的有限断层滑动分布模型（Ye et al., 2025; Xu et al., 2026）进行对比验证。
li: Poor east-west spatial constraint on the southern (aw2) and middle (aw3) sources due to one-sided azimuthal coverage of GNSS stations in eastern India.
Inability to detect coseismic subsidence because upward acoustic wave propagation steepens compressive positive pulses while rarefaction negative peaks remain indistinct.

The empirical travel-time relation assumes constant propagation conditions and neglects directional anisotropy, local atmospheric temperature variability, and horizontal neutral winds (introducing up to ±40 km location uncertainty).
由于印度东部GNSS台站方位角覆盖偏于一侧，对南段（aw2）和中段（aw3）声源的东西向位置约束较差。
由于向上传播的声波会使压缩正脉冲变陡而稀疏负峰值不明显，该方法难以有效识别同震沉降区。
经验走时关系假设传播条件恒定，忽略了方向各向异性、局部大气温度变化和水平中性风的影响（带来高达±40公里的定位不确定性）。

tm.why: The paper maps coseismic vertical crustal uplifts and correlates them with fault slip patches along the 480-km rupture of the 2025 Mw 7.7 Myanmar earthquake.

The study utilizes ionospheric seismology, specifically coseismic ionospheric perturbations (CIP) driven by acoustic waves propagating into the upper atmosphere, to infer seismic source characteristics.

ev.notes: Full 10-page PDF provided and analyzed, including all 4 main figures, methodology, equations, and references.

sum: Submarine pumice clasts contain abundant isolated vesicles encased in volcanic glass that develop low internal pressures (~1.23 kPa) as water vapor cools and condenses. Using elastic spherical shell mechanics, Mohr-Coulomb failure criteria, and buckling stability analysis alongside IODP Expedition 398 core data and X-ray microtomography, this study explains how the high compressive strength of glass preserves isolated vesicles down to ~1–2 km water depth (~15 MPa). This mechanical threshold sets a depth limit for submarine eruptions capable of forming buoyant pumice rafts. Furthermore, combining Hashin-Shtrikman-Walpole bounds, Hertz-Mindlin contact theory, and Gassmann fluid substitution, the author demonstrates a novel mechanism for submarine slope stability: fracturing isolated vesicles during incipient shear releases low-pressure vapor that condenses, significantly reducing pore fluid pressure and increasing effective stress. Consequently, pumice-rich deposits exhibit velocity-strengthening behavior during shear, making them more gravitationally and seismically stable than previously assumed.
海底喷发浮石含有大量被玻璃包裹的孤立气孔，冷却凝结后内部呈低压状态。本文结合弹性球壳力学模型、莫尔-库仑破裂准则、屈曲稳定性分析以及IODP 398航次岩芯数据和X射线显微CT图像，证明玻璃的高抗压强度使孤立气孔能在约1-2公里水深（~15 MPa）下得以保存，这限定了形成浮石筏的喷发水深上限。此外……

t: Models isolated vesicles as spherical elastic glass shells subject to Mohr-Coulomb and buckling failure, and applies Hashin-Shtrikman, Hertz-Mindlin, and Gassmann rock physics models to compute pore pressure drops upon vesicle rupture.
利用球形弹性壳莫尔-库仑与屈曲破坏模型分析气孔保存，并结合岩石物理模型计算气孔破裂引起的孔隙压力下降。

Uses porosity and grain density measurements of submarine pumice from IODP Expedition 398 (Archaeos, Kolumbo, Kameni eruptions) alongside 0.635-micron synchrotron X-ray microtomography of a 1650 CE Kolumbo pumice clast.
使用IODP 398航次海底浮石的孔隙度与颗粒密度数据，以及1650 CE Kolumbo浮石的0.635微米同步辐射X…

Isolated vesicles with 80% typical porosity persist up to ~15 MPa (~1.5 km depth). Rupturing just ~0.001–0.002 isolated porosity fraction reduces pore pressure from lithostatic to hydrostatic because bulk modulus Ksed is ~3.9 GPa.
80%孔隙度的孤立气孔可承受约15 MPa（~1.5公里水深）；仅破裂千分之几的孤立气孔即可将孔隙压力从静岩压力降至静水…
Volcaniclastic layers could still form preferred failure surfaces if their high permeability enables fluid pressure accumulation or where finer-grained/altered ash lacks isolated porosity.
若高渗透率导致流体压力积聚，或细粒/蚀变火山灰缺乏孤立气孔，火山碎屑层仍可能成为潜在滑动面。

Demonstrates that crushing underpressured isolated vesicles in submarine pumice reduces pore fluid pressure and strengthens slopes during incipient shear, contrary to assumptions that pumice layers promote failure.
首次提出海底浮石中低压孤立气孔在剪切初期破裂会降低孔隙水压并增强斜坡稳定性，打破了浮石层易滑坡的传统认识。

kc: Establishes a mechanical model showing that high glass compressive strength preserves low-pressure isolated vesicles in submarine pumice down to ~1–2 km water depth.
Identifies a ~1–2 km vent depth limit for submarine eruptions capable of generating buoyant pumice rafts.
Demonstrates via X-ray microtomography and IODP 398 grain density data the preservation and rupture relics of isolated vesicles in submarine deposits.
Proposes a pore-pressure reduction mechanism whereby rupturing isolated vesicles during shear strengthens volcaniclastic sediments and arrests slope failure.
建立了力学模型，证明火山玻璃的高抗压强度可使海底浮石中的低压孤立气孔保存到约1-2公里水深。
确定了能够产生漂浮浮石筏的海底火山喷发口水深上限（约1-2公里）。
通过X射线显微断层扫描和IODP 398颗粒密度数据，证实了海底沉积物中孤立气孔的保存及破裂遗迹。
提出了一种孔隙压力降低机制：剪切过程中孤立气孔破裂会强化火山碎屑沉积物并抑制斜坡失稳。
me: Isochoric thermodynamic cooling calculations to determine internal vesicle vapor pressure upon quenching.
Elastic spherical shell stress modeling combined with Mohr-Coulomb failure criteria and knocking-down elastic buckling stability analysis.
Synchrotron X-ray computed microtomography (0.635 micron voxel size) to image internal water-filled and gas-filled pores in pumice.
Three-phase rock physics modeling using Hashin-Shtrikman-Walpole bounds, Hertz-Mindlin contact theory, and Gassmann fluid substitution to estimate pore pressure drop during shear.
等容热力学冷却计算，用于确定淬火冷却后气孔内部的蒸汽压力。
结合莫尔-库仑破坏准则和折减弹性屈曲稳定性分析的弹性球壳应力建模。
同步辐射X射线显微断层扫描（体素大小0.635微米），用于对浮石内部充水和充气孔隙进行成像。
结合Hashin-Shtrikman-Walpole界限、Hertz-Mindlin接触理论和Gassmann流体替换的三相岩石物理建模，以估算剪切过程中的孔隙压力下降。
de: Connected and isolated porosity data and bulk grain density measurements of pumice lapilli from IODP Expedition 398 (765 ka Archaeos, 1650 CE Kolumbo, and 726 CE Kameni eruptions).
High-resolution 3D X-ray computed microtomography scan of a water-saturated pumice clast from the 1650 CE Kolumbo eruption (core U1593B1H4W, 407 mbsl).
Compilation of historical submarine eruption vent depths and pumice raft observations (e.g., 2012 Havre, Volcano-F, Fukutoku Oka-no-Ba).
IODP 398航次采集的浮石火山砾（765 ka Archaeos、1650 CE Kolumbo和726 CE Kameni喷发）的连通与孤立孔隙度数据及颗粒密度测量值。
1650 CE Kolumbo喷发（岩芯U1593B1H4W，水深407米）水饱和浮石碎屑的高分辨率三维X射线显微断层扫描图像。
历史海底喷发口水深和浮石筏观测数据的汇编（如2012年Havre、Volcano-F、福德冈之场等火山）。
li: Treats vesicles as idealized concentric spherical elastic shells with uniform wall thickness per vesicle.
Assumes isochoric conditions and pure H2O vapor inside isolated vesicles during cooling and pore-pressure drop calculations.
Volcaniclastic layers may still act as failure planes if high permeability promotes fluid transport or if volcanic ash becomes chemically altered.
将气孔理想化为具有均匀壁厚的同心球形弹性壳体。
在冷却和孔隙压力下降计算中，假设孤立气孔处于等容条件且内部为纯水蒸气。
如果高渗透性促进流体运移或火山灰发生化学蚀变，火山碎屑层仍可能充当滑坡滑动面。

tm.why: The paper investigates the rock physics, mechanical stability, and vesicle preservation of submarine volcaniclastic pumice deposits and their implications for volcano flank and submarine slope failure.

ev.notes: Full 9-page PDF including main text, equations, 5 figures, and Appendices A and B used for evaluation.

sum: This study integrates meso- and micro-structural observations, carbon-oxygen stable isotopes (δ13C, δ18O), clumped isotope thermometry (Δ47), and carbonate geochronology (U-Th and 14C) along the Monte Marine normal fault (MMNF) in the central Apennines, Italy. By comparing exhumed footwall fault zones with shallow active strands in paleoseismological trenches, the authors identify three geochemical groups reflecting distinct fluid regimes: (1) closed-system, rock-buffered cataclasites formed at ~30–52°C (~1 km depth), constraining a maximum average exhumation rate of ~1.57 ± 0.30 mm/yr since ~569 ka; (2) open-system cataclasites (~74°C) recording episodic upwelling of deep crustal fluids; and (3) shallow meteoric-water-buffered veins, coatings, and trench concretions (~4–15°C) spanning ~481 ka to the Holocene (5.3–4.0 ka cal BC). The novelty lies in bridging deep, long-term exhumed fault-fluid archives with shallow trench paleoseismology, demonstrating persistent hydraulic connectivity and distributed seismogenic deformation over ~575 kyr.
本研究结合中微观构造观测、碳氧稳定同位素、团簇同位素测温（Δ47）及碳酸盐岩年代学（U-Th和14C），重建了意大利中亚平宁山脉蒙特马里内正断层（MMNF）的时空演化。通过对比剥露的下盘断层带与古地震探槽中的浅表断层，划分出三类地球化学端元：深部岩石缓冲碎裂岩（30–52°C）、记录深部热流体混合的……

t: Integrates 1:10,000 structural mapping and fault kinematics with carbonate δ13C-δ18O stable isotopes, Δ47 clumped isotope paleothermometry, MC-ICP-MS U-Th dating, and AMS 14C dating across exhumed fault rocks and paleoseismological trenches.
结合1:10,000构造填图、稳定同位素、Δ47团簇同位素测温及U-Th和14C测年分析剥露断层与探槽样品。

307 fault plane and 97 slickenline measurements, plus carbonate bedrock, cataclasites, gouges, veins, breccia cements, and trench concretions analyzed for δ13C-δ18O, Δ47 (19 samples), U-Th (23 samples), and 14C (2 subsamples).
307个断层面与97个擦痕数据，以及基岩、碎裂岩、脉体和探槽结核的同位素、19个Δ47和25个测年数据。

Identifies three carbonate groups: rock-buffered cataclasites (30.1–52.3°C, up to 575 ka) yielding ~1.57 ± 0.30 mm/yr maximum exhumation rate, deep-fluid-mixed cataclasites (73.9°C), and meteoric-water-buffered mineralizations (3.8–14.8°C) spanning 481 ka to 5.3–4.0 ka cal BC.
识别出三类碳酸盐端元，限定约57.5万年以来连续活动及最大平均剥露速率1.57±0.30 mm/yr。

The ~1.57 mm/yr exhumation rate is a maximum estimate integrating multi-strand tectonic denudation and erosion while neglecting advective heating, and open-system mixing in Group-2 precludes paleo-depth estimation.
剥露速率假设纯传导地温梯度而忽略流体平流增温，且第2组开放混合体系无法重建古深度。

Directly links deep, long-term exhumed fault-zone carbonate fluid archives (~575 ka) with shallow Holocene paleoseismological trench concretions to trace fault-fluid evolution across crustal levels and seismic cycles.
首次将深部剥露断层长周期碳酸盐流体档案与浅表古地震探槽全新世记录直接关联。

kc: Reconstructed ~575 kyr of continuous, structurally controlled fluid circulation and extensional faulting along the Monte Marine normal fault (MMNF).
Classified fault-related carbonates into three end-member P-T-X groups spanning deep rock-buffered cataclasites, deep warm fluid mixing zones, and shallow meteoric-dominated pathways.
Constrained a maximum average exhumation rate of 1.57 ± 0.30 mm/yr since ~569 ka across the distributed 1–2 km-wide fault zone.

Linked Middle Pleistocene footwall mineralizations to Holocene paleoseismological trench concretions (5.3–4.0 ka cal BC), demonstrating enduring hydraulic connectivity and multi-splay rupture behavior.
重建了蒙特马里内正断层（MMNF）约57.5万年以来受构造控制的连续流体循环与伸展断层活动历史。
将断层相关碳酸盐岩划分为三类温压-流体端元：深部岩石缓冲碎裂岩、深部热流体混合带及浅表大气降水主导通道。
限定了1–2 km宽分布式断层带自约56.9万年以来的最大平均剥露速率为1.57 ± 0.30 mm/yr。
将中更新世下盘矿化与全新世古地震探槽结核（5.3–4.0 ka cal BC）联系起来，证实了持久的水力连通性与多分支破裂行为。
me: 1:10,000 field geological mapping and fault kinematic inversion using structural indicators (fault planes and slickenlines).
Carbon and oxygen stable isotope (δ13C, δ18O) mass spectrometry and clumped isotope (Δ47) paleothermometry to determine precipitation temperatures and parental fluid δ18Ow.
MC-ICP-MS U-Th radiometric dating of 23 carbonate veins, coatings, breccia cements, and cataclasites.
Accelerator Mass Spectrometry (AMS) 14C radiocarbon dating of tabular carbonate concretions from paleoseismological trenches.
1:10,000野外地质填图与基于断层面及擦痕构造标志的断层运动学分析。
碳氧稳定同位素（δ13C、δ18O）质谱分析与团簇同位素（Δ47）古温标测定，以反演沉淀温度与母流体氧同位素组成。
利用MC-ICP-MS对23件碳酸盐脉、断层涂抹层、角砾岩胶结物及碎裂岩样品进行U-Th同位素测年。
利用加速器质谱（AMS）对古地震探槽中的板状碳酸盐结核进行14C放射性碳测年。
de: 307 post-orogenic extensional fault plane measurements and 97 slickenline orientation records across the 8–10 km long MMNF zone.
C-O stable isotope dataset across bedrock, cataclasites, fault gouges, veins, slickenfibers, and trench concretions (Table 1).
19 clumped isotope (Δ47) temperature determinations (6–10 replicates each) and 23 U-Th age determinations plus 2 calibrated 14C ages.
横跨8–10 km长MMNF断层带的307个造山后伸展断层面测量数据及97个擦痕产状记录。
涵盖基岩、碎裂岩、断层泥、方解石脉、擦痕纤维及探槽结核的碳氧稳定同位素数据集（表1）。
19个样品的团簇同位素（Δ47）温度测定（每个样品6–10次重复）以及23个U-Th年龄和2个校正14C年龄数据。
li: Open-system fluid mixing in Group-2 cataclasites (~74°C) precludes reliable paleo-depth or exhumation rate estimates from those samples.
The maximum exhumation rate (~1.57 mm/yr) assumes a purely conductive 25°C/km geothermal gradient, neglecting potential advective heat transport by fault fluids.
Five of seven fault-core cataclasite samples exceeded the upper detection limit of U-Th dating (>600 ka).
第2组碎裂岩（~74°C）处于开放流体混合体系，无法用于可靠地估算古深度或剥露速率。
最大剥露速率（~1.57 mm/yr）假设了25°C/km的纯传导地温梯度，忽略了断层流体平流热传输的潜在影响。
7个断层核碎裂岩样品中有5个超出了U-Th测年方法的上限（>600 ka）。

tm.why: The study reconstructs fault zone architecture, fluid-rock interactions, permeability evolution, and long-term seismogenic fault behavior across structural levels of an active normal fault.
It constrains Quaternary extensional tectonics, tectonic exhumation rates (~1.57 mm/yr), and upper-crustal fluid circulation in the central Apennines.
It integrates fault-hosted carbonate geochronology with paleoseismological trench records to refine the timing of Holocene surface-rupturing paleoearthquakes and multi-splay rupture behavior.

ev.notes: Full 23-page PDF read and analyzed, including all text sections (§1–§5), Table 1, and Figures 1–8.

sum: This paper introduces a probabilistic surrogate-assisted framework for Bayesian full-waveform inversion (FWI) to overcome the high computational cost of Markov chain Monte Carlo (McMC) sampling. By replacing expensive forward simulations with predictions from a misfit-guided deep learning (CNN) surrogate, the method operates in offline, adaptive, or two-stage regimes. To make the surrogate tractable, a rock-physics-guided, shape-based parameterization reduces the dimensionality to around 10. Tested on synthetic models, including a CO2 plume monitoring scenario, the adaptive regime achieves a 7.1x wall-clock speedup and reduces GPU-hour costs by 84% while maintaining posterior accuracy. It outperforms Stein variational gradient descent (SVGD) by an order of magnitude.
本文提出基于深度学习代理模型的贝叶斯全波形反演框架，解决McMC采样计算成本高的问题。该方法利用CNN预测误差代替正演，并通过形状参数化将反演降至约10维。在二氧化碳羽流监测等合成模型测试中，自适应模式实现7.1倍加速并减少84%的GPU机时，保持了高后验精度，效率比SVGD高一个数量级。

sum: This study investigates reservoir-triggered seismicity (RTS) at the Castanhão Reservoir in NE Brazil using continuous seismic data from 2009–2010. By applying template matching (PyMPA) and double-difference relocation, the authors build a high-resolution catalog of 227 events (Mw 0.0–2.7) delineating a steeply dipping fault zone within the Jaguaribe Shear Zone. Modeling of pore-pressure diffusion yields a hydraulic diffusivity of ~0.080 m²/s, indicating that seismicity is governed by fluid pressure diffusion. Analysis of seismic strain dynamics and regularity metrics reveals a multi-stage preparatory process leading to the largest Mw 2.1 event. The findings highlight how moderate pore-pressure perturbations can reactivate critically stressed secondary strike-slip faults, causing delayed swarm-like seismicity in intraplate settings.
本研究利用连续地震数据分析了巴西Castanhão水库的触发地震。通过模板匹配和双差定位构建了高分辨率目录，揭示了Jaguaribe剪切带内的走滑断裂。孔隙压扩散模拟表明水力扩散系数为0.080 m²/s，证实地震受流体扩散控制。研究表明，中等孔隙压扰动即可激活临界应力的次级断层，在板内引发延迟群震……

采用PyMPA模板匹配和概率定位，结合双差重定位构建高分辨率目录，并进行孔隙压力扩散模拟。
Continuous seismic waveform data from a local network around the Castanhão Reservoir in NE Brazil, spanning the years 2009 to 2010.
2009至2010年间巴西东北部Castanhão水库周围地方地震台网的连续地震波形数据。
A catalog of 227 events (Mw 0.0–2.7) delineating a steeply dipping fault zone, with pore-pressure modeling yielding a hydraulic diffusivity of ~0.080 m²/s.
获得227个事件（Mw 0.0-2.7）的目录，揭示了陡倾断裂带，孔隙压模拟得到水力扩散系数约为0.080 m²/s。
The analysis is constrained by a short monitoring period (2009–2010) and a limited number of relocated events.

Integrates high-resolution seismicity relocation, pore-pressure diffusion modeling, and seismic strain dynamics to characterize RTS in secondary transtensional structures within intraplate strike-slip systems.
结合高分辨率地震重定位、孔隙压扩散模拟和地震应变动力学，刻画了板内走滑系统中次级张扭构造的触发地震特征。

sum: International Ocean Discovery Program (IODP) Expedition 502 successfully drilled a sediment-buried petit-spot volcano, recovering basalts from the interior of its magmatic system. Geochemical and isotopic analyses of these basalts reveal a unique signature characterized by Ni-rich olivine, low Mg#, SiO2-rich bulk compositions, Ba enrichment, and EM1-like Sr-Nd isotopes. Thermodynamic modeling indicates that these signatures cannot be explained by fractional crystallization of peridotite-derived melts alone, requiring contributions from an enriched SiO2-excess pyroxenite source. Additionally, fresh glasses show low vesicularity and CO2 depletion. These findings demonstrate that conventional seafloor sampling misses critical petrological complexities of EM1-type mantle heterogeneities, which are instead preserved within the interior of petit-spot volcanic systems.
国际大洋发现计划（IODP）502航次首次对沉积物覆盖的小热点火山进行科学钻探，获取了其内部岩浆系统的玄武岩样品。地球化学与同位素分析显示，这些玄武岩具有富Ni橄榄石、低Mg#、富SiO2及富Ba等独特特征，并具有极强的EM1型Sr-Nd同位素特征。热力学模拟表明，该特征无法仅通过橄榄岩熔体的结晶分……

t: Geochemical and isotopic analysis combined with thermodynamic modeling of fractional crystallization to evaluate peridotite versus pyroxenite mantle sources.
结合地球化学与同位素分析，利用热力学模拟评估橄榄岩与辉石岩地幔源区。
Basaltic cores and fresh glasses recovered from the interior of a sediment-buried petit-spot volcano during IODP Expedition 502.
IODP 502航次从沉积物覆盖的小热点火山内部钻取回收的玄武岩岩心和新鲜玻璃。
Recovered basalts exhibit EM1-like Sr-Nd isotopes, Ni-rich olivine, and SiO2-rich compositions, requiring an enriched SiO2-excess pyroxenite mantle source.
玄武岩呈EM1型同位素特征及富SiO2成分，表明存在富集型富SiO2辉石岩地幔源。
The study is limited to a single drilled petit-spot site, and thermodynamic models simplify complex multi-component mantle melting processes.
研究局限于单一钻探点位，且热力学模型简化了复杂的多组分地幔熔融过程。
First drilling of a buried petit-spot volcano interior, revealing hidden mantle heterogeneities missed by conventional seafloor dredging.
首次钻探隐伏小热点火山内部，揭示了常规海底拖网无法发现的深部地幔非均匀性。

Identification of a highly enriched EM1-like Sr-Nd isotopic signature and unique geochemical features (Ni-rich olivine, low Mg#, SiO2-rich bulk).
Demonstration of SiO2-excess pyroxenite contribution to petit-spot magmas using thermodynamic modeling.
首次对沉积物覆盖的小热点火山进行科学钻探（IODP 502航次），获取了其内部玄武岩样品。
发现了高度富集的类EM1型Sr-Nd同位素特征及独特的地球化学特征（富Ni橄榄石、低Mg#、富SiO2全岩）。

sum: Accurate calibration of broadband seismometers is critical for global seismic networks, yet systems to measure the temperature coefficient of tri-axial seismometer sensitivity were previously lacking. This study develops a calibration system combining a triaxial vibration exciter with a thermostatic chamber to test four broadband seismometers (two Trillium Compact 120s, a Trillium Horizon 360, and a CMG-3T) across temperatures from −15°C to +45°C. Comparing sensor outputs against laser-calibrated reference servo accelerometers and internal calibration coils, the authors found a consistent linear midband sensitivity temperature coefficient of (0.11 ± 0.01) %/°C across all tested models. This variation is primarily driven by the temperature dependence of the internal NdFeB permanent magnet paired with the feedback coil. In contrast, output time delay variations were under 2 ms, and the low-frequency cutoff varied within 1%. Monitoring site temperature within 8°C is recommended to maintain 1% network calibration accuracy.
本研究开发了一套结合三轴振动台与恒温箱的标定系统，在−15°C至+45°C范围内测试了四台宽频带地震仪（两台Trillium Compact、一台Trillium Horizon 360和一台CMG-3T）。通过与激光干涉仪标定的参考伺服加速度计及内部标定线圈对比，发现所有测试地震仪的中频灵敏度均随……

t: A thermostatic chamber mounted on a triaxial vibration exciter applies 1–5 Hz sinusoidal vibrations at temperatures from −15°C to +45°C, comparing seismometer outputs against laser-calibrated reference accelerometers and internal calibration coils.
将恒温箱固定在三轴振动台上，在−15°C至+45°C下施加正弦振动，对比参考加速度计与内部线圈标定地震仪。
Laboratory calibration recordings across six temperature steps (−15°C to +45°C) for four commercial broadband sensors: two Trillium Compact 120s, one Trillium Horizon 360, and one Güralp CMG-3T.
四台商用宽频带地震仪（两台TC120、一台TH360和一台CMG-3T）在6个温度点的实验室标定数据。

Midband sensitivity varied linearly with a temperature coefficient of (0.11 ± 0.01) %/°C across all sensors, driven by an inverse ~−0.10 %/°C variation in the coil-magnet coefficient, while time delays stayed under 2 ms.
所有传感器的中频灵敏度温度系数均为(0.11±0.01)%/°C，主要由线圈磁体引起，时间延迟变化小于2 ms。
For Trillium Horizon 360 and CMG-3T, the ~2.7 mHz cutoff frequency lies below the > 4 mHz measurement band, introducing fitting errors in low-frequency cutoff temperature trends.
TH360和CMG-3T约2.7 mHz的截止频率低于4 mHz的测量下限，导致低频截止拟合误差较大。

First laboratory system combining a triaxial exciter and thermostatic chamber to systematically quantify absolute triaxial sensitivity, phase shift, and coil temperature coefficients in large broadband seismometers.
首次建立结合三轴振动台与恒温箱的实验系统，系统量化了大型三轴宽频带地震仪的温度灵敏度与相位特性。

kc: Developed a triaxial vibration exciter and thermostatic chamber system to calibrate broadband seismometers from −15°C to +45°C.
Determined a universal midband sensitivity temperature coefficient of (0.11 ± 0.01) %/°C across three commercial broadband seismometer models.
Identified the internal feedback permanent magnet (coil coefficient G_coil) as the primary physical source of sensitivity temperature dependence.
Demonstrated that phase delay variations (< 2 ms) and low-frequency cutoff shifts (< 1%) are negligible for standard seismic network operations.
开发了结合三轴振动激励器与恒温箱的测试系统，可在−15°C至+45°C范围内标定宽频带地震仪。
测定了三种主流商用宽频带地震仪的中频灵敏度温度系数，均约为(0.11 ± 0.01) %/°C。
揭示了与反馈线圈配对的内部永磁体（线圈系数G_coil）是灵敏度温度依赖性的主要物理来源。
证明了全温区内相位延迟变化（< 2 ms）和低频截止频率偏移（< 1%）对常规地震观测影响可忽略。
me: Combined a triaxial vibration exciter with a thermostatic chamber to apply orthogonal sinusoidal vibrations (1–5 Hz) at stabilized temperatures.
Calculated absolute midband sensitivity (1–1.6 Hz) by comparing seismometer output voltage against pre-calibrated reference servo accelerometers.
Measured relative frequency response (4 mHz to 1 Hz) and coil coefficients using electromagnetic excitation of the internal calibration coil.
将三轴振动台与恒温箱结合，在稳定温度点施加1–5 Hz的三轴正弦振动激励。
通过对比受试地震仪与预先经激光干涉仪标定的参考伺服加速度计的输出电压，计算1–1.6 Hz的绝对中频灵敏度。
利用内部标定线圈施加4 mHz至1 Hz正弦电压，测量相对频率响应、低频截止频率及线圈系数。
de: Tested four broadband seismometers: two Nanometrics Trillium Compact (TC120), one Nanometrics Trillium Horizon 360 (TH360), and one Güralp CMG-3T.
Conducted overnight temperature stabilization tests at −15°C, 0°C, +15°C, +23°C, +30°C, and +45°C with power supplies and digitizers kept at 23°C.
Validated reference servo accelerometers against an external laser interferometer following ISO 16063-11 from −20°C to +75°C.
测试了四台宽频带地震仪：两台Trillium Compact (TC120)、一台Trillium Horizon 360 (TH360)和一台CMG-3T。
在−15°C、0°C、+15°C、+23°C、+30°C和+45°C六个温度点进行过夜恒温稳定测试，电源和采集器置于23°C室温环境。
遵循ISO 16063-11标准，使用外部激光干涉仪在−20°C至+75°C范围内对参考伺服加速度计进行了初级标定验证。

Detailed component-level investigation of the internal magnets and electronics was beyond the scope of the study due to proprietary designs.
TH360和CMG-3T的极低截止频率（约2.7 mHz）超出了测量频率下限（> 4 mHz），导致拟合误差较大。
受限于商业地震仪内部元件详细参数的保密性，未能对内部磁体和电子元件进行更深入的组件级物理测试。

tm.why: The paper develops an experimental system to measure and calibrate the temperature dependence of broadband seismometer sensitivity, phase shift, and low-frequency cutoff.

sum: Accurate seismic imaging in deep, low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) regions of faulted basins is often hindered by rapid lateral velocity variations and complex intrastratal faults. This paper proposes a pre-stack depth migration (PSDM) velocity modeling workflow constrained by multiple information sources. First, an initial velocity model splices shallow velocities from micro-logging-constrained first-arrival inversion with intermediate-to-deep interval velocities converted from root-mean-square velocities via horizon-constrained velocity inversion (CVI). Next, model-based tomography iteratively analyzes residual velocities horizon-by-horizon from top to bottom to establish a low-frequency structural velocity framework. Finally, multi-attribute constrained grid tomography—incorporating well logs, horizons, dip, azimuth, and continuity volumes—iteratively refines high-resolution interval velocities from coarse (800×800 m) to fine (100×100 m) grids. Applied to 3-D field data from Block H in an eastern China oilfield, the workflow accurately captures a 3000–4000 m velocity inversion, flattens common imaging point gathers, and sharply delineates deep basement boundaries and steep faults.
针对断陷盆地深层低信噪比区速度横向变化快、小断层发育导致的成像难题，本文提出了一种多信息约束的叠前深度偏移（PSDM）速度建模流程。该方法首先拼接微测井约束的浅层初至波反演速度与层位约束速度反演（CVI）得到的中深层层速度以建立初始模型；随后采用基于模型的层析反演自上而下逐层迭代消除残差，建立反映盆……

t: A three-step PSDM velocity modeling workflow integrating shallow micro-logging first-arrival inversion and mid-deep CVI for the initial model, top-to-bottom model-based tomography for macro-trends, and multi-attribute constrained grid tomography for interval refinement.
融合浅层微测井初至反演、中深层CVI初始建模、逐层模型层析及多属性网格层析的三步PSDM速度建模方法。
3-D seismic reflection data, micro-logging, and well logs from Block H in a faulted basin in an eastern China oilfield, targeting deep, low-SNR Cretaceous formations with complex faults.
中国东部某油田断陷盆地H区块三维地震资料、微测井及钻井数据，目标为深埋低信噪比白垩系复杂断层区。

Iterative residual velocity analysis reduced deep horizon lateral time residuals from ~0.03 s to near zero, accurately captured a velocity inversion at 3000–4000 m in Well A, and improved basement and steep-fault PSDM imaging.
深层第11层位剩余时差由约0.03 s收敛至近零，准确刻画A井3000–4000 m速度反转，改善基底与陡断层成像。
The workflow demands higher computational effort than conventional methods and depends strongly on the reliability of interpreted horizons and pre-processed seismic attribute constraint volumes.
计算与人工迭代工作量较大，且高度依赖解释层位可靠性及属性约束体的去噪质量。
Combines macro-scale structural control from horizon-guided model tomography with fine-scale multi-attribute grid tomography and shallow-to-deep velocity splicing for low-SNR faulted basins.
将浅中深拼接初始速度、基于模型的宏观趋势控制与多属性网格层析精细刻画相结合。

kc: Proposes a three-stage PSDM velocity modeling workflow combining initial spliced velocities, model-based structural tomography, and multi-attribute constrained grid tomography.
Constructs a robust initial depth-domain velocity model by splicing shallow micro-logging constrained first-arrival tomography with mid-to-deep horizon-constrained velocity inversion (CVI).

Demonstrates on 3-D seismic data from Block H in eastern China improved velocity matching with well logs (capturing a 3000–4000 m velocity inversion) and clearer imaging of deep basement and steep faults.
提出了结合拼接初始速度建模、基于模型的构造层析反演与多属性约束网格层析反演的三阶段PSDM速度建模工作流。
通过拼接浅层微测井约束初至波层析速度与中深层层位约束速度反演（CVI）层速度，构建了稳健的深度域初始速度模型。
在中国东部H区块三维地震数据中验证了该方法，实现了3000–4000 m速度反转段的井震速度吻合，并显著提升了深层基底和陡倾角断层的成像清晰度。

sum: This study utilizes shear-wave splitting of Moho P-to-S converted phases (Pms) from receiver functions at 198 stations to map crustal anisotropy, thickness, and Vp/Vs ratios across the Pamir. The results show strong crustal anisotropy (mean delay ~0.66 s) with a systematic rotation of fast-polarization directions. In the southern Pamir, convergence-parallel fast directions and low Vp/Vs ratios (1.60–1.72) indicate felsic bulk crust and the removal of mafic lower crust. Conversely, northern Pamir exhibits orogen-parallel fast directions indicating pure-shear thickening. These findings support a geodynamic model of Indian-lithosphere-induced delamination of the Pamir lithosphere rather than uniform southward subduction of the Asian lithosphere.

sum: Geophysical inverse problems often use Generative Neural Networks (GNNs) to encode geological priors into a low-dimensional latent space. However, if the true Earth lies outside the learned generative manifold, standard latent-space inversion fails. This paper proposes a Bayesian model-space inversion method that uses the GNN generative manifold as a soft guide rather than a strict constraint. By defining a Gaussian prior around the autoencoder reconstruction in the high-dimensional model space, the solution can deviate from the manifold to fit observed data. The authors validate the method using Metropolis-Hastings MCMC on four synthetic non-linear travel-time tomography experiments based on MNIST digits and SedSimple sedimentary simulations. Results show that uniform priors yield blurry models with high uncertainty, and latent-space inversions produce overconfident errors on off-manifold targets. Conversely, the proposed GNN-informed model-space inversion accurately recovers off-manifold structures with low relative error and uncertainty.
地球物理反演常利用生成式神经网络（GNN）将地质先验编码至低维潜在空间，但当真实地下模型位于生成流形之外时，标准潜在空间反演会失效。本文提出一种贝叶斯模型空间反演方法，利用对抗自编码器（AAE）的生成流形作为引导而非严格约束。通过在模型空间定义围绕流形重构的高斯先验，结合Metropolis-Has……

Latent-space inversion fails on off-manifold targets with overconfident, high relative errors, while GNN-informed model-space inversion successfully recovers small-scale off-manifold features with low relative error and low uncertainty.

Because prior information cannot constrain features outside the GNN manifold, recovering off-manifold structures requires increased data coverage (more sources and receivers), and tuning the off-manifold uncertainty parameter tau^2.

sum: This review paper synthesizes structural geology, geomechanics, geochemistry, and operational data from major CO2 storage projects (e.g., Sleipner, Quest, In Salah) to evaluate fault behavior. It addresses how faults act as barriers, conduits, or seismic sources under pressure, thermal, and geochemical perturbations. The authors highlight that while no measurable fault-related leakage has been documented, microseismicity is common, including recent ML > 4.0 events near Quest. The paper reviews across-fault sealing proxies, leakage risks, and induced seismicity mechanisms, identifying key data classes and coupled workflows to establish robust risk envelopes for industrial-scale carbon capture and storage (CCS).

sum: This study analyzes the 2010 Jiashian earthquake sequence in southwestern Taiwan to resolve its complex fault geometry. By integrating an enhanced earthquake catalog, local seismic tomography, and focal mechanism inversions, the authors delineate the active fault structures and velocity variations associated with the sequence. The results provide critical insights into the seismotectonics of the region, highlighting the role of pre-existing structures and stress distribution in controlling the rupture behavior and spatial distribution of aftershocks.

sum: Full waveform inversion (FWI) is highly nonlinear and ill-posed under noisy or incomplete data. While Annealed Stein Variational Gradient Descent (ASVGD) enables particle-based Bayesian FWI and uncertainty quantification, it typically relies on simple handcrafted priors that fail to capture complex geological structures. This paper introduces a diffusion-regularized ASVGD-FWI framework where a denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM), pretrained on 50,000 velocity models from the GeoFWI dataset, serves as an implicit geological projection operator via shaping regularization. Instead of only initializing or post-processing particles, the diffusion prior guides particle updates at every iteration alongside data likelihood and kernel repulsion. Validated on synthetic Marmousi and Overthrust benchmarks and an offshore China field dataset, the method reduces inversion artifacts, yields sharper interfaces (reducing Overthrust MAE from 173 to 153), and produces more focused reverse-time migration images while concentrating posterior uncertainty around poorly constrained, structurally complex regions.
全波形反演（FWI）具有强非线性和不适定性。退火Stein变分梯度下降（ASVGD）虽能实现贝叶斯FWI和不确定性量化，但常依赖简单手工先验。本文提出扩散正则化ASVGD-FWI框架，利用在GeoFWI数据集（约5万个速度模型）上预训练的去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM），通过整形正则化算子在每次迭代中直……

t: The method integrates a pretrained U-Net diffusion model into annealed SVGD FWI via a splitting-based shaping regularization scheme, projecting particles updated by data-likelihood and kernel-repulsion forces onto a learned geological manifold.
通过分裂整形正则化将预训练U-Net扩散模型嵌入退火SVGD，将更新后的粒子投影到地质流形。
The diffusion prior is trained on 50,000 GeoFWI models (100x100 grid), and the inversion is tested on noisy synthetic Marmousi and Overthrust models and a 40-shot offshore China marine dataset.

Diffusion-guided ASVGD outperforms classic ASVGD on Marmousi (MAE 92.68 vs 94.80, SSIM 0.72 vs 0.69) and Overthrust (MAE 153 vs 173, SNR 25.3 vs 24.7 dB), with only ~11% extra runtime (964 s vs 870 s).

Because the diffusion model is trained on fixed 100x100 models, inversions on larger grids require overlapping patch decomposition, and performance relies heavily on training dataset diversity and starting timestep selection.
