Instead of using diffusion models only for particle initialization or post-processing, the pretrained diffusion model is embedded directly into the ASVGD update as an implicit regularization operator.
并非仅用于粒子初始化或后处理，而是将预训练扩散模型作为隐式正则化项直接融入SVGD每次迭代更新。

kc: Integrates a pretrained diffusion model directly into the ASVGD particle update loop via shaping regularization as an implicit geological projection operator.
Demonstrates superior structural fidelity and reduced model error compared to classic ASVGD on synthetic Marmousi and Overthrust benchmarks, even at 2 dB SNR.
Validates the workflow on offshore China field data, achieving more geologically consistent velocity models and better-focused reverse-time migration (RTM) images and ADCIGs.
通过整形正则化将预训练扩散模型作为隐式地质投影算子直接集成到ASVGD粒子更新循环中。
在Marmousi和Overthrust合成基准测试（甚至2 dB低信噪比）中，相比传统ASVGD展现出更高的结构保真度和更低的模型误差。
在中国近海实际数据上验证了该流程，获得了地质一致性更好的速度模型以及更聚焦的逆时偏移（RTM）成像和角道集。
me: Pretraining a U-Net based Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model (DDPM) on the 50,000-sample GeoFWI velocity dataset.
Annealed Stein Variational Gradient Descent (ASVGD) with a radial basis function (RBF) kernel and hyperbolic tangent temperature schedule.
Splitting-based shaping regularization that projects ASVGD-updated velocity particles onto the learned geological manifold using overlapping 100x100 patches.
Acoustic wave equation forward modeling and automatic differentiation adjoint gradients implemented via Deepwave and PyTorch.
在包含5万个样本的GeoFWI速度数据集上预训练基于U-Net的去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）。
采用径向基函数（RBF）核与双曲正切温度退火调度的退火Stein变分梯度下降（ASVGD）。
基于分裂格式的整形正则化，利用重叠的100x100分块策略将ASVGD更新后的速度粒子投影到学习到的地质流形上。
基于Deepwave和PyTorch自动微分实现的声波方程正演模拟与伴随梯度计算。
de: GeoFWI dataset (~50,000 synthetic 100x100 velocity models with 2-11 layers, folds, faults, and salt bodies) for diffusion prior training.
Marmousi synthetic benchmark (100x216 grid, 5 shots, 7 Hz Ricker wavelet, DSNR = 15.7 dB, 50 initial GRF-perturbed particles).
Overthrust synthetic benchmark (100x401 grid, 10 shots, 5 Hz Ricker wavelet, DSNR = 16.9 dB and 2 dB noise sensitivity test, 50 vs 100 particles test).
Offshore China marine field dataset (201x301 grid, 40 shots at 200 m spacing, 240 traces per shot at 25 m spacing, bandpass filtered 5-15 Hz) evaluated via RTM and ADCIGs.
用于训练扩散先验的GeoFWI数据集（约5万个100x100网格的合成速度模型，含褶皱、断层和盐丘）。
Marmousi合成模型实验（100x216网格，5炮，7 Hz雷克子波，信噪比15.7 dB，50个高斯随机场扰动初始粒子）。
Overthrust合成模型实验（100x401网格，10炮，5 Hz雷克子波，测试16.9 dB与2 dB信噪比及50与100个粒子对比）。
中国近海海洋实际地震数据实验（201x301网格，40炮，每炮240道，5-15 Hz带通滤波），并通过RTM和角道集评估。
li: Fixed 100x100 input size of the GeoFWI-trained diffusion model requires an overlapping patch-based strategy with shift size tuning to avoid boundary artifacts.
Inversion performance depends on the diversity and geological plausibility of the synthetic training dataset used for the diffusion prior.
Under strong noise (2 dB DSNR), the posterior mean model still becomes less continuous and exhibits local perturbations in deep and boundary regions.
基于GeoFWI训练的扩散模型输入尺寸固定为100x100，需采用重叠分块策略并调节步长以避免边界伪影。
反演性能依赖于用于训练扩散先验的数据集的地质合理性与结构多样性。
在强噪声（信噪比2 dB）下，后验均值模型在深部和边界区域仍会出现连续性下降和局部扰动。

tm.why: The paper develops an improved Bayesian full-waveform inversion (FWI) framework to reconstruct high-resolution subsurface velocity models.
The core algorithm uses Annealed Stein Variational Gradient Descent (ASVGD) to approximate the posterior distribution and quantify uncertainty in FWI.
A pretrained denoising diffusion probabilistic model (DDPM) is incorporated as a learned geological projection operator to regularize the inversion.

ev.notes: Full 26-page PDF analyzed, including mathematical formulations in Section 2, synthetic and field data experiments in Section 3, sensitivity discussions in Section 4, all 21 figures, and 2 tables.

sum: This study analyzes deformation fabrics, melt compositions, metamorphic temperatures, and paleopiezometry in the metamorphic sole beneath the Tsiknias Thrust, Tinos, Greece, representing a Late-Cretaceous subduction interface at ~30 km depth (0.85 GPa). Using amphibole-plagioclase geothermometry and EBSD subgrain-size piezometry, the authors find a background temperature of ~600°C and interseismic shear stresses of 30–60 MPa (median 40 MPa). However, within 10 m of the thrust, apparent temperatures reach 675–775°C, and the host amphibolites are cut by plagioclase-rich (anorthositic) veins with quench textures, skeletal spinels, and ilmenite enrichment. Thermodynamic modeling shows these veins cannot result from equilibrium partial melting, but instead match non-equilibrium sequential frictional melting of amphibole and plagioclase during seismic slip. Vein thicknesses of 1–10 mm imply coseismic energy dissipation of >=10^7 J/m^2, demonstrating that major (Mw >= 7) earthquakes drive transient heating and melting in ophiolitic metamorphic soles, largely obscured later by interseismic ductile creep.
本研究分析了希腊蒂诺斯岛锡克尼亚斯逆冲断层下变质底辟的变形组构、熔体成分、变质温度和古应力计数据，该处代表约30公里深（0.85 GPa）的晚白垩世俯冲界面。利用角闪石-斜长石地质温度计和EBSD亚晶粒尺寸古应力计，测得背景温度约600°C，震间剪切应力为30-60 MPa（中位数40 MPa）。然……

t: The authors combine amphibole-plagioclase geothermometry, EBSD subgrain-size paleopiezometry, and Theriak-Domino thermodynamic phase equilibria modeling with microstructural analysis to evaluate temperature, shear stress, and melting mechanisms beneath the Tsiknias Thrust.
结合角闪石-斜长石温度计、EBSD亚晶粒尺寸古应力计、热力学相平衡模拟及显微构造分析。

Amphibolite samples collected along transects beneath the Tsiknias Thrust on Tinos, Greece, analyzed via electron probe microanalysis (EPMA), EBSD mapping, BSE imaging, and whole-rock major element geochemistry.
采集锡克尼亚斯逆冲断层下剖面的角闪岩样品，进行EPMA、EBSD、BSE成像和全岩主量元素分析。

Background metamorphic temperatures are ~580–630°C with interseismic shear stresses of 30–60 MPa (median 40 MPa), while the top 10 m records apparent temperatures of 675–775°C and 1–10 mm coseismic plagioclase melt veins requiring >=3x10^7 J/m^2.
背景温度约580–630°C，震间剪切应力30–60 MPa；顶部10米表观温度达675–775°C并发育同震斜长石熔体…

Interseismic ductile deformation obscures most coseismic melting records, subgrain piezometry may underestimate peak stresses during seismic cycles, and scarce amphibole rheological data prevent quantitative creep-rate testing.
震间韧性变形掩盖了大部分同震熔融记录，且缺乏角闪石流变学实验数据。

Identifies reworked coseismic frictional melt veins in an ophiolitic metamorphic sole, proving that steep temperature inversions beneath ophiolites can result from Mw >= 7 subduction earthquakes rather than hot young slabs.
在蛇绿岩变质底辟中识别出同震摩擦熔融脉，证明陡峭温度倒转可由7级以上俯冲地震产生。

kc: Demonstrates that anorthositic veins and leucocratic pods in the top 10 m beneath the Tsiknias Thrust originated from non-equilibrium coseismic frictional melting rather than equilibrium partial melting.
Determines ambient subduction interface conditions at ~30 km depth of ~600°C background temperature and 30–60 MPa (median 40 MPa) interseismic shear stress via EBSD subgrain-size piezometry.

Shows that steep apparent temperature inversions (up to ~775°C over 10 m) and 1–10 mm melt veins can be explained by transient frictional heating (~3x10^7 J/m^2 breakdown work) during Mw >= 7 earthquakes, without requiring young hot lithosphere or structural excision.
证明锡克尼亚斯逆冲断层下10米内的斜长岩脉和浅色体源于非平衡同震摩擦熔融，而非平衡部分熔融。
通过EBSD亚晶粒尺寸古应力计，确定了约30公里深处俯冲界面的环境条件：背景温度约600°C，震间剪切应力为30–60 MPa（中位数40 MPa）。
表明陡峭的表观温度倒转（10米内高达约775°C）和1–10毫米熔体脉可由7级以上地震期间的瞬态摩擦生热（约3x10^7 J/m^2破裂功）解释，无需年轻热岩石圈或构造缺失。
me: Amphibole-plagioclase geothermometry (Holland & Blundy, 1994) using electron probe microanalysis (EPMA) across varying spatial radii to test for disequilibrium.
Electron-backscatter diffraction (EBSD) mapping and subgrain-size paleopiezometry (Goddard et al., 2020) on plagioclase and amphibole to estimate interseismic shear stress.
Gibbs free energy minimization thermodynamic modeling (Theriak-Domino) to compare equilibrium partial melt compositions with observed vein geochemistry.
Microstructural and geochemical analysis using optical microscopy, backscattered electron (BSE) imaging, and energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS).
利用电子探针（EPMA）在不同空间半径下进行角闪石-斜长石地质温度计分析（Holland & Blundy, 1994），以检验非平衡状态。
对斜长石和角闪石进行电子背散射衍射（EBSD）制图和亚晶粒尺寸古应力计分析（Goddard et al., 2020），以估算震间剪切应力。
利用吉布斯自由能最小化热力学模拟（Theriak-Domino），将平衡部分熔融成分与观测到的岩脉地球化学成分进行对比。
利用光学显微镜、背散射电子（BSE）成像和能谱分析（EDS）进行显微构造和地球化学分析。
de: Field structural measurements and rock samples from three transects (Livada Bay, SW Tsiknias Oros, Kolimpithra Bay) across the metamorphic sole of the Tinos Ophiolite.
EPMA mineral chemistry dataset for amphibole-plagioclase pairs across 20 samples spanning 0 to 380 m structural depth beneath the Tsiknias Thrust.
EBSD microstructural orientation maps on 7 amphibolite samples from 0 to 78 m depth beneath the thrust.
Whole-rock major element geochemistry of host amphibolites and separated plagioclase veins.
来自蒂诺斯蛇绿岩变质底辟三条剖面（Livada湾、Tsiknias Oros西南、Kolimpithra湾）的野外构造测量和岩石样品。
锡克尼亚斯逆冲断层下0至380米构造深度范围内20个样品的角闪石-斜长石对EPMA矿物化学数据集。
断层下0至78米深度7个角闪岩样品的EBSD显微构造取向图。
主岩角闪岩和分离出的斜长石脉的全岩主量元素地球化学数据。
li: Ductile deformation during interseismic intervals pervasively reworks and obscures coseismic melt features, leaving only the last few earthquake records discernible.
Subgrain-size piezometry reflects interseismic creep stresses and may underestimate peak coseismic shear stresses due to fluctuating stress during the seismic cycle.
Experimental rheological data for amphibole are too scarce to quantitatively test the partition between seismic slip and ductile creep rates.
震间期的韧性变形普遍改造并掩盖了同震熔融特征，仅留下最后几次地震记录可供识别。
亚晶粒尺寸古应力计反映的是震间蠕变应力，由于地震周期中的应力波动，可能低估了峰值同震剪切应力。
角闪石的实验流变学数据过于匮乏，无法定量检验地震滑动与韧性蠕变速率之间的分配比例。

tm.why: The paper estimates coseismic energy dissipation (fracture energy) of >=10^7 J/m^2 from frictional melt veins, linking them to Mw >= 7 earthquakes on an ancient subduction interface.
It investigates fault zone mechanics, paleopiezometric shear stresses (30-60 MPa), coseismic frictional melting, and interseismic ductile shearing along the Tsiknias Thrust.
The study examines the metamorphic sole of the Tinos Ophiolite to constrain thermal and mechanical conditions of an ancient subduction plate boundary at ~30 km depth.

ev.notes: Full 30-page PDF including text, 12 main figures, 2 main tables, and Appendix A (4 figures, 1 table) was read and analyzed.

sum: This study evaluates seismic source discrimination for 210 small-magnitude (ML ≤ 3.5) events at local distances (≤350 km) in the United Kingdom. The authors demonstrate that high-frequency (>8 Hz) network-averaged P/S amplitude ratios successfully distinguish earthquakes from explosions, while lower frequencies (2–4 Hz) separate offshore explosions and quarry blasts. Although a path and site correction model reduces ratio variability, simple network averaging remains the most critical step for effective discrimination. Additionally, applying a convolutional neural network pre-trained on French seismic data yields high classification accuracy in the UK. Combining these CNN predictions with high-frequency P/S ratios further enables the identification of longwall mining-induced earthquakes. The findings show that P/S ratios and machine learning are robust tools for local-distance source discrimination.
本研究评估了英国近距离（≤350 km）小震级（ML≤3.5）事件的震源识别方法。结果表明，高频（>8 Hz）台网平均P/S振幅比能有效区分地震与爆炸，而低频（2-4 Hz）可区分海上爆炸与采石场爆破。虽然路径和场地校正能降低变率，但台网平均是实现有效识别的关键。此外，将在法国数据上预训练的卷积神经……

t: P/S amplitude ratio analysis across multiple frequency bands combined with a pre-trained convolutional neural network classifier.
结合多频段P/S振幅比分析与预训练卷积神经网络分类器进行震源识别。
Seismic waveforms from 210 small-magnitude (ML ≤ 3.5) earthquakes, explosions, and quarry blasts recorded at local distances in the UK.
英国近距离记录到的210个小震级（ML≤3.5）地震、爆炸和采石场爆破的地震波形数据。
High-frequency (>8 Hz) network-averaged P/S ratios successfully discriminate earthquakes and explosions, while combining P/S ratios with CNN predictions identifies mining-induced events.
高频（>8 Hz）台网平均P/S比成功区分了地震与爆炸，结合CNN预测可进一步识别矿震。
The transferability of the machine learning model relies on geological similarities between the training (France) and target (UK) regions.
机器学习模型的迁移能力依赖于训练区（法国）与目标区（英国）之间的地质相似性。
Extending P/S ratio discrimination to small-magnitude local events in the UK and demonstrating cross-border transferability of a pre-trained deep learning model.
将P/S比识别拓展至英国本地小震级事件，并证实了预训练深度学习模型的跨国迁移能力。

kc: Demonstrated that high-frequency (>8 Hz) network-averaged P/S ratios can discriminate small-magnitude (ML ≤ 3.5) earthquakes and explosions at local distances in the UK.
Showed that low-frequency (2-4 Hz) P/S ratios can separate offshore explosions from quarry blasts.
Successfully transferred a convolutional neural network pre-trained on French seismic data to classify UK events, showing high cross-border model generalizability.
Combined CNN predictions with P/S ratios to identify longwall mining-induced earthquakes.
证实了高频（>8 Hz）台网平均P/S比能有效识别英国近距离小震级（ML ≤ 3.5）地震与爆炸。
表明低频（2-4 Hz）P/S比可以区分海上爆炸与采石场爆破。
成功将基于法国地震数据预训练的卷积神经网络迁移应用于英国事件分类，展示了高跨国模型泛化性。
结合CNN预测与P/S比，实现了对长壁开采诱发矿震的有效识别。
me: P/S amplitude ratio analysis across multiple frequency bands (2-4 Hz and >8 Hz).
Network-averaging of amplitude ratios to suppress path and site effects.
Path and site amplitude correction modeling.
Transfer learning/application of a pre-trained Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) classifier.
多频段（2-4 Hz和>8 Hz）P/S振幅比分析。
通过台网平均压制路径和场地效应。
路径与场地振幅校正建模。
预训练卷积神经网络（CNN）分类器的迁移应用。
de: Seismic waveform data from 210 small-magnitude (ML ≤ 3.5) seismic events in the United Kingdom recorded at local distances (≤350 km).
英国近距离（≤350 km）记录到的210个小震级（ML ≤ 3.5）地震事件的波形数据。
li: The transferability of the machine learning model depends on geological similarities between the training region (France) and the target region (UK).
Discrimination of specific event types (like mining-induced earthquakes) requires combining multiple metrics rather than a single classifier.
机器学习模型的迁移能力依赖于训练区（法国）与目标区（英国）之间的地质相似性。
识别特定事件类型（如矿震）需要结合多种指标，而非依赖单一分类器。

tm.why: The paper focuses on discriminating earthquakes from explosions and other seismic sources to improve catalog accuracy.
The study applies a pre-trained convolutional neural network to classify seismic sources in the UK.
The paper addresses the discrimination of quarry blasts and longwall mining-induced earthquakes.

ev.notes: The analysis is based on the provided abstract and Crossref metadata as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the fate of the subducting Pacific slab beneath the Kamchatka Peninsula using 1,696 P-to-S receiver functions recorded at 84 seismic stations from 1990 to 2023. Common conversion point stacking with 3D velocity corrections (TX2019slab and Jiang2009Vp) maps the 410-km, 520-km, and 660-km discontinuities. Beneath northern Kamchatka, the mantle transition zone (MTZ) thins by 18–21 km, corresponding to a 150–180 K thermal anomaly. This argues against a stagnant detached slab fragment in the MTZ and instead supports deep semi-toroidal mantle upwelling around the slab edge that thermally modifies the slab margin. Conversely, southwestern Kamchatka exhibits a thickened MTZ (278 ± 12 km) and a prominent P520s arrival, indicating penetration of a cold, likely hydrated Cretaceous Pacific slab to the base of the MTZ. These findings provide new observational constraints on along-strike variations in slab-mantle interactions.
本研究利用1990至2023年间84个台站记录的1696条P-S接收函数，通过共转换点叠加和三维速度校正，成像了堪察加半岛下方的地幔转换带（MTZ）间断面。结果显示，堪察加北部MTZ减薄18–21 km（对应150–180 K热异常），排除了大型冷断离板片滞留于MTZ的假说，支持深达MTZ的半环状板……

t: Radial P-to-S receiver functions are computed by deconvolving vertical from radial components, moveout-corrected with IASP91, stacked in 1° circular CCP bins at 535 km piercing depth, and corrected using 3D velocity models.
通过径向与垂向分量反褶积计算P-S接收函数，经IASP91动校正后在535 km深度1°网格叠加，并作三维速度校正。
1,696 high-quality teleseismic P-wave receiver functions from 466 earthquakes (epicentral distances 30°–100°) recorded at 84 seismic stations across Kamchatka between 1990 and 2023.
1990–2023年间堪察加84个台站记录的466个远震事件，筛选出1696条高质量P波接收函数。

Northern Kamchatka (Subarea A) shows ~18–21 km MTZ thinning (232 ± 12 km after TX2019slab correction; ~150–180 K heating), whereas southwestern Kamchatka (Subarea C) shows MTZ thickening (283 ± 13 km) and strong P520s.
堪察加北部MTZ减薄18–21 km（校正后232±12 km，升温150–180 K），西南部加厚至283±13 km…
Receiver function observations cannot completely rule out small or laterally displaced detached slab fragments outside the study area, nor directly constrain the rate of slab-margin weakening.
无法完全排除研究区外存在小型断离板片碎片，也无法直接约束板片边缘热改造的速率。

Provides the first broad-coverage receiver-function constraints on the MTZ beneath northern Kamchatka, demonstrating that slab-edge mantle flow extends to MTZ depths and refuting a large stagnant detached slab.
首次利用广覆盖接收函数约束堪察加北部MTZ结构，证实板片边缘流深达MTZ并排除大型滞留断离板片。

kc: Maps the 410-km, 520-km, and 660-km discontinuities beneath the entire Kamchatka Peninsula using 1,696 P-to-S receiver functions with 3D velocity corrections.
Identifies 18–21 km MTZ thinning (150–180 K thermal anomaly) beneath northern Kamchatka, ruling out a large cold detached slab in the MTZ and supporting deep semi-toroidal slab-edge mantle flow.
Detects significant MTZ thickening (up to ~278–287 km) and a strong P520s phase beneath southwestern Kamchatka, indicating deep penetration of a cold, hydrated Pacific slab.
利用1696条P-S接收函数结合三维速度校正，绘制了整个堪察加半岛下方410 km、520 km和660 km间断面的起伏。
发现堪察加北部MTZ减薄18–21 km（150–180 K热异常），排除了MTZ内存在大型冷断离板片的可能，支持延伸至MTZ深度的半环状板片边缘地幔流。
在堪察加西南部探测到MTZ显著加厚（约278–287 km）及强P520s震相，表明冷且含水的太平洋板片深入MTZ底部。
me: Deconvolution of vertical from radial teleseismic P waveforms (0.02–0.2 Hz Bessel bandpass filter) to extract P-to-S receiver functions.
Common conversion point (CCP) stacking in 1° radius bins with ray-piercing points calculated at 535 km depth using the IASP91 model and 50-iteration bootstrap resampling.
3D velocity corrections of d410 and d660 depths and MTZ thickness using the global TX2019slab (Vp and Vs) and regional Jiang2009Vp models.
采用0.02–0.2 Hz贝塞尔带通滤波及径向与垂向分量反褶积提取远震P-S接收函数。
基于IASP91模型计算535 km深度射线穿刺点，在1°半径网格内进行共转换点（CCP）叠加及50次自举重采样误差估计。
利用全球TX2019slab模型（Vp和Vs）和区域Jiang2009Vp模型对d410、d660深度及MTZ厚度进行三维速度校正。
de: 1,696 quality-controlled radial P-wave receiver functions from 466 teleseismic events (epicentral distance 30°–100°).
Waveform recordings collected from 84 broadband stations across networks IM, IU, XJ, YC, and X9 (EarthScope and GEOFON) between 1990 and 2023.
来自466个远震事件（震中距30°–100°）并经质量控制的1696条径向P波接收函数。
1990至2023年间由EarthScope和GEOFON数据中心（IM、IU、XJ、YC、X9台网）84个宽频带台站收集的波形记录。
li: Uncertainties in the 3D tomographic velocity models used for depth corrections remain, especially for the P-wave-only regional model.
Receiver functions cannot completely exclude small or laterally displaced detached slab fragments outside the sampled study area or constrain the exact historical rate of slab margin weakening.
用于深度校正的三维层析成像速度模型仍存在不确定性，特别是仅包含P波的区域模型。
接收函数无法完全排除研究区外存在小型或侧向位移的断离板片碎片，也无法直接约束板片边缘弱化的具体速率与历史。

tm.why: The study uses 1,696 P-to-S receiver functions and CCP stacking to image the 410-km, 520-km, and 660-km mantle transition zone discontinuities beneath Kamchatka.
The results constrain slab penetration into the deep mantle and semi-toroidal mantle flow around the northern Pacific slab edge.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PDF analyzed, including abstract, main text, all 5 figures, and references.

sum: This study presents a conceptual geodynamic framework proposing that the contrast in hydraulic stress transmission between the solid elastic lithosphere and the partially molten, fluid-like asthenosphere provides a distributed horizontal driving force for plate tectonics. Based on mechanical principles of stress transmission, the model estimates a horizontal normal stress contrast of ~10^9 Pa at 70 km depth. It addresses the initiation of melt-induced microfractures and demonstrates that the predicted compressional stress (500–1500 MPa) significantly exceeds the lithospheric buckling limit (55–600 MPa), making subduction initiation mechanically feasible. This framework provides a quantitative physical explanation for Archean tectonics and trench formation.
本研究提出了一个地球动力学概念框架，认为固体弹性岩石圈与半熔融流体状软流圈之间的液压应力传递差异可为板块运动提供分布式的水平驱动力。基于应力传递的物理原理，估算出在约70公里深度处可产生约10^9帕的水平正应力差。该模型探讨了熔体微裂隙的萌生机制，并表明预测的挤压应力（500-1500 MPa）远超……

t: Analytical mechanical modeling and order-of-magnitude estimation of stress state differences between elastic solid and isotropic fluid.
弹性固体与各向同性流体之间应力状态差异的解析力学建模与数量级估算。
Theoretical physical parameters (Poisson's ratio, lithospheric thickness, rock strength) used for order-of-magnitude calculations.
用于数量级计算的理论物理参数（泊松比、岩石圈厚度、岩石强度）。
Horizontal stress contrast reaches ~10^9 Pa at 70 km depth, yielding compressional stresses of 500-1500 MPa, exceeding the lithospheric buckling limit (55-600 MPa).
在70公里深度处水平应力差达到约10^9帕，产生500-1500 MPa的挤压应力，超过了岩石圈弯曲临界应力（55-60…
The model is conceptual and simplified, lacking 3D numerical geodynamic simulations to validate the dynamic evolution.
该模型为概念性和简化模型，缺乏三维数值地球动力学模拟来验证其动态演化过程。
Introduces solid-fluid hydraulic stress contrast as a primary distributed horizontal driving force for plate tectonics.
引入固体-流体液压应力差作为板块构造的主要分布式水平驱动力。

kc: Proposed a new conceptual model of plate driving forces based on solid-fluid hydraulic stress contrast.
Estimated the horizontal normal stress contrast at the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary to be on the order of 10^9 Pa.
Demonstrated that the predicted compressional stress (500-1500 MPa) exceeds the lithospheric buckling limit, enabling subduction initiation.
Provided a mechanical explanation for the multi-plate, small-scale, fast-cycling tectonic style of the early Earth.
提出了一种基于固液液压应力差的板块驱动力新概念模型。
估算出岩石圈-软流圈边界处的水平正应力差可达10^9帕数量级。
论证了预测的挤压应力（500-1500 MPa）超过岩石圈弯曲临界应力，使俯冲启动在力学上可行。
为早期地球多板块、小尺度、快速循环的太古代构造样式提供了力学解释。
me: Analytical mechanical modeling of stress states in elastic solids versus isotropic fluids.
Order-of-magnitude estimation of horizontal normal stress contrasts at depth.
Mechanical feasibility analysis of lithospheric buckling and shear sliding under gravity.
弹性固体与各向同性流体中应力状态的解析力学建模。
深部水平正应力差的数量级估算。
重力场下岩石圈弯曲和剪切滑移的力学可行性分析。
de: Theoretical physical parameters of the lithosphere and asthenosphere (e.g., Poisson's ratio of 0.25, effective depth of 70 km, rock strength, and buckling limits).
岩石圈和软流圈的理论物理参数（如泊松比0.25、有效深度70 km、岩石强度和弯曲临界值）。
li: The model is highly conceptual and simplified, lacking 3D numerical geodynamic simulations to validate the dynamic evolution over geological time.
该模型具有高度的概念性和简化性，缺乏三维数值地球动力学模拟来验证其在地球历史时期的动态演化。

tm.why: The paper proposes a conceptual geodynamic model of lithosphere-asthenosphere coupling and plate driving forces.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is strictly based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata.

sum: This study explores the physical interaction between deep slow slip events (SSEs) and the megathrust seismic cycle. Utilizing numerical modeling of the subduction interface governed by rate-and-state friction, the authors evaluate how transient slow slip at depth transfers stress to the shallower locked seismogenic zone. The research highlights the critical role of deep SSEs in modulating the timing, size, and recurrence intervals of megathrust earthquakes, providing key theoretical insights into earthquake forecasting and hazard assessment in subduction zones.
本研究探讨了深部慢滑移事件（SSE）与俯冲带大地震周期之间的物理相互作用。通过对受速率-状态摩擦定律控制的俯冲界面进行数值模拟，作者评估了深部瞬态慢滑移如何向浅部锁定的发震带传递应力。研究强调了深部慢滑移在调节大地震发生时间、破裂规模和复现周期中的关键作用，为俯冲带地震预测和灾害评估提供了重要理论启……

t: Numerical modeling of subduction megathrust seismic cycles incorporating rate-and-state friction to simulate both seismic and aseismic slip.
结合速率-状态摩擦定律的俯冲带大地震周期数值模拟，用以模拟地震和无震滑移。
Synthetic simulations of subduction zone interfaces combined with conceptual comparison to geodetic observations of slow slip events.
俯冲带界面的合成数值模拟，并与慢滑移事件的大地测量观测进行概念性对比。
Deep slow slip events significantly modulate the stress state of the seismogenic zone, altering earthquake recurrence intervals and rupture patterns.
深部慢滑移事件显著调节发震带的应力状态，改变大地震的复现周期和破裂模式。
Simplified fault geometry and friction parameters that may not fully capture the 3D complexity of real subduction zones.
简化的断层几何和摩擦参数可能无法完全捕捉真实俯冲带的三维复杂性。
A comprehensive physical framework linking deep transient slow slip directly to the long-term megathrust seismic cycle dynamics.
建立了将深部瞬态慢滑移与长期大地震周期动力学直接联系起来的完整物理框架。

kc: Establishes a physical modeling framework linking deep slow slip events to megathrust seismic cycles.
Demonstrates how transient stress transfer from deep SSEs modulates the recurrence intervals of large earthquakes.
Provides insights into how slow slip can either delay or trigger megathrust ruptures depending on the cycle phase.
建立了将深部慢滑移事件与俯冲带大地震周期联系起来的物理模拟框架。
展示了深部慢滑移事件的瞬态应力传递如何调节大地震的复现周期。
揭示了慢滑移如何根据地震周期阶段延迟或触发大地震破裂。
me: Numerical modeling of seismic cycles on a subduction megathrust.
Application of rate-and-state friction laws to simulate both seismic and aseismic slip.
Stress transfer analysis from deep transient slip to the seismogenic zone.
俯冲带大地震断层地震周期的数值模拟。
应用速率-状态摩擦定律来模拟地震和无震滑移过程。
深部瞬态滑移向发震带的应力传递分析。
de: Synthetic simulations of subduction zone megathrusts under varying frictional properties.
Comparison of model behaviors with geodetic observations of slow slip events (e.g., GNSS/InSAR).
在不同摩擦属性下俯冲带大地震的合成数值模拟。
将模型行为与慢滑移事件的大地测量观测（如GNSS/InSAR）进行对比。
li: The simplified fault geometry and homogeneous friction parameters may not capture full 3D complexity.
Relies heavily on assumed rate-and-state friction parameters which are difficult to constrain in situ.
简化的断层几何形状和均匀的摩擦参数可能无法捕捉完整的三维复杂性。
高度依赖于假设的速率-状态摩擦参数，这些参数在原位很难约束。

tm.why: The paper directly investigates the role of deep slow slip events on the megathrust seismic cycle.
It models how slow slip transients transfer stress and influence megathrust rupture characteristics.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. Analysis is based on the paper title, author list, and their established research expertise in rate-and-state seismic cycle modeling and geodetic observations of slow slip.

sum: Precambrian cratonic keels exhibit anomalously high seismic shear velocities while remaining nearly neutrally buoyant. Using the global Rayleigh-wave tomographic model 3DLGL-TPESvoigt combined with geoid and isostatic density constraints, the authors perform a least-squares thermochemical inversion using Perple_X phase equilibria to map magnesium number (Mg#) and modal olivine content across global cratons. They find strong mantle depletion above 150 km (Mg# > 92) that decreases with depth toward the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary. However, major-element depletion alone leaves a 1%–3.5% shear-velocity deficit at 150 km depth. Testing alternative hypotheses shows that cooler temperatures, eclogite, chromium in garnet, or radial anisotropy cannot simultaneously satisfy seismic velocity and gravity observations. The simplest explanation is adding a small volume fraction of diamond (<1% over most cratons, locally up to 1.95% at 150 km) below the graphite-diamond transition, representing ~0.5% of mantle carbon.
前寒武纪克拉通岩石圈根部具有极高的剪切波速和近中性浮力。本研究结合全球瑞利波层析成像模型（3DLGL-TPESvoigt）与大地水准面及均衡密度约束，利用Perple_X热力学相平衡进行最小二乘反演，首次由地震学绘制了全球克拉通的镁指数（Mg#）和橄榄石含量分布图。结果表明150 km以上存在强烈亏……

t: Regularized least-squares inversion at each cratonic location and depth minimizing differences between tomographic shear velocity, isostatic/geoid density profiles, and Perple_X mineralogical predictions parameterized by Mg# and Si#.
基于Perple_X热力学计算，在各克拉通网格和深度对波速和均衡密度进行正则化最小二乘反演求取Mg#和Si#。

The global upper-mantle shear-velocity model 3DLGL-TPESv (version 2022-11), derived from waveform inversion of 2,008,820 vertical-component Rayleigh wave seismograms with ~600 km lateral and ~50 km vertical resolution.
基于2,008,820条瑞利波波形反演的全球上地幔S波速度模型3DLGL-TPESv及大地水准面密度约束。

Shallow cratonic mantle (<150 km) shows strong depletion (Mg# 92–94, mean ~92.5), while adding <1% diamond volume fraction (up to 1.95% locally) at 150 km explains residual 1%–3.5% fast velocity misfits.
150 km以浅地幔强烈亏损（平均Mg#≈92.5），在150 km加入<1%（局部达1.95%）金刚石可消除1%–3.…
Horizontal (600 km) and vertical (50 km) tomographic resolution limits sharp compositional contrasts, and inferred diamond fractions are upper limits exceeding typical kimberlite xenolith abundances.
水平600 km和垂向50 km分辨率无法分辨尖锐界面，且金刚石估算含量高于常见捕虏体平均值。

First global derivation of cratonic mantle depletion maps (Mg# and modal olivine) by jointly inverting seismic shear-wave tomography and geodynamic density constraints, quantifying a global diamond hypothesis.
首次联合地震层析成像与地球动力学密度约束反演获得全球克拉通岩石圈亏损程度与金刚石含量分布图。

kc: Derived the first global seismological maps of magnesium number (Mg#) and modal olivine content (M_Ol) within cratonic lithospheric roots.
Demonstrated that cratonic keels are strongly depleted above 150 km (mean Mg# ≈ 92.5) and become progressively more fertile toward the LAB.
Showed that major-element depletion alone leaves a 1%–3.5% Vs underprediction at 150 km depth beneath the fastest craton cores.
Proposed that a minute volume fraction of diamond (<1% on average, up to 1.95% locally at 150 km) reconciles high shear velocities with neutral buoyancy.
首次基于地震学模型反演获得了全球克拉通岩石圈根部的镁指数（Mg#）和模态橄榄石含量（M_Ol）分布图。
证实克拉通根部在150 km以上高度亏损（平均Mg# ≈ 92.5），向岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）方向逐渐富集。
发现仅改变主量元素亏损无法完全解释最快克拉通核部150 km深处高达1%–3.5%的剪切波速正异常。
提出在150 km深处存在微量金刚石（普遍<1%，局部达1.95%）是同时满足极高剪切波速与中性浮力约束的最简解释。
me: Converted the Sv tomographic model 3DLGL-TPESv to an isotropic Voigt average (3DLGL-TPESvoigt) using PREM radial anisotropy.
Estimated global LAB depth and cratonic geotherms by mapping asthenospheric velocities to temperature and finding the intersection with a 1315 °C mantle adiabat.
Constrained cratonic mantle excess density to 0.5% ± 0.5% (linearly decreasing from 0.80% at 100 km to 0% at 200 km) using isostasy and geoid moment laws.
Performed regularized least-squares inversion at each grid node and depth for petrological parameters (Mg# and Si#) using Gibbs free energy minimization in Perple_X.
Computed residual diamond and eclogite volume fractions using Voigt-Reuss-Hill averaging of shear moduli and Voigt averaging of densities.
结合PREM径向各向异性模型，将垂直极化S波模型3DLGL-TPESv转换为Voigt各向同性平均波速模型（3DLGL-TPESvoigt）。
利用实验关系将波速转换为温度，通过寻找与1315 °C地幔绝热线交点构建全球LAB深度图与克拉通地温线。
基于均衡理论和大地水准面矩定律，将克拉通地幔超额密度约束在0.5% ± 0.5%（从100 km处的0.80%线性减小至200 km处的0%）。
利用Perple_X吉布斯自由能最小化计算相平衡，在各网格点和深度对岩石学参数（Mg#和Si#）进行正则化最小二乘反演。
采用剪切模量的Voigt-Reuss-Hill平均和密度的Voigt平均，计算消除残差所需的金刚石和榴辉岩体积分数。
de: Global upper-mantle shear-wave velocity model 3DLGL-TPESv (v2022-11), built from waveform inversion of 2,008,820 vertical-component Rayleigh wave seismograms recorded from 1976 to November 2022.
Geoid height constraints (cratons within 5–10 m of mid-ocean ridges) and Crust5.1 crustal thickness/density constraints.
Thermodynamic mineral physics databases (Xu et al. 2008; Stixrude & Lithgow-Bertelloni 2011; Holland & Powell 1998) evaluated via Perple_X.
Global surface kimberlite/diamond distribution database (CONSOREM v3) for spatial comparison.
全球上地幔剪切波速度模型3DLGL-TPESv（v2022-11），基于1976年至2022年11月记录的2,008,820条垂直分量瑞利波波形反演构建。
大地水准面高度观测约束（克拉通与洋中脊差异在5–10 m以内）以及Crust5.1全球地壳模型。
通过Perple_X软件评估的多种地幔矿物热力学数据库（Xu et al. 2008; Holland & Powell 1998等）。
全球金伯利岩与地表金刚石分布数据库（CONSOREM v3），用于与反演结果进行空间对比。
li: Limited spatial resolution of the surface-wave tomographic model (~600 km horizontally and ~50 km vertically) prevents resolving sharp compositional gradients.
Inferred diamond volume fractions (up to 1.95%) are up to two orders of magnitude higher than typical kimberlite xenolith averages and represent upper bounds.
Modal olivine content (M_Ol) has smaller partial derivatives than Mg# and remains sensitive to the choice of starting model (pyrolite vs. harzburgite).
面波层析成像模型的空间分辨率有限（水平约600 km，垂向约50 km），无法分辨岩石学参数的尖锐边界。
反演估算的金刚石体积分数（局部高达1.95%）比典型金伯利岩捕虏体观测值高出两个数量级，仅代表上限值。
模态橄榄石含量（M_Ol）的偏导数较小，反演结果对初始模型（地幔岩或方辉橄榄岩）的选择较为敏感。

tm.why: The paper maps the thermochemical composition, depletion (Mg#), LAB depth, and buoyancy of cratonic lithospheric roots.
The study interprets a global S-wave upper-mantle tomographic model (3DLGL-TPESvoigt) derived from over two million Rayleigh wave waveforms.
The authors explicitly evaluate radial anisotropy effects when converting Sv velocities to isotropic Voigt averages and testing whether anisotropy can explain high cratonic velocities.

ev.notes: Full 17-page article PDF (Article in Press in Scientific Reports) including main text, 5 main figures, Methods, and references was read and analyzed.

sum: This study investigates co- and post-seismic P-wave velocity (Vp) changes at seismogenic depths (3–6 km) following the 2019 Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest earthquake using 2D time-lapse travel-time tomography of 50,345 P-wave arrivals from 2011 to 2024. The average Vp dropped by nearly 2% coseismically and gradually recovered through 2024. Spatially, co-seismic Vp changes exhibit a four-quadrant pattern matching the strike-slip volumetric strain lobes: Vp increases in compressional zones (especially within the porous sedimentary basin) and decreases in tensional zones. Post-seismically, these patterns reverse, indicating ongoing, incomplete crustal healing over several years. Notably, the distal Coso Volcanic Field experienced a pronounced co-seismic Vp drop followed by rapid recovery, highlighting strong hydrological and poroelastic responses in fluid-rich magmatic systems. Unlike shallow autocorrelation studies showing rapid recovery within weeks, this work demonstrates that deeper seismogenic brittle damage and static stress perturbations require multi-year recovery.
本研究利用2011至2024年间50,345条P波到时数据，通过二维延时走时层析成像研究了2019年Ridgecrest Mw 7.1地震在发震深度（3-6 km）的同震与震后P波速度（Vp）变化。平均Vp在同震期骤降近2%，随后缓慢恢复。空间上，同震Vp变化呈四象限分布，与走滑断层的体应变象限一致……

t: 2D time-lapse travel-time tomography jointly inverting P-wave arrival residuals across two periods using LSQR with Laplacian spatial smoothing and temporal damping.
采用结合拉普拉斯空间平滑和时间阻尼的LSQR算法，对双时段P波走时残差进行二维延时层析成像联合反演。
50,345 P-wave arrivals from M≥2.0 earthquakes (2011–2024) from SCEDC, divided into pre-seismic (P1: 19,386 rays), co-seismic (P2: 19,773 rays), and post-seismic (P3: 11,186 rays) periods.
SCEDC的50,345条M≥2.0地震P波到时（2011–2024），分为震前、同震和震后三个时段。
Mean Vp dropped ~2% coseismically (from ~6.15 to ~6.03 km/s) and recovered to ~6.08 km/s by 2024; spatially, Vp increased in compressional quadrants and decreased in tensional quadrants and at Coso.
同震平均Vp下降约2%（6.15至6.03 km/s），2024年恢复至6.08 km/s；空间呈四象限应变响应。
The 2D straight-ray tomography lacks vertical depth resolution and is restricted to the upper crust (<12 km, best at 3–6 km) where earthquake ray paths are dense.
二维直射线层析成像缺乏垂向分辨率，且受限于震源深度（<12 km，最佳为3-6 km）。
First high-resolution lateral imaging of co- and post-seismic Vp changes at seismogenic depths (3–6 km) for Ridgecrest, revealing four-quadrant static strain sensitivity and multi-year healing.
首次对Ridgecrest发震层（3-6 km）波速变化进行高分辨率成像，揭示四象限静态应变响应及多年恢复。

kc: Images co- and post-seismic P-wave velocity changes at seismogenic depths (3–6 km) for the 2019 Mw 7.1 Ridgecrest earthquake using 2D time-lapse tomography.
Reveals a four-quadrant co-seismic Vp change pattern that correlates with static volumetric strain lobes (increasing in compressional zones, decreasing in tensional zones).
Demonstrates that deep seismogenic recovery takes several years and remains incomplete by 2024, contrasting with rapid (days-to-months) shallow crustal healing.
Identifies strong co-seismic velocity reduction and rapid post-seismic recovery at the distal Coso Volcanic Field driven by magmatic/hydrothermal pore pressure.
利用二维延时层析成像揭示了2019年Ridgecrest Mw 7.1地震在发震深度（3-6 km）的同震和震后P波速度变化。
发现了与静态体应变象限高度吻合的四象限同震Vp变化模式（挤压区波速增加，拉张区波速降低）。
证明了深部发震层的恢复持续数年且至2024年仍未完成，与浅层地壳数天至数月的快速愈合形成鲜明对比。
揭示了远场Coso火山区受岩浆和热液孔隙压力主导的显著同震波速下降及震后快速恢复现象。
me: 2D joint time-lapse travel-time tomography with straight-ray approximation for short epicentral distances (<2°).
Simultaneous LSQR inversion of two time periods incorporating station/event correction terms, Laplacian spatial smoothing, and temporal damping.
Linear regression of traveltime versus epicentral distance across sliding time windows to track regional mean Vp evolution.
Volumetric strain calculation from a finite-fault slip model to evaluate rock strain sensitivity constants (K).
针对短震中距（<2°）采用直射线近似的二维联合延时走时层析成像。
结合台站/事件校正项、拉普拉斯空间平滑和时间阻尼参数的双时段联合LSQR反演。
利用分时间窗的走时-震中距线性回归拟合，追踪区域平均P波速度的时序演化。
基于有限断层滑动模型计算体应变，定量评估岩石应变灵敏度常数（K）。
de: 50,345 P-wave arrival times from M≥2.0 earthquakes (2011–2024) obtained from the Southern California Earthquake Data Center (SCEDC).

Three tomographic time periods: P1 (pre-seismic: 2011.01.01–2019.07.05, 19,386 rays), P2 (co-seismic/early aftershocks: 2019.07.06, 19,773 rays), and P3 (post-seismic: 2021.01.01–2024.12.31, 11,186 rays).
Checkerboard resolution tests confirming 10' x 10' spatial resolution and trade-off curves selecting optimal smoothing (300) and damping (30) parameters.
来自南加州地震数据中心（SCEDC）2011至2024年间M≥2.0地震的50,345条P波到时数据。
棋盘格分辨率测试（证实研究区具有10'×10'的空间分辨率）以及优选平滑参数（300）和阻尼参数（30）的L曲线测试。
li: Uses a 2D straight-ray approximation that averages velocity variations vertically across the upper crust (primarily 3–6 km depth) rather than resolving 3D depth-dependent changes.
Relies on passive earthquake distributions (<12 km focal depth), limiting spatial resolution outside the central aftershock zone.
采用二维直射线近似，将上地壳（主要为3-6 km深度）的波速变化在垂向上进行了平均，无法分辨三维深度依赖的变化。
依赖于被动源地震分布（震源深度<12 km），导致中央余震区以外的空间分辨率受限。

tm.why: The paper employs 2D P-wave travel-time time-lapse tomography using 50,345 arrivals to image co- and post-seismic velocity changes.
The study investigates co-seismic crustal damage, stress-induced volumetric strain lobes, and multi-year post-seismic fault zone healing.
The authors analyze significant velocity reduction and rapid recovery in the distal Coso Volcanic Field driven by fluid migration and magma reservoir pore pressure.

ev.notes: Full 11-page PDF of Geophysical Research Letters article used, including all equations, figures, and section text.

sum: Whether enhanced melt supply can shift oceanic crustal accretion from tectonic to symmetric magmatic modes at Earth's slowest-spreading ridge (~6–10 mm/yr) remains unresolved due to thick sediment and missing seismic data in the eastern Nansen Basin. This study reconstructs sediment thickness and residual basement depth across the Arctic Eurasian Basin by combining multichannel seismic constraints with end-member time-dependent sedimentation and compaction models. After Airy isostatic and thermal subsidence corrections, residual basement reveals a clear west–east transition: the western basin exhibits deep residual basement and strong conjugate-flank asymmetry (index A up to ~0.45 km), reflecting magma-poor accretion. East of 85°E, residual basement progressively shallows and asymmetry drops to ≤0.05 km, persisting even under conservative maximum-sedimentation scenarios. These findings demonstrate that sustained melt supply since ~45 Ma promoted near-symmetric crustal thickening across both conjugate flanks of the eastern Gakkel Ridge.
本研究结合多道地震约束与随时间变化的沉积-压实端元模型，重建了北极欧亚盆地的沉积物厚度和剩余基底深度，并进行了艾里均衡和热沉降校正。结果显示欧亚盆地存在显著的东西向转变：西部盆地表现为较深的剩余基底和强烈的不对称性（不对称指数A达~0.45 km），符合贫岩浆超慢速增生特征；而在东经85°以东，剩余……

t: Reconstructs present-day sediment thickness via forward compaction of time-dependent sedimentation rates, removes sediment loading via Airy isostasy, and subtracts global thermal subsidence to obtain residual basement depth and flank asymmetry index A.
通过正演压实模型重建沉积厚度，利用艾里均衡去除沉积负载，并减去全球热沉降以获取剩余基底深度及不对称指数A。

Integrates compiled multichannel seismic profiles across the Eurasian Basin, IBCAO v5 bathymetry, oceanic crustal ages (10–45 Ma), and end-member Cenozoic sedimentation rates from adjacent Arctic troughs.
整合欧亚盆地多道地震剖面、IBCAO v5水深、10–45 Ma洋壳年龄及邻近海槽的新生代端元沉积速率。

Western Eurasian Basin exhibits negative residual basement (-0.5 to -0.1 km) and high flank asymmetry (index A up to ~0.45 km); east of 95°E, residual basement shallows (-0.2 to 0.2 km) and index A drops to ≤0.05 km.
西部盆地剩余基底较深且不对称性高（指数A达0.45 km）；95°E以东基底变浅且指数A降至≤0.05 km。
Direct seismic constraints are absent in the thickly sedimented eastern Nansen Basin, and unconstrained sediment velocities introduce ±0.05 km uncertainty into residual basement depth.
东ナン森盆地缺乏直接地震覆盖，且未独立约束的沉积物波速带来约±0.05 km的剩余基底深度误差。

First constraint on conjugate-flank crustal symmetry in the eastern Eurasian Basin by bracketing Nansen Basin sedimentation, proving enhanced melt supply induces symmetric accretion at Earth's slowest-spreading ridge.
首次通过约束东ナン森盆地沉积不确定性揭示共轭两翼对称性，证明充足熔体供给可在最慢速洋脊实现对称增生。

kc: Reconstructed basin-wide sediment thickness and residual basement depth across the Arctic Eurasian Basin by integrating seismic profiles with bracketed time-dependent sedimentation models.
Quantified conjugate-flank crustal accretion symmetry along the Gakkel Ridge using an asymmetric residual basement depth index (index A) over 10–45 Ma crust.
Demonstrated that enhanced melt supply since ~45 Ma drives near-symmetric magmatic crustal accretion on both flanks of the ultraslow-spreading eastern Gakkel Ridge.
结合地震剖面与端元时间相关沉积模型，重建了北极欧亚盆地的沉积物厚度与剩余基底深度。
利用不对称剩余基底深度指数（指数A）量化了加克尔洋脊10–45 Ma洋壳的共轭两翼增生对称性。
证实了自约45 Ma以来增强的熔体供给在超慢速扩张的东加克尔洋脊两翼促成了近对称的岩浆型洋壳增生。
me: Forward sediment compaction modeling using time-dependent decompacted sedimentation rates and exponential porosity-depth decay for the unseismically surveyed eastern Nansen Basin.
Airy isostatic sediment-loading correction using an empirical depth-dependent sediment density relation.
Residual basement depth calculation relative to a plate thermal subsidence model along tectonic flowlines, evaluated via an asymmetry index A between conjugate flanks.
针对缺乏地震覆盖的东ナン森盆地，采用随时间变化的去压实沉积速率与指数孔隙度-深度衰减关系进行正演沉积压实建模。
利用经验深度相关沉积物密度关系进行艾里均衡沉积负载校正。
沿构造流线相对于板块热沉降模型计算剩余基底深度，并通过共轭两翼间的不对称指数A进行评估。
de: Compiled multichannel seismic (MCS) profiles across the Eurasian Basin from Russian Federal projects, Alfred Wegener Institute (AWI), and BGR.
Bathymetry from IBCAO Version 5 and global oceanic crustal age grids (10–45 Ma) from Seton et al. (2020).
Minimum and maximum sedimentation-rate end-member constraints derived from the western Nansen Basin and St. Anna/Voronin Troughs.
汇编了来自俄罗斯联邦项目、阿尔弗雷德·韦格纳研究所（AWI）和德国联邦地球科学与自然资源研究所（BGR）横跨欧亚盆地的多道地震（MCS）剖面。
采用IBCAO第5版水深数据以及Seton等（2020）的全球洋壳年龄网格（10–45 Ma）。
源自西ナン森盆地以及圣安娜/沃罗宁海槽的最小和最大沉积速率端元约束数据。
li: The eastern Nansen Basin lacks direct seismic coverage, requiring reliance on bracketed end-member sedimentation-rate models.
Sparse seismic data and serpentinized mantle exposure in the westernmost basin (0–30°E) introduce substantial uncertainty into local sediment and crustal thickness interpretations.
Sediment seismic velocity for depth conversion is not independently constrained across the entire basin, introducing ~±0.05 km uncertainty in residual basement depth.
东ナン森盆地缺乏直接的地震覆盖，必须依赖端元沉积速率模型进行约束。
盆地最西端（0–30°E）地震数据稀疏且存在蛇纹石化地幔出露，给局部沉积物和地壳厚度解释带来较大不确定性。
用于时深转换的沉积物地震波速度在整个盆地内缺乏独立约束，给剩余基底深度带来约±0.05 km的不确定性。

tm.why: The paper investigates oceanic crustal accretion symmetry, sediment thickness, and residual basement depth across the Eurasian Basin and ultraslow Gakkel Ridge using seismic constraints and sedimentation models.

ev.notes: Full 12-page PDF provided and analyzed, including equations, methodology, error sensitivity analysis, and all 4 figures.

sum: This study measures the single-crystal elasticity of lawsonite at high pressures, revealing phase transitions at ~4.5 and ~9 GPa linked to hydrogen-bond reorganization. Lawsonite exhibits moderately low P-wave velocity, very low S-wave velocity, and exceptionally high isotropic aggregate Poisson's ratios (0.32–0.38) and Vp/Vs ratios (1.92–2.27). These unique elastic properties provide a compelling mineralogical explanation for anomalously high Poisson's ratio zones observed at 20–90 km depth in both hot (e.g., Cascadia, SW Japan) and cold (e.g., NE Japan) subduction zones, challenging the conventional view that such anomalies solely reflect overpressurized fluids. Additionally, its strong velocity anisotropy helps explain observed seismic anisotropy in subducting slabs.
本研究测量了高压下劳森石的单晶弹性，发现在约4.5和9 GPa处存在与氢键重组相关的相变。实验表明，劳森石具有中等偏低的P波速度、极低的S波速度，以及异常高的泊松比（0.32-0.38）和Vp/Vs比（1.92-2.27）。这些独特的弹性特征为Cascadia、西南日本和东北日本等俯冲带20-90……

t: High-pressure, room-temperature single-crystal elasticity experiments to determine the elastic tensor of lawsonite across phase transitions.
高压室温单晶弹性实验，用于测定劳森石在相变过程中的弹性张量。
Experimental measurements of lawsonite's elastic properties at pressures up to and exceeding 9 GPa.
劳森石在高达并超过9 GPa压力下的弹性性质实验测量数据。
Lawsonite exhibits exceptionally high Poisson's ratios (0.32–0.38) and Vp/Vs ratios (1.92–2.27), explaining subduction zone anomalies without requiring fluids.
劳森石表现出异常高的泊松比（0.32-0.38）和Vp/Vs比（1.92-2.27）。
The experiments were performed at room temperature, neglecting the high-temperature effects present in actual subduction zones.
实验在室温下进行，忽略了实际俯冲带中存在的高温效应。
Provides a purely mineralogical explanation for high Poisson's ratio anomalies in subduction zones, challenging the conventional fluid-saturated crust model.
为俯冲带高泊松比异常提供了纯矿物学解释，挑战了传统的流体饱和模型。

kc: Measured the single-crystal elastic tensor of lawsonite at high pressures.
Identified anomalous elastic changes at ~4.5 and ~9 GPa associated with hydrogen-bond reorganization.
Demonstrated that lawsonite possesses exceptionally high Poisson's ratios (0.32–0.38) and Vp/Vs ratios (1.92–2.27).
Proposed a mineralogical mechanism for high Poisson's ratio anomalies in subduction zones, alternative to fluid-saturated models.
测量了高压下劳森石的单晶弹性张量。
发现了在约4.5和9 GPa处与氢键重组相关的异常弹性变化。
证明了劳森石具有异常高的泊松比（0.32-0.38）和Vp/Vs比（1.92-2.27）。
为俯冲带高泊松比异常提出了一种替代流体饱和模型的矿物学机制。
me: High-pressure, room-temperature single-crystal elasticity experiments to determine the elastic tensor of lawsonite.
高压室温单晶弹性实验，用于测定劳森石的弹性张量。
de: Experimental measurements of lawsonite's elastic properties at pressures up to and exceeding 9 GPa.
劳森石在高达并超过9 GPa压力下的弹性性质实验测量数据。
li: Experiments were conducted at room temperature, which does not fully replicate the high-temperature conditions of real subduction zones.
实验在室温下进行，未能完全模拟真实俯冲带的高温条件。

tm.why: The paper investigates the elastic properties of lawsonite to explain seismic velocity and Poisson's ratio anomalies in subduction zones.
The paper discusses the strong velocity anisotropy of lawsonite and its implications for interpreting observed seismic anisotropy in subducting slabs.

sum: This study presents a high-resolution 3D crustal model of the Southern Apennines, Italy, parameterized on a 5 × 5 × 1 km³ grid. The model integrates geological, geophysical, and petrophysical datasets, including laboratory velocity measurements, stratigraphic well logs, seismic tomography, and gravity/magnetic inversions. By applying pressure- and temperature-dependent corrections to P-wave velocities from regional tomography, the authors delineate key intra-crustal boundaries (e.g., Mesozoic limestones, crystalline basement, and mafic lower crust) down to the Moho. The model is validated using independent borehole data and receiver functions. The novelty lies in the systematic integration of multi-scale, multi-disciplinary datasets with P-T corrections to ensure internal consistency across tectonic domains, providing an open-access, FAIR-compliant framework for seismic hazard and geodynamic modeling.
本研究构建了意大利南亚平宁山脉5×5×1 km³网格的高分辨率三维地壳模型。该模型系统整合了实验室速度测量、测井、地震层析成像及重磁反演等多学科数据。通过对区域层析成像P波速度进行温压校正，精细刻画了从浅部中生代灰岩、结晶基底到深部下地壳及莫霍面的关键界面。利用独立钻孔和接收函数数据对模型进行了验证……

t: Integration of geological, geophysical, and petrophysical data with pressure- and temperature-dependent corrections applied to regional seismic tomography P-wave velocities.
整合地质、地球物理和岩石物理数据，并对区域地震层析成像P波速度进行温度和压力校正。
Laboratory velocity measurements, stratigraphic well logs, regional seismic tomography, gravity/magnetic inversions, and validation data (boreholes, receiver functions).
实验室速度测量、地层测井、区域地震层析成像、重磁反演以及验证数据（钻孔、接收函数）。
A consistent 3D crustal model of the Southern Apennines down to the Moho, delineating key boundaries like Mesozoic limestones and crystalline basement.
构建了延伸至莫霍面的南亚平宁山脉一致性三维地壳模型，刻画了中生代灰岩和结晶基底等关键边界。
Grid resolution (5x5x1 km³) and reliance on regional-scale datasets and simplified P-T correction assumptions.
网格分辨率（5x5x1 km³）受限，且依赖于区域尺度数据集和简化的温压校正假设。
Systematic, multi-disciplinary integration combined with P-T corrections to ensure cross-scale consistency, released as an open-access FAIR dataset.
系统性的多学科数据整合结合温压校正以确保跨尺度一致性，并作为开源FAIR数据集发布。

kc: Developed a high-resolution 3D crustal model of the Southern Apennines on a 5 × 5 × 1 km³ grid.
Integrated multi-disciplinary datasets including laboratory measurements, well logs, seismic tomography, and gravity/magnetic inversions.
Applied pressure- and temperature-dependent corrections to regional seismic tomography P-wave velocities.
Delineated key intra-crustal boundaries down to the Moho and validated them with independent borehole and receiver function data.
构建了南亚平宁山脉5 × 5 × 1 km³网格的高分辨率三维地壳模型。
整合了包括实验室测量、测井、地震层析成像和重磁反演在内的多学科数据集。
对区域地震层析成像P波速度应用了温度和压力校正。
刻画了延伸至莫霍面的关键地壳内部边界，并利用独立钻孔和接收函数数据进行了验证。
me: Multi-data integration (geological, geophysical, petrophysical).
Pressure- and temperature-dependent velocity corrections for P-wave tomography.
3D grid parameterization (5 × 5 × 1 km³).
Validation using independent borehole data and receiver functions.
多源数据整合（地质、地球物理、岩石物理）。
针对P波层析成像的压力和温度相关速度校正。
三维网格参数化（5 × 5 × 1 km³）。
利用独立钻孔数据和接收函数进行验证。
de: Laboratory P-wave velocity measurements under varying pressure and temperature conditions.
Stratigraphic well logs and regional seismic tomography (Vp) models.
Gravity and magnetic inversion models.
Independent validation datasets (boreholes, receiver functions).
不同压力和温度条件下的实验室P波速度测量数据。
地层测井记录和区域地震层析成像（Vp）模型。
重力和磁力反演模型。
独立的验证数据集（钻孔、接收函数）。
li: Resolution is limited by the 5 × 5 × 1 km³ grid size and the density of regional geophysical datasets.
P-T corrections rely on simplified geothermal and pressure gradient assumptions.
分辨率受限于5 × 5 × 1 km³的网格大小以及区域地球物理数据集的密度。
温压校正依赖于简化的地温梯度和压力梯度假设。

tm.why: The paper presents a high-resolution 3D crustal model of the Southern Apennines extending down to the Moho discontinuity.
The model integrates regional seismic tomography (Vp) and applies pressure- and temperature-dependent corrections to it.

ev.notes: Analysis based on the published abstract of the ESSD preprint/comment since no PDF was available.

sum: This methodological paper clarifies the phenomenological theory of aftershocks and its inverse relationship between the earthquake source deactivation coefficient and mainshock magnitude. Prompted by recent independent confirmation in the Central Himalayas (Poudel et al., 2026) that mistakenly attributed the method to the Modified Omori Law (MOL), the authors explain why their approach is diametrically opposed to MOL. While MOL assumes a monotonic decay, real aftershock sequences exhibit non-monotonic deactivation coefficients after the initial Omori epoch. Instead of assuming a forward decay law, the authors formulate an inverse problem to compute the deactivation coefficient directly from smoothed waiting times or synchronization functions. They introduce continuous and discrete representations of source 'proper time', demonstrating that waiting times form a geometric progression during the Omori epoch. Validations using the 1994 Northridge and 2011 Tohoku earthquakes confirm consistency across representations and empirical magnitude scaling.
本文阐述了余震唯象理论及地震震源失活系数与主震震级之间的反比关系。针对近期喜马拉雅中部地震研究（Poudel等，2026）证实该规律但误将其归因于修正大森定律（MOL）的情况，作者阐明了其方法与MOL的本质区别。该方法不预先假设余震衰减定律，而是通过引入震源“固有时间”的连续与离散表示，直接从余震观……

t: The authors formulate an inverse problem to calculate the earthquake source deactivation coefficient directly from the derivative of smoothed waiting times or discrete synchronization functions in source proper time, avoiding prior decay assumptions.
提出求解反问题的方法，直接利用平滑等待时间或离散同步函数在震源固有时间下的导数计算震源失活系数。

The study uses earthquake catalog data including the SCEC catalog for the 1994 M6.7 Southern California earthquake, the first 4500 aftershocks of the M9.1 Tohoku earthquake, and Central Himalayan scaling relations.
使用SCEC目录中1994年M6.7北岭地震数据、M9.1日本东北大地震前4500次余震及喜马拉雅经验关系。

Deactivation coefficient decreases linearly with mainshock magnitude (R² = 0.82). For the M9.1 Tohoku Omori epoch, both continuous and discrete proper-time inversions yield σ = 0.0014 (R² = 0.82 and 0.97), matching Himalayan extrapolation (0.0019).
失活系数随主震震级线性减小（R²=0.82）；东北大地震连续与离散反演均得σ=0.0014，与外推值0.0019吻合。

The phenomenological framework cannot explain the physical mechanism causing the geometric progression of shocks during the Omori epoch or the subsequent chaotic fluctuations of the deactivation coefficient.
唯象理论无法解释大森期余震呈等比数列及随后失活系数混沌波动的物理机制。

Clarifies the methodological distinction between inverse proper-time source deactivation analysis and forward Modified Omori Law fitting, unifying continuous and discrete representations of source proper time.
厘清了固有时间反问题与修正大森定律的本质区别，统一了震源固有时间的连续与离散表示。

kc: Clarified that the phenomenological aftershock methodology solves an inverse problem for the deactivation coefficient rather than relying on the Modified Omori Law (MOL).
Formulated both continuous (tau) and discrete (x) representations of earthquake source proper time.
Demonstrated that during the Omori epoch, average waiting times between consecutive aftershocks form a geometric progression.
Validated consistency of the deactivation coefficient (0.0014) for the 2011 M9.1 Tohoku earthquake across two proper-time representations and an empirical Himalayan scaling relation.
阐明了余震唯象理论方法是通过求解反问题来计算失活系数，而非基于修正大森定律（MOL）。
建立了地震震源固有时间的连续（τ）和离散（x）两种表示形式。
证明了在大森期内，连续余震之间的平均等待时间呈等比数列分布。
利用2011年M9.1日本东北大地震验证了两种固有时间表示下失活系数（0.0014）的一致性及其与喜马拉雅经验关系的外推吻合度。
me: Phenomenological differential evolution equation for aftershock frequency using source proper time.
Inverse problem solution computing the deactivation coefficient via time derivatives of optimally smoothed waiting times.
Discrete proper-time (x-representation) synchronization function fitting and logarithmic differentiation.
基于震源固有时间的余震频率唯象微分演化方程。
通过对最优平滑后的等待时间求导来计算失活系数的反问题求解方法。
离散固有时间（x表示）同步函数拟合与对数求导法。
de: Aftershock sequences from multiple mainshocks (M 6 to 9) establishing the inverse relation between deactivation factor and mainshock magnitude.
Southern California Earthquake Data Center (SCEC) catalog for the Jan 17, 1994 M6.7 Northridge earthquake.
First 4,500 aftershocks of the 2011 M9.1 Tohoku earthquake and empirical data from Central Himalaya earthquakes (M <= 7.6).
多个主震（震级6至9级）的余震序列数据，用于建立失活因子与主震震级的反比关系。
南加州地震数据中心（SCEC）目录中1994年1月17日M6.7北岭地震的余震数据。
2011年M9.1日本东北大地震的前4500次余震数据，以及喜马拉雅中部地震（M <= 7.6）的经验关系数据。
li: The phenomenological theory cannot explain the underlying physical mechanism driving the geometric progression of shocks or non-monotonic variations in the deactivation coefficient.
The discrete geometric progression approximation holds strictly only during the initial Omori epoch where the deactivation coefficient varies slowly.
该唯象理论无法解释导致大森期内余震呈等比数列或失活系数非单调变化的底层物理机制。
离散等比数列近似仅在失活系数缓慢变化的初始大森期内严格成立。

tm.why: The paper investigates the relaxation dynamics of an earthquake source following a mainshock using a phenomenological theory of aftershocks.
The study analyzes aftershock sequences and waiting times derived from seismic catalogs such as the SCEC catalog.
The authors formulate and solve an inverse problem to determine the time-varying source deactivation coefficient from observed aftershock rates without prior decay law assumptions.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 16-page arXiv PDF text and figures.

sum: This study presents a supervised feed-forward neural network designed for the automated quality control and interpretation of single-station microtremor horizontal-to-vertical (H/V) spectral ratio measurements. Trained on a dataset of 3,000 field measurements spanning over 20 years, the model classifies spectral intervals into seven categories: normal, 1D resonance, 2D/3D resonance, artifact, velocity inversion, data requiring cleaning, and malfunctioning sensor. The neural network achieves an accuracy of 80%–82% on unseen data, with the primary challenge being the distinction between 2D/3D resonances and artifacts. The approach is robust against variations in instrument type, window length, and smoothing parameters, offering a reliable, probability-based alternative to the widely used but rigid SESAME (2004) criteria for seismic hazard and stratigraphic studies.
本研究开发了一种监督前馈神经网络，用于单台微动水平与垂直（H/V）谱比观测数据的自动质量控制和解释。利用20多年野外测量积累的3000个样本进行训练，该模型可将谱段划分为正常、一维共振、二维/三维共振、人工伪迹、速度反转、需清洗数据和仪器故障等7类。测试集准确率达80%–82%，主要难点在于区分二维……

t: A supervised feed-forward neural network trained on individual spectral components and H/V curves to classify microtremor spectra into seven categories.
一种基于单个谱分量和H/V曲线训练的监督前馈神经网络，用于将微动谱划分为七个类别。
A dataset of 3,000 microtremor measurements collected over 20 years across diverse geological and environmental settings.
包含3000个微动测量样本的数据集，收集自20多年来不同地质和环境背景下的野外工作。
The neural network achieved 80%–82% accuracy on unseen data, demonstrating robustness to instrument types, window lengths, and smoothing parameters.
神经网络在未见数据上达到了80%–82%的准确率，并对仪器类型、窗长和平滑参数表现出鲁棒性。
The main classification challenge is distinguishing between 2D/3D resonances and artificial spectral artifacts due to their high similarity.
主要分类难点在于由于谱特征高度相似，难以区分二维/三维共振与人工伪迹。
Provides a machine-learning-based, probabilistic alternative to the rigid, threshold-based SESAME (2004) guidelines for microtremor H/V quality control.
为微动H/V质量控制提供了一种基于机器学习的概率性替代方案，取代了传统的、基于阈值的SESAME标准。

kc: Developed a supervised feed-forward neural network for automated classification and quality control of single-station microtremor H/V spectra.
Created a robust classification scheme spanning seven distinct geological, environmental, and instrumental categories.
Demonstrated an alternative to the rigid, threshold-based SESAME (2004) guidelines with an 80%–82% classification accuracy.
开发了一种用于单台微动H/V谱自动分类和质量控制的监督前馈神经网络。
构建了一个涵盖地质、环境和仪器等7个不同类别的鲁棒分类体系。
展示了一种替代传统、基于阈值的SESAME (2004) 标准的方法，分类准确率达到80%–82%。
me: Supervised feed-forward neural network training.
Consistent windowing, smoothing, and spectral normalization of microtremor components.
Probability-based classification of spectral intervals and aggregation into synthetic quality assessments (accept, reject, reanalyze).
监督前馈神经网络训练。
对微动分量进行一致的窗函数处理、平滑和谱归一化。
对谱区间进行基于概率的分类，并汇总为综合质量评估（接受、拒绝、重新分析）。
de: A training dataset of 3,000 examples compiled from over 20 years of field measurements in diverse geological and environmental settings.
Testing on unseen data to evaluate classification accuracy and robustness against instrument types, window lengths, and smoothing parameters.
包含3000个样本的训练数据集，源自20多年在不同地质和环境背景下的野外测量。
在未见数据上进行测试，以评估分类准确性以及对仪器类型、窗长和平滑参数的鲁棒性。
li: Difficulty in distinguishing between 2D/3D resonances and artificial artifacts due to their spectral similarities.
Performance depends on the consistency of preprocessing (windowing, smoothing, normalization) established during training.
由于谱特征相似，难以准确区分二维/三维共振与人工伪迹。
性能依赖于训练期间建立的前处理（加窗、平滑、归一化）的一致性。

tm.why: The paper focuses on single-station ambient noise measurements analyzed through the horizontal-to-vertical (H/V) spectral ratio.
The authors develop and train a supervised feed-forward neural network to classify microtremor spectra.
H/V spectral ratio measurements are widely applied in seismic hazard assessment and site response studies.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the detailed abstract provided in the metadata, as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the 2023 Mw 6.8 Al Haouz earthquake in Morocco, which struck the slowly deforming High Atlas mountain belt. Using seismic and geodetic data, the authors demonstrate that the rupture occurred on an inherited, blind, steeply dipping to oblique-reverse fault. The paper analyzes the co-seismic stress transfer associated with this event, shedding light on how stress is distributed and released in intraplate or slowly deforming tectonic regions. The findings highlight the role of pre-existing basement structures in controlling modern seismicity and hazard in the High Atlas.
本研究分析了發生在緩慢變形的高阿特拉斯山脈的2023年摩洛哥阿爾豪茲Mw 6.8地震。作者結合地震與大地測量數據，證實此次地震發生在一個繼承性的、隱伏的陡傾斜向逆斷層上。研究進一步計算了同震應力傳遞，揭示了緩慢變形造山帶中的應力釋放與分佈特徵。該成果強調了前寒武紀或古生代基底構造對現代地震活動的控制……

t: Joint inversion of seismic and geodetic data combined with Coulomb failure stress change modeling to characterize the fault geometry and stress transfer.
結合地震與大地測量數據的聯合反演，以及庫侖破裂應力變化模擬。
Seismic waveforms and satellite geodetic data (InSAR) covering the 2023 Al Haouz earthquake sequence in Morocco.
覆蓋2023年摩洛哥阿爾豪茲地震序列的地震波形與衛星大地測量（InSAR）數據。
The earthquake ruptured a blind, steeply dipping oblique-reverse fault, transferring stress to adjacent segments in the slowly deforming High Atlas.
地震破裂了一條隱伏的陡傾斜向逆斷層，並向高阿特拉斯造山帶的相鄰段傳遞了應力。
Deep, blind faulting and lack of surface rupture increase the uncertainty of the shallow fault geometry and slip distribution.
深部隱伏破裂且無地表破裂，增加了淺部斷層幾何形狀和滑移分佈的不確定性。
Demonstrates how inherited basement structures accommodate shortening and transfer co-seismic stress in slowly deforming intraplate mountain belts.
揭示了繼承性基底構造在緩慢變形造山帶中如何吸收縮短並傳遞同震應力。

kc: Identified the causative fault of the 2023 Al Haouz earthquake as an inherited, blind, steeply dipping oblique-reverse fault.
Modeled co-seismic stress transfer to understand its impact on surrounding fault systems in the High Atlas.
Provided insights into earthquake physics and seismic hazards in slowly deforming mountain belts.
確定了2023年阿爾豪茲地震的發震斷層為一條繼承性的、隱伏的陡傾斜向逆斷層。
模擬了同震應力傳遞，以理解其對高阿特拉斯山脈周圍斷層系統的影響。
為緩慢變形造山帶的地震物理學和地震危險性評估提供了新見解。
me: Seismic source inversion (moment tensor or slip distribution modeling).
Coulomb stress transfer modeling.
Geodetic data analysis (InSAR and/or GNSS) to constrain fault geometry.
地震波源反演（震源機制解或滑移分佈建模）。
庫侖應力傳遞模擬。
大地測量數據分析（InSAR和/或GNSS）以約束斷層幾何形狀。
de: Teleseismic and regional seismic waveforms of the 2023 Al Haouz earthquake.
Spaceborne geodetic observations (InSAR interferograms) covering the epicentral area.
Geological and structural maps of the High Atlas mountain belt.
2023年阿爾豪茲地震的遠震和區域地震波形數據。
覆蓋震央區域的衛星大地測量觀測數據（InSAR干涉圖）。
高阿特拉斯山脈的地質和構造圖件。
li: Lack of surface rupture limits direct geological verification of the blind fault geometry.
Inherent trade-offs in joint seismic-geodetic inversions for deep, steeply dipping sources.
缺乏地表破裂限制了對隱伏斷層幾何形狀的直接地質驗證。
深部陡傾震源的地震-大地測量聯合反演中存在固有的折衷與多解性。

tm.why: The paper investigates the rupture mechanism and co-seismic stress transfer of the 2023 Al Haouz earthquake.
It focuses on inherited blind steep-dipping-to-oblique reverse faulting in a slowly deforming mountain belt.
It discusses the tectonic setting and inherited structures of the High Atlas mountain belt.

ev.notes: Analysis is based on the paper title and metadata from Crossref, as no PDF or abstract was available.

sum: This paper presents a new unified joint inversion framework that integrates surface wave dispersion data with local and teleseismic body wave traveltimes. The method is designed to resolve both shallow and deep structures simultaneously. It is validated using data from the southern California plate boundary region, imaging from the upper crust to the upper mantle. Additionally, its application to the temporary dense Weifang array demonstrates its capability and potential for high-resolution imaging using dense seismic arrays. The primary novelty lies in the unified integration of multiple data types to bridge the resolution gap between shallow crustal and deep mantle structures.
本文提出一种统一的联合反演框架，整合面波频散数据与局部及远震体波走时。该方法旨在同时解析浅部与深部结构。在南加州板块边界区域的应用成功重建了上地壳至上地幔结构，验证了其有效性；在潍坊密集台阵的应用展示了其利用临时台阵进行多尺度成像的潜力。其创新点在于统一整合多种数据，弥补了浅深部成像分辨率的断层。

t: A joint inversion framework that simultaneously inverts surface wave dispersion and local/teleseismic body wave traveltimes.
同时反演面波频散与局部/远震体波走时的联合反演框架。
Seismic datasets from southern California and the temporary dense Weifang array.
来自南加州板块边界区域和潍坊临时密集台阵的地震数据集。
Successfully imaged the lithospheric structure from the upper crust to the upper mantle in southern California.
成功重建了南加州从上地壳到上地幔的岩石圈三维速度结构。
Requires overlapping coverage of both high-quality dispersion and traveltime data.
需要高质量频散数据与走时数据在空间上的重叠覆盖。
A unified framework bridging shallow and deep imaging by combining local/teleseismic body waves with surface waves.
通过结合局部/远震体波与面波，构建了连接浅部与深部成像的统一框架。

kc: Developed a new unified joint inversion framework integrating surface wave dispersion and body wave traveltimes.
Validated the method in southern California, imaging from the upper crust to the upper mantle.
Demonstrated the framework's applicability to temporary dense arrays (Weifang array).
开发了一种整合面波频散和体波走时的统一联合反演新框架。
在南加州地区进行了方法验证，实现了从上地壳到上地幔的成像。
展示了该框架在临时密集台阵（潍坊台阵）上的应用潜力。
me: Joint inversion of surface wave dispersion data.
Integration of local and teleseismic body wave traveltimes.
面波频散数据的联合反演。
局部和远震体波走时数据的整合。
de: Seismic data from the southern California plate boundary region.
Seismic data from the temporary dense Weifang array.
南加州板块边界区域的地震数据。
潍坊临时密集台阵的地震数据。
li: The performance depends on the availability and quality of both surface wave and body wave datasets.
反演效果依赖于面波和体波数据集的可用性及质量。

tm.why: The paper presents a joint inversion framework integrating surface wave dispersion and body wave traveltimes for seismic tomography.
It introduces a new unified joint inversion framework to resolve multi-scale structures.
The method is applied to image structures from the upper crust to the upper mantle.

ev.notes: No PDF was available. The analysis is based entirely on the provided abstract and metadata.

sum: This study investigates the physical mechanisms controlling the 2023 M7.8 Kahramanmaras and M7.6 Ekinozu earthquake doublet in Türkiye using 3-D dynamic rupture simulations via the Fast Domain Partitioning Boundary Integral Equation Method (FDP-BIEM). The authors construct a 3-D nonplanar fault geometry from the Global Earthquake Model and constrain the regional tectonic stress field using pre- and post-seismic focal mechanism inversions. Without fine-tuning local frictional heterogeneity, the primary model naturally reproduces the M7.8 rupture transfer from the Narlı Fault to the East Anatolian Fault (EAF), the ~18-second delay of the southwestward rupture, and arrest at the 2020 M6.7 rupture zone. Furthermore, incorporating an observed ~30° clockwise stress rotation along the Çardak-Sürgü Fault demonstrates how the directivity pulse from the M7.8 event dynamically triggered the M7.6 event and drove its westward supershear propagation, highlighting phase-transition-like criticality in backward-branching fault systems.
本研究利用快速域分解边界积分方程法（FDP-BIEM）开展三维动态破裂模拟，探讨2023年土耳其M7.8和M7.6双震的物理控制机制。作者基于全球地震模型构建三维非平面断层几何，并结合震前与震后震源机制反演约束区域构造应力场。无需精细调节局部摩擦异质性，主模型即自然重现了M7.8地震从Narlı断层……

t: Uses the Fast Domain Partitioning Spatiotemporal Boundary Integral Equation Method (FDP-BIEM) with unstructured triangular meshes and a linear slip-weakening friction law in an elastic half-space, projecting inverted tectonic stress tensors onto 3-D nonplanar faults.
采用快速域分解时空边界积分方程法与线性滑移弱化准则，将反演的构造应力投影至三维非平面断层。

Constructs 3-D fault geometry from Global Earthquake Model (GEM) traces and active fault maps, and constrains stress tensors via focal mechanism inversions of 1938–2017 earthquakes and 2023 M>4 aftershocks from GCMT, KOERI, and AFAD.
基于GEM和活动断层图构建三维断层模型，利用1938-2017年地震及2023年余震震源机制反演应力场。

Simulations reproduce the M7.8 subshear rupture (~2.9 km/s), an ~18 s delay for SW propagation at the Narlı-EAF junction, and a transient ~5 MPa dynamic Coulomb stress pulse that triggers the M7.6 westward supershear rupture.
重现了M7.8亚剪切破裂、西南向约18秒延迟，以及在Çardak断层产生高达5 MPa动态应力脉冲并触发超剪切破裂。
Constant R=0.4 along the Amanos Segment reduces accuracy in the south, smoothed GEM geometry omits small-scale jogs, and linear slip-weakening cannot capture the 9-hour triggering delay.
Amanos段恒定应力比降低了南端精度，平滑几何忽略了细小阶区，且未模拟9小时延迟成核机制。

Incorporates an observed ~30° clockwise Shmax rotation on the CSF and demonstrates how a directivity pulse dynamically triggers backward-branching synthetic faults without tuning frictional heterogeneity.
引入CSF约30°顺时针应力旋转观测约束，揭示了破裂方向性脉冲触发后向分支同向断层的物理机制。

kc: Reproduced the first-order rupture propagation, ~18 s southwestward delay, moment rate function, and final slip of the M7.8 Kahramanmaras earthquake using pre-seismic 3-D fault geometry and regional stress constraints.

Identified a ~30° clockwise rotation of maximum horizontal compressional stress (Shmax) along the Çardak-Sürgü Fault from aftershock focal mechanisms, which is critical for triggering the M7.6 Ekinozu earthquake.

Demonstrated that the S-wave directivity pulse from the M7.8 rupture caused a transient ~5 MPa dynamic Coulomb stress increase on the backward-branching Çardak Fault, triggering the M7.6 event and its westward supershear rupture.
仅凭震前三维断层几何和区域应力约束，重现了M7.8地震的一阶破裂传播、西南向约18秒延迟、矩率函数及最终滑移分布。
通过余震震源机制识别出Çardak-Sürgü断层沿线最大水平主压应力（Shmax）顺时针旋转约30°，这是触发M7.6地震的关键条件。
证明M7.8破裂产生的S波方向性脉冲在后向分支Çardak断层上引起高达5 MPa的动态库仑应力瞬态增加，触发了M7.6事件及其向西的超剪切破裂。
me: 3-D dynamic rupture modeling using the Fast Domain Partitioning Spatiotemporal Boundary Integral Equation Method (FDP-BIEM) in a homogeneous isotropic elastic half-space with linear slip-weakening friction.
Regional tectonic stress tensor inversion using pre-seismic (1938–2017) and post-seismic (2023 M>4 aftershocks) earthquake focal mechanisms.
Parametric sensitivity analysis on the vertical stress ratio (Rv) and Shmax orientation along the Çardak Fault to map the dynamic triggering phase diagram.
采用快速域分解时空边界积分方程法（FDP-BIEM）与线性滑移弱化摩擦准则，在均匀各向同性弹性半空间中进行三维动态破裂模拟。
利用震前（1938–2017年）和震后（2023年M>4余震）震源机制解进行区域构造应力张量反演。
针对Çardak断层上的垂向应力比（Rv）和最大水平主应力方位角开展参数敏感性分析，构建动态触发相图。
de: 3-D fault surface mesh (~100,000 unstructured triangular elements) derived from the Global Earthquake Model (GEM) and active fault maps of Türkiye.
Focal mechanism catalogs from GCMT, KOERI, AFAD, and literature (1938–2017 and 2023 aftershocks) for stress tensor inversions.
Near-fault strong-motion waveforms, kinematic slip inversions, teleseismic moment rate functions, and InSAR slip distributions used for model validation.
基于全球地震模型（GEM）和土耳其活动断层图构建的三维非平面断层网格（约100,000个非结构化三角形单元）。
来自GCMT、KOERI、AFAD及文献的震源机制目录（1938–2017年地震及2023年余震），用于应力张量反演。
用于模型验证的近断层强地面运动波形、运动学滑移反演、远震矩率函数及InSAR同震滑移分布。
li: The GEM fault geometry smooths out fine-scale segment boundary structures (extensional/compressional jogs) and omits the Doğanşehir Fault.
Assumes a constant stress ratio R=0.4 along the Amanos Segment, leading to an overestimated rupture length and duration at the southwestern end.
Does not explicitly simulate the 9-hour nucleation delay of the M7.6 event, which requires rate-and-state friction or poroelastic/fluid-migration modeling.
GEM断层几何平滑了小尺度段落边界结构（拉张/挤压阶区），且未包含Doğanşehir断层。
在Amanos段假设恒定的应力比R=0.4，导致模拟的西南端破裂长度和持续时间偏大。
未能显式模拟M7.6事件长达9小时的延迟成核过程，这需要引入速率-状态摩擦准则或孔隙弹性/流体迁移模型。

tm.why: The paper conducts 3-D physics-based dynamic rupture simulations to reproduce the rupture propagation, delay, and triggering of the 2023 Kahramanmaras and Ekinozu earthquake doublet.
The study investigates 3-D nonplanar fault geometry, tectonic prestress projections, Coulomb failure stress changes, and frictional mechanics governing multi-segment fault interactions.
Simulations use the Fast Domain Partitioning Spatiotemporal Boundary Integral Equation Method (FDP-BIEM) parallelized across 128 nodes on the Earth Simulator supercomputer.

ev.notes: Evaluated using the complete 39-page preprint PDF (accepted as a chapter in AGU monograph, Strike-slip Tectonics: Oceanic Transform Faults to Continental Plate Boundaries), including abstract, full text, 1 table, and 18 figures.

sum: This study analyzes the stability and numerical dispersion properties of the B-spline-based distributional finite-difference method (DFDM) for the 1D homogeneous scalar wave equation, comparing it against collocated finite-difference (FDM) and continuous spectral-element methods (SEM). Using generalized eigenvalue problems for Störmer-Verlet time-stepping stability and the generalized Rayleigh quotient for spatial and temporal dispersion, the authors evaluate trade-offs between time-step limits and accuracy. They introduce a dimensionality-dependent optimal cost metric combining spatial points per wavelength and time steps per wavelength for a target dispersion error threshold. While DFDM exhibits tighter Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy (CFL) stability restrictions and worse scaling with accuracy order, it achieves substantially lower spatial dispersion errors at low points per wavelength. Extrapolating to 3D shows that DFDM consistently outperforms SEM and FDM for dispersion error thresholds below 1%, making it highly promising for memory-constrained, high-accuracy 3D seismic wave simulations.
本研究分析了基于B样条的分布有限差分法（DFDM）求解一维均匀标量波动方程的稳定性和数值频散特性，并与有限差分法（FDM）和连续谱元法（SEM）进行对比。研究利用广义特征值问题确定显式Störmer-Verlet时间积分的稳定性边界，采用广义瑞利商量化空间与时间频散误差，并提出了一种结合每波长空间点……

t: The 1D scalar wave equation is discretized using B-spline DFDM, FDM, and SEM with Störmer-Verlet time stepping. Stability is derived via generalized eigenvalues of mass and stiffness matrices, and dispersion via the generalized Rayleigh quotient.
采用B样条DFDM、FDM和SEM及Störmer-Verlet积分求解一维波动方程，由广义特征值分析稳定性，广义瑞利商…
Numerical experiments use a 1D homogeneous domain of length L = 1 m, wave speed c = 1 m/s, and N = 401 degrees of freedom, testing accuracy orders p = 2, 4, 8 and extrapolating costs to d = 1, 3.
在L=1m、c=1m/s、N=401的一维均匀区域进行数值实验，测试p=2,4,8阶精度并外推至三维成本。

DFDM has the worst stability scaling with order p (slope ~1.24 vs ~0.92 for SEM and ~0.08 for FDM), but achieves O(dx^2p) spatial dispersion accuracy with lower errors, yielding the lowest 3D computational cost for error thresholds <= 1%.
DFDM随阶数p的稳定性缩放最差（斜率约1.24），但频散误差最小，在三维且误差阈值≤1%时计算成本最低。

The cost metric ignores matrix-vector product overhead and mass-matrix inversion costs, and the 1D homogeneous scalar analysis neglects 3D numerical anisotropy, heterogeneity, and elastic wave complexities.
成本度量忽略了矩阵运算和求逆开销，一维均匀标量分析未考虑三维数值各向异性和非均匀弹性介质。

First rigorous quantification of maximum stable time-step bounds, Rayleigh-quotient dispersion curves, and optimal accuracy-versus-stability computational cost metrics for B-spline DFDM compared with SEM and FDM.
首次严格量化了B样条DFDM的最大稳定时间步长、瑞利商频散曲线，并提出权衡精度与稳定性的最优成本度量。

kc: Quantified the CFL stability bounds and Courant number scaling with accuracy order for B-spline DFDM, FDM, and SEM using generalized eigenvalue analysis.
Formulated a generalized Rayleigh quotient approach to evaluate semi-discrete (spatial) and fully discrete (total and worst-case) numerical dispersion errors.
Introduced an optimal computational cost metric balancing spatial degrees of freedom and time steps required to achieve a target dispersion error threshold in 1D and 3D.
Demonstrated that DFDM with non-uniform not-a-knot B-splines (DFDMb) improves stability scaling over uniform knots but slightly degrades spatial dispersion accuracy.
利用广义特征值分析量化了基于B样条的DFDM、FDM和SEM的CFL稳定性边界及库朗数随精度阶数的缩放规律。
提出了基于广义瑞利商的方法，用于评估半离散（空间）和全离散（总体及最坏情况）数值频散误差。
引入了最优计算成本度量，权衡在一维和三维中达到目标频散误差阈值所需的空间自由度和时间步数。
证明了采用非均匀not-a-knot节点的DFDM变体（DFDMb）虽改善了随精度阶数的稳定性缩放，但略微增加了空间频散误差。
me: Spatial discretization of the 1D scalar wave equation with homogeneous Neumann boundary conditions using single-element B-spline DFDM, collocated central FDM, and continuous Galerkin SEM.
Explicit Störmer-Verlet time integration and stability analysis via the spectral radius and maximum eigenvalue of the generalized mass-stiffness matrix pair.
Numerical dispersion analysis using the generalized Rayleigh quotient to approximate numerical frequencies for harmonic waves.
Constrained optimization of a d-dimensional computational cost metric subject to CFL stability, Nyquist anti-aliasing, and worst-case dispersion error thresholds.
采用单单元B样条DFDM、同位中心差分FDM和连续Galerkin SEM对带有齐次Neumann边界条件的一维标量波动方程进行空间离散。
采用显式Störmer-Verlet时间积分，并通过广义质量-刚度矩阵对的最大特征值和谱半径进行稳定性分析。
利用广义瑞利商近似简谐波的数值频率，开展空间与全离散数值频散分析。
在满足CFL稳定性、Nyquist抗混叠和最坏情况频散误差阈值的约束下，对d维计算成本度量进行优化分析。
de: 1D numerical experiments on a homogeneous domain (L = 1 m, c = 1 m/s, N = 401 degrees of freedom, fundamental frequency f0 = 0.5 Hz).
h-refinement (varying N at p = 4) and p-refinement (varying accuracy order p from 2 to 20 at N = 401) stability experiments.
Semi-discrete and fully discrete (fixed Courant number C = 1/16) dispersion evaluations for accuracy orders p = 2, 4, 8.
1D and extrapolated 3D optimal cost metric comparisons across dispersion error thresholds from 10^-6% to 10%.
一维均匀介质数值实验（区域长度L = 1 m，波速c = 1 m/s，自由度N = 401，基频f0 = 0.5 Hz）。
h细化（固定p = 4改变N）和p细化（固定N = 401改变精度阶数p = 2至20）的稳定性实验。
针对精度阶数p = 2, 4, 8的半离散与全离散（固定库朗数C = 1/16）频散误差评估。
在10^-6%至10%频散误差阈值范围内的一维及外推三维最优计算成本对比实验。
li: The cost metric models single-array memory access and ignores matrix-vector product overhead, parallelization efficiency, and mass matrix inversion costs.
The rigorous analysis is restricted to the 1D homogeneous scalar wave equation using a single DFDM element.
Extrapolation to 3D neglects numerical anisotropy and does not explicitly model 3D elastic phase/group velocities or multi-set Lebedev grids.
成本度量仅模拟单数组内存访问，忽略了矩阵-向量乘法开销、并行效率以及质量矩阵求逆的计算成本。
严格的分析仅限于使用单个DFDM单元的一维均匀标量波动方程。
向三维的外推忽略了数值各向异性，且未显式模拟三维弹性波的相速度/群速度或多套Lebedev网格的开销。

tm.why: The paper conducts a rigorous mathematical and numerical analysis of stability, dispersion, and computational cost of the distributional finite-difference method (DFDM) for solving the scalar wave equation compared against FDM and SEM.
