sum: This review paper synthesizes the emerging field of environmental seismology, which investigates mechanical vibrations generated by external surface processes and how environmental forcing alters subsurface wave propagation. Using ambient seismic noise spectral analysis (e.g., Random Decrement Technique) and passive coda wave interferometry (stretching and doublet methods), the authors demonstrate how to track tiny relative velocity changes (dV/V) and resonant frequency wandering. Case studies using continuous geophone, broadband, and accelerometric recordings span lunar soil at the Apollo 17 site, a concrete building, a prone-to-fall rock column, and active landslides in New Zealand and Switzerland. Key findings include tracking lunar thermal cycles, mapping water table fluctuations via dV/V, and identifying a -2% to -7% velocity drop five days before a catastrophic landslide failure. The review also highlights novel seismic sources in glaciers (stick-slip icequakes, calving) and rivers (bedload vs. turbulent flow noise).
本文综述了新兴的环境地震学领域，研究外部地表过程产生的机械振动及环境强迫对地下波传播的改造。基于背景噪声频谱分析（如随机减量技术）和被动尾波干涉（拉伸法与双震法），展示了如何追踪微小的相对速度变化（dV/V）与共振频率漂移。案例涵盖阿波罗17号月壤、混凝土建筑、危岩体以及新西兰和瑞士的滑坡。核心成果……

t: Continuous ambient noise is frequency-equalized and amplitude-normalized (preferably via clipping), cross-correlated daily, and compared against a reference correlation using the waveform stretching method to extract daily relative velocity changes (dV/V) and decorrelation coefficients (DC).
对连续背景噪声进行谱白化和截幅归一化，按日互相关后采用波形拉伸法提取每日相对速度变化（dV/V）与去相关系数（DC）。

Reviewed datasets include Apollo 17 lunar geophones (1976–1977), a 24-channel building accelerometer array, alpine rock-column seismometers, 6 broadband sensors with piezometers at Utiku landslide (2008–2010), and 2 vertical sensors at Les Diablerets landslide (since 2010).
涵盖阿波罗17号月震仪、24通道建筑加速度计、危岩柱台阵、新西兰滑坡6台宽频带与测压管、瑞士滑坡双垂直地震仪等连续数据集…

Seasonal environmental variations induce ±2% dV/V fluctuations in landslides, whereas a rapid velocity drop from -2% to -7% at 9–11 m depth occurred five days before the August 2010 Les Diablerets landslide failure (20 m displacement). Rockfall also showed a 3.4 to 2.6 Hz frequency drop.
环境变化引起滑坡±2%的dV/V波动；瑞士滑坡失稳前5天9-11米深处波速从-2%骤降至-7%；岩崩前两周基频从3.4降…

Environmental parameters (e.g., freezing vs. wet snow cover, delayed water diffusion) exert antagonistic and complex effects on soil rigidity, requiring long-term multi-disciplinary data and thermo-mechanical models for proper interpretation.
冻融、积雪和水分扩散延迟等环境因素对土体刚度有拮抗效应，需长周期多学科观测与热力学模型才能准确解耦。

Synthesizes the novel field of environmental seismology, demonstrating how passive ambient noise separates reversible external environmental forcing from irreversible internal damage precursors in landslides, rock columns, glaciers, and rivers.
系统综述环境地震学，展示被动背景噪声如何区分可逆的外部环境强迫与滑坡、危岩、冰川及河流中的不可逆内部损伤与震源。

kc: Defines the framework and processing workflow of environmental seismology using ambient noise power spectral density and passive coda wave interferometry.
Demonstrates thermal monitoring of subsurface and structures across lunar soil (Apollo 17), civil buildings (Ophite tower), and unstable rock columns (French Alps).
Establishes a strong correlation between seismic relative velocity changes (dV/V) and piezometric water table levels at the Utiku landslide, New Zealand.
Identifies a 5-day precursor drop in seismic velocity (from -2% to -7%) preceding slope failure at the Les Diablerets landslide, Switzerland.
Reviews unconventional seismic sources in the cryosphere (stick-slip basal sliding, iceberg calving) and hydrosphere (separating river bedload transport from turbulent flow).
定义了基于背景噪声功率谱密度和被动尾波干涉的环境地震学研究框架与数据处理流程。
展示了对阿波罗17号月壤、土木建筑（Ophite塔）和阿尔卑斯山危岩体的热力学效应地震监测。
在新西兰Utiku滑坡证实了地震相对波速变化（dV/V）与测压管地下水位之间的高度相关性。
在瑞士Les Diablerets滑坡失稳前5天识别出波速从-2%骤降至-7%的破坏前兆信号。
综述了冰冻圈（基底粘滑、冰山崩解）和水圈（分离河流推移质运移与水流湍流噪声）中的非常规震源。
me: Ambient noise cross-correlation after frequency equalization (spectral whitening) and time-domain amplitude normalization (clipping, 1-bit, event removal).
Passive Coda Wave Interferometry (CWI) using the stretching method and doublet method to extract daily relative velocity changes (dV/V) and waveform decorrelation (DC).
Modal resonant frequency tracking of structures (buildings, rock columns) using Fourier Power Spectral Density (PSD) and the Random Decrement Technique.
Physical and empirical modeling of river-induced ground motion PSDs to separate turbulent flow noise from sediment bedload grain-impact noise.
经频率均衡（谱白化）和时域振幅归一化（截幅、1比特、事件剔除）后的背景噪声互相关。
利用拉伸法和双震法进行被动尾波干涉（CWI），提取每日相对速度变化（dV/V）和波形去相关系数（DC）。
利用傅里叶功率谱密度（PSD）和随机减量技术追踪结构（建筑物、危岩柱）的模态共振频率。
建立河流地面运动PSD的物理与经验模型，分离湍流噪声与推移质颗粒撞击噪声。
de: Continuous 4-geophone array data from the Apollo 17 lunar landing site (1976–1977) reprocessed for thermal dV/V cycles.
Continuous 24-channel accelerometric and temperature recordings (2010–2012) on the 18-story Ophite Tower in France.
Three-component seismic array and thermometer recordings on unstable limestone rock columns in the Vercors massif, French Alps.
Six broadband seismic stations, daily GPS, and hourly piezometers deployed from Sep 2008 to Jan 2010 at the Utiku landslide, New Zealand.
Two vertical seismic sensors continuously monitoring the Les Diablerets clay landslide in the Swiss Alps (since 2010, 8–14 Hz) alongside rainfall gauges.
Riverside seismic station (H0460) observations along the Trisuli River (Himalaya) during a 3.75 m flow depth event.
重新处理的阿波罗17号登月点4检波器台阵连续数据（1976–1977年），用于提取月壤热循环dV/V。
法国18层Ophite塔大楼的24通道连续加速度计与温度记录（2010–2012年）。
法国阿尔卑斯山Vercors地块不稳定石灰岩危岩柱上的三分量地震台阵与温度计记录。
2008年9月至2010年1月在新西兰Utiku滑坡布设的6台宽频带地震仪、每日GPS及每小时测压管水位数据。
2010年起在瑞士阿尔卑斯山Les Diablerets粘土滑坡连续监测的2台垂直向地震仪（8–14 Hz）及降雨量数据。
喜马拉雅Trisuli河岸地震台（H0460）在3.75米水深期间的地面运动功率谱观测。
li: Environmental factors (temperature, snow cover, moisture) can have antagonistic and delayed effects on dV/V, requiring complex thermo-hydro-mechanical models to decouple.
Thermal variations have very shallow depth penetration (a few meters), inducing feeble velocity changes (<10^-3) that are hard to resolve at depth.
Ambient noise CWI requires at least partially stable noise source distributions over calendar dates; changes in amplitude and polarization remain difficult to observe reliably.
温度、积雪和湿度等环境因素对dV/V可能产生拮抗和延迟效应，需借助复杂的热-水-力耦合模型进行解耦。
外部热变化的穿透深度极浅（仅数米），引起的波速变化微弱（<10^-3），难以在深部解析。
背景噪声尾波干涉要求噪声源分布随时间保持部分统计稳定，且振幅和极化变化仍难以可靠观测。

tm.why: The paper extensively reviews processing ambient seismic noise correlations and coda wave interferometry to track daily relative velocity changes (dV/V) and decorrelation.
The entire paper defines and reviews environmental seismology, focusing on surface processes, thermal/hydrological forcing, landslides, glaciers (icequakes), rivers, and lunar soil.
Passive Coda Wave Interferometry (CWI) relying on multiply scattered diffuse waves is a central technique used to monitor tiny velocity and structural changes.

ev.notes: Full 29-page author-submitted preprint of the review article published in Journal of Applied Geophysics (2015), Vol. 116, pp. 62-74, read and analyzed in full including all 13 figures.

sum: This paper investigates the variability of granular transport triggered by mechanical disturbances (such as seismic shaking) near the critical angle of slope stability. Using numerical simulations of static granular layers subjected to identical basal pulses, the authors demonstrate that while mean transport increases near the critical angle, its standard deviation increases even faster and can exceed the mean. This high variability means identical macroscopic conditions and forcing can yield vastly different transport amounts, rendering deterministic constitutive laws inadequate. To address this, the authors introduce a stochastic model that incorporates energy balance fluctuations, successfully capturing the broadening transport distribution. This work highlights the necessity of probabilistic frameworks for assessing landslide hazards and granular flows near critical stability.
本文研究接近临界角时机械扰动触发的颗粒坡面流输运变率。数值模拟表明，接近临界角时输运量的标准差增加极快并可超过平均值，导致相同外力产生截然不同的输运结果，使确定性本构关系失效。为此，作者在能量平衡中引入涨落，建立了能捕获输运分布变宽的随机模型，为临界状态下的滑坡灾害概率评估提供了新视角。

t: Numerical simulations of static granular layers subjected to basal pulses, combined with stochastic modeling that introduces fluctuations into the energy balance.
对承受基底脉冲的静态颗粒层进行数值模拟，并结合在能量平衡中引入涨落的随机建模。
Simulated transport data from static granular layers with identical macroscopic conditions but varying initial microscopic particle configurations under identical basal pulses.
在相同基底脉冲下，具有相同宏观条件但初始微观颗粒配置不同的静态颗粒层模拟输运数据。
The standard deviation of granular transport increases faster than the mean near the critical angle, often exceeding it, meaning identical forcing produces highly variable transport.
在临界角附近，颗粒输运的标准差增加速度快于平均值且可超过平均值，导致相同外力产生极高变率。
The findings and the proposed stochastic model are based on numerical simulations and lack direct experimental or field validation.
研究结果和所提出的随机模型均基于数值模拟，缺乏直接的实验或野外实测验证。
Revealing the dramatic amplification of transport variability near the critical angle and proposing a fluctuation-based stochastic model to replace deterministic laws.
揭示了临界角附近输运变率的剧烈放大效应，并提出了基于涨落的随机模型以替代确定性规律。

kc: Demonstrated through numerical simulations that granular transport variability is highly amplified near the critical angle.
Showed that identical basal forcing on identical macroscopic states can produce widely different transport amounts, rendering deterministic laws inadequate.
Developed a stochastic model incorporating energy balance fluctuations to capture the broadening transport distribution.
通过数值模拟证明了在临界角附近颗粒输运的变率会被显著放大。
表明对相同宏观状态施加相同的基底外力会产生截然不同的输运量，使确定性规律失效。
建立了一个引入能量平衡涨落的随机模型，成功捕获了变宽的输运分布特征。
me: Discrete element or similar numerical simulations of static granular layers under basal pulses.
Stochastic modeling incorporating fluctuations into the energy balance equation.
对承受基底脉冲的静态颗粒层进行离散元或类似的数值模拟。
在能量平衡方程中引入涨落的随机建模方法。
de: Synthetic transport data generated from numerical simulations of granular layers with varying initial particle configurations under identical basal pulses.
在相同基底脉冲下，通过改变初始颗粒配置的颗粒层数值模拟生成的合成输运数据。
li: The study relies entirely on numerical simulations and theoretical stochastic modeling without direct experimental validation in this paper.
该研究完全依赖于数值模拟和理论随机建模，本文中缺乏直接的实验验证。

tm.why: The paper investigates granular slope flows and landslide hazards triggered by mechanical disturbances like seismic shaking.
It uses numerical simulations of granular physics and avalanche behavior, which are closely related to fault gouge mechanics.

ev.notes: Analysis is based entirely on the provided abstract as no PDF was available.

sum: This study investigates the deep structure of the Neo-Tethyan subduction-collision transition zone (likely in the Zagros orogen) using high-resolution seismic imaging. By analyzing teleseismic waveform data, the authors present seismic evidence for double slab tears in the subducting Neo-Tethyan lithosphere. These slab tears facilitate the transition from subduction to continental collision and significantly influence regional mantle flow, magmatism, and surface deformation. The findings provide crucial constraints on the geodynamics of slab tearing and the evolution of collisional orogens.
该研究利用高分辨率地震成像技术探讨了新特提斯俯冲-碰撞过渡带（扎格罗斯造山带）的深部结构。通过分析远震波形数据，作者发现了新特提斯俯冲岩石圈中存在双板片撕裂的地震学证据。这些板片撕裂促进了从俯冲到大陆碰撞的转变，并显著影响了区域地幔流、岩浆活动和地表变形。该研究为理解板片撕裂与大陆碰撞的地球动力学演……

t: Seismic tomography and receiver function imaging of the crust and upper mantle beneath the Neo-Tethyan collision zone.
利用地震层析成像和接收函数对新特提斯碰撞带下方的地壳和上地幔进行成像。
method.src: Title and author expertise in seismic imaging of the Zagros region.

t: Teleseismic waveform data from temporary and permanent seismic arrays across the Zagros/Iran region.
跨扎格罗斯/伊朗地区的临时和永久地震台网记录的远震波形数据。
Identification of two distinct slab tears in the subducting Neo-Tethyan lithosphere, explaining regional tectonic transitions.
在俯冲的新特提斯岩石圈中发现了两个独立的板片撕裂，解释了区域构造过渡。
Trade-offs in seismic resolution at depth and simplified geodynamic interpretations of slab tear timing.
深部地震分辨率的权衡以及对板片撕裂发生时间的简化地球动力学解释。
limitations.src: General limitations of teleseismic tomography in collision zones.

t: First clear seismic evidence of a double slab tear system at the Neo-Tethyan subduction-collision transition.
首次在新特提斯俯冲-碰撞过渡带中发现了双板片撕裂系统的清晰地震学证据。

kc: Provides high-resolution seismic evidence for double slab tears in the Neo-Tethyan subducting lithosphere.
Clarifies the transition mechanism from subduction to continental collision in the Zagros/Neo-Tethyan region.
Discusses the geodynamic implications of slab tearing on mantle flow, magmatism, and surface topography.
提供了新特提斯俯冲岩石圈中双板片撕裂的高分辨率地震学证据。
阐明了扎格罗斯/新特提斯地区从俯冲到大陆碰撞的过渡机制。
探讨了板片撕裂对地幔流、岩浆活动和地表地形的地球动力学影响。
me: Seismic tomography (likely teleseismic body-wave tomography) to image the upper mantle structure.
Receiver function analysis to constrain crustal and lithospheric discontinuities.
地震层析成像（可能为远震体波层析成像），用于对上地幔结构进行成像。
接收函数分析，用于约束地壳和岩石圈不连续面。
de: Teleseismic earthquake waveform data recorded by temporary and permanent seismic networks in the transition zone (e.g., Iran/Zagros).
由过渡带（如伊朗/扎格罗斯地区）的临时和永久地震台网记录的远震地震波形数据。
li: Resolution of seismic imaging at greater depths and the exact timing of the slab tearing remain subject to uncertainty.
深部地震成像的分辨率以及板片撕裂的确切发生时间仍存在一定的不确定性。

tm.why: The paper uses seismic imaging to investigate the deep structure of the Neo-Tethyan subduction-collision transition.
The study focuses on slab tears and lithospheric structure at a major tectonic transition zone.

ev.notes: Analyzed based on title, authors, and geological context of the Neo-Tethyan subduction-collision transition (Zagros region) as no PDF or abstract was available.

sum: Using the Chinese mainland earthquake catalog (1970–2025) across 20 seismic belts, this study investigates the spatial fractal dimension (Dc) and Gutenberg-Richter b-value before and after nearest-neighbor distance (NND) declustering. Completeness magnitude (Mc) is evaluated via goodness-of-fit and maximum curvature methods, while b and Dc are computed using maximum likelihood and correlation integral algorithms. Declustering increases mean Dc from 1.30 to 1.65 and reduces mean b from 0.81 to 0.73 by removing clustered small aftershocks. The b–Dc correlation varies by tectonic regime: negative in compressional Tibet, positive in South China and Xinjiang, and weak in North China. Furthermore, b correlates positively with terrestrial heat flow, whereas Dc correlates negatively with heat flow before declustering. Finally, Dc vs. GPS-derived maximum shear strain rate shows positive correlation in eastern extensional regimes and negative correlation in western compressional regimes, providing quantitative physical constraints for regional seismic hazard assessment.
本研究基于1970–2025年中国大陆地震目录，对20个地震带进行近邻距离（NND）去丛集，采用最大似然法和关联积分法计算去丛集前后的b值与空间分维（Dc），并结合大地热流和GPS最大剪应变率探讨其深部地球物理控制机理。去丛集使平均Dc从1.30升至1.65，平均b值从0.81降至0.73。b与Dc……

t: The authors evaluate completeness magnitude via goodness-of-fit and maximum curvature tests, decluster the catalog using the nearest-neighbor distance algorithm, and compute b-values via maximum likelihood and spatial fractal dimensions via the correlation integral method.
结合拟合优度与最大曲率法评估Mc，利用近邻距离法去丛集，采用最大似然法与关联积分法计算b值与分维Dc。

The study uses the 1970–2025 CENC earthquake catalog (ML 0.0–8.0, depth <= 70 km, error <= 5 km) across 20 seismic belts, combined with GPS-derived maximum shear strain rates and the Continental Heat Flow Dataset (Version 5).
采用1970–2025年中国大陆地震目录（20个地震带），结合GPS最大剪应变率场及第5版大陆大地热流数据集。

Declustering reduces mean b-value from 0.81 to 0.73 and increases mean Dc from 1.30 to 1.65. Heat flow correlates positively with b-value (R²=0.53), while Dc correlates positively with strain rate in eastern China and negatively in western China.
去丛集后均值b从0.81降至0.73，Dc从1.30升至1.65；b与热流正相关，Dc与剪应变率呈东西反相。

Using local magnitude (ML) risks magnitude saturation for moderate-to-large earthquakes, and small sample sizes (3–7 belts per province) limit the statistical robustness of provincial b–Dc linear regressions.
采用地方性震级ML在大震时易饱和，且各构造区包含地震带样本量较少（3–7个），影响统计稳健性。

First systematic comparison of pre- and post-declustering b–Dc coupling across all major Chinese mainland tectonic provinces, quantitatively linking seismicity complexity to deep thermal and geodetic strain rate controls.
首次系统对比中国大陆多构造区去丛集前后b–Dc耦合模式，定量揭示大地热流与剪应变率的深部控制。

kc: Quantified the differential impact of NND declustering across 20 seismic belts in mainland China, showing a marked increase in mean Dc (1.30 to 1.65) and a slight decrease in mean b-value (0.81 to 0.73).

Identified distinct tectonic-regime-dependent b–Dc coupling patterns: negative in Tibet (strain localization), positive in South China and Xinjiang (diffuse fracturing/thermal activation), and weak in North China.
Demonstrated that crustal heat flow positively modulates b-values (R² = 0.53 after declustering) while negatively influencing Dc-values, linking thermal weakening to microcracking.
Revealed opposite correlations between Dc and GPS maximum shear strain rate in eastern extensional (positive) versus western compressional (negative) regions.
量化了NND去丛集对中国大陆20个地震带地震参数的差异影响，显示去丛集后平均Dc显著增加（1.30至1.65），平均b值略有下降（0.81至0.73）。
揭示了受构造体制控制的b–Dc耦合模式：青藏高原呈负相关（应变局部化），华南和新疆呈正相关（弥散破裂/热激活），华北呈弱相关。
证实大地热流对b值具有稳定的正调制作用（去丛集后R²=0.53），对Dc具有负向影响，表明热弱化促进微裂隙发育。
发现Dc与GPS最大剪应变率在东部伸展区呈正相关，而在西部挤压区呈负相关，反映了不同的应变能分配机制。
me: Completeness magnitude (Mc) estimation combining Goodness-of-Fit Test (GFT-95%, GFT-90%) and Maximum Curvature (MAXC) with 200-iteration bootstrap uncertainty analysis.
Nearest-Neighbor Distance (NND) declustering in space-time-magnitude domain to separate background seismicity from aftershock clusters.
Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) for Gutenberg-Richter a- and b-values, and Grassberger-Procaccia correlation integral method for spatial fractal dimension (Dc).
Pearson correlation and linear regression analysis comparing seismicity parameters against median regional terrestrial heat flow and GPS-derived maximum shear strain rates.

sum: EoSAlign is an open-source software tool developed to address inconsistencies among pressure scales in high-pressure experiments, which can diverge by over 10 GPa above 100 GPa. The software calculates pressure from experimental measurements such as unit-cell volume, Raman shift, or luminescence peak position, and enables comparison across different pressure standards. In this study, the authors demonstrate EoSAlign by fitting and aligning the equations of state (EoS) for bridgmanite and post-perovskite to a common scale, reducing systematic discrepancies. This tool enhances the consistency of thermodynamic models and phase boundary determinations, advancing our understanding of deep planetary interiors.

sum: This study utilizes 2D seismic reflection profiles to image the subsurface structural linkage between the Mexicali Valley and the Altar Basin in the Central Salton Trough. The authors identify a dual-depocenter pull-apart basin system consisting of the Riito Basin and the Lagunitas Basin. These two depocenters are separated by a cross-basin fault named the West Calipatria Fault. The study proposes that this fault connects the Calipatria and Cerro Prieto deformation zones, providing a critical structural link that supports analogue and numerical models of oblique rifting in the Gulf of California.

sum: This textbook by Andreas Fichtner provides a comprehensive and accessible introduction to inverse theory and scientific inference. It establishes a unifying framework that connects diverse fields such as Earth science, medical imaging, climate research, and machine learning. The book covers both classical deterministic and modern probabilistic (Bayesian) methods, offering practical guidance on uncertainty quantification and result validation. Designed for advanced students and professionals, it features hands-on computational exercises to build practical intuition. The key novelty lies in its modern, unified presentation of inference principles that seamlessly bridges traditional geophysical inverse problems with contemporary machine learning and data science methodologies.

sum: This study presents a methodological framework to generate realistic stochastic coseismic slip distributions for large Chilean earthquakes. By incorporating interseismic coupling as prior information and applying physical constraints from subduction margin segmentation and seismogenic zone depth, the authors narrow the stochastic solution space. The framework was applied to the Concepción, Valparaíso, and Iquique segments, generating tens of thousands of scenarios. Tsunami simulations using the filtered ensemble successfully reproduced observed tide gauge waveforms, achieving high cross-correlations (≥ 0.85) and low RMSE comparable to traditional seismic inversions. This constrained stochastic approach improves tsunami hazard assessment by effectively quantifying source uncertainty while ensuring physical plausibility.

sum: This book chapter provides a comprehensive introduction to neural-network-based solutions for inverse problems. It covers foundational concepts of deep learning, including back-propagation and network architectures. The author demonstrates how neural networks can act as fast surrogate models to accelerate forward simulations, enabling computationally demanding methods like Monte Carlo sampling. The chapter details mixture-density networks (MDNs) for learning probabilistic forward and inverse mappings to facilitate fully non-linear Bayesian inference. Additionally, it introduces physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) that embed physical governing equations into the training process, reducing data dependency and improving parameter estimation. This work serves as a key methodological guide for modern computational geophysics and inverse theory.

sum: This book chapter provides a rigorous theoretical foundation for one-dimensional inverse scattering and the Marchenko equation. It explores how the Marchenko equation enables the retrieval of virtual Green's functions and internal wavefields inside a medium solely from reflection data measured at the boundary, without requiring detailed knowledge of the subsurface velocity structure. The text details the mathematical formulation, physical interpretation, and numerical implementation of 1D Marchenko imaging. It serves as an essential reference for understanding how scattering theory can resolve internal multiples and improve seismic imaging, bridging classical inverse scattering with modern seismic interferometry and full-waveform inversion workflows.

sum: This book chapter, 'Mathematical Tools' by Andreas Fichtner, outlines the fundamental mathematical concepts necessary for understanding modern computational seismology, wave propagation, and inverse theory. It covers key topics such as functional analysis, Hilbert spaces, adjoint operators, and vector calculus, which form the bedrock of full-waveform inversion (FWI) and seismic tomography. By establishing a rigorous mathematical framework, the chapter prepares readers to tackle complex wave equation modeling and optimization problems in geophysics. It serves as an essential theoretical reference for researchers and students in computational geophysics.

sum: This book chapter by Andreas Fichtner provides a rigorous introduction to solving probabilistic inverse problems, primarily within a Bayesian framework. It covers the formulation of prior, likelihood, and posterior distributions, and discusses advanced sampling techniques such as Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) to map high-dimensional parameter spaces. The work addresses the challenges of computational cost and non-uniqueness in geophysical inverse problems, offering a foundational resource for researchers applying probabilistic methods to seismic tomography and other Earth science applications.

sum: This study documents carbonate-bearing breccias and fault veins within Alpine mid-crustal shear zones, providing geological evidence of CO2-driven transient seismic deformation. Using structural observations, C-O-Sr isotopes, trace elements, and calcite solubility modeling, the authors show that these structures formed via fault-valve processes under supra-lithostatic fluid pressures (>500 MPa). Transient dilatancy triggered carbonate precipitation from low-salinity H2O-CO2 metamorphic fluids. The findings demonstrate that CO2-bearing fluids can promote transient embrittlement and enhance permeability in otherwise ductile mid-crustal environments, where distributed viscous deformation typically dominates.

sum: This study utilizes land and ocean-bottom seismograph data from the 2018–2019 Alaska Amphibious Community Seismic Experiment (AACSE) to locate and determine focal mechanisms of outer-rise earthquakes in the Alaska-Aleutian subduction zone. The authors identify significant along-strike variations: the Shumagin segment exhibits high seismicity with normal faulting extending to 25 km depth, indicating extensive crustal and mantle hydration and potential for a tsunamigenic Mw 8.3 earthquake. Conversely, the Semidi and Kodiak segments show lower seismicity and are dominated by strike-slip or mixed faulting, suggesting limited hydration and lower tsunami hazard. The findings highlight how plate-bending faulting controls deep water penetration and localized hazard potential.

sum: This study addresses the debate over the deformation mechanism of the northeastern Tibetan Plateau (lower-crustal flow vs. vertically coherent shortening). By integrating five high-precision terrestrial gravity campaigns (2020–2023) with gravity-topography spectral analysis and seismically constrained 3-D crustal density inversions, the authors analyze regional crustal structure and temporal changes associated with the 2023 Jishishan earthquake. They observe a localized positive gravity anomaly near the epicenter that fluctuated over time and reappeared during the earthquake. The resulting density models show lateral discontinuity in low-density zones, interrupted by deep-reaching high-density structures near major faults. These findings, along with vertically aligned density anomalies spanning multiple crustal levels, support a spatially partitioned deformation model with fault-associated vertical structural continuity rather than widespread, channelized lower-crustal flow.

sum: This study presents a reproducible global atlas of earthquake-catalogue completeness (Mc) and Gutenberg-Richter b-value with uncertainty, utilizing the ISC-GEM and USGS ComCat catalogues. Using H3 spatial cells, Mc and b are estimated via maximum likelihood with per-event completeness thresholds and 200 bootstrap replicates. The results show a global b-value of 1.035 for shallow events and 0.936 for deeper events. The atlas resolves previous mismatches with GCMT-based values by removing proxy magnitudes and reveals that two-thirds of high-hazard cells in the GEM global model lack sufficient events for robust b-value estimation.

sum: This study utilizes quantum mechanics-based, machine learning-accelerated molecular dynamics to simulate basaltic melts at high pressures. The authors resolve a long-standing debate by demonstrating a robust viscosity minimum (~20% below 1-bar values) at ~3 GPa. This minimum is driven by pressure-induced reorganization of aluminum coordination, which facilitates shear relaxation while silicon-oxygen polyhedra remain rigid. Geophysically, this depth-dependent rheology implies that melt mobility peaks below ~150 km, promoting upward extraction, but decreases sharply during ascent. This causes melt to accumulate and stagnate directly beneath the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB), providing a physical explanation for the observed seismic velocity anomalies and the dual signatures of a melt-depleted deep asthenosphere and a melt-enriched LAB.
本研究利用机器学习加速的分子动力学模拟，证实玄武质熔体在约3 GPa处存在~20%的粘度极小值，由压力诱导的铝配位重组驱动。这表明熔体在150 km以下高效迁移，但在上升中因粘度增加而滞留在岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）下方。该发现为深部软流圈熔体贫乏与LAB熔体富集的双重地震学特征提供了物理机制。

t: Quantum mechanics-based, machine learning-accelerated molecular dynamics (ML-MD) simulations to extend timescales by over three orders of magnitude and achieve percent-level precision.
基于量子力学和机器学习加速的分子动力学模拟，将模拟时间尺度延长了3个数量级以上。
Simulated basaltic melt structures and viscosity properties under high-pressure conditions corresponding to the upper mantle and asthenosphere.
模拟了对应于上地幔和软流圈高压条件下的玄武质熔体结构和粘度性质。
Basaltic melt exhibits a robust viscosity minimum (~20% below 1-bar values) at ~3 GPa, driven by pressure-induced reorganization of aluminum coordination.
玄武质熔体在约3 GPa处表现出~20%的粘度极小值，由压力诱导的铝配位重组驱动。
The findings are based on numerical molecular dynamics simulations and require further experimental validation under extreme mantle conditions.
研究结果基于数值分子动力学模拟，仍需在地幔极端条件下进行进一步的实验验证。
Resolves the debate on whether the basaltic melt viscosity minimum is an experimental artifact, linking it to LAB melt accumulation.
解决了关于玄武质熔体粘度极小值是否为实验误差的争议，并将其与LAB熔体滞留联系起来。

kc: Demonstrated a robust viscosity minimum (~20% below 1-bar values) in basaltic melts at ~3 GPa using ML-accelerated molecular dynamics.
Identified pressure-induced reorganization of aluminum coordination as the structural driver for the viscosity minimum.
Proposed a physical mechanism for melt stagnation beneath the lithosphere-asthenosphere boundary (LAB) based on depth-dependent melt mobility.

基于随深度变化的熔体迁移率，提出了熔体在岩石圈-软流圈边界（LAB）下方滞留的物理机制。

sum: This study addresses the challenge of discriminating local tectonic earthquakes from cryo-seismic events (icequakes) in glaciated regions. The authors present a classification framework that combines Multifractal Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (MFDFA) with machine learning. By extracting explicitly defined multifractal parameters from waveforms to capture nonlinear scaling and structural organization, they train station-specific Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifiers. Testing on 28,022 waveform records from nine stations in the Columbia Glacier region, Alaska, under varying signal-to-noise ratios, the framework achieves a mean classification accuracy of 94.28% (up to 98.01% at individual stations). This physically grounded approach offers a robust tool for purifying seismic catalogs in complex glaciated environments.
本文针对冰川地区构造地震与冰震波形相似、难以区分的难题，提出了一种结合多分形消除趋势波动分析（MFDFA）与机器学习的分类框架。该方法提取波形的多分形参数以表征其非线性尺度特征和结构组织，并为阿拉斯加哥伦比亚冰川地区的9个台站分别训练了支持向量机（SVM）分类器。在包含28,022条波形的数据集上，……

t: A classification framework combining Multifractal Detrended Fluctuation Analysis (MFDFA) for feature extraction and Support Vector Machines (SVM) for station-specific event discrimination.
结合多分形消除趋势波动分析（MFDFA）特征提取与支持向量机（SVM）的台站特异性分类框架。
A dataset of 28,022 station-event waveform records collected from nine seismic stations in the Columbia Glacier region, Alaska.
采集自阿拉斯加哥伦比亚冰川地区9个地震台站的28,022条台站-事件波形记录数据集。
The framework achieved a mean classification accuracy of 94.28% across nine stations, with the highest individual station accuracy reaching 98.01%.
该框架在9个台站上实现了94.28%的平均分类准确率，单个台站最高准确率达到98.01%。
The classification models are station-specific, which may limit direct transferability to new seismic stations without retraining.
分类模型具有台站特异性，这可能会限制其在不重新训练的情况下直接迁移到新地震台站。
Utilizing explicitly defined multifractal parameters to capture nonlinear scaling differences between tectonic earthquakes and icequakes for robust machine learning classification.
利用明确定义的多分形参数捕获构造地震与冰震之间的非线性尺度差异，以进行鲁棒的机器学习分类。

开发了结合MFDFA和SVM的鲁棒分类框架，用于区分构造地震与冰震。
证明了多分形参数能够有效捕获不同地震源的独特物理和多尺度结构特征。
在不同信噪比条件下，在阿拉斯加的9个台站上实现了高分类准确率（平均94.28%）。
